char_164_nightm_CN_009.voiceText: Doctor, don't you get tired of it, from time to time? Your work,life, feelings, everything... What would you say to just forgetting all of it, all at once? With my power, things like that can be arranged...

char_164_nightm_CN_010.voiceText: Your sleeping face is so cute, it makes me want to...

char_164_nightm_CN_011.voiceText: I'm Nightmare... Ah, that's a code name. My real name is Gloria. But, if you don't mind, I'd rather you call me that... I think my code name... is kind of scary...

char_164_nightm_CN_012.voiceText: You're making me stronger... but why...?

char_164_nightm_CN_013.voiceText: I came here as a patient, to get treatment for my disease. But now, I'm given to understand that that doctor wants me to fight for you, doesn't she?

char_164_nightm_CN_014.voiceText: Don't you think I'm only barely qualified for this promotion? Not that it matters—go ahead and call your shots. At this point, I'm just lucky to even be alive.

char_164_nightm_CN_019.voiceText: What sorts of incredible powers will you show me? I can't wait to see.

char_164_nightm_CN_020.voiceText: So these are our enemies? Well, well, you look like fun.

char_164_nightm_CN_021.voiceText: Um, is there anything to eat?

char_164_nightm_CN_022.voiceText: Say, why don't you let me take you on?

char_164_nightm_CN_024.voiceText: Ah, the battlefield. How I missed you.

char_164_nightm_CN_028.voiceText: You'll run if—if you know what's good for you.

char_164_nightm_CN_030.voiceText: Well, sorry, but this is the end I prepared for you.

char_164_nightm_CN_031.voiceText: We won. What more could you ask for?

char_164_nightm_CN_033.voiceText: I'll be fine in the corner...

char_164_nightm_CN_036.voiceText: D-did I do something bad again...? J-Just, please let me apologize. I'm so, sooo sorry...

char_220_grani_CN_001.voiceText: Reporting in, Doctor! Patrol completed. Nothing out of the ordinary!

char_220_grani_CN_002.voiceText: I'm starving. That battle really took a lot out of me... You say you've got something to eat? Just for me? Whoa... It's… it's an apple pie! Thanks a lot! It looks great!

char_220_grani_CN_003.voiceText: Everybody here at Rhodes Island calls me 'Tiny,' but it really doesn't bother me. The boys back on the force always teased me the same way. Hey! Don't pat my head! Or rub my ears! Or squeeze my cheek for that matter!

char_220_grani_CN_004.voiceText: Doctor, I might not make it to training on Wednesdays or Fridays... Right, I need to be out there helping the civil corps to keep the peace and catch the bad guys! Wh-waht? I have an important mission on Friday?!

char_220_grani_CN_005.voiceText: Rhodes Island has lots of strong Operators, but there's no one who can match my speed!

char_220_grani_CN_006.voiceText: Time flies, Dcotor. We've been working together so long. I will never forget anything we've been through. But we can't stop now! We have to keep striving for that bright future, don't we?

char_220_grani_CN_007.voiceText: I just bumped into Skadi in the hallway... Doctor, you think she's cold and distant, don't you? She's actually very kind. Really!

char_220_grani_CN_008.voiceText: Compared to everyone else, I'm pretty ordinary. I don't have any superpowers, or spectacular achievements to brag about... But I don't need magic or claws to make the world a better place. I can do that with my own two hands! But before that, we still have to eat well.

char_220_grani_CN_009.voiceText: Doctor, you always worry so much about your people, but you never remember to take care of yourself. You can't do that! No matter what dangers you may face, I promise I'll be there to hold your hand! Definitely, you have my word!

char_220_grani_CN_010.voiceText: Hmm? Why do you smell so good, Doctor? You're definitely hiding something tasty, aren't you?!

char_220_grani_CN_011.voiceText: Mounted Police Officer Grani, here to answer your call for help! Fear not. From this point forward, I will protect you!

char_220_grani_CN_012.voiceText: I see. That's another thing I should watch out for. Got it!

char_220_grani_CN_013.voiceText: An elite promotion medal? For me? Thank you, Doctor! I'll hang it up with my police medal!

char_220_grani_CN_014.voiceText: Since the day of my first mission, I've been leaning on this lance to get back on my feet. As long as I grip it tight, my heart will brim with the courage it needs to protect the people and their dreams.

char_220_grani_CN_017.voiceText: Shall I go scout the battlefield?

char_220_grani_CN_018.voiceText: You're making me the captain? Okay. I'll protect the whole squad!

char_220_grani_CN_019.voiceText: All right, let's bring home a victory!

char_220_grani_CN_025.voiceText: My lance will clear a path!

char_220_grani_CN_027.voiceText: Only one comes out on top when the lances are crossed!

char_220_grani_CN_028.voiceText: My battlefield extends well above the ground!

char_220_grani_CN_029.voiceText: If you look to harm those under my protection, you'll have to go through me first!

char_220_grani_CN_030.voiceText: Nice! That was an excellent fight! You all did splendidly!

char_220_grani_CN_031.voiceText: Doctor, please stay close to me. There may still be some enemies around.

char_220_grani_CN_032.voiceText: Damn it... I can't let myself fall here!

char_220_grani_CN_036.voiceText: If we get the chance, I hope we can see the world together, Doctor.

char_263_skadi_CN_001.voiceText: I advise you to keep at least two meters away from me, for your own good. And of course you shouldn't speak to me either... I don't want you to be the next victim of what's after me.

char_263_skadi_CN_002.voiceText: You've read my file? Terrible, isn't it? If I'm allowed to stay by your side, the same misfortune will befall you, and that's trouble for me too.

char_263_skadi_CN_003.voiceText: My long hair looks good? Oh… Well, thank you. Would you like to feel it? It should have a soft touch. I'm confident of that.

char_263_skadi_CN_004.voiceText: Could that be...? The one over there, you guys call her Specter now, right? Why is she dressed as a nun? Amnesia? That's a problem… Dr. {@nickname}, you have to help her. She can't be allowed to forget her true function.

char_263_skadi_CN_005.voiceText: You just don't know when to give up, do you? I suppose I have no choice but to defend you with all my might.

char_263_skadi_CN_006.voiceText: Down beneath the vast blue sea, below the white waves that lap endlessly at the earth, lies all that I once held dear. I fear that one day misfortune will once again take away someone important from me. That is why I fled. I don't want anyone I care about... to suffer on my account.

char_263_skadi_CN_007.voiceText: Good, another easy day. No giant tentacles coiling up my teammates, no fanatics lurking in the shadows with their hands coated in blood... Yes, just some straight fights on the battlefield. An easy day for me.

char_263_skadi_CN_008.voiceText: According to legend, my people have fought against those calamities for aeons. Perhaps we kept them from making landfall and terrorizing you city folk as well... So, how about buying me a drink, as a thank you?

char_263_skadi_CN_009.voiceText: When you've finally made the long journey through the dark up to the water's surface—your eyes dazzled by the sparkling stars all over the sky, your cheek soothed by the cradling waves, your tears seep into your mouth. They have the same salty taste of your home—compared to all that, the bathtub at Rhodes Island is so tiny and puny... I'll have to show you my home someday.

char_263_skadi_CN_010.voiceText: Dr. {@nickname}, you fell asleep…? Rest well then, and may you never see your dream eroded by sea waves.

char_263_skadi_CN_011.voiceText: I am Skadi, a bounty hunter. Are you really hiring me? I cannot say what calamities I may bring with me.

char_263_skadi_CN_012.voiceText: So this is how you fight. Rush in with a 'woosh,' knock them down with a 'pow,' and finish them with a 'thud.' Very good. I'll keep it in mind.

char_263_skadi_CN_013.voiceText: So this is the promotion you Rhodes Island folks are always going on about? Not bad. Feels like I've become stronger. Just by a bit, maybe.

char_263_skadi_CN_014.voiceText: Your thirst for my power really troubles me... But if nothing can really stop you, then brace yourself, for the infinite darkness we will stand against together.

char_263_skadi_CN_017.voiceText: I am quite skilled at teamwork, but...

char_263_skadi_CN_018.voiceText: You're placing everyone's life in my hands?

char_263_skadi_CN_019.voiceText: It's hardly a sport when all the enemies are human.

char_263_skadi_CN_020.voiceText: Compared to the calamities I fought against, you are barely a threat.

char_263_skadi_CN_025.voiceText: Who knows what lurks within the kelp forest?

char_263_skadi_CN_026.voiceText: This sword has a terrifying past. Care to find out?

char_263_skadi_CN_027.voiceText: Sing me a song, my torturous nightmare.

char_263_skadi_CN_028.voiceText: Don't blink, for you may miss the misery of your death.

char_263_skadi_CN_030.voiceText: The words and thoughts of our enemies mean nothing to me. All I care about is how to defeat them.

char_263_skadi_CN_031.voiceText: Feeling a little rusty? Hope you won't mind having part of your share taken away.

char_263_skadi_CN_032.voiceText: Such simple misfortunes are only the beginning.

char_263_skadi_CN_033.voiceText: Put me in a room by myself please.

char_263_skadi_CN_036.voiceText: Y-You should watch your distance... I really can't guarantee your safety this close…

char_263_skadi_CN_042.voiceText: Never let down your guard, Doctor.

char_284_spot_CN_001.voiceText: Work's kinda like a trap, and you just fling yourself into it.

char_284_spot_CN_002.voiceText: I don't talk much 'cause I don't want to. Not 'cause I'm looking down on anyone.

char_284_spot_CN_003.voiceText: What did Midnight do this time? Did he finally end up in Medical after hitting on one too many ladies in the hallway? No? Too bad.

char_284_spot_CN_004.voiceText: Got something, Doctor? I could probably lend a hand. But I'd rather not eat up too much of my time. I got a lot of comics to read.

char_284_spot_CN_005.voiceText: I know I speak a little too bluntly sometimes, but I always get my work done. It's not like I got professional pride or anything, I just can't respect somebody who doesn't finish his work.

char_284_spot_CN_007.voiceText: Rhodes Island is a strange place. The people here just say whatever they're thinking, and somebody's always there to help when someone needs it.

char_284_spot_CN_008.voiceText: Reserve Op Team A6 is a real diverse crowd. We have Lady Stinky-face, Miss Lacking-self-confrol, Narcissist Kun, and a little walking time bomb. But still, I do think I can trust them. They work hard, even if they don't show it.

char_284_spot_CN_009.voiceText: I used to live free and easy like everyone else at Rhodes Island, but my family thought I was a freak. This place may be a freakshow, but at least everyone's happy, and that's pretty good.

char_284_spot_CN_010.voiceText: Can I go back to my room now?

char_284_spot_CN_011.voiceText: Hi, I'm Spot from Operation Reserve Team A6. My job is to protect the other troublemakers on my team, I guess.

char_284_spot_CN_012.voiceText: I've seen this battle before. Bad guys got their asses kicked.

char_284_spot_CN_013.voiceText: I'm gonna work twice as hard. I'll bump it up from a 0.1 to a 0.2, I think.

char_284_spot_CN_017.voiceText: I won't ask about the meaning of this mission then.

char_284_spot_CN_018.voiceText: I wanna get back to my dorm.

char_284_spot_CN_020.voiceText: Save us a lot of time if you just surrender.

char_284_spot_CN_026.voiceText: Don't see any harm in this.

char_284_spot_CN_028.voiceText: Holding this shield is tiring, pal.

char_284_spot_CN_029.voiceText: Been through an easy battle, you say? Then better do it all over again.

char_284_spot_CN_030.voiceText: With hard work, even an idiot can get the job done.

char_284_spot_CN_031.voiceText: Perfection is for suckers, you know.

char_284_spot_CN_036.voiceText: If you keep petting me like that, my hair's gonna get tangled.

char_281_popka_CN_001.voiceText: Ummm... Nice to see you again, Doctor. It makes me happy... hehe...

char_281_popka_CN_002.voiceText: Doctor, do you need a break? I made you some tea, and Miss Orchid made cookies. Here, hope you like them… And, umm... Cheer up!

char_281_popka_CN_003.voiceText: Why is everyone in Team A6 always fighting with each other...? If things keep going like this, we can't be a team anymore... Fighting is bad. I must make them understand!

char_281_popka_CN_004.voiceText: The gear on my chainsaw is kinda loose, the one that makes the 'vrrrr' sound ... But I don't remember using it lately. Weird...

char_281_popka_CN_005.voiceText: Doctor, is Team A6 getting along well...? That's really some good news. Peace is the best... As long as they don't fight, nothing will bother me while I stay with you…

char_281_popka_CN_007.voiceText: I don't know why, but I sometimes get these gaps in my memory. Then when I ask my teammates in A6, they just smile and tell me nothing happened at all...

char_281_popka_CN_008.voiceText: Um, Doc-Doctor, did I just pass out...? Um, why is everyone lying on the floor? Miss Catapult? Mr. Midnight? Mr. Spot? Why do you all have bruises on your face? And Miss Orchid too...

char_281_popka_CN_009.voiceText: I'm actually super strong? You say I lost control over my power, when I wanted to stop my friends from fighting each other? That's why I don't remember anything...? Okay, I think I get it! Umm... right, I will put my power to good use!

char_281_popka_CN_010.voiceText: Aaaah! The cup! I didn't control my grip... Errmm... I'm in trouble when the Doctor wakes up...

char_281_popka_CN_011.voiceText: Popukar from Operation Reserve Team A6, reporting in. I'm sorry my teammates are always fighting each other, Doctor… But don't worry, I know what to do.

char_281_popka_CN_012.voiceText: Umm, Doctor, is the girl in the video... me?

char_281_popka_CN_013.voiceText: I'm so happy I don't even know what to say...! Thank you, Doctor...! Thank you so much!

char_281_popka_CN_017.voiceText: My name is Popukar... Nice to meet you...

char_281_popka_CN_018.voiceText: B-But... I really don't know anything about tactics or strategies or anything…

char_281_popka_CN_019.voiceText: Miss Catapult, um, it's time to deploy!

char_281_popka_CN_020.voiceText: Miss Orchid, don't worry... I'll be fine.

char_281_popka_CN_023.voiceText: I want to stop this fight.

char_281_popka_CN_029.voiceText: Mr. Midnight, come back here... Miss Orchid is staring at you…

char_281_popka_CN_030.voiceText: Can everyone have a good peaceful talk, now...?

char_281_popka_CN_031.voiceText: Doctor… Doctor…? Here, I made some tea. You must be tired.

char_281_popka_CN_032.voiceText: **A painful groan** I'm… injured…? It hurts…

char_281_popka_CN_033.voiceText: Please don't leave me here alone...

char_281_popka_CN_042.voiceText: Doctor, are you getting along with everyone today...?

char_308_swire_CN_001.voiceText: Doctor, we can't waste even one single precious minute! One minute could mean a loss of millions on the account with extra casualties on the field! Huh? Coffee? I take it with a sachet of sugar and heavy on the milk foam, thanks!

char_308_swire_CN_002.voiceText: They say Rhodes Island is a criminal organization, full of Infected people dirtying up the corridors. But that couldn't be further from the truth. Rhodes Island's Operators are giving their lives to make things better for everyone, just like the police force of Lungmen!

char_308_swire_CN_003.voiceText: Hear me out, do you think we could redesign the instructors' office? At least add a bit of flavor to it, maybe a handmade rug or some atomistic art whatnot. It's just so bland now. Dobermann might say she doesn't care, but it really kills my enthusiasm...

char_308_swire_CN_004.voiceText: Ahhh, that awful Ch'en isn't here, is she? Back when we were in the L.G.D. together, she shot me this dirty look every time we bumped into each other. It made me wonder if I've done anything bad! I just... kinda want to take over the L.G.D. myself. That couldn't be bad, right?

char_308_swire_CN_005.voiceText: Exercise, study, training, researching my competitors and market shifts... Gotta keep them up!

char_308_swire_CN_006.voiceText: I've been allowed to set aside the family business for a while. But it's clear to me that the future of Lungmen needs both a stable public sector and security apparatus, as well as a healthy business and financial system. In both respects, I'm ready to be of service to Lungmen!

char_308_swire_CN_007.voiceText: Lungmen bureaucracy is complicated, even for us. Keeping the peace, protecting the people, directing traffic, negotiating trade... Agh, it's absolutely backbreaking. But as long as what we do is good for Lungmen, I'll be—hehe—very pleased.

char_308_swire_CN_008.voiceText: Doctor, why is Rhodes Island's training course so short...? Insufficient capital? Unacceptable, I'm requesting an immediate transfer to the business division! It's-it's not as if I like business, but if you need me to do it, I'm... more than capable!

char_308_swire_CN_009.voiceText: You know, Doctor, Lungmen could use someone as talented as you. So, well... If you're not enjoying this line of work, there's plenty of opportunities in the banking and management sectors! I-I can get you a job! Oh? You'd rather we work with Rhodes Island? ...Fine!

char_308_swire_CN_010.voiceText: Uughh... I'm exhausted... Two shifts in a row really does... zzz... zzz...

char_308_swire_CN_011.voiceText: Swire, Senior Superintendent of the L.G.D.. I'll be joining Rhodes Island as a training consultant. Dr. {@nickname}, I'm looking forward to working together with you for the future of Lungmen!

char_308_swire_CN_012.voiceText: Hmm, as far as tactical theory goes, this is a decent application!

char_308_swire_CN_013.voiceText: A promotion? Hmm? But it doesn't do anything for me back in Lungmen, does it? Well, if you insist, I suppose I will accept it!

char_308_swire_CN_014.voiceText: Maybe it's that you want me to improve your relationship with Lungmen. Or, possibly, you truly need my talents. I suppose it could be something else you want, too... I'm not sure exactly what, and I can't promise it'll be on offer. But I'll be a stalwart with you to the end.

char_308_swire_CN_017.voiceText: Aha~! You finally need my wisdom!

char_308_swire_CN_018.voiceText: Everyone, follow my orders to the letter!

char_308_swire_CN_019.voiceText: Wipe them out in one fell swoop! It's cheaper that way!

char_308_swire_CN_020.voiceText: Let's finish this quickly. My time is far too precious!

char_308_swire_CN_022.voiceText: I've seen through the enemy's strategies!

char_308_swire_CN_023.voiceText: This is far from my only battlefield!

char_308_swire_CN_024.voiceText: Business competitor or not, you will get a lesson from me!

char_308_swire_CN_029.voiceText: Fantastic! In battle as in business: high risk, high return!

char_308_swire_CN_030.voiceText: Capital is all mergers and acquisitions! Victory is like investigation and arrest!

char_308_swire_CN_031.voiceText: ...Bad... just bad... You can do better, can't you? We'll work it out together. Don't give up!

char_308_swire_CN_032.voiceText: How could this have happened? How could I... How could I have blundered so badly?!

char_308_swire_CN_033.voiceText: Not bad... No, I think this room could use some more renovation!

char_308_swire_CN_036.voiceText: How... How about we go for dinner together? M-my treat!

char_253_greyy_CN_001.voiceText: Hi, Doctor. If you need anything, please tell me...  Um, I assume you still remember my code name...?

char_253_greyy_CN_002.voiceText: Doc-Doctor, hi... Um, I just checked the Medical Department's power grid, and taking some files around while I'm at it... No, nobody's forcing me! I mean, they take such good care of me, it's the least I can do for them...

char_253_greyy_CN_003.voiceText: I decided to learn electric Arts just so my friends back in the slums could have some light, just so the nights would be a little less miserable... That pitch black, it's really scary. And the kinds of people who live in the dark, they can be scary too...

char_253_greyy_CN_004.voiceText: These Originium generators here at Rhodes Island are amazing... You know, if we had anything like them back home, we wouldn't need to live in the dark all the time, like life without light is normal.

char_253_greyy_CN_005.voiceText: My mother taught me the basics of Arts. She told me I use Arts just like she did when she was younger, but I'm also as sickly as she was... If she were still alive, I'd hope she could come with me to Rhodes Island...

char_253_greyy_CN_006.voiceText: Doctor, before I got the training from you, all I could do with my Arts was light up one little room. But now that little spark has turned into something that can help lots of people...! Thank you so much!

char_253_greyy_CN_007.voiceText: Huh? A current anomaly in Miss Mayer's storeroom? W-why is it her again... What? Dr. Kal'tsit wants more cables for her lab? And another outage in Ifrit's room? Waahhhh... Doctor, help meee...

char_253_greyy_CN_008.voiceText: Zzz... Wha? Doctor...? Ah! Sorry! I wasn't napping! I, um, I was... Oh, is this Medical?

char_253_greyy_CN_009.voiceText: Doctor, are you going out again...? Okay, I know. I'll wait here for you... Um, Doctor, please hurry back...

char_253_greyy_CN_010.voiceText: Whoa...! Aaaugh... Static electricity. Gave me a jolt...

char_253_greyy_CN_011.voiceText: H-Hi. My name is Greyy. I'm kind of an electrician... Erm, th-thanks for taking me on...!

char_253_greyy_CN_012.voiceText: C-could you pause it for a minute? I-I'm taking notes…

char_253_greyy_CN_013.voiceText: A promotion? Okay, I'll take it to... Huh? It's, it's for me...? Really?

char_253_greyy_CN_014.voiceText: Hehe. Doctor, I shall light the way for you!... Um, sorry, just got too full of myself...  But I actually mean it...!

char_253_greyy_CN_018.voiceText: I'm the Captain...? O-Okay! If that's your wish, Doctor!...

char_253_greyy_CN_019.voiceText: Let me handle the logistical support...!

char_253_greyy_CN_020.voiceText: Doctor, I see the enemies rallying...

char_253_greyy_CN_022.voiceText: I should be able to do it...!

char_253_greyy_CN_026.voiceText: I won't let you hurt my friends...!

char_253_greyy_CN_028.voiceText: An electric shock c-can really hurt...!

char_253_greyy_CN_029.voiceText: Doctor, we've done a wonderful job...! Cou-Could we go home now?...

char_253_greyy_CN_031.voiceText: Doctor, the ones who ran off... We won't see them again, will we?

char_253_greyy_CN_036.voiceText: Doctor, you're really tall... I-I wonder when I'll get to be that tall...

char_010_chen_CN_001.voiceText: I will be your bodyguard, Doctor.

char_010_chen_CN_002.voiceText: I've always had my suspicions about Rhodes Island. Still do.

char_010_chen_CN_003.voiceText: Why are you staring at me? Nothing better to do?

char_010_chen_CN_005.voiceText: I know every nook and cranny in Lungmen. The docks, the neon signs, the winding paths, I can see them all in my mind, clear as day. I'll never forget them.

char_010_chen_CN_006.voiceText: Things around here have deteriorated lately. I'll be on guard, but I'll still need you to be careful.

char_010_chen_CN_007.voiceText: Maybe one day that man will take note of my efforts, but until then…

char_010_chen_CN_008.voiceText: Amiya trusts you completely. When I see you two together, it makes me wonder... what if I had someone like that by my side?

char_010_chen_CN_009.voiceText: I've... I've never been able to rely much on anyone, not even...

char_010_chen_CN_010.voiceText: Doctor? You fell asleep? Hmph. No nerves to keep you awake, then.

char_010_chen_CN_011.voiceText: Ch'en. Leader of the L.G.D.'s Special Inspection Unit. For my own reasons,I'll be joining you for a while. Seeing as we're already well acquainted from our prior work together, I'll ask you to take me to my workplace now.

char_010_chen_CN_012.voiceText: It's all in the service of more efficient operations.

char_010_chen_CN_013.voiceText: A promotion? I've been through these things before.

char_010_chen_CN_014.voiceText: Roger. Just give me all the missions your usual Operators can't handle.

char_010_chen_CN_018.voiceText: Listen up! We'll be much more efficient if we work together.

char_010_chen_CN_029.voiceText: Your evil must be stopped. I will do so by any means necessary.

char_010_chen_CN_030.voiceText: Where did you find the courage to challenge me?

char_010_chen_CN_031.voiceText: The wounded wait here for a medivac. The rest of you, stay on guard.

char_010_chen_CN_033.voiceText: So this is Rhodes Island's base? Bigger than I expected.

char_010_chen_CN_036.voiceText: Doctor, you're in a good mood. Is it because that operation went well? Same here.

char_298_susuro_CN_001.voiceText: Time for a break, Doctor. Have you been at it since the last round? Take a break now, please.

char_298_susuro_CN_002.voiceText: It is my duty to perform regular check-ups on Oripathy patients. Some are personable enough, but a few are hard to communicate with. It's not the first time, though, so worry not, they will understand how vital a doctor is to them.

char_298_susuro_CN_003.voiceText: Do you know everything an amnesia patient should know? Don't work yourself into the ground. Work and relaxation are equally important!

char_298_susuro_CN_004.voiceText: You always have patients who ignore the doctor's orders, but in battle, a doctor can't ignore a cry for help.

char_298_susuro_CN_005.voiceText: The cruelty of war and disasters have often spurred the development of medicine, so doctors must be at the forefront of pain and suffering. As long as I can help my patients get their lives back, I'm ready to face that fact.

char_298_susuro_CN_006.voiceText: The time I've worked with you has been, uh... some of my happiest! Come on, Doctor, you know I'm not good with words, so don't play dumb!

char_298_susuro_CN_007.voiceText: Here's a pen. How did I know you wanted it? Well, I've been working with you for a while now, isn't it natural I picked up on it?

char_298_susuro_CN_008.voiceText: I'm still far below the level of Doctors Silence and Shining, but I'm not afraid of how hard it may be for me. How can I measure up to your confidence in me otherwise?

char_298_susuro_CN_009.voiceText: The sun is indeed warm on the deck, and the breeze is cozy as well... No, I'm not slacking off. Even a doctor needs to relax, right? Why don't you tell me what's bothering you? You can even whisper it.

char_298_susuro_CN_010.voiceText: Who designed this meal plan? It's simply horrifying!

char_298_susuro_CN_011.voiceText: Sussurro, Medic, reporting in and reminding you to follow your doctor's orders, no matter how much you have on your plate.

char_298_susuro_CN_012.voiceText: I must make more copies of these battle notes for Myrrh and company.

char_298_susuro_CN_013.voiceText: Promotion ceremony, while everyone stares at me? I don't have to make any embarrassing speeches, do I? No, no, I'm not nervous at all, really...

char_298_susuro_CN_014.voiceText: For this promotion, I have to thank the entire hard-working Medical Unit behind me and the guidance of the Doctor. I'm very, very grateful to you all!

char_298_susuro_CN_017.voiceText: Don't worry, I'll watch over them.

char_298_susuro_CN_018.voiceText: Hold everything! You must complete all pre-battle physical exam to deploy!

char_298_susuro_CN_019.voiceText: Attention, medics, please follow all standard procedures in a battle.

char_298_susuro_CN_020.voiceText: Safety first, and do not touch anything that may be suspicious or infected!

char_298_susuro_CN_022.voiceText: Louder! It's hard to hear over the battle!

char_298_susuro_CN_023.voiceText: Look over here for a doctor!

char_298_susuro_CN_025.voiceText: Don't worry, you'll be okay in no time!

char_298_susuro_CN_026.voiceText: Don't concern yourself with fighting, you're still wounded!

char_298_susuro_CN_028.voiceText: Scream if you're in pain, don't hold it in!

char_298_susuro_CN_029.voiceText: Finally, the battle's over. You should take a break too. I imagine commanding the mission would take a toll on your body.

char_298_susuro_CN_030.voiceText: No casualty on our side. The Doctor's leadership is indeed unparalleled.

char_298_susuro_CN_031.voiceText: Will the enemy return? There are still wounded unable to move here.

char_298_susuro_CN_032.voiceText: Make way, make way! Stop crowding! Wounded coming through!

char_298_susuro_CN_033.voiceText: Promise you'll rest when it's time to, okay?

char_298_susuro_CN_036.voiceText: Phew. I need a drink after work! Mind handing me a juice, Doctor? Thanks!

char_151_myrtle_CN_001.voiceText: Hey, Doctor. I'm here to hang!

char_151_myrtle_CN_002.voiceText: Doctor, don't look down on me just 'cause I'm little. Back where I'm from, all the kids looked up to me.

char_151_myrtle_CN_003.voiceText: Durin used the name of our race as her codename because she's so lazy, but isn't it kind of dumb how calling me 'Myrtle of Durin' made me sound like I belong to her or something?

char_151_myrtle_CN_004.voiceText: I understand how all the machines here work, but it still feels weird using them. Some have a lot of different parts, but some are surprisingly simple.

char_151_myrtle_CN_005.voiceText: My banner? Good eye, Doctor. It sure is a tablecloth from my house. I sneaked it out with me because it can't get dirty. My dad is probably pretty mad about it!

char_151_myrtle_CN_006.voiceText: Is my apple really that great? They're popular back home. You can study or play with it if you want, Doctor, just don't break it.

char_151_myrtle_CN_007.voiceText: There are still many things I'm not used to on land, but I love the many delicious foods. The cafe on Rhodes Island is my favorite!

char_151_myrtle_CN_008.voiceText: I do have to point out the fact, Doctor, that I am a full-grown adult! And I'm tall by Durin standards! Please tell everyone to stop patting me on the head and giving me candy!

char_151_myrtle_CN_009.voiceText: Say, Doctor, are you interested in my homeland? I can take you there! But it's pretty far, so wait till I'm in the mood.

char_151_myrtle_CN_010.voiceText: Are you taking a break? You can use my banner as a blanket.

char_151_myrtle_CN_011.voiceText: Reporting in! You must be the Doctor? Call me Myrtle, Myrtle of Durin. Durin said I could get a job here, so what have you got for me? I may be small, but I'm tough!

char_151_myrtle_CN_012.voiceText: Cool fight... Got some more, Doctor?

char_151_myrtle_CN_013.voiceText: Oh, did I get promoted? Does that mean I can go somewhere I couldn't before?

char_151_myrtle_CN_014.voiceText: I told you I'm tough! Told you!

char_151_myrtle_CN_017.voiceText: There's a mission? I wanna go!

char_151_myrtle_CN_025.voiceText: I have to get serious now!

char_151_myrtle_CN_027.voiceText: We're counting on you again today, little apple.

char_151_myrtle_CN_029.voiceText: Phew, I'm exhausted! I wanna go to lie down, Doctor.

char_151_myrtle_CN_030.voiceText: Flawless victory! I was pretty good, wasn't I, Doctor?

char_151_myrtle_CN_031.voiceText: We won, Doctor, and that's what counts!

char_151_myrtle_CN_036.voiceText: Why can't the cafe open 24 hours?

char_151_myrtle_CN_042.voiceText: Any more fun things to do, Doctor?

char_274_astesi_CN_001.voiceText: I drew up the work schedule for you. Please kindly follow.

char_274_astesi_CN_002.voiceText: How to make a celestial globe is a secret, but as we know, anything can be on the table for a fair price. I'd be happy to reveal my trick of the trade as long as your price is right.

char_274_astesi_CN_003.voiceText: Observing the stars everyday makes my neck sore. Wonder if the medics would have any suggestions for that... What, Miss. Warfarin is the physician on duty today? Um... I'll check again another day.

char_274_astesi_CN_004.voiceText: Astrology is learning about the present and the future from celestial alignments. It's not quite divination, but with the same result. So, would you like to give it a try, Doctor? It's free of charge!

char_274_astesi_CN_005.voiceText: 'Similar genes, among blood relatives, causes, uh, reverberations of Originium...' I can barely understand a word in this work of an occultist. Doctor, Can you interpret the medical report for me?

char_274_astesi_CN_006.voiceText: Ever since my Oripathic infection, the stars have diminished their responses to me. I must find a way to reverse it before I lose all my power. Otherwise I'l… Could you help me, Doctor?

char_274_astesi_CN_007.voiceText: You want to know more about the organization I'm with? Sorry, I took an oath not to divulge anything, and it's not for public knowledge, anyway. If you're curious, just think of it as a completely neutral community.

char_274_astesi_CN_008.voiceText: Sometimes, I envy Astgenne...  Ah, guess I should call her Elena now. She has everything I'm missing... But like you said, Doctor, we relied on each other because we complement each other, that's why we're sisters.

char_274_astesi_CN_009.voiceText: As the nights bid us farewell, so do the starlights fade and quell. If this is the end that awaits us ahead, I should be picking up something more meaningful to do. Such as? Umm... Doctor, do you mind me waking you up every morning?

char_274_astesi_CN_010.voiceText: The tea's ready, Doctor. Time for a little break.

char_274_astesi_CN_011.voiceText: Astesia, astrologer, reporting for guard duty. I'm yours to command, Doctor.

char_274_astesi_CN_013.voiceText: A promotion medal? How exquisite. I'll treasure it well.

char_274_astesi_CN_014.voiceText: Stars shine bright, bearing witness of our past nights.

char_274_astesi_CN_018.voiceText: Let me be the guiding star for all.

char_274_astesi_CN_020.voiceText: The stars will light our way.

char_274_astesi_CN_023.voiceText: Don't panic, Astesia. Do it like you usually do.

char_274_astesi_CN_026.voiceText: Lend me your wings, avians among the stars!

char_274_astesi_CN_027.voiceText: The serpent has brought about your end.

char_274_astesi_CN_028.voiceText: The light of stars shall be my blade!

char_274_astesi_CN_029.voiceText: So this is 'our' power, a power even the stars failed to foresee...

char_274_astesi_CN_030.voiceText: Fantastic results, Doctor. But don't overwork yourself, be sure to rest up well.

char_274_astesi_CN_031.voiceText: If I put in more effort, maybe the outcome could be better…

char_274_astesi_CN_032.voiceText: I'm dead on my feet... but it's not time to quit yet

char_274_astesi_CN_033.voiceText: Let me see... Yes, the layout's good. The furniture won't attract any unwanted spirits this way.

char_274_astesi_CN_036.voiceText: W-What's that... something on my face?

char_326_glacus_CN_001.voiceText: I'll be quietly modifying the Raythean Franker over here. You can focus on your work. I won't disturb you.

char_326_glacus_CN_002.voiceText: Why does everyone always keep their distance from Blue Poison? I don't get it... She and I are both special? Umm, alright.

char_326_glacus_CN_003.voiceText: Anything you want to say, Doctor? No? Okay. I'll be here. You can chat with me anytime.

char_326_glacus_CN_004.voiceText: I always lose my appetite when the dorm is too hot... Oh, don't worry about it. It's a family thing, I'm not actually complaining.

char_326_glacus_CN_005.voiceText: Why did I come to Rhodes Island? If I could run as I pleased on these legs, I wouldn't have left my homeland.

char_326_glacus_CN_006.voiceText: Vulcan and I have a similar distaste for 'old things,' but I still think we have fundamentally different philosophies.

char_326_glacus_CN_007.voiceText: So, Doctor, Blue Poison says I always seem to be hiding something. Do I really give people that impression? Sometimes? How…?

char_326_glacus_CN_008.voiceText: It's not that I don't want to talk, it's just that I never got my way much before. So I'm not used to speaking up. Hope you won't take it the wrong way, Doctor.

char_326_glacus_CN_009.voiceText: Two memories stand out to me. One is the first time I ran with this exoskeleton. My eyes went wide and all was right with the world. As for the other... That would have to be right here, right now at Rhodes Island.

char_326_glacus_CN_010.voiceText: Umm? When did the Doctor fall asleep...?

char_326_glacus_CN_011.voiceText: Operator Glaucus reporting for onboarding. So… may I go back to my room now?

char_326_glacus_CN_012.voiceText: Hmm… Okay, I see. I got it now.

char_326_glacus_CN_013.voiceText: I named the weapon, actually. Maybe it represents what I really want in life... Huh? Did they just announce my name for promotion?

char_326_glacus_CN_014.voiceText: Trust in others… Well, I don't know what to do to make them feel trusted, but I'll keep trying.

char_326_glacus_CN_018.voiceText: What? I'm the captain? Did I sign up without realizing it?

char_326_glacus_CN_019.voiceText: I wonder what interesting things we'll find this time…

char_326_glacus_CN_022.voiceText: Fully charged and ready to go.

char_326_glacus_CN_023.voiceText: The feeling of standing on dry land…

char_326_glacus_CN_029.voiceText: No hostile movement detected. Please check your status, team.

char_326_glacus_CN_030.voiceText: No active enemy signals. EMP disabled. Nice work, team.

char_326_glacus_CN_031.voiceText: Some enemies have escaped. Should we give chase?

char_326_glacus_CN_032.voiceText: EMP disabled. We'd better call for backup quick.

char_326_glacus_CN_033.voiceText: No problem, just need to find that screw first…

char_326_glacus_CN_034.voiceText: Oh… sorry, my mind was wandering.

char_326_glacus_CN_036.voiceText: Mind taking a walk with me, Doctor?

char_348_ceylon_CN_001.voiceText: I'll be writing reports or reading nearby, just call when you need me.

char_348_ceylon_CN_002.voiceText: I believe you reap what you sow, and have always followed that principle.

char_348_ceylon_CN_003.voiceText: ...Wait, I didn't know Oripathy could take on this characteristic! This needs to be investigated immediately! Doctor, if you'd excuse me... Hmm, I wonder if there are any suitable subjects in Rhodes Islands...

char_348_ceylon_CN_004.voiceText: The day is not complete without tea. Would you like a cup too, Doctor? I have the best tea leaves in all Victoria.

char_348_ceylon_CN_005.voiceText: I've been with Schwarz since childhood. I know everything about her, including her past before we met. But I'm not giving that up so easily.

char_348_ceylon_CN_006.voiceText: If I could find a cure for Schwarz, wouldn't that mean I could cure other infected too? Worry not, Doctor, I'm not that selfish. But please also know that Schwarz is dearest to my heart.

char_348_ceylon_CN_007.voiceText: Originium research is still a vastly unexplored territory, Doctor. But I just want to find a cure, which is why I longed for Rhodes Island ever since I heard about it.

char_348_ceylon_CN_008.voiceText: Doctor, did you know, I hate those who would discriminate against Schwarz because of her infection. But, there are no people like that here at Rhodes Island. No-one here will reject her, and I can further my medical knowledge... I'm really glad that I came here.

char_348_ceylon_CN_009.voiceText: Regardless of how good a leader is, there's still a chance she could be blinded by selfish interest, so you must watch out for that, Doctor. But as long as I'm around, I'll put you back on the right path anytime you stray.

char_348_ceylon_CN_010.voiceText: Doctor, it's not good to sleep while sitting up... Mm, I guess it's fine. Let me at least get a blanket for you.

char_348_ceylon_CN_011.voiceText: Hello, I'm Ceylon, graduate of the Victoria National University with a major in Originium research. I start my internship on Rhodes Island today with Dr. Kal'tsit's approval. Nice to meet you, Doctor.

char_348_ceylon_CN_012.voiceText: An excellent application of Originium. Rhodes Island sure lives up to its reputation!

char_348_ceylon_CN_013.voiceText: So I'm officially recognized by Rhodes Island? Thank you, Doctor, I'll work even harder!

char_348_ceylon_CN_014.voiceText: Rhodes Island does boast amazing Originium research! I will cure Schwarz one day if I keep working here! Please help me too, Doctor!

char_348_ceylon_CN_017.voiceText: A mission? Perfect time to try out my new Originium ability.

char_348_ceylon_CN_018.voiceText: Relax, I'm a pretty good commander.

char_348_ceylon_CN_019.voiceText: I wonder if we'll find rare materials along the way?

char_348_ceylon_CN_020.voiceText: Don't panic, handle it with composure.

char_348_ceylon_CN_023.voiceText: Leave the support work to me.

char_348_ceylon_CN_027.voiceText: This move should be better for the present situation.

char_348_ceylon_CN_029.voiceText: Phew... Hehe, it feels like I just finished a difficult experiment. I might be tired, but I feel a sense of accomplishment.

char_348_ceylon_CN_030.voiceText: The enemy should be gone now, so I'm going to look around the perimeter.

char_348_ceylon_CN_031.voiceText: They wouldn't have gotten away if I were Schwarz...

char_348_ceylon_CN_032.voiceText: Don't just stand there, Doctor, give me a hand with the wounded!

char_348_ceylon_CN_033.voiceText: Maybe talk to the other doctors on base.

char_348_ceylon_CN_034.voiceText: Wait, my hair is getting messed up!

char_348_ceylon_CN_036.voiceText: Don't tell me the Doctor dozed off in the chair again...

char_348_ceylon_CN_042.voiceText: How are you, Doctor? Care for some tea with me?

char_340_shwaz_CN_001.voiceText: I've noted down your schedule. You can confirm with me anytime.

char_340_shwaz_CN_002.voiceText: If it's about making someone bleed, do not send Lady Ceylon to the task. Let those who live amongst the shadow take it over, like me.

char_340_shwaz_CN_003.voiceText: I won't tell you anything more about Lady Ceylon. And of course, others won't learn anything more about you from me.

char_340_shwaz_CN_004.voiceText: I'm your bodyguard, Doctor. My duty is to protect you, not chat with you. If you want to talk, please stop turning to me like Lady Ceylon does and find someone else.

char_340_shwaz_CN_005.voiceText: My expertise? Killing targets, guarding people, and... making tea. Don't be so shocked. After all, the tea Lady Ceylon makes is… Anyway, I'm good at that.

char_340_shwaz_CN_006.voiceText: Doctor, based on the danger involved in the missions to date, I believe you need to learn self-defense in addition to my protection. Otherwise, even I can't guarantee your safety.

char_340_shwaz_CN_007.voiceText: Once you've got blood on your hands, there's no turning back… Doctor, I do not wish you to go down the same road as mine. So leave the dirty works to me.

char_340_shwaz_CN_008.voiceText: You want to hear my revenge story? You won't be able to sleep at night, Doctor. But… somehow I do have this strange urge to tell you. Well then, let's hit the bar. This story will take a while.

char_340_shwaz_CN_009.voiceText: Sinners always get what they deserve, I know that. But I do wonder sometimes that... if I could have met Lady Ceylon and you sooner, maybe I'd be more than just a killer. It's still not too late for me? Do you really mean that, Doctor?

char_340_shwaz_CN_010.voiceText: Falls asleep just like that? Can't keep a guard up at all, just like her.

char_340_shwaz_CN_011.voiceText: I'm Schwarz, Lady Ceylon's personal bodyguard, here to join Rhodes Island with her. If at all possible, please assign me to accompany her.

char_340_shwaz_CN_012.voiceText: I see that Rhodes Island is teeming with war monsters. I can only try to learn their way of battle.

char_340_shwaz_CN_013.voiceText: Now I understand why Rhodes Island wanted me. Your vision is a hundred times crazier than anything I ever did.

char_340_shwaz_CN_014.voiceText: Reawaken my memories? I'm fine with it. Maybe you can tame the evil inside us when on battlefields. Please, tame it for us.

char_340_shwaz_CN_025.voiceText: I've got you in my sight.

char_340_shwaz_CN_028.voiceText: Lady Ceylon may have mercy. I do not.

char_340_shwaz_CN_029.voiceText: Doctor, in a dangerous mission like this,  you'd better give you command from as far as possible.

char_340_shwaz_CN_030.voiceText: We got everyone, per your order.

char_340_shwaz_CN_031.voiceText: The perimeter is secured. What's next?

char_340_shwaz_CN_032.voiceText: Come, Doctor, I'll ensure your safety.

char_340_shwaz_CN_034.voiceText: ...?! Please, Doctor, I don't want you to hurt yourself.

char_340_shwaz_CN_042.voiceText: Don't let your guard down even on base, Doctor.

char_188_helage_CN_001.voiceText: Queching the flames of war demands prolonged suffering. To ignite them, however, it takes naught but a lapse of thought.

char_188_helage_CN_002.voiceText: The fall of Chernobog dealt a devastating blow to Azazel, our clinic. I must rebuild it for the children. As long as they can have a shelter to call home, any place will do. You don't need a reason to try for your family.

char_188_helage_CN_003.voiceText: Rhodes Island is in a respectable position, but the Infected of Ursus face prospects far worse than anyone could imagine. They must be ready to resort to violence in order to survive. At the end of the day, virtue and dignity hold meaning only for those who live to see the next dawn.

char_188_helage_CN_004.voiceText: All Ursus should take pride in their nation and their Emperor.' I, too, fought for Ursus once, but I don't have the passion driving me anymore. Time has robbed me of too much.

char_188_helage_CN_005.voiceText: Life in the military has taught me two things: First, have faith in your fellow soldiers; second, have faith in them, but do not trust them. This dilemma has always plagued our lands, and none can escape it.

char_188_helage_CN_006.voiceText: Dr. {@nickname}, a limitless future awaits you, just as it does for those children. Though I can neither let go of yesterday nor look forward to tomorrow, I shall fight for you till my last drop of blood, so you may be part of that future.

char_188_helage_CN_007.voiceText: I am fine with Ursus as my enemy. Once I swore my utmost loyalty to it, but that was returned with endless disillusionment and shame. For the children's sake, I will never falter, much less surrender.

char_188_helage_CN_008.voiceText: Once there was a long battle. When I finally broke into the enemy headquarters, I was too late... All I could do for my dying friend was take his pocket watch and sword. The enemy lost their commander, whose death brought us a brief victory. That day, Ursus enjoyed her momentary triumph, but I knew my war was over. A war where I lost everything.

char_188_helage_CN_009.voiceText: The photograph inside my pocket watch? Hahahah, so you saw it... This is Neon from when she was little. Isn't she adorable? She's not so quiet anymore, but she loves herself now, and that's all that matters... Live free, Dr. {@nickname}, that's my wish, even if it is trite.

char_188_helage_CN_010.voiceText: Don't lose focus. You must be alert at all times on Rhodes Island.

char_188_helage_CN_011.voiceText: Hellagur, an infected mercenary. I will work with Rhodes Island in order to rebuild my Azazel Clinic and protect my family. But be advised, I have no medical skills.

char_188_helage_CN_012.voiceText: Battlefields may change, but not the cruelty.

char_188_helage_CN_013.voiceText: I'm used to it as a soldier, but I find it fascinating as an infected. Thank you for the ribbon, Dr. {@nickname}.

char_188_helage_CN_014.voiceText: War will never truly be over, but I believe even this land will end eventually. Maybe you can end our suffering one day, Dr. {@nickname}. Now, give me your order!

char_188_helage_CN_017.voiceText: Only butchers thirst for blood. We are merely paying the price of survival.

char_188_helage_CN_018.voiceText: I'll have them following orders to Ursus army standards!

char_188_helage_CN_019.voiceText: I don't mind losing my life, if that is enough to end this all.

char_188_helage_CN_020.voiceText: You have never seen a real war, pathetic runts.

char_188_helage_CN_022.voiceText: A slip of the mind is the difference between life and death.

char_188_helage_CN_023.voiceText: Killing is but the last resort.

char_188_helage_CN_024.voiceText: I've never truly left the battlefield, I know.

char_188_helage_CN_025.voiceText: A lash of blade, the flesh to flay.

char_188_helage_CN_026.voiceText: A thrust of whip, the sword to rip.

char_188_helage_CN_027.voiceText: A cleave of spear, the armor to tear!

char_188_helage_CN_028.voiceText: Decapitator'… Our sacrifices were not in vain.

char_188_helage_CN_029.voiceText: You leave the fight behind, and pay for it with yet more fighting.

char_188_helage_CN_030.voiceText: Avert your eyes, I'm about to end their misery.

char_188_helage_CN_031.voiceText: Keep your guard up. One flaw is all the enemy needs to turn the tables.

char_188_helage_CN_032.voiceText: There is no shame in failure. At least you had the chance to learn from it.

char_188_helage_CN_033.voiceText: If only I can find shelter for the children.

char_188_helage_CN_036.voiceText: Would you like a candy? I still have some. But watch out for cavities.

char_260_durnar_CN_001.voiceText: Aw, c'mon, get someone more literate for this job. I'm a soldier, all I know is following orders. Paperwork's beyond me.

char_260_durnar_CN_002.voiceText: Life is tough enough already. Let's relax with some butter, frosting and jam.

char_260_durnar_CN_003.voiceText: If Frostleaf wasn't still lugging that big axe around, there's no way I would've recognized her. We fought together before, probably as enemies. Anyway, I'm relieved to see her living the good life at Rhodes Island.

char_260_durnar_CN_004.voiceText: Watch it, Doctor, you can't go touching my weapon. I just replaced the Originium on that thing. It's dangerous when you hold it wrong... Look out! I, I'll take you to Medical...

char_260_durnar_CN_005.voiceText: Defensive ability is what matters to a Defender. I don't care if it's organic fiber or ceramic padding, as long as it's the state-of-the-art, just buy it!

char_260_durnar_CN_006.voiceText: Stories from my past? Umm… Don't have much to say. I mean, what kind of story could a bad tempered soldier have? All those merits and medals... Hmph, they're nothing in the face of the lives lost.

char_260_durnar_CN_007.voiceText: The greenies we got in the reserves are pretty good. But they suck at securing amenities. Back in my day, the rookies were way smarter about hiding cookies.

char_260_durnar_CN_008.voiceText: I talked to Logistics. From now on, they're putting 'Industrial Material' on all our snack packaging. Then, all we need is you to sign off on them for us, Doctor.

char_260_durnar_CN_009.voiceText: Doctor? Oh, sorry. I was all caught up in reminiscing. I still can't get past certain things. If my old commander was anything like you, maybe... We wouldn't have had to go through that.

char_260_durnar_CN_010.voiceText: Psst, Psst! Want some pop rocks? I got all kinds. I know I got one you'll love.

char_260_durnar_CN_011.voiceText: Hard as rock and lethal as lightning! That's me, Dur-nar. Nice to meet you, Doctor.

char_260_durnar_CN_012.voiceText: Ah, shoot, I'm out of popcorn.

char_260_durnar_CN_013.voiceText: A promotion? Good, good, do I get paid more too? Awesome!

char_260_durnar_CN_014.voiceText: The old me only knew how to charge on ahead and fight without stopping. Now, I fight for everybody. Just give your orders, Doctor.

char_260_durnar_CN_017.voiceText: Ready to deploy. Where am I needed?

char_260_durnar_CN_018.voiceText: I only have one request: Safety first and don't ever forget it.

char_260_durnar_CN_019.voiceText: We're off! Remember to stay frosty and keep an eye out.

char_260_durnar_CN_020.voiceText: I never did get used to the stench of war.

char_260_durnar_CN_023.voiceText: I'll leave the support to you.

char_260_durnar_CN_029.voiceText: Ever heard of the Medal of Glory? I feel that's tailor-made for you.

char_260_durnar_CN_030.voiceText: No need to clean up the battlefield? Okay, then we're done here.

char_260_durnar_CN_031.voiceText: The enemy still hasn't gone far. Should we chase them down?

char_260_durnar_CN_032.voiceText: Take it easy, Doctor. It's not your fault...

char_260_durnar_CN_033.voiceText: Whoa, I bet a fancy interior like this cost a bundle!

char_260_durnar_CN_036.voiceText: You must be drunk to want to hear me sing war songs. Okay, don't you regret it.

char_355_ethan_CN_001.voiceText: Yo, Doctor! Is it time for my shift? Hmm? I suddenly popped up out of nowhere? Nope, just got here.

char_355_ethan_CN_002.voiceText: C'mon, man, I worked with you on my background check. And I told you a million times: My last job was with Reunion, sure. But I wasn't mixed up in any of the criminal stuff. No guilt here!

char_355_ethan_CN_003.voiceText: If there's one thing I really hated about Reunion, it was the food! If you can even call it food… My team mostly got by on rock-hard black bread. I had to throw it in a pot and simmer it into stew every time. Those people were just brutal on their stomachs.

char_355_ethan_CN_004.voiceText: You must've run into Reunion's 'Wraith' guys a whole bunch of times, right? I was one of those. They sent me to scout stuff, never did any fighting. I used to place bets on who would or wouldn't get seen as a way to deal with the boredom. Thinking back, I guess that was kind of rough on the other guys.

char_355_ethan_CN_005.voiceText: What did I do before I joined Reunion? I was playing hide n' seek with the Infected hunters, duh. With my sneaky little power here, they went home empty-handed every time, haha… But all I could do was hide. And that wasn't gonna help change things for the Infected.

char_355_ethan_CN_006.voiceText: I joined up with the underground because I wanted to help other Infected. But over time, I got jaded, then I stopped being a good guy... Well, at least my hands are 'clean' again. What do I mean by that? Hehe, that's enough questions, friend. Never you mind.

char_355_ethan_CN_007.voiceText: Look, camouflage Arts are really complicated! First, you gotta actually know the compisition and texture of your surroundings. Then, you memorize the shape of every crack in the wall, and all the colors of all the soil and every tree. If you don't have those down, even your nerves will get you popping out, and then it's only a matter of time until you're made.

char_355_ethan_CN_008.voiceText: You were the only one in the office, and your snacks disappeared as soon as you turned your head? Wow, that's weird. Why don't you leave it to me? I'll solve this mystery and bring the thief right to you. Yep.

char_355_ethan_CN_009.voiceText: So this is a map of the operating area? Let's see… Wow, you're really something. Your strategies are so clever, no wonder Reunion always got their asses handed to them. Okay, I'm moving out!

char_355_ethan_CN_011.voiceText: Where am I? Right in front of you! You can call me Ethan. How did I get in here? Haha! Can't answer that one yet.

char_355_ethan_CN_012.voiceText: Where was I? C'mon! Right over there! Look at the top left of screen. Top left corner!

char_355_ethan_CN_013.voiceText: Haha, I told you before right? You won't regret putting work into my hands.

char_355_ethan_CN_014.voiceText: Yo, Doctor. Make sure you remember the little guys like me. I could die in some battle somewhere and nobody would even know I was gone. So please, remember where I am!

char_355_ethan_CN_017.voiceText: The wall moved, right before your eyes? Naw, you're exaggerating, definitely.

char_355_ethan_CN_018.voiceText: Eyyy! I'm the captain now, so you'd all better listen up!

char_355_ethan_CN_019.voiceText: Don't panic if you suddenly notice a missing squadmate.

char_355_ethan_CN_020.voiceText: Time to fight? I gotta hide first!

char_355_ethan_CN_026.voiceText: Violence can't solve all your problems, but it can solve you!

char_355_ethan_CN_029.voiceText: Are we done fighting? Ahh, I'm beat!

char_355_ethan_CN_030.voiceText: I worked pretty hard. You saw me, right? Right?

char_355_ethan_CN_031.voiceText: So what if they got away. Just let 'em go.

char_355_ethan_CN_032.voiceText: You should go first, at least I can grab their legs.

char_355_ethan_CN_033.voiceText: Nice room you got here. Let's see what sticks out the most.

char_355_ethan_CN_036.voiceText: Hey, wanna go for a stroll?

char_355_ethan_CN_042.voiceText: Hey, Doctor, somebody looks happy. Did something good happen?

char_275_breeze_CN_001.voiceText: I'll gladly offer my help if you need it. Just remember to return the favor someday.

char_275_breeze_CN_002.voiceText: Vina... Err, I mean, Miss Siege—always gives me this feeling I can't describe. I wonder why...?

char_275_breeze_CN_003.voiceText: My dad? Oh my, you know I ran away from home and you're still going to ask me that? Doctor, are you perhaps not the best at conversation?

char_275_breeze_CN_004.voiceText: Dr. {@nickname}! Do have a try of my cooking... You taste medicine? Oh, gosh... Well, I do have some knowledge in herbs, but you know I wouldn't be experimenting on you, would I? Eheheh...

char_275_breeze_CN_005.voiceText: I used to think my parents were so stuffy and numb to it all, so I ran away from home to find a new life. But after having traveled so far and been through so much, I've come to realize why my parents felt how they did now. Ahahah, c'est la vie, as the saying goes.

char_275_breeze_CN_006.voiceText: Dr. {@nickname}, see that lone cloud over there, off from the rest? That's the way my hometown lies.

char_275_breeze_CN_007.voiceText: Faith' is an interesting topic. I never had the chance to go to Laterano, but how funny I should hear all about its feats on Rhodes Island? Although I've mostly heard about, er... one very overly active girl. Has Laterano always been such a lively place?

char_275_breeze_CN_008.voiceText: The boats of Toron need a lighthouse to make their way back to port, and Rhodes Island has served as the safe haven at the end of my trip. Dr. {@nickname}, your light might not illuminate the whole harbor, but go on... Do what I couldn't. It's my honest request.

char_275_breeze_CN_009.voiceText: Right here, right now, is where I, Grace Arizona, place my faith. Dr. {@nickname}, you hold my hopes in your hands, forever more.

char_275_breeze_CN_010.voiceText: ...That's the face of someone lost in their dreams. I wonder if you're feeling uneasy, Doctor?

char_275_breeze_CN_011.voiceText: Breeze, a traveling scholar from Toron County. It is a pleasure to meet you, Doctor. Phew, I've had enough of formal etiquette, so this will be the last of it.

char_275_breeze_CN_012.voiceText: ...Stunning medical skills. There's Rhodes Island for you...

char_275_breeze_CN_013.voiceText: I bestow my heartfelt blessings on you for your gift, Doctor. Hmm? What a shoddy reaction—this is a hand-kiss, you know, we're being serious here. Hurry up, come on!

char_275_breeze_CN_014.voiceText: Well, this time won't be as mannerful as the last, not that I'd think you were hoping for that? So here goes. I will dedicate everything to Rhodes Island, a pledge that transcends my consciousness.

char_275_breeze_CN_017.voiceText: Leave the medical work to me.

char_275_breeze_CN_018.voiceText: Thank you for your trust. I will make sure to prioritize the safety of the Operators.

char_275_breeze_CN_020.voiceText: Those who seek to inflict harm on others have no right to ask for forgiveness.

char_275_breeze_CN_024.voiceText: Make sure to look after yourself.

char_275_breeze_CN_030.voiceText: Every victory creates a kindling that will flourish into an everlasting fire.

char_275_breeze_CN_031.voiceText: Keep your senses alert. The wind is still restless.

char_275_breeze_CN_032.voiceText: Why are they so fixated on hurting others...?

char_275_breeze_CN_033.voiceText: What a... unique place this is.

char_275_breeze_CN_036.voiceText: Doctor, would you like to hear the story of my hometown?

char_248_mgllan_CN_001.voiceText: I'll stay with you until my next expedition, Doctor. Don't be afraid to send me out anywhere you need me.

char_248_mgllan_CN_002.voiceText: I actually heard about you a long time ago, Doctor! Yeah, Mayer and MuMu told me all about you. I just had to come to Rhodes Island to see what you're like in person. Oh, I also got a little present for you! Here!

char_248_mgllan_CN_003.voiceText: This one? It's an Emperor strap! Who...? The Emperor of Penguin Logistics! I visited that company a whole bunch, so I've met him lots of times. He's so cute! I give him plenty of pets every time I go! You ever pet him before, Doctor? You don't dare? Why?!

char_248_mgllan_CN_004.voiceText: Is Iffy doing better these days? Last time I left Rhine Lab, she was in pretty bad shape. I've been worried about her…

char_248_mgllan_CN_005.voiceText: Has Mayer made anything new? I haven't worked on any new equipment for a long time, so I wanna do some research with her. Oh right, Doctor, I'll let you in on a little secret. If you bother Mayer while she's working... What? She already bit you?

char_248_mgllan_CN_006.voiceText: Unlike Meeboo, Sisyphus or Kirkika, my drones are operated differently. There is a limit to how many I can run at once, and it's just the way it goes. But I have a new system in development. I think you'll be surprised before long.

char_248_mgllan_CN_007.voiceText: The North? It's like a cold, cruel wonderland. But it's also the place where my dreams lie. And I'm willing to do whatever it takes to make them come true.

char_248_mgllan_CN_008.voiceText: 'The tiny gardner, and the tiny flower, growing under the tile with no one to care for it...' It was Iffy's favorite storybook, maybe because it resonated with her. But, well... It seems like she doesn't remember it. Hmm… that's odd.

char_248_mgllan_CN_009.voiceText: The North... it's both mysterious and beautiful. The towering cliffs, the lonely, snow-covered trees, the glowing, prismatic Originum crystals… And the vast snowland, stretching to the ends of the earth. Doctor, you should come see it with me. We'll go together, okay?

char_248_mgllan_CN_010.voiceText: Doctor? Stay awake Doctor! If you fall asleep, you'll freeze to death!

char_248_mgllan_CN_011.voiceText: Rhine Lab Specialist Magallan just discovered a mysterous research vessel! And you are…? Oh my goodness, you're that doctor from Rhodes Island! Uh, W-Would you like to join my expedition!? Adventuring together would be really interesting!

char_248_mgllan_CN_013.voiceText: Update complete! Now my devices respond twice as fast.

char_248_mgllan_CN_014.voiceText: Doctor, if you're curious about the results of my research, then I'll have to show you my stuff! Hehe, just so you know, I'll be showing you true power, so brace youself!

char_248_mgllan_CN_017.voiceText: Leave the exploration and support to me.

char_248_mgllan_CN_019.voiceText: Hold on, calibrating my equipment… Done!

char_248_mgllan_CN_020.voiceText: Preflight testing complete. Drones standing by.

char_248_mgllan_CN_022.voiceText: I bet you need my skills.

char_248_mgllan_CN_024.voiceText: All my equipment's good to go!

char_248_mgllan_CN_025.voiceText: Is the target marked? Ok, launching drone!

char_248_mgllan_CN_029.voiceText: Watch out, there's a blind spot in my scan—What, it's already over? All thanks to you, Doctor, you're reliable as ever.

char_248_mgllan_CN_031.voiceText: There's still some enemies around. Are we going after them?

char_248_mgllan_CN_032.voiceText: They're flanking us? My bad, sorry…

char_248_mgllan_CN_033.voiceText: Hm...? You even have heated floors?! Ahh, this is bliss.

char_248_mgllan_CN_036.voiceText: Come on, Doctor. Ice skating isn't so cary. I'm here with you.

char_248_mgllan_CN_042.voiceText: Um? Anything I can help with?

char_131_flameb_CN_001.voiceText: {@nickname}, compared to the old ones, today's battle are too relaxed and juvenile . They are weak. Weak enough to make weapons rust. And once a warrior's weapons rust, death soon follows.

char_131_flameb_CN_002.voiceText: Life is but a brief flicker before the vast maw of annihilation. Cherish that view of the sunset while you still can, {@nickname}.

char_131_flameb_CN_003.voiceText: Practical exercises? Nah, I'm not interested. While Rhodes Island boasts many powerful warriors, squandering one's physical strength on a game is wasteful. Only on the edge of life and death does the clashing of swords have value.

char_131_flameb_CN_004.voiceText: I'm not concerned with the plight of the Infected? Hmph, don't misunderstand me - fighting in vain is what I hate. No enemy worth spilling my blood has come forward, and that's all there is to it.

char_131_flameb_CN_005.voiceText: Rampant slaughter liberates your inner instinct, 'teamwork' only robs you of it. What 'trust' and 'strategizing' buy you are nothing but illusions of security. And these illusions, {@nickname}, will one day cost you your life.

char_131_flameb_CN_006.voiceText: This blade ran through two crown princes, and this other one slew three generals. In our chaotic world, anything can happen. I don't know who will claim my life, but on that day, I sure hope it'll be more exciting than when I took these lives.

char_131_flameb_CN_007.voiceText: Shining, huh? A pity, she could have been a worthy adversary. But after she got pulled into that mess with the 'Confessarii,' I bet she felt her blade had been besmirched. Hmph, Swordsmen without faith in their swords are beneath mention.

char_131_flameb_CN_008.voiceText: {@nickname}, you remember that battle, right? After killing all the ambushers, I led the survivors and charged straight into the traitor's fortress. I was the only one who made it out alive. How did it all start? Oh, you know the answer to that. I've seen you before, and my memory is very good.

char_131_flameb_CN_009.voiceText: {@nickname}, help me fetch those seeds in the cupboard, won't you? Thank you. Yes, I'm actually quite fond of flowers. No matter how brilliantly they blossom, their petals must wither and fall into the wind. When will the petals wither next, Doctor?

char_131_flameb_CN_011.voiceText: We meet again, {@nickname}. Don't worry, I understand the situation you're in now, and pose no threat to you. I shall be your blade, so use me as you see fit, Doctor.

char_131_flameb_CN_012.voiceText: The skills a great warrior needs are those which defy recording.

char_131_flameb_CN_013.voiceText: Promotion? What? So you actually care about these rituals now?

char_131_flameb_CN_014.voiceText: I have no concept of what it's like to be Infected. Perhaps Rhodes Island can help me understand. I don't care, but if you have your own considerations. Fine, I'll hear them out.

char_131_flameb_CN_017.voiceText: Ahh, I've longed for a hurricane of blood.

char_131_flameb_CN_018.voiceText: I've been a captain before, and it didn't end well.

char_131_flameb_CN_019.voiceText: I will bathe in their blood.

char_131_flameb_CN_023.voiceText: So, who shall be my opponent?

char_131_flameb_CN_024.voiceText: Will it be you? Or maybe you?

char_131_flameb_CN_027.voiceText: Whose name will you cry as you pass?

char_131_flameb_CN_030.voiceText: A weak enemy proves nothing. Search for a worthier battlefield.

char_131_flameb_CN_031.voiceText: A dedicated opponent will prove to be a worthy adversary in the future, let them do just that.

char_131_flameb_CN_032.voiceText: The rest of you, go. It has always been my job to destroy the pursuing enemy.

char_131_flameb_CN_036.voiceText: You're just in time, I find myself in need of a whetstone…

char_279_excu_CN_001.voiceText: Fragmentation mines deployed. None may interfere with your work or rest, Doctor. You can focus on your duty.

char_279_excu_CN_002.voiceText: I am well aware that Rhodes Island has its own specialists in countering infiltration, sabotage and assassination. I know not who is behind these, but they are operating covertly in every corner of this landship. My mind is just playing tricks on me? Negative, Doctor. My mind does not play tricks.

char_279_excu_CN_003.voiceText: I serve the Laterano Notarial Hall, so I rarely live in Laterano. But even if a Laterano citizen lives in other city-states, most of their rights and privileges still depend on the support of the Hall. In my case, for example, my work has less to do with the living, but more with those at death's door.

char_279_excu_CN_004.voiceText: The control system is denying you access? Please allow me to check it. Mm, it appears to be a front-end crash caused by inputting an erroneous command. It has nothing to do with the framework and can be easily solved. Doctor, please feel free to ask me if you have any similar issues in the future. I understand machines better than I do people.

char_279_excu_CN_005.voiceText: There are many Sankta at Rhodes Island who also use a gun. They will not fire at one other in the face of the law, but I am different. If necessary, I will not hesitate to fire upon my fraters. Of course, there is hardly a need for that, because my fists are sufficient to deal with most of them.

char_279_excu_CN_006.voiceText: Do not worry about the Notarial Hall. They are all reasonable people, and the agreement I signed with Rhodes Island is also in line with their protocols, so they won't make things difficult for you. As a matter of fact, Doctor, I think you are well suited for notarial work yourself. They always welcome foreign employees.

char_279_excu_CN_007.voiceText: I have a distant relative who had great musical talent ever since she was a child. Contrary to what others expected, her gift led her onto a tumultuous path. Fortunately, she seems to hate me very much, because I cannot see the illusion she creates, nor understand what emotion means to people.

char_279_excu_CN_008.voiceText: Private disputes are more frequent than public conflicts, as chaos is the norm over order. I have seen much more people who fired upon me at first glance than those who opened their doors to welcome me. But it matters not, for I can complete any commission, whether it is to kill a living person on behalf of the dead, or to create a dead person on  behalf of the living.

char_279_excu_CN_009.voiceText: Being treated as an aberration is normal to me, because I cannot understand other people, nor do I have any desire to deal with them. On the contrary, talking to you is quite interesting to me, Doctor. Neither you nor the Notarial Hall has denied me because of the way I live. You make me feel at ease. Thank you.

char_279_excu_CN_010.voiceText: Rest is necessary, Doctor. Take your time and rest well.

char_279_excu_CN_011.voiceText: Well met, Doctor of Rhodes Island. I am a Laterano citizen who signed a clean-up agreement with your company. Here is my certificate. You require to know my name? You may call me Executor, if you insist.

char_279_excu_CN_012.voiceText: There is value in referencing these battles.

char_279_excu_CN_013.voiceText: Thank you. I have already prepared all the ammunition I need for the next battle. If the situation worsens, please allow me to use heavier firepower. Promotion? I have already thanked you for that.

char_279_excu_CN_014.voiceText: Another promotion? I understand, there must be an infiltration operation that requires me at the heart of the enemy. If that's your wish, then I have no objections. You have no such a need? You are just promoting me? Why's that?

char_279_excu_CN_017.voiceText: The law won't enforce itself. It needs executors.

char_279_excu_CN_018.voiceText: I am not good at working with others.

char_279_excu_CN_024.voiceText: Only the law is the truth.

char_279_excu_CN_025.voiceText: My bullets always find their targets.

char_279_excu_CN_026.voiceText: I carry out the wills of the dead and the living.

char_279_excu_CN_028.voiceText: All is permitted when called by necessity.

char_279_excu_CN_029.voiceText: Mission completed. All contracts successfully fulfilled.

char_279_excu_CN_031.voiceText: Mission completed. Defects in the result.

char_279_excu_CN_033.voiceText: Do not worry about me. I have no need for stable residence.

char_279_excu_CN_036.voiceText: How can I help you, Doctor?

char_190_clour_CN_001.voiceText: Did you call me here for a new hunt? No? Gah…

char_190_clour_CN_002.voiceText: This claw pendant? It's a symbol of revenge. The Ursus mercenaries who hurt my people treat these things as dogtags, so there's no mistaking them.

char_190_clour_CN_003.voiceText: A beast took my left hand when I was hunting. Luckily, a mechanic gave me a prosthetic limb, so I can draw my bowstring again.

char_190_clour_CN_004.voiceText: There was a time when I would've turned anyone who mocked my scars into a pincushion! But if you ask me now... Well, people like that aren't even worth the trouble.

char_190_clour_CN_005.voiceText: If you're ever facing a difficult decision, let your instincts decide for you. Your body won't lie—This is what I've learned after a lifetime of hunts.

char_190_clour_CN_006.voiceText: I've been living alone ever since my village was wiped out.  So, I… I'm still getting used to being around people... But since you trust me and give me important work, I swear I'll return the favor.

char_190_clour_CN_007.voiceText: Ehh, a pebble got stuck in my prosthetic finger...? Darn it, I'm going to need a mechanic to fix it... N-No, I don't need you, I can handle this myself!

char_190_clour_CN_008.voiceText: You'll make sure I don't ever lose anyone else? Hmph. Big words. But I'll see for myself if you can back those up.

char_190_clour_CN_009.voiceText: The doctors here offered to get rid of my more recent scars, but I said no. I want to keep them. They're proof of my work here... You, you understand what I'm getting at?

char_190_clour_CN_010.voiceText: You're sleeping? Looks like this one can fall asleep almost anywhere. Well, that's a trait we hunters share…

char_190_clour_CN_011.voiceText: Vermeil, hunter. You won't regret giving me work.

char_190_clour_CN_012.voiceText: Can I take another look at that?

char_190_clour_CN_013.voiceText: Thank you, but... are you sure it's okay to promote someone like me?

char_190_clour_CN_014.voiceText: I don't really care about stuff like Oripathy or 'the rest of my life.' Right now, the happiest thing I can imagine is fighting by your side.

char_190_clour_CN_018.voiceText: You want me to be the captain? Am I... really cut out for the job?

char_190_clour_CN_019.voiceText: The big game hunt is about to start!

char_190_clour_CN_020.voiceText: You don't seem to understand your situation here. You've fallen into my trap.

char_190_clour_CN_023.voiceText: I can smell the game on the wind.

char_190_clour_CN_025.voiceText: You'd better start running, or there's only one way this ends.

char_190_clour_CN_026.voiceText: Don't underestimate the people of the wilderness.

char_190_clour_CN_028.voiceText: This arrow will find your throat!

char_190_clour_CN_029.voiceText: Strong game is still just game.

char_190_clour_CN_030.voiceText: Nice. If you were born in Siracusa, you would've been a great hunter.

char_190_clour_CN_031.voiceText: The target got away. I'm going after it.

char_190_clour_CN_032.voiceText: We can't let it end like this…

char_190_clour_CN_033.voiceText: This place has walls and a roof… that's enough for me.

char_190_clour_CN_036.voiceText: ...My plans for the day? Help you with missions. Shoot at enemies. Use up all my arrows. Finish the mission. Eat dinner, go to sleep. Simple enough.

char_213_mostma_CN_001.voiceText: Ahaha, aren't you the lucky one, Doctor? I don't have any work for the day, so I wouldn't mind keeping you company for a bit.

char_213_mostma_CN_002.voiceText: The marketplaces of Lungmen, the suburbs of Ursus, the ancient ruins of Victoria... Doctor, this world holds countless beautiful sights, but very few people will ever seek them out.

char_213_mostma_CN_003.voiceText: Doctor, do you want to hear a story of my journeys? In that case, I'd recommend preparing some fine tea cakes before we sit down. Otherwise, even the most fascinating tales will turn bland.

char_213_mostma_CN_004.voiceText: I've witnessed the rise and fall of many organizations, but so far, Rhodes Island is the most interesting one I've seen. Will the epochs bend to your will, or finally swallow you whole? ...I'm dying to find out.

char_213_mostma_CN_005.voiceText: Doctor, concerning our next destination, I have a few recommendations for where we can get some good food. Interested?

char_213_mostma_CN_006.voiceText: Doctor, you seem to already know a thing or two about fallen angels. Unfortunately, I can't give you any more details than that. Even if I could share everything else with you one day, this would remain my solitary secret.

char_213_mostma_CN_007.voiceText: Doctor, you don't need to concern yourself with how to have a good relationship with me. For me, friends, family, and love... I have nothing against them, but I don't need them either. Heh, not like that's going to stop you from trying, right? Well, I don't really mind, so give it your best shot~

char_213_mostma_CN_008.voiceText: I'm back... Huh? No way, Doctor, were you seriously waiting here for me the whole time? You even brought snacks... Hah, all right. If you're going to go this far, I guess I can't turn you down. As thanks, I'll tell you about something interesting that happened on a delivery run.

char_213_mostma_CN_009.voiceText: ...I see now. When I thought of having a friend like you, the spark of joy I felt wasn't fake after all. Scrap what I said before, Doctor. Maybe I do need a bit of warmth in my life.

char_213_mostma_CN_011.voiceText: Hey there, Doctor. You might've heard from Emperor that I'm not bound by the contract between Penguin Logistics and Rhodes Island, and can therefore act independently. Having that said, I'll probably be staying here anyway when I'm not busy, so I'll see you around~

char_213_mostma_CN_012.voiceText: Let me see how Rhodes Island fights.

char_213_mostma_CN_013.voiceText: Doctor, relying on me isn't a very wise decision.

char_213_mostma_CN_014.voiceText: Doctor, you really want to see me go all out? Just for the record, I'd like to ask - I won't have to worry about paying for the collateral damage after this, right?

char_213_mostma_CN_018.voiceText: Hmm... Sorry, but why don't we let everyone do their own thing?

char_213_mostma_CN_019.voiceText: If this is the place... I'll lead the way.

char_213_mostma_CN_025.voiceText: Seventy percent-ish should do the trick.

char_213_mostma_CN_026.voiceText: Isn't it about time to wrap things up?

char_213_mostma_CN_027.voiceText: I have nothing against you guys, but this is just a part of life.

char_213_mostma_CN_028.voiceText: What should we get to eat after this?

char_213_mostma_CN_029.voiceText: Some thrill-seeking every now and then isn't half bad either.

char_213_mostma_CN_030.voiceText: Hm? I thought I missed a few, but I guess that's a job well done.

char_213_mostma_CN_031.voiceText: For a transporter, the results of a battle don't really matter. Just surviving is enough of a victory.

char_213_mostma_CN_032.voiceText: I guess I don't get this whole 'teamwork' thing after all...

char_213_mostma_CN_033.voiceText: Mind if I go wander around?

char_325_bison_CN_001.voiceText: Doctor, do you need my help transporting anything?
