char_325_bison_CN_002.voiceText: This noisy metal music... sounds like Exusiai is throwing another one of her parties again. Doctor, should I go reprimand her?

char_325_bison_CN_003.voiceText: I'm quite good with manual labor. I also know a bit about company management as well. So, Doctor, is there anywhere I can be of use?

char_325_bison_CN_004.voiceText: My parents were the first generation to settle in Lungmen, so I'm actually a Lungmen native... Doctor, if there's anything you'd like to learn about it, I wouldn't mind helping you out.

char_325_bison_CN_005.voiceText: Doctor, if you want to know how a real logistics company operates, it'd be best to just ask me directly. Penguin Logistics is more of an exception than the rule, and though I don't mean this in a bad way, they don't have any reference value whatsoever.

char_325_bison_CN_006.voiceText: What do I like to do outside of work? Other than just resting, I'll sometimes accompany Croissant on her shopping trips and make sure she doesn't waste too much money... Doctor, do you also want to come along?

char_325_bison_CN_007.voiceText: I used to believe that for any company to survive in the long run, standardization and efficiency were of critical importance. That's why at first, I couldn't fathom how a company like Penguin Logistics could stay afloat.

char_325_bison_CN_008.voiceText: After getting to know more about the people at Penguin Logistics and talking to them, I began to understand that the world is much broader than I had thought. There's nothing wrong with structure and rules, but they don't necessarily apply to everyone.

char_325_bison_CN_009.voiceText: Doctor, perhaps you haven't realized this yourself, but the fact that you can unite so many people with very different personalities under one banner is no simple feat... It'd be great if I could become more like you one day.

char_325_bison_CN_010.voiceText: Doctor... You're taking a nap? I guess it can wait. Guess I'll start tidying up the place first.

char_325_bison_CN_011.voiceText: Pleased to meet you, Doctor. My name is Bison. According to the terms of our contract, I will now also be a member of Rhodes Island. I look forward to working with you.

char_325_bison_CN_012.voiceText: Thank you very much. I will make sure to learn from this.

char_325_bison_CN_013.voiceText: Thank you very much, Doctor. As long as I put my best foot forward, my hard work will be rewarded. This is what I believe.

char_325_bison_CN_014.voiceText: At Penguin Logistics and Rhodes Island, I saw a more expansive world than before... Doctor, one day, I will also find my place in this world.

char_325_bison_CN_018.voiceText: On-site command? I have some experience with that.

char_325_bison_CN_019.voiceText: Yes, I've noted the mission location and objectives.

char_325_bison_CN_020.voiceText: Hah... I won't be a burden on the others.

char_325_bison_CN_021.voiceText: What would you like me to do?

char_325_bison_CN_026.voiceText: Hang in there a bit longer? Understood.

char_325_bison_CN_027.voiceText: Don't worry, my shield still holds firm.

char_325_bison_CN_029.voiceText: Way to go, Doctor! You must be the kind of leader that every company wants to have if you wanted to change jobs.

char_325_bison_CN_030.voiceText: Wow, Doctor... You really are amazing!

char_325_bison_CN_031.voiceText: The basic objectives of the mission have been accomplished. This should be good enough, right?

char_325_bison_CN_032.voiceText: Don't feel down, Doctor. We'll have another chance.

char_325_bison_CN_033.voiceText: So this is the inside of Rhodes Island... It sure is big.

char_325_bison_CN_036.voiceText: Sora's new album is really good.

char_243_waaifu_CN_001.voiceText: Doctor, where are you going? Shouldn't you be working? Lunch? Well then, I'm coming along. There's a few things I want to buy, and I can also keep a lookout for you.

char_243_waaifu_CN_002.voiceText: Sorry, Doctor, Rhodes Island is just a part-time job for me. I have to study hard to make sure I have a nice, normal future ahead of me. If you plan to have me aboard and on 24-hour call… Well, I'll have to ask you reconsider that.

char_243_waaifu_CN_003.voiceText: I color coded all the documents to be sent out, the backups have already been delivered, your schedule is right here. I bought your late night snack and put it in the refrigerator. Don't forget to heat it up. And last, oh, do you need me to change the light bulb in your office for you?

char_243_waaifu_CN_004.voiceText: Did I ever tell you about my other job? No? Well, I won't. Don't look at me like that, Doctor. There's just not much to say. If my other office worked a tenth as hard as Rhodes Island does, they'd probably have become the only detective agency in Lungmen.

char_243_waaifu_CN_005.voiceText: You wonder where I learned martial arts? Well, I have my old codger and his weird education to thank for that. Not that I resent kung fu. Martial arts should always be a part of me if I hope to uphold justice.

char_243_waaifu_CN_006.voiceText: Just like how people value morality, martial arts have yin and yang, right and wrong. To right those wrongs, to defeat evil, to counter bad kung fu, these are all second nature to me. The world is dark, and someone must stand for justice.

char_243_waaifu_CN_007.voiceText: You think you just saw me? In downtown Lungmen? That may have been me. I just finished class. Hm? You saw me beat down some thugs who were harassing a passerby? And then slipped away before the police arrived? Must have been someone else. Heh heh. Definitely. You were just seeing things, that's it.

char_243_waaifu_CN_008.voiceText: My rotten dad said he had to go find the true meaning of kung fu before he went off, and I still don't know where he is. Please! What year does he think it is? Find some common sense and learn some responsibility before you get yourself killed. But at least I haven't forgotten what he taught me: 'Martial arts have martial virtue, humans have human kindness.'

char_243_waaifu_CN_009.voiceText: Doctor, did any mail come for me? It did? Great. They included my grade report inside... I need them for a lot of things. It's been straight A's for me, so far. If I don't work hard enough, I'll end up regretting all the things I wasn't strong enough to do.

char_243_waaifu_CN_010.voiceText: Falling asleep at a time like this... Oh well, I'll just finish your work for you.

char_243_waaifu_CN_011.voiceText: Is this Rhodes Island? Nice to meet you. I'm Waai Fu, your new part-timer. Please don't go easy on me. I can handle anything you ask of me. Yes, just give me the word.

char_243_waaifu_CN_012.voiceText: If I can fight like this here, I can definitely knock them out.

char_243_waaifu_CN_013.voiceText: Thank you very much, Doctor. You placed your trust in me, and I won't let you down.

char_243_waaifu_CN_014.voiceText: I often witness injustices in my life. If I ever find myself unable to stop them, I reflect on the moment, and force myself to get stronger. So, if ever you need me, don't hesitate to say so. I'll be there, with all my strength!

char_243_waaifu_CN_018.voiceText: I have much to learn, but I won't turn down the responsibility.

char_243_waaifu_CN_019.voiceText: Fight evil with the fist of justice!

char_243_waaifu_CN_020.voiceText: Like cutting weeds and pulling roots!

char_243_waaifu_CN_025.voiceText: You have crossed the line too far!

char_243_waaifu_CN_026.voiceText: Pick on someone your own size!

char_243_waaifu_CN_027.voiceText: Don't blink! Song Do Bart Cham style!

char_243_waaifu_CN_028.voiceText: The mind directs, the fist executes!

char_243_waaifu_CN_029.voiceText: Foul intentions lead a foul life. Repent now. There is still time.

char_243_waaifu_CN_031.voiceText: That was not enough. I need to train more.

char_243_waaifu_CN_032.voiceText: Father... I'm still... not strong enough.

char_243_waaifu_CN_033.voiceText: At least it's better than some old, messy detective agency.

char_243_waaifu_CN_034.voiceText: An ambush...?! ...Doctor, don't you ever sneak up on me like that again. Now let's get you to Medical first.

char_243_waaifu_CN_036.voiceText: You want to go for a walk? Sure, let's get going. It's safer to have me with you.

char_133_mm_CN_001.voiceText: Doctor, even though I'm now your employee, if your conduct is even slightly shady, I won't stand by idly!

char_133_mm_CN_002.voiceText: Rhodes Island has a suspicious smell about it...

char_133_mm_CN_003.voiceText: Careful observation is fundamental to all investigations! It might seem basic, but it always works!

char_133_mm_CN_004.voiceText: You, over there! Face me, and put your hands where I can see 'em! Ah, sorry... I got the wrong person...

char_133_mm_CN_005.voiceText: I always thought that penguin over there is super suspicious. Look, even though it dresses like that, it spends money like it's water or something. It's even wearing a gold necklace! You know how much detectives like me make... that kind of lifestyle is simply unthinkable!

char_133_mm_CN_006.voiceText: Mmmm... so frustrating! How am I going to investigate that shady logistics company? ...Should I break in? Err, but those two guards give off fierce vibes that make my skin crawl... No, no, I'm not scared or anything, I'll just have to use my head and come up with a plan!

char_133_mm_CN_007.voiceText: Why are you giving me this bean paste bun? I would neber eat shumfing libe ris on an inweshtigation, you musht watch too mush TV or...(chewing)... A real detective only eats donuts while on a mission!

char_133_mm_CN_008.voiceText: Three months, then three months after that. Then another three months after that. I've already been undercover for ten months! Chief, what the heck is going on...? ...Hey! You scoundrels, stop eavesdropping on my call!

char_133_mm_CN_009.voiceText: Doctor, that penguin seems to have noticed that I'm investigating it... I'm starting to fear for my life...!

char_133_mm_CN_010.voiceText: Wake up! Waaake uppp! Stop slacking off!

char_133_mm_CN_011.voiceText: I'm the Royal Detective, May. Please cooperate with my investigation! Eh? I've got the wrong address? Impossible! I have evidence that proves that penguin is hiding here!

char_133_mm_CN_012.voiceText: Don't I look super cool when I'm conducting my investigation?

char_133_mm_CN_013.voiceText: Thank you for the promotion Chief I'm so very grateful for... Hey, wait, you aren't even my real boss!

char_133_mm_CN_014.voiceText: Elite team? Hey, I'm a Royal Detective! Why am I being promoted by some mercenary organization?!

char_133_mm_CN_017.voiceText: Be careful not to let any shady people onto the team.

char_133_mm_CN_018.voiceText: Hehehe! Leader? Nay, call me Inspector General!

char_133_mm_CN_019.voiceText: All troops, move out! All troops, moooove outttt!!

char_133_mm_CN_020.voiceText: You criminals! Behave and turn yourselves in!

char_133_mm_CN_023.voiceText: It's time to investigate the scene!

char_133_mm_CN_027.voiceText: Now you're going to get a taste of my taser!

char_133_mm_CN_028.voiceText: It won't hurt, it'll just give you a little buzz!

char_133_mm_CN_029.voiceText: For a master detective, there is no case that can't be solved!

char_133_mm_CN_030.voiceText: Take away all these suspects! Ugh... Fine, I'll do it myself...

char_133_mm_CN_031.voiceText: Hmm... I feel like we missed some of the clues?

char_133_mm_CN_033.voiceText: I have a hunch as to what will happen here!

char_133_mm_CN_034.voiceText: You and your villainous hand! I'll remember this!

char_133_mm_CN_036.voiceText: D-don't think you can wash away your crime just like that...!

char_356_broca_CN_002.voiceText: That Amiya girl is one of this place's leaders? What a black-hearted organization Rhodes Island is.

char_356_broca_CN_003.voiceText: I have no intent on being a freeloader. If you need any manual labor done, just let me know.

char_356_broca_CN_004.voiceText: I have nothing against taking orders, but I don't like fighting without knowing why I'm doing it.

char_356_broca_CN_005.voiceText: My hobbies? I have no reason to tell you, do I? ...Good grief, stop making that face. You'll leave me alone if I tell you, right... I like modifying various things.

char_356_broca_CN_006.voiceText: Back then, had it not been for Chiave and Aosta, I would've been dead in that alley. So, my life belongs to them. No matter what they want me to do, I will do it without hesitation.

char_356_broca_CN_007.voiceText: I don't hate you, but... I find it difficult to fully trust you.

char_356_broca_CN_008.voiceText: Work hard, make money, and continue surviving. I used to think that was all there was to life. However, Aosta was right. In a country like Siracusa, something like that is nothing more than a pipe dream.

char_356_broca_CN_009.voiceText: I acknowledge your right to lead.... However, Aosta once said that corruption begins to seep into an organization the moment you let your guard down. To prevent that from happening, I'll be keeping a close eye on you.

char_356_broca_CN_010.voiceText: Asleep? Good grief, what a carefree fellow... Tch, where'd the blanket go...

char_356_broca_CN_011.voiceText: Since Chiave decided for me to join you, I don't have much else to say. You can call me Broca. I will listen to your orders, but don't count on me to do anything extra. I have no love for large organizations like yours.

char_356_broca_CN_014.voiceText: Maybe Aosta was right, maybe Rhodes Island is trustworthy. If that's the case, I...

char_356_broca_CN_030.voiceText: They've all been taken care of.

char_356_broca_CN_031.voiceText: Need me to go after them?

char_356_broca_CN_032.voiceText: No need to panic. You did what you could. Even Aosta makes mistakes.

char_261_sddrag_CN_001.voiceText: Doctor, here is the paperwork. Is it strange to see me on clerical errands? The truth is, compared to battle, I much prefer... writing...

char_261_sddrag_CN_002.voiceText: Doctor, look outside the window. The night is quiet... and peaceful. Up until now, every night has been filled with the red light of fire, and the stench of burning. I only feel easier... on nights like tonight.

char_261_sddrag_CN_003.voiceText: There's been a—red-haired Vouivre girl, who never stops staring at me... Does she suspect my identity? But... she wouldn't have any evidence... Hm. I'm not going to let her find me out.

char_261_sddrag_CN_004.voiceText: Is it time for my regular medical examination? Un... Understood. But... I don't trust those other doctors. If I have to be examined, I want... you to help me with it.

char_261_sddrag_CN_005.voiceText: You all have a lot of questions, but I can't answer any of them. This is for your own sakes, and I encourage you ... not to overestimate yourselves.

char_261_sddrag_CN_006.voiceText: ...I am strong. I know the terrifying power I hold, though I... have no love for it. But if you desire it—then yes, I will fight...

char_261_sddrag_CN_007.voiceText: This spear... I am not able to fully use its power. Despite that, I've had it take so many lives. Guilt? ...No, I have no guilt. After all, our lives are all equally worthless

char_261_sddrag_CN_008.voiceText: I do not mind my Oripathy... Without it, I would never have spent my days here. It will take my life? I—still do not mind it... So many other things across this land could kill just the same, why then... would you fixated on this particular one?

char_261_sddrag_CN_009.voiceText: I am a shadow, but I do not spurn that. I am only able to stay here, incognito, because I am a shadow... However... however... if someone with the same face as me ever finds you, do not fight her! You will die. I don't... I don't want you dead...

char_261_sddrag_CN_010.voiceText: I will stand vigil for you, so... please rest at ease. Good night.

char_261_sddrag_CN_011.voiceText: You were the ones... who saved me? You want my name? ...Just 'Reed' is fine... like the reeds by a pond. A nondescript existence...

char_261_sddrag_CN_012.voiceText: Your battles are—very bitter... but, this way, many more may continue to live.

char_261_sddrag_CN_013.voiceText: Forward, soldiers of Dublinn! ...I was constantly forced to give these words, but in reality—I hated them...

char_261_sddrag_CN_014.voiceText: You have a dream that calms my soul... and I want to help you accomplish it. So long as I rouse the fires of Dublinn, they may come to light your way in the dark of night.

char_261_sddrag_CN_017.voiceText: The fires of war will char the wilderness...

char_261_sddrag_CN_018.voiceText: Just as you have exhorted me, I will no longer neglect the lives of others...

char_261_sddrag_CN_019.voiceText: And so, we go to harvest...

char_261_sddrag_CN_020.voiceText: Why do you burn as easily as stalks of wheat...?

char_261_sddrag_CN_022.voiceText: No one else will see I am here, will they...?

char_261_sddrag_CN_025.voiceText: The living blaze will purify your tainted souls.

char_261_sddrag_CN_029.voiceText: Endless battles, flames that never cease to smolder... This isn't what you truly desire, is it?

char_261_sddrag_CN_030.voiceText: Should this fight be for the sake of our shared future, I will bear anything...

char_261_sddrag_CN_031.voiceText: What else can we hope to gain from the battlefield? Let's go. Hurry, let's go home...

char_261_sddrag_CN_032.voiceText: No. I won't let anyone hurt you... I swear it.

char_261_sddrag_CN_033.voiceText: Can I have a separate room? I don't mind how small it may be...

char_261_sddrag_CN_036.voiceText: Doctor... won't my body temperature burn you?

char_017_huang_CN_001.voiceText: C'mon, I'm no good with paperwork. You sure you want me here in the office? I'd be better out in the field. Wouldn't you rather I brought home some wins?

char_017_huang_CN_002.voiceText: I fight for the Infected. Life for our people is rough, anyone with eyes can see that. It's just that most people don't give a damn about our lives. But I do, I care a lot. We've got so many operators here counting on me, and I'm NOT about to let them down.

char_017_huang_CN_003.voiceText: The reason I work for Rhodes Island? Because I've got nowhere better to be, naturally. But I've gotta be honest, I can't think of any place better than here. The pay's good, the medical treatment is cutting edge, and we've even got a cute little rabbit. It's just brilliant. What could be better?

char_017_huang_CN_004.voiceText: I'm one of Rhodes Island's frontline breachers, I don't have powerful Arts that wipe the field, and it's not like my combat techniques could down a whole army. But, if I combine the two things I'm good at, then BOOM! You get quick results. I think that's what they call a chemical reaction.

char_017_huang_CN_005.voiceText: Amiya is one of the most talented fighters I've ever met. She keeps a clear head in any situation, and her Arts are enough to scare even me.  You know, Doctor, I can't help but wonder, how did she get so good at fighting, as young as she is? Honestly, I wish she was picking up joyful, happy experiences, not the combat kind.

char_017_huang_CN_006.voiceText: If you need my help, no need to be shy - just say the word! You put your trust in me, and I return the favor. You command, I fight. It's symbiotic. Aw, look at us! We're the best partners in all Rhodes Island! Oh, don't tell Amiya I said that.

char_017_huang_CN_007.voiceText: The crew's been buzzing about who you used to be, before your memory loss. They were talking back before I even met you. It looks to me like you aren't the same person anymore. Soooo, I guess I'm talking about two different Doctors? Past Doctor and Present Doctor, hah!

char_017_huang_CN_008.voiceText: Dr. Kal'tsit says you're going to really shoulder responsibility for Rhodes Island someday. She saved my life, and I trust her. She also asked me to decide what kind of person you are for myself. And I'm going to do that, at least until Oripathy takes my life.

char_017_huang_CN_009.voiceText: Hey, Doctor, pass me that towel, would you? Yeah, just finished training. I need at least six hours every day to stay combat-ready. Gotta roll out whenever the order comes in, you know. Alright, I've kept you waiting long enough. So where are we going this time? If that's the plan, I guess you're picking up the tab?

char_017_huang_CN_010.voiceText: Would people get the wrong idea if I carried the Doctor to bed? Maybe I'm better off leaving well enough alone…

char_017_huang_CN_011.voiceText: Rhodes Island Operator, Blaze, reporting in. Here, the authorization letter signed by Dr. Kal'tsit. Now I'm under your direct command. Alrighty, Doctor, let's show the other squads what we can do!

char_017_huang_CN_012.voiceText: I've seen a lot of battles like this. But tougher times might still be ahead of us.

char_017_huang_CN_013.voiceText: Hehe, can you feel the air getting hotter? No? Reeaaally? Then I'd better kick things up a notch. Aww, I was trying to get you fired up.

char_017_huang_CN_014.voiceText: Us Rhodes Island Operators put all our trust in Amiya, Dr. Kal'tsit, and you, Present Doctor. Because you've never given up on any of us. Fighting for the Infected is the right thing to do. It's worth it, Doctor.

char_017_huang_CN_017.voiceText: Time for combat? Count me in!

char_017_huang_CN_018.voiceText: Alright, I'm the leader, huh? I got this, I know all about wiping out hostiles!

char_017_huang_CN_019.voiceText: Us frontline breachers have high standards. Try to keep up!

char_017_huang_CN_020.voiceText: It may be a little gruesome, but I love shredding steel and crushing bunkers!

char_017_huang_CN_021.voiceText: You know, it wasn't easy learning high-temperature vapor dynamics!

char_017_huang_CN_022.voiceText: Let me show you the chainsaw techniques the other elite operators taught me!

char_017_huang_CN_023.voiceText: This place could use some heat.

char_017_huang_CN_024.voiceText: Hear the roar of my chainsaw!

char_017_huang_CN_025.voiceText: Don't worry if you see fire, that's just a side effect!

char_017_huang_CN_026.voiceText: Surrender now if you don't want to get sawed in half!

char_017_huang_CN_027.voiceText: My blood's only gonna make this place hotter!

char_017_huang_CN_028.voiceText: Fresh blood coats my saw, and boils the whole battlefield!

char_017_huang_CN_029.voiceText: No sacrifice is meaningless, and no victory comes without a cost.

char_017_huang_CN_030.voiceText: The rights of the Infected will only be won by the actions of the Infected!

char_017_huang_CN_031.voiceText: Let's work harder next time. We can always do better, right?

char_017_huang_CN_032.voiceText: Let's just say luck wasn't on our side this time.

char_017_huang_CN_033.voiceText: Any new facilities at Rhodes Island this time?

char_017_huang_CN_036.voiceText: Wait a second! I'm way too sweaty!

char_017_huang_CN_042.voiceText: Doctor, when are we heading out on our next mission?

char_367_swllow_CN_001.voiceText: Fine. At least I can get a break from the dusty air outside, if I stay here with you.

char_367_swllow_CN_002.voiceText: I don't shy away from sensitive discussions about the Infected? That's true. They're obviously different from us. But they also have the right to seize hope, just like us. So they don't need me to do anything special for them. That's equality, isn't it?

char_367_swllow_CN_003.voiceText: Blaze is too reckless sometimes. I know she's strong, but… What? You know how to handle her?  Forget it, I'll ask Amiya what I should do to get along with her after we get back.

char_367_swllow_CN_004.voiceText: I was just speaking objectively. If you don't want to be discriminated against, then you shouldn't expect special treatment... What, she went back to her room crying? Look, I feel a little bad about it, but is someone that fragile really operator material?

char_367_swllow_CN_005.voiceText: Rhodes Island is changing, Doctor. Maybe you don't feel it, since you're the reason it's changing, and not everyone is so annoyingly outspoken as I am. Anyway, I do appreciate the direction Rhodes Island is moving.

char_367_swllow_CN_006.voiceText: I used to prefer long-distance missions, like I was running away from Rhodes Island. I'll admit that was a little ungrateful, considering Rhodes Island adopted me. But now? Hehe, if you still have operators who like splattering blood all over the place, maybe I'll apply to serve in some faraway place again.

char_367_swllow_CN_007.voiceText: Doctor, would you sometimes feel afraid? Catastrophes, Originium, Oripathy, and the Infected? Hm, I'm still plagued by nightmares even now. But these days, I have Amiya, and idiots like that Blaze. I guess I'm not as afraid as I used to be.

char_367_swllow_CN_008.voiceText: Why are you called 'Doctor?' No, I'm not trying to get you to remember anything, it's just that title makes me very... wistful. Looking at all the Infected around you... Brings to mind a little bit of the past.

char_367_swllow_CN_009.voiceText: I've known the whole time. When my mother brought me to Rhodes Island, she'd already lost her mind. I didn't feel the pain her inner conflicts caused her, but I can relate to it, because I relied on that obsession to get me to where I am today. Only now, I've found a new direction... I want to find her, and I want to save her.

char_367_swllow_CN_010.voiceText: You shoulder the future of Rhodes Island. And with the burden of that responsibility, you can't be so lackadaisical.

char_367_swllow_CN_011.voiceText: So you're the Doctor? Amiya told me about you. I'm GreyThroat. Please don't disappoint me.

char_367_swllow_CN_012.voiceText: For efficiency's sake, speed up the playback. I'll still be able to see it all clearly.

char_367_swllow_CN_013.voiceText: Even now, I'm still on bad terms with a handful of operators. My promotion might spark controversy, just a reminder.

char_367_swllow_CN_014.voiceText: Whether Infected or not, we all choose to walk upon this land of our own free will. And so we must all work hard to survive, right?

char_367_swllow_CN_018.voiceText: Whether or not they'll listen to my orders is another matter.

char_367_swllow_CN_019.voiceText: A panoramic view of the battlefield.

char_367_swllow_CN_020.voiceText: I just have to rout them, right?

char_367_swllow_CN_026.voiceText: I see them. Too bad they don't see me.

char_367_swllow_CN_027.voiceText: I'm skilled enough to resolve this.

char_367_swllow_CN_028.voiceText: Don't worry, their sights are totally empty.

char_367_swllow_CN_029.voiceText: We won't see many victories like this, since our power is limited.

char_367_swllow_CN_030.voiceText: I have no talent to speak of. So as a crossbowman, I can't let an enemy within three meters. Not even a corpse.

char_367_swllow_CN_031.voiceText: The medics should stay behind to tend the wounded. I will chase after them, considering I'm used to working alone anyway.

char_367_swllow_CN_032.voiceText: Watch your flanks. I'll cover our retreat.

char_367_swllow_CN_033.voiceText: I've been here for years, but I rarely wander around inside…

char_367_swllow_CN_036.voiceText: Aren't you afraid of upsetting the Infected operators if they see you with me all the time?

char_302_glaze_CN_001.voiceText: Any work today? If it's nothing urgent, let's put it off till later.

char_302_glaze_CN_002.voiceText: My Arts detect nearby creatures, and this auxiliary device even amplifies the ability. Sounds great, right? That's why the Garrison Team sent me to patrol the city, in case any students were trying to climb the walls and skip school. I gotta admit, they sure know how to put people to work.

char_302_glaze_CN_003.voiceText: Just for the record, the so-called secret of Laterano or whatever? I don't know a single thing about it. I'm just after the easy life. The less I know, the better off I'll be, don't you think?

char_302_glaze_CN_004.voiceText: Hmm? Isn't that guy over there from the Notarial Hall...? What? He wants to make sure I'm 'fulfilling my obligations?' Dear Lord! I pay my taxes on time every month, okay? Anyway, just give me a whisper if he's looking for me. I need time to run and hide.

char_302_glaze_CN_005.voiceText: I was really bored, so I went down to the bridge to chill out… Err, I mean, I wanted to enjoy the scenery. But everybody was looking at me like I was there to assassinate somebody. Man, they really take me for a killer? As if I'd ever want a job like that. Way too much trouble.

char_302_glaze_CN_006.voiceText: My old brass would always drone on about 'defending the glory of Laterano with your life' and blah blah blah. But that kind of stuff is so boring. I hated how dead-end my life was back then. Working with Rhodes Island is way better. You give me something more practical.

char_302_glaze_CN_007.voiceText: My hair's a little messy? Meh, I forgot to deal with my bed head. It's not like I have a mission today... Aww, this sucks... Can you tell me if my braid is crooked? It feels kinda weird. You really oughta have a mirror in your office, you know.

char_302_glaze_CN_008.voiceText: Here, I got you a cake. So, what do you usually do during your breaks? You really should take a lap around the city, get yourself some fresh air, don't you think? If you're worried about your safety, just grab an operator who can go 'pow pow' on any baddies who pop up, and you're set.

char_302_glaze_CN_009.voiceText: Wanna watch a movie? We're almost done with work anyway. How about... this romance about a princess and a wanderer from afar? Wait, I need to hang up my do-not-disturb sign. Wouldn't want someone walking in with a pile of documents.

char_302_glaze_CN_010.voiceText: Break time. Now, what should I do...?

char_302_glaze_CN_011.voiceText: Ambriel, sniper, from Laterano… Alright, that's introductions out of the way before they give me a headache. Here, I just opened this pack of chocolate pretzel sticks. Want one?

char_302_glaze_CN_012.voiceText: Man, how long is this video…? Is there no option to play all of them at once?

char_302_glaze_CN_013.voiceText: Much obliged. Oh, speaking of which, do these promotions come with a salary increase? There's something I've been looking at…

char_302_glaze_CN_014.voiceText: Thank you very much. I've been with Rhodes Island for a while now, right? Before I knew it, I'd gotten a whole lot out of this, and made some good memories too.

char_302_glaze_CN_017.voiceText: Woah, my teammates look pretty capable this time.

char_302_glaze_CN_018.voiceText: Just a heads-up for you, my tactics are a little unorthodox.

char_302_glaze_CN_020.voiceText: I hope we can wrap this mission up before dinner.

char_302_glaze_CN_022.voiceText: Let me finish this choco stick first.

char_302_glaze_CN_026.voiceText: Well, well, well, somebody's no good at hiding.

char_302_glaze_CN_029.voiceText: You always win big like this, Doctor. You're really something!

char_302_glaze_CN_030.voiceText: Not a single shot wasted - perfect.

char_302_glaze_CN_031.voiceText: Not the prettiest victory, but a win's a win, right?

char_302_glaze_CN_032.voiceText: The number of targets is still increasing, and they're about to launch an attack. Doctor, let's get out of here...

char_302_glaze_CN_033.voiceText: Doctor! Time to restock the pretzel sticks in the vending machine!

char_302_glaze_CN_036.voiceText: I hear some new clothes came into the store? Doctor, come check 'em out with me!

char_2014_nian_CN_001.voiceText: Man, I'm so bored... Might just go shopping... You know what, yeah, we're doing it! Come on, put your shoes on. Yeah, we're both going out, that's why I said 'we'!

char_2014_nian_CN_002.voiceText: That lame look of yours is grinding my gears... Here, have a toy to lighten up. You're busy with work? Who cares about some boring-ass work? Just one thing: don't lose sight of this little doll, or it'll vanish in the blink of an eye.

char_2014_nian_CN_003.voiceText: Maaan, I'm so hungry... But as they say, gourmet food takes a gourmet cook. My brother's a great chef, you get hungry at one of our family reunions, just call him up and he'll take care of you. Now that's what I call service! Rhodes Island's food tastes like crap compared to his.

char_2014_nian_CN_004.voiceText: Lungmen's a pretty chill place, but their cuisine? It's got no kick to it! How can they eat that flavorless baby food? Listen up: spice is a way of life. Once you taste a little pleasant pain and feel that explosion of heat on your tongue, you'll realize what you've been missing all this time.

char_2014_nian_CN_005.voiceText: I used to just focus myself on what I needed for daily life, but I'm the type to really absorb my surroundings. And somehow or other I keep getting into fights. So I guess I could say it feels weird to NOT carry a weapon around. So it goes, I guess.

char_2014_nian_CN_006.voiceText: Rituals get passed down from generation to generation not 'cause they have any inherent meaning, but because people find their own meaning in them. A performance has its rewards, and a wish has its fulfillment. And when one of my favorite stories is involved, you bet your ass I'm gonna participate.

char_2014_nian_CN_007.voiceText: If you're out of touch with reality, you'll end up crushed beneath its boot, sooner or later. You'd think that's common freakin' sense, but some of my siblings ignore reality for what it is. Their dull lives are only gonna get harder for 'em as time goes on.

char_2014_nian_CN_008.voiceText: Your dreams turn to haze when you've lived as long as I have. But I've got better stuff to do than dream all day, and that's why l feel so alive. Sure, life is suffering, but seeing people carve something out for themselves is incredible. And as for you: think you got what it takes to be the anvil to my hammer?

char_2014_nian_CN_009.voiceText: Blacksmithing may just be a regular old occupation, but it was also a part of early civilization. I'll keep metallurgy well and alive, even if everything else dies out. That's the future I chose for myself long ago. And you, you've made important choices before, haven'tcha? Don't ever go back on them. Stay true to the end and see it through. That's what it means to complete something.

char_2014_nian_CN_010.voiceText: You're sleeping AGAIN? Wake up, sunshine! We're going shopping! C'mon, hurry!

char_2014_nian_CN_011.voiceText: Anybody home? Heard from one of your guys that I can make a comfy living here! Something about free lodging and food, with plenty of free time left over... Hm? This area is for staff only? Don't be like that! You make it sound like I don't belong here!

char_2014_nian_CN_012.voiceText: Huh? What good do you think this stuff's gonna do me? Skills like these are only useful to people who value them.

char_2014_nian_CN_013.voiceText: A promotion? That takes me back... I got something like this once before. Anyway, that's cool, I guess. You have my thanks!

char_2014_nian_CN_014.voiceText: People are like tools; you can classify 'em. And you, you're an interesting one... Or should I say 'unusual'? I could forge you a good sword, but since you ain't gonna swing it, let alone fight in the first place, it'd just be a waste of metal.

char_2014_nian_CN_017.voiceText: Guess one thing's never gonna change with time: swords will inevitably clash.

char_2014_nian_CN_018.voiceText: Say what? Lead the team? Never led anyone before, but I guess I'll try.

char_2014_nian_CN_019.voiceText: A smith's gotta be ready to pay the debts accrued by the weapons she forges.

char_2014_nian_CN_020.voiceText: My sword's gonna cleave your bodies and values alike.

char_2014_nian_CN_021.voiceText: Oh? You want me to handle this(, personally)?

char_2014_nian_CN_022.voiceText: A knife, a life; weapons are the basis for society.

char_2014_nian_CN_023.voiceText: 'When 'tis a choice of life and death, why shouldst thou lay down thy arms?'

char_2014_nian_CN_024.voiceText: Let's just get this done with.

char_2014_nian_CN_025.voiceText: You dare strike my shield with your spear? That's gonna end with you in pieces!

char_2014_nian_CN_026.voiceText: My body burns at over 1,400 degrees!

char_2014_nian_CN_027.voiceText: Even a virtuous king must, from time to time, look to the sword.

char_2014_nian_CN_028.voiceText: Why do I gotta waste my precious time on the likes of you third-rate amateurs?

char_2014_nian_CN_029.voiceText: Not bad! I see some faint promise in you!

char_2014_nian_CN_030.voiceText: These small fry ain't even close to quelling my hunger.

char_2014_nian_CN_031.voiceText: Man, you sure messed up. What'd I tell you about air bubbles weakening the iron?

char_2014_nian_CN_032.voiceText: Terrible... If I really let myself loose, things would get a whole lot nastier... for everyone involved.

char_2014_nian_CN_033.voiceText: Mind if I do some redecorating in here?

char_2014_nian_CN_036.voiceText: Hold still! I'm making you a little something for your ear. It'll look great, just don't move!

char_2014_nian_CN_042.voiceText: Yo, Doctor, you had lunch yet?

char_225_haak_CN_001.voiceText: Oh yeah, my dude, when you're callin' my name to get my attention, don't forget to stress the K at the end. Or else I might assume you're stammering or somethin'.

char_225_haak_CN_002.voiceText: Whoa, whoa, hold up! Is that vampire lady none other than 'Mr. Blood'?! Man, we've still not settled that medical score we had a while back, and this is the perfect opportunity! I'll have to set up my experiment equipment later... Heheheheh!

char_225_haak_CN_003.voiceText: Lemme guess, Hung's still tellin' you to watch out around me, ain't he? Oh, just to 'look after me'? Yeah, that sounds like him all right. But listen, Boss, I know your type. You're like me, and you just wanna do whatever you want, right? Then just ignore that guy. We can do whatever fun stuff we like.

char_225_haak_CN_004.voiceText: Yeah, I develop new drugs, do surgery, and nurture bacteria cultures, but those are all just fun hobbies to me. Doc. Aak? Nah, don't call me that. I don't save anyone, 'cuz I can't teach them the value of their lives. All I can do is just prevent 'em from dying.

char_225_haak_CN_005.voiceText: The medical department guys are askin' for me? Man, give me a break. I don't dig those professional physicians. They firmly believe that being a doctor's this noble job, and are content with saving more lives... before everything just comes crashing down when their faith got shattered. I've seen that happen time and time again. Honestly, it makes me sad.

char_225_haak_CN_006.voiceText: I don't dislike Rhodes Island. Instead, I think you guys are doing your job just fine. People are dyin' in the world right as we speak, and with all those doctors cooping up in labs, waiting for patients to knock on their clinics' doors, diseases ain't rid themselves of these lands. Hardly anyone gets it, but you people seem to have it in mind... Keep up the good stuff, will ya?

char_225_haak_CN_007.voiceText: Me, a cynic? You got me wrong, my dude. I simply pity all the people on this land. Everyone's got their own hardships to deal with, and I know that. But what's the point of curing pains and sufferings when we can't cure their source? What medicine saves a man who's being murdered? Terra doesn't need more doctors in suits, my dude.

char_225_haak_CN_008.voiceText: My pops was an amazing doctor, and he was all about saving people's lives. But his colleagues slandered him, sidelined him, and framed him. That's how he ended up as a underground doctor, the nastiest among the wicked. Stuff like that ain't so unusual, but I'll admit, what happened to him really changed my own life.

char_225_haak_CN_009.voiceText: Have Waai Fu and Hung left? Really? Aight, I'm gonna hang out in your office for a while then. Y'know, if anyone can make this land a better place, it's gotta be people like them. You, meanwhile... Well, guess we are simply two peas in a pod, aren't we?

char_225_haak_CN_010.voiceText: Aha! You Feelin' tired? Then come try this new compound I made! Free of charge, of course!

char_225_haak_CN_011.voiceText: So you're the Doctor, eh? Nice to meet'cha. My name's Aak. That's right, two A's with a K. Anyway, I'm here 'cause the agency got some business here at Rhodes Island. A quick question before we start: does the phrase 'medical mishap' put you off?

char_225_haak_CN_012.voiceText: Huh... Does this mean I might get involved in combat scenarios like this? Surely not, right?

char_225_haak_CN_013.voiceText: A promotion? Almost too good to be true, man. I knew my agency has been exploiting me all along!

char_225_haak_CN_014.voiceText: Honestly, I dunno if I'm helpful or not. The way I see it, you've gotta be nice to be helpful, and I'm not blind to how people perceive me. But in any case, if you ever get sick, you know who to call.

char_225_haak_CN_017.voiceText: We goin' on a mission? Sure, let's do it.

char_225_haak_CN_018.voiceText: All right, team, gimme your thoughts on my new meds after this is done.

char_225_haak_CN_019.voiceText: Once I start an operation, there's no stoppin' it.

char_225_haak_CN_020.voiceText: Relax, guys. You just can't die with me by your side.

char_225_haak_CN_021.voiceText: When prescribing, I always go double-down on the dosage.

char_225_haak_CN_022.voiceText: I ain't one for battle, but treating peole is so much fun!

char_225_haak_CN_023.voiceText: Time for a clinical test of my new meds.

char_225_haak_CN_024.voiceText: Learn to treat yourself with kindness, or regret when sickness treats you.

char_225_haak_CN_025.voiceText: All lives are equal... while yours is a deviation.

char_225_haak_CN_026.voiceText: Just take the shot. You will be amazed.

char_225_haak_CN_027.voiceText: My potion might give the bad guys a new leaf to turn over!

char_225_haak_CN_028.voiceText: Medicine, a box you wish you've never opened!

char_225_haak_CN_029.voiceText: I doubt I can make the world a better place on my own, but at least I can stop it from gettin' any worse with your help.

char_225_haak_CN_030.voiceText: Could we capture some enemies for a little experimenting? It's not violating ethics as long as no one sees it. Not a chance? Aww.

char_225_haak_CN_031.voiceText: Letting 'em get away like that? You are a saint.

char_225_haak_CN_032.voiceText: Don't worry, my dude. I can fix any injury as long as the patient's still breathing.

char_225_haak_CN_033.voiceText: Now, now, let's see. Which of these rooms is my new lab?

char_225_haak_CN_036.voiceText: Yo, my dude! Found any new experiment samples for me?

char_226_hmau_CN_001.voiceText: Hi, Doc. Have you eaten yet? Here, I got some cookies if you're hungry.

char_226_hmau_CN_002.voiceText: Doc, I know Aak's been a nuisance to you, but could you be lenient with him? He teases people a lot, but he's not a bad person. Also, let me know if he ever gets under your skin, I'll give him a lesson on that.

char_226_hmau_CN_003.voiceText: Just call on me when you're hungry, Doc, and I'll make you a little something to eat. I may not look a like a chef, but I did learn a recipe or two from Mr. Lee.

char_226_hmau_CN_004.voiceText: Say, Doc, do you give any lectures on machines here at Rhodes Island? I've got an interest in that stuff and was hoping I could learn something new.

char_226_hmau_CN_005.voiceText: Hahah, just between you and me, Doc, for the longest time I thought all detectives do the same stuff as Mr. Lee. You know, taking sips of tea at the scene of gang fights, that sort of thing.

char_226_hmau_CN_006.voiceText: I'm sure you already know, but with the intellect and talent that Aak's got, he's destined for great things one day. But personally, all that matters to me is that he doesn't ever go back to what he used to be.

char_226_hmau_CN_007.voiceText: Me and Mr. Lee, well... How should I put it... I was a bit scared of him at first. He seemed like a clever guy who's got a lot going on, which had me on edge... But now after knowing him for so many years, I know I have nothing to worry about, haha.

char_226_hmau_CN_008.voiceText: Hey, Doc, If you need info on something or someone, just tell me and I'll ask Mr. Lee for you. Nothing in Lungmen happens without him knowing about it.

char_226_hmau_CN_009.voiceText: To be honest with you, I actually don't like getting into fights. I'd much rather we could all get along with each other. But I won't back down from inevitable conflicts; there are things I'll fight to protect. Things like the agency, and now, Rhodes Island as well.

char_226_hmau_CN_010.voiceText: Do– Phew, almost woke the Doc up... Guess I'll take this opportunity to rest too.

char_226_hmau_CN_011.voiceText: You must be the doctor that Mr. Lee talked about. The name's Hung, it's a pleasure to meet you. My fields of expertise are security and repairing machinery. If you ever need a bodyguard for a public appearance, or if your TV or fridge break down, just give me a holler!

char_226_hmau_CN_012.voiceText: Woah, your operators never cease to amaze me... I've got to work harder.

char_226_hmau_CN_013.voiceText: Thanks, Doc! I'll be giving it 110% from here on out!

char_226_hmau_CN_014.voiceText: Doc, don't hesitate to give me all the work you need done. I might not have the brain for many things, but I've got the brawn!

char_226_hmau_CN_019.voiceText: Stay close behind so we don't get split up.

char_226_hmau_CN_024.voiceText: I'm here to protect you all!

char_226_hmau_CN_027.voiceText: You're not hurting anyone on my watch!

char_226_hmau_CN_028.voiceText: A little scratch ain't gonna stop me!

char_226_hmau_CN_029.voiceText: *pant*... *pant*... Sorry, Doc, but could you give me a minute? I'm totally burned out.

char_226_hmau_CN_030.voiceText: You can stay here and rest, Doc. I'll clean up the battlefield.

char_226_hmau_CN_031.voiceText: Stay beside me, Doc. There are still enemies around.

char_226_hmau_CN_032.voiceText: Hurry, Doc, climb onto my back! I'm getting you out of here!

char_226_hmau_CN_036.voiceText: Sup, Doc? Anything I can help you with?

char_383_snsant_CN_001.voiceText: D-Doctor! Excuse me, but could you please move a little? You're stepping on a coin...

char_383_snsant_CN_002.voiceText: My dream is for all Terra to know… Okay, maybe just Lungmen… Umm, well, maybe I'll just start with Rhodes Island, or even just you! Yes, my dream is for you to know my skill…

char_383_snsant_CN_003.voiceText: Aaaugh… I forgot to turn out the lights when I left the office yesterday… Hm? Rhodes Island has power generation facilities so we don't have to pay for electricity? R-Really? Does that mean I can start eating dinner every day?

char_383_snsant_CN_004.voiceText: So this is the Originium ammunition that Jessica ordered... Uh, D-Doctor, the amount on the bill, is it right? Or maybe it's in the currency of some small, remote country? It's not? It's Lungmen Dollars? I-I-I-I see... Nonono, I-I'm just a-a-a little surprised, hehehe...

char_383_snsant_CN_005.voiceText: Oripathy... Hm, even though it's a bit outside my field of study, it might be worth looking into... But if I add another research project, I'll go from two meals a day to two days a meal... Aww…

char_383_snsant_CN_006.voiceText: Frugality is a virtue, but for me, it's more like a habit... E-Even so, if you or my friends ever have money troubles, I'll gladly help out! I'm serious!

char_383_snsant_CN_007.voiceText: You'd like to take a look at my clawhook? That's probably fine... B-But whatever you do, don't push this button. And watch your thumb when you're holding the grip... W-Wait, you're not winding the rope correctly, and... Oh, I-I'm sorry, don't mind me, you can keep looking at it...

char_383_snsant_CN_008.voiceText: After I become a great, world-famous scientist with lots of money, I swear I'll have three meals a day and dessert too, just like Jessica... And then, with the money I can't even spend, I'll invest it into making Lungmen a better place. Um... if a day like that ever comes.

char_383_snsant_CN_009.voiceText: Money is very important. Before I went back to Lungmen, I turned down a big retention fee from the research institute, so my self-funded research project went under... But, it's more important to be home. I can always save up again, and now I won't go dizzy looking at all those big numbers!

char_383_snsant_CN_010.voiceText: …Doctor fell asleep? Then I'll handle the rest of the work, though I am a bit hungry.

char_383_snsant_CN_011.voiceText: Oww... my head! Sorry... Oh, a-are you the Doctor? It's a pleasure to meet you! My name is Snowsant. Sorry, I shouldn't be walking with my head down…

char_383_snsant_CN_012.voiceText: Woah... This isn't something you can learn with more effort...

char_383_snsant_CN_013.voiceText: Wha-what? A promotion? I… feel a bit more pressure, but I'll be okay. This is proof that I'm one step closer to making something of myself!

char_383_snsant_CN_014.voiceText: 'Heaven rewards the hard-working.' Wouldn't you agree, Doctor?

char_383_snsant_CN_017.voiceText: It'll be all right. I just need to remember my training and work hard…

char_383_snsant_CN_018.voiceText: You want m-me to be the squad leader? But I really don't know anything about battle…

char_383_snsant_CN_019.voiceText: Clawhook checked and ready! Take a deep breath... I can do this!

char_383_snsant_CN_023.voiceText: I hope my clawhook won't malfunction…

char_383_snsant_CN_024.voiceText: This is my first time being so close to a battlefield...

char_383_snsant_CN_026.voiceText: Please hold still, don't make it hard on you!

char_383_snsant_CN_028.voiceText: Claw's all good for a catch!

char_383_snsant_CN_029.voiceText: As long as we work together, there's no obstacle we can't overcome! R-Right, Doctor?

char_383_snsant_CN_030.voiceText: Not a single resource wasted, a flawless victory!

char_383_snsant_CN_031.voiceText: Some enemies got away, sh-should we chase after them?

char_383_snsant_CN_032.voiceText: I, I'll go salvage some damaged parts, to at least reduce our losses…

char_383_snsant_CN_033.voiceText: Wooooah, so this is what it's like inside Rhodes Island... I'm so jealous…

char_2013_cerber_CN_001.voiceText: Hm...? What should I do? Just put these papers in this box?

char_2013_cerber_CN_002.voiceText: Doctor, are you working? Can I watch? Yay! Here I come, sofa.

char_2013_cerber_CN_003.voiceText: I'm super strong! Forget one bad guy, I can take on a hundre—Uhh, maybe a hundred is a bit much... But ninety-nine is no problem! Um-hum!

char_2013_cerber_CN_004.voiceText: I found a bunch of these little bottle things in some room, and the sauce inside tasted pretty good. Spicy? Umm... a little. But it's really yummy! Want some, Doctor?

char_2013_cerber_CN_005.voiceText: My den is right here. Doctor's den is above my head, and Vulcan's den is on my left... Okay, got it! One more time? Um, sure. My den is above my head, Doctor's den is on my left, and Vulcan's den is right here!

char_2013_cerber_CN_006.voiceText: Whoa… So this is where I started ? Oh, oh, then how far did I go? And where did you catch me? You can find it all on this map?!

char_2013_cerber_CN_007.voiceText: So hungry... My tummy's been grumbling for hours. Can we go to the canteen yet?

char_2013_cerber_CN_008.voiceText: I don't know much about Arts, but when other people try to use my weapons, they can't make all those cool sparky things happen. Anyway Doctor, don't worry. As long as I'm here, the bad guys can't hurt you. And I can tell who the bad guys are.

char_2013_cerber_CN_009.voiceText: Bad guys usually come in groups, and I don't always have friends around. But the more weapons you have, the more power you have. Am I right? So, can I get another hammer for my bag? Or a javelin! They're super useful! No…? Hmph! But I need it!

char_2013_cerber_CN_011.voiceText: You seem pretty nice. They call you 'Doctor,' right? My name is Ceobe, but if that's too hard to say, you can also call me Kay. I'm staying here from now on!

char_2013_cerber_CN_013.voiceText: This little button is for me? Alright, I'll put it on. Hmmm... Done!  Do I look cool?

char_2013_cerber_CN_014.voiceText: One's not enough, two gets the job done, and three is for safety. As long as I bring the right weapons for the job, I'll take out every bad guy I see!

char_2013_cerber_CN_018.voiceText: I'm in command? What's a command?

char_2013_cerber_CN_019.voiceText: Are we gonna eat goodies when we get back?

char_2013_cerber_CN_029.voiceText: With your brains, my job is super easy! You're the best, Doctor!

char_2013_cerber_CN_030.voiceText: All you need is a little bang, bump, pow! And they're done!

char_2013_cerber_CN_031.voiceText: Are you hurt? Should I wrap your ouchie?

char_2013_cerber_CN_032.voiceText: Hurry! Run! Before it's too late!

char_2013_cerber_CN_033.voiceText: This thing's super fluffy. Lying on it's gonna feel great!

char_2013_cerber_CN_036.voiceText: Doctor, can I follow you around?

char_2013_cerber_CN_042.voiceText: Nice to meet you, Doctor! Mhm, that's a proper greeting, right?

char_306_leizi_CN_001.voiceText: Look carefully. The files are sorted by type, then time limit prioritization, then finally, by distance from nearest to farthest. This is the most efficient organization method! ...Wait, I seem to have done all the paperwork on accident. This... is supposed to be your job, right?

char_306_leizi_CN_002.voiceText: I've checked all files related to the elite Operator, Blaze, and there are no records of her real name, or place and date of birth. Don't tell me you don't know; aren't you supposed to be one of the leaders here? You really don't know? Then... nevermind. Sorry, I shouldn't have accused you.

char_306_leizi_CN_003.voiceText: You don't need to be so cautious around me. Other than the case at hand, I'll treat everything else on the ship as if it never happened. But if there's another explosion in the hallway outside my room, I'll make the perpetrator's hair stand on end for two weeks!

char_306_leizi_CN_004.voiceText: 'Assume the responsibilities for the post to which you are assigned.' As one of the leaders of Rhodes Island, is it not your duty to... Huh? My hair's standing up again? Hold on! G-give me a moment to fix my look first! Weird, I thought I had discharged all the static electricity this morning...

char_306_leizi_CN_005.voiceText: Even today, I can vaguely recall the first time I saw you in Lungmen. You, Blaze, and Ch'en... are all holding onto countless secrets... and I will uncover them one by one. You're willing to exchange secrets? Wait, y-you... it's t-too early for that...!

char_306_leizi_CN_006.voiceText: Ask me anything. Only when you speak up can I decide what is just and unjust, and whether I wish to take action. I need to take my identity into consideration? This has nothing to do with that! The Censorate, Central Judicial Office, and the Department of Discipline and Supervision... are only institutions. Laws can only be proven just when enforced by someone.

char_306_leizi_CN_007.voiceText: Rhodes Island's ideals conflict with my beliefs. However, I do recognize the necessity of seeking common ground while understanding our differences... The same is true when providing assistance in exchange for information.

char_306_leizi_CN_008.voiceText: No matter where I am, the electricity flowing through my body never ceases. The thunderbolt is the symbol of justice; it drives me forward and sometimes even wakes me up at night... Someone is complaining that I broke the AC unit? ...How rude! How is that possible?! I don't even need to use a remote for the AC, let alone touch it!

char_306_leizi_CN_009.voiceText: Blaze was implicated in a major incident. All the clues have purposely been eliminated, but I have my doubts about the way the facts of the case are connected based upon a few coincidences between certain persons and times. This has nothing to do with you, but you should take adequate precautions. All I can do is offer you a fair warning.

char_306_leizi_CN_010.voiceText: You can't even properly manage your physical condition... how slovenly! Look at you sprawled out like this... Were you waiting for me to put a blanket over you or something? ...There won't be a next time.

char_306_leizi_CN_011.voiceText: I've signed obtained an investigation authorization with your company. Don't worry about it, this is purely over personal matters. If you so wish, you may call me Leizi. Who am I? Have we met before? Are you serious?!

char_306_leizi_CN_012.voiceText: I see, this is a completely different principle from military training.

char_306_leizi_CN_013.voiceText: Elite status? Is this... a promotion? The promotion process at Rhodes Island seems to differ from that of ordinary private companies...

char_306_leizi_CN_014.voiceText: I, Leizi, am the bearer of the thunder and the law, the vision and reach of Great Yan. My philosophy does not align with that of Rhodes Island, and I have no intention on bridging the gap between the Infected and non-Infected. However, we can now fight side by side against our enemies!

char_306_leizi_CN_017.voiceText: With my own eyes, I shall judge what power Rhodes Island possesses.

char_306_leizi_CN_018.voiceText: I can do that, yes, albeit at a price.

char_306_leizi_CN_020.voiceText: I have no interest in the identity of my enemies.

char_306_leizi_CN_025.voiceText: Rise, thunder of the five elements!

char_306_leizi_CN_026.voiceText: No forgiveness unto sinners! Retribution of thunder!

char_306_leizi_CN_027.voiceText: Through the three thunders is justice governed!

char_306_leizi_CN_028.voiceText: The essence of Lei Fa... is my will becoming one with Terra.

char_306_leizi_CN_029.voiceText: Well done. As my standards are quite high, you should be proud of yourself.

char_306_leizi_CN_030.voiceText: Unacceptable. You can do even better! Do not rest upon your laurels - you have the ability to strive for greater heights!

char_306_leizi_CN_031.voiceText: Impossible, what happened? How can this be?

char_306_leizi_CN_032.voiceText: Shameful...! Begone, you! Go back and reflect! I will hold back the enemies, so just go!

char_306_leizi_CN_036.voiceText: Oh... did that hurt? Please be careful of the static electricity around me.

char_385_finlpp_CN_001.voiceText: Smiling can help you feel revitalized. Why don't you try smiling, Doctor.

char_385_finlpp_CN_002.voiceText: Rhodes Island isn't one of those black-hearted corporations, right? Let's see... Lungmen Industrial Waste Disposal License, Lungmen City Sewage Permit... Whoa, it seems your certifications are in order, and the sewage treatment here looks good enough too. Hehehe, not bad! A real compliant organization!

char_385_finlpp_CN_003.voiceText: Hah, this water tastes amazing! A bit cool and a little sweet, just like the springs back in my hometown... Where's the water source? How is it filtered? What are you using to filter it? Tell me, Doctor!

char_385_finlpp_CN_004.voiceText: There are signs of excessive wastewater discharge this month... Wait a sec, did I take too many baths again? Gosh, I must reflect upon my behavior…

char_385_finlpp_CN_005.voiceText: I love my hometown! It's out in the sticks, so we don't get the fashion and convenience of city life. But the water there is cool and delicious, and the air is always so fresh. Heehee, that's hard to come by in the city!

char_385_finlpp_CN_006.voiceText: The pollution near the city is getting worse and worse. Earlier, we even had problems with the water supply in my hometown, and resolving that situation required a lot of effort. While Catastrophes pose a very clear threat to us, pollution will also erode away at our habitable spaces! Therefore, protecting our environment is also of great importance!

char_385_finlpp_CN_007.voiceText: Heave, ho! That should be the last shoe... Got it! Phew, now, this waterway will be much cleaner, and my daily efforts here won't go to waste! Thank you for accompanying me, Doctor!

char_385_finlpp_CN_008.voiceText: There is a legend among my people that we came from a place far, far away. But now there are fewer and fewer of us, nobody seems to know where we came from, or where we're going…

char_385_finlpp_CN_009.voiceText: Back in my hometown during harvest season, each family will make lots and lots of delicious food! Braised, sweet and sour, steamed, fried, marinated, anything you can imagine! Doctor, why don't we go visit together? The people there are very hospitable.

char_385_finlpp_CN_010.voiceText: Ugh... So dry... I want to soak in a bath...

char_385_finlpp_CN_011.voiceText: Hello, I am the municipal waterway cleaner, codename Purestream! From now on, I will handle the water treatment and sanitation of this ship, so please rest assured! Oh, these are pickled vegetables from my hometown. Everyone is welcome to try some—I assure you, they're delicious!

char_385_finlpp_CN_012.voiceText: If the purpose is to gain experience, wouldn't it be faster to put everything into practice?

char_385_finlpp_CN_013.voiceText: Am I getting a raise? With this promotion and salary increase, I'm well on my way to the top! Hehe, I'll have to tell everyone back home the good news.

char_385_finlpp_CN_014.voiceText: Visible and invisible threats take different priorities, but they are both threats to us! I'm glad you understand that, Doctor.

char_385_finlpp_CN_017.voiceText: No problem, just leave it to me!

char_385_finlpp_CN_018.voiceText: Such an important task... I'll do my best!

char_385_finlpp_CN_019.voiceText: Rhodes Island Water Treatment Team, heading out!

char_385_finlpp_CN_020.voiceText: Surprise inspection! That punk just poured paint down the sink! Get him!

char_385_finlpp_CN_021.voiceText: A fight? Alright! Lemme Roll up my sleeves… Oh, I don't have sleeves.

char_385_finlpp_CN_028.voiceText: Did that splash of cool water wake you up?

char_385_finlpp_CN_029.voiceText: Wonderful, all contaminants cleaned! This mission was a great success!

char_385_finlpp_CN_030.voiceText: Operation complete! But we have to be diligent with the cleanup.

char_385_finlpp_CN_031.voiceText: Hey, where'd the enemy run off to? I-I can't find them!

char_385_finlpp_CN_032.voiceText: The situation is getting worse. Shoud we retreat? We can come back when we're stronger!

char_385_finlpp_CN_033.voiceText: I hope I can get a nice, big bathtub.

char_385_finlpp_CN_036.voiceText: Let me tell you a secret - I can swim upright!

char_385_finlpp_CN_042.voiceText: Good morning, Doctor! Would you like a cup of cool, refreshing spring water?

char_222_bpipe_CN_001.voiceText: Assistant? The one where ye just stand next tae folk, aye? Nae bother, saw that plenty in the army myself. Wait, I have tae do paperwork too? And assess combat data? And compile reports?! Th-that sounds mighty hectic.

char_222_bpipe_CN_002.voiceText: Back in school, Chenchen always had a pissed off look on her face, made no end of enemies at first, but tha's just the kind of girl she is. Nae time at all, she had people seein' her wi fresh eyes. But y'know, bandagin' up her wounds, cookin' for her, teamin' up wi her squad and all that... I had tae look after her a fair bit, and that was no easy thing.

char_222_bpipe_CN_003.voiceText: I'm great at drivin' machines! Harvesters, tractors, tillers, I'll be right at home wi anythin'. Hm? PDAs? Screens? Wireless systems? If yer meanin' little gadgety stuff, I'm nae so—ah crims, I just barely touched this—why's it smokin'?

char_222_bpipe_CN_004.voiceText: Ye didnae get a proper supper in yesterday, did ye? No, I dinnae want tae hear aboot 'work, work, work'! If yer body gives out on ye, ye willnae be able tae get a thing done. Tell me what ye'd like, and I'll whip it right up for ye. Ah, na anything too fancy though, aye? I'd be lost tryin'.

char_222_bpipe_CN_005.voiceText: This Rhodes Island ship is... crivens, it's a million times more wonderful than Victoria's warships! We've got sunlight, wheat fields, herds of stockbeasts... Doctor, what if, we try growin' somethin' too? Like potatoes, say? I know all aboot growin' potatoes!

char_222_bpipe_CN_006.voiceText: Where d'ye think someone's hometown ends? The hoose furthest from the tractors? Or where the land meets the sky? Does it stop at the fronts we keep drawin' and redrawin' maps wi, all reds and blues and lines and arrows...? Y'know, after so many battles... sometimes I cannae recall what my hometown looks like.

char_222_bpipe_CN_007.voiceText: I'm sure that I ran across her once, that Reed lass. But she looks so lonely the noo, so pitiful... can she really be the same terrifyin' person I met before? It's right strange. I should go ask her...  What? I cannae talk tae her? Why no?!

char_222_bpipe_CN_008.voiceText: My mum's part of the reason I ended up runnin' off to military school at all. Always bangin' on like 'Vouivre women must keep gettin' stronger', she is. ...S'pose I wanted to be cheeky about it, aye? Though lookin' back on it, no need to be AS tough as my mum. Och, I'm still more soft and cute than hard and chiselled, wouldn't you say? Go on, say?

char_222_bpipe_CN_009.voiceText: When I was still in the army, I came across this spectre-like force. Hauntin' the dark edges of Victoria, and most of the people who witnessed them went missin'. I've a duty to expose them, and that's why I've been scramblin' aboot. Oh, dinnae you step in for me. You've got yer own callin' to worry about, na?

char_222_bpipe_CN_010.voiceText: Ah! Fancy that, skivin' off! Aww, got me jealous. Doesnae beat a nice hay pile for a few winks though, aye? I'm noddin' off just thinkin' aboot it... Wouldn't hurt tae take a wee kip myself...

char_222_bpipe_CN_011.voiceText: Hello! You're the Doctor, aye? Officer Ch'en fae Lungmen said I'd be able tae find some helpers here! I need tae sign my name first? Aye, right enough. Baaag...pipe. There! Eh? 'Become an Operator?' 'Full-time bed and board'? Ach, what's goin' on here?!

char_222_bpipe_CN_012.voiceText: Whoa, you folks here at Rhodes Island sure can fight!

char_222_bpipe_CN_013.voiceText: A promotion? Hmm... cannae say if I like it or na. For soldiers, more responsibilities means more battles, and a greater risk of mistakes.

char_222_bpipe_CN_014.voiceText: Joinin' Rhodes Island has been a good thing for me. Oripathy and the Infected may seem a touch scary at first, but runnin' from it willnae solve a thing. That's what I've learned here, and I mean it when I say, thank you—I see my way now, right ahead of me.

char_222_bpipe_CN_018.voiceText: Assumin' leadership! Team will hereby carry out the operation!

char_222_bpipe_CN_024.voiceText: My spear and I hail from Victoria!

char_222_bpipe_CN_029.voiceText: Be it school or the military, I've still seen worse.

char_222_bpipe_CN_030.voiceText: Phew... I've managed tae live up t' the reputation of this uniform once more.

char_222_bpipe_CN_031.voiceText: Enemy routed! All units, pursue only wi caution!

char_222_bpipe_CN_032.voiceText: You get out of here! Go!

char_222_bpipe_CN_033.voiceText: How do I get tae the greenhoose?

char_222_bpipe_CN_036.voiceText: Wanna go on a picnic? Just the two of us!

char_222_bpipe_CN_042.voiceText: Doctor, how's about we go farmin'!

char_379_sesa_CN_001.voiceText: Hmm, is this the Doctor's room? How boring. It looks just like those never-changing hills of Sargon. At least get a game console, will you?

char_379_sesa_CN_002.voiceText: {@nickname}, I feel something resonating from within you. How strange. Is this because we still have so much untapped potential? But alas, you've forgotten your past. Does it feel like a burden's been lifted off of you, or does it make things more painful?

char_379_sesa_CN_003.voiceText: {@nickname}, I take greater pride in natural wisdom than the knowledge that is deliberately taught! With Rhodes Island at my side, we will get ever-closer to the Great Truth. Hey, don't avert your gaze. There's nothing to be ashamed of, is there?

char_379_sesa_CN_004.voiceText: 'I wish to cross over to the distant shores.' That used to be the secret phrase people used to communicate with me. That bridge is the link between two worlds, transferring wisdom and imbuing power... Hey, let me finish. It's rude to just turn around and walk off like that!

char_379_sesa_CN_005.voiceText: Rhodes Island has some pretty tasteless folks, acting like their outer appearance is just some decoration, like a skin to be taken off! You'll come off as slovenly to people if you don't carefully coordinate your look, right? What, my clothes are tattered? You simply don't understand the boldness of this fashion statement...

char_379_sesa_CN_006.voiceText: Do you believe that weapons have souls? The things they've experienced, the hands they've been passed through, and the reason they've been swung... No! These have nothing to do with the soul. For a weapon, any belief or meaning has been superimposed upon it. Tell me, are we weapons, or are we people with souls imposed upon us?

char_379_sesa_CN_007.voiceText: A genius? Do people like that really exist...? Most craftspeople in Sargon are just ordinary apprentices who are still learning to walk, tinkering with metals. But as long as they continue down the path, even they can reach the road's destination.

char_379_sesa_CN_008.voiceText: Need my help making some adjustments? My skills aren't something that can ever see the light of day. 'Allowing everyone to just pick up a weapon is the way to creating wars.' I must wear these shackles to restrict myself. Or, do you wish to unchain me and unleash havoc upon this world?

char_379_sesa_CN_009.voiceText: Do you know about who I am? And about my past? No, you don't know, nor should you know. My incognito exists to bury the past behind me. Forget about it, and let these things sink into the depths of the deserts.

char_379_sesa_CN_010.voiceText: I don't mind this kind of peace and quiet.

char_379_sesa_CN_011.voiceText: I know exactly what you're searching for, Doctor of Rhodes Island! You long for truth and power! And I, Sesa, am willing to grant you these things... Woah, wait, wait up! Don't push me out the door! I'm serious about my job application!

char_379_sesa_CN_013.voiceText: ...You wish for greater power? Don't draw any unnecessary attention before the time is right. Otherwise, it'll be veeery dangerous.

char_379_sesa_CN_014.voiceText: 'The bridge is the connection, the ammunition is wisdom, the weapon is the will, and harmony is equality.' Shall we tear asunder the veil that obfuscates the Truth? Perhaps I can lend you a bit more power... Just a bit more.

char_379_sesa_CN_017.voiceText: The 'bridge' seeks completion... Those weapons in your hands... May I take a closer look?

char_379_sesa_CN_018.voiceText: Let me guide you... Just rub this oil into the bolt slot of your crossbow. Remember to apply it uniformly.

char_379_sesa_CN_019.voiceText: It's time for our efforts to bear fruit! Just remember, these weapons must be handled delicately.

char_379_sesa_CN_020.voiceText: The battlefield destroys both weapons and their hosts.

char_379_sesa_CN_022.voiceText: Set me free! This is what I should yell, right?

char_379_sesa_CN_025.voiceText: Free the weapon from the flesh...

char_379_sesa_CN_027.voiceText: I shall be your end! It's fine for me to say stuff like that, right?

char_379_sesa_CN_028.voiceText: How can you ever understand the suffering of the victims?

char_379_sesa_CN_029.voiceText: Such a fierce battle is inevitably accompanied by great pain, but the weapon in your hands will never lie. It roars triumphantly!

char_379_sesa_CN_030.voiceText: You are a bit too dependent upon my powers. Speak no more of it. You know the old agreement, a cup of black tea with two cubes of sugar.

char_379_sesa_CN_031.voiceText: Being able to escape the weapons' bloodbath is perhaps a good thing.

char_379_sesa_CN_032.voiceText: No matter how much you run, the weapons will always be waiting. For the day you and I are wiped out.

char_379_sesa_CN_033.voiceText: The Great Truth needs an equally great space to house it! Wait, no, I don't need a room this big...

char_379_sesa_CN_034.voiceText: Watch out! I... I'm still not able to fully control my powers!

char_379_sesa_CN_036.voiceText: Do you want to hear a story? I know many old stories.

char_337_utage_CN_001.voiceText: Doctor, ready to get to work? I won't take no for an answer! C'mon! 3, 2, 1, start!

char_337_utage_CN_002.voiceText: Nails are part of a girl's appeal. Gotta take care of them properly.

char_337_utage_CN_003.voiceText: Why do I call myself Utage? Well, it's not that complicated. I just want to be happy as if we were throwing a party every night. As long as I'm in a good mood, everything else is gonna be okay.

char_337_utage_CN_004.voiceText: You already saw it, Doctor? Well, that's too bad... C'mon, let's use up this two-person discount coupon.

char_337_utage_CN_005.voiceText: When I contracted Oripathy and was to be sent here, my mother was afraid I'd be bullied, and gave me the family heirloom, Shishiou, to defend myself with. Didn't find any bullies, but I did manage to cut some pretty nasty folks. Doctor, you really know how to appeal to people.

char_337_utage_CN_006.voiceText: Everyone here gets pretty scary when they get serious. I'm as scary as six people combined? Am I really that terrifying...?

char_337_utage_CN_007.voiceText: Help me pick up ten boxes of limited-edition cookie sticks tomorrow? Just take the money out of my account. Huh? Preorders are already sold out? Then... c'mon, you've gotta think of a way, Doctor! Please!

char_337_utage_CN_008.voiceText: Doctor, you're razor-sharp some of the time and dull as a piece of wood at others. I don't get why. Oh, I see, right out of 'Flirting Guidebook,' huh? I'd expect nothing less from you, Doctor.

char_337_utage_CN_009.voiceText: It's not good to rely too much on any single person, but I'll make an exception for... Eek, Doctor! Oh it's nothing, I was just rambling to myself! D-d-did you need anything from me?

char_337_utage_CN_010.voiceText: If you're tired, just go to bed. Not that complicated.

char_337_utage_CN_011.voiceText: Hey, Doctor. I'm the Operator who just joined recently, Utage. My interests are... Oh, I don't need to go into the details? In that case, I look forward to working with you.

char_337_utage_CN_013.voiceText: Do I get to do less work if I get promoted? No dice? Oh well...

char_337_utage_CN_014.voiceText: It's time to move out. Let's crush those nasty folks~

char_337_utage_CN_017.voiceText: All right everyone, I'll be counting on your orders!

char_337_utage_CN_018.voiceText: I'm the team leader? ...Eh? Me? Team leader?

char_337_utage_CN_020.voiceText: C'mon, c'mon! I can't wait any longer.

char_337_utage_CN_026.voiceText: It won't hurt if I don't miss.

char_337_utage_CN_027.voiceText: Just send me the leftover parts.

char_337_utage_CN_028.voiceText: You look rather cute when you're crying.

char_337_utage_CN_029.voiceText: Ahh, I'm finally done blowing off steam, how exciting. Doctor, let's get some crepes.

char_337_utage_CN_030.voiceText: How exciting. Thanks for all the support~

char_337_utage_CN_031.voiceText: You're saving the stragglers for me? Well, I'll dig right in.

char_337_utage_CN_032.voiceText: Doctor, stop spacing out and start running.

char_337_utage_CN_033.voiceText: As long as I can buy the new magazines, it doesn't really matter where I'm staying.

char_252_bibeak_CN_001.voiceText: I don't need to go outside today? Thank goodness... Infected like me have no right to wear outfits like these. How strange it is that I can't wear the clothes I make with my own two hands... Oh? Rhodes Island has no such rules? Truly?

char_252_bibeak_CN_002.voiceText: Um... my outfit? O-Oh, I designed this one myself. The skirt incorporates some traditional motifs, though it can't compare to my papa's work... Still, this is my attempt at a vintage style.

char_252_bibeak_CN_003.voiceText: Good afternoon, Doctor. I'm trying to tidy my room... Sorry it always ends up so messy... I seldom had to organize my own room, so I'm only just learning how. It's actually rather fun... although I often break things in the process...

char_252_bibeak_CN_004.voiceText: I've had trouble adjusting since being pulled away from my old life. At first, I felt like I couldn't go on living as an Infected, and I was just so frightened... But I'm not like that anymore. There's so much I want to learn, and I want to do more for those just like me here at Rhodes Island.

char_252_bibeak_CN_005.voiceText: Since I was young, my father insisted I study swordsmanship. I didn't enjoy it at the time. But after the incident, I've found holding the sword more reassuring... than holding the spinning thread.

char_252_bibeak_CN_006.voiceText: I used to be afraid to go outside. As an Infected, I felt like everything scorned me... But now I understand that one's self-esteem has nothing to do with whether or not she is Infected. After all, that is the most beautiful adornment.

char_252_bibeak_CN_007.voiceText: Doctor, um... D-Do you think… I could make some clothes for you...? I believe you'd be perfect for bringing out some of my ideas. Oh, I do hope my request doesn't trouble you, I've actually been asking the other Operators just the same…

char_252_bibeak_CN_008.voiceText: The people who stoned me with Originium... Of course I hated them. But now... If I continued to harbor that contempt and despair, it would have driven me to do terrible things. I have no regrets about running away from home, even if it holds many warm memories of my past.

char_252_bibeak_CN_009.voiceText: I've learned so much from everyone. Now I want to incorporate that into something we can all wear. Hehe, even with that in mind, the elements are a bit complicated. But that reflects my feelings, whether I'm brandishing my sword or flourishing my needle.

char_252_bibeak_CN_010.voiceText: I'll use this time to craft something small.

char_252_bibeak_CN_011.voiceText: H-Hello, Doctor... My codename is Bibeak... Excuse me, but is there a facility with a loom and a sewing machine here?

char_252_bibeak_CN_012.voiceText: The way they fight... I've never even considered it before…

char_252_bibeak_CN_013.voiceText: A p-p-promotion? Are you sure...? I'm actually not very good at fighting... Thank you very much.

char_252_bibeak_CN_014.voiceText: All the Operators of Rhodes Island, and you, Doctor… stand at my side. I know, even with my limited lifespan, I'm still able to live as a normal woman… Or even, a life most people would never dream possible.

char_252_bibeak_CN_019.voiceText: Just like a textile, there is only one way to weave.

char_252_bibeak_CN_022.voiceText: Our combat uniforms are all ready!

char_252_bibeak_CN_023.voiceText: Is wielding the sword the same as wielding the needle?

char_252_bibeak_CN_024.voiceText: I can also fight! Believe in me!

char_252_bibeak_CN_026.voiceText: Save the talk for after the battle! There are people I must protect!

char_252_bibeak_CN_028.voiceText: Can the thread of life also be cut?

char_252_bibeak_CN_029.voiceText: Great work, Doctor! Um, what did you think about my performance?

char_252_bibeak_CN_030.voiceText: I-it's finally over! If your uniform is damaged, I can help repair it…

char_252_bibeak_CN_031.voiceText: Oh, someone got away! But, that's a better outcome... than the cruelty of death.

char_252_bibeak_CN_033.voiceText: Hmm... Where is the textiles room?

char_252_bibeak_CN_036.voiceText: Oh, Doctor, could you grab those textiles for me?

char_159_peacok_CN_001.voiceText: Since you summoned me, you must be eager to feast your eyes upon my elegant dancing form, right? Uh...? Help you move the luggage...? Hey! I didn't come here to do manual labor!
