char_4048_doroth_CN_006.voiceText: I made lots of friends in the world of science. They often discuss their dreams with me; some are not so good at expressing themselves, but I can guess. You say I've guessed wrong sometimes? Hm... perhaps. Maybe I should reflect...

char_4048_doroth_CN_007.voiceText: It's getting cool outside. Remember to dress warm when you go into the field... *sneeze* I, er, forgot to do so myself. I often forget these things if Elena isn't there to remind me. *Sneeze* Oh, thanks for the coat. That's so kind of you.

char_4048_doroth_CN_008.voiceText: I never thought of myself as a genius. I'm just fortunate. My father and other people in the Pioneer team saved the money to send me to school, while the government sponsorship also allowed me to pursue scientific research. I'm here today thanks to the help of many people. That's why I want to do my best to help others too.

char_4048_doroth_CN_009.voiceText: Sometimes, I wake up in the middle of the night in the labs and feel... scared. Scared that people will end up abandoning me, even after all I've done, and even... with hatred in their hearts. What should I do? All I want is to bring them happiness. Can you help me, Doctor?

char_4048_doroth_CN_010.voiceText: All work and no play makes it a sleepy day... We have so much in common, don't we... Let me turn up the temperature. Noise-canceling mode... Oh, seems your cabin isn't equipped with that…?

char_4048_doroth_CN_011.voiceText: Hello, I'm Dorothy, head of the Originium Art Section at Rhine Lab. Dr. Silence already introduced me? Then it saves both of us the formalities. Please, just call me Dorothy.

char_4048_doroth_CN_012.voiceText: Are these simulations or... hm, Rhodes Island feels different from how I imagined, but I understand.

char_4048_doroth_CN_013.voiceText: As a matter of fact, I was worried about not spending enough time on the Rhodes Island Landship... maybe I should apply to Kristen for another long-term cooperation project.

char_4048_doroth_CN_014.voiceText: Doctor, how do you like my lab? I'm thinking about what equipment I should bring over. Mechanist says my command of resonance might come in handy in obstacle removal and weapon development.

char_4048_doroth_CN_017.voiceText: What sights will the Doctor show us this time?

char_4048_doroth_CN_018.voiceText: Don't worry, I'll take care of the others.

char_4048_doroth_CN_019.voiceText: The battlefield is an extension of the laboratory.

char_4048_doroth_CN_023.voiceText: Do you need the traps activated?

char_4048_doroth_CN_025.voiceText: The sand will reshape the land.

char_4048_doroth_CN_026.voiceText: The slightest vibration can change the result.

char_4048_doroth_CN_027.voiceText: Stay down, and you won't get hurt any worse.

char_4048_doroth_CN_028.voiceText: No, I won't let you take another step… I promised them.

char_4048_doroth_CN_029.voiceText: Whether it's by your calculation or instinct… All I could say is, marvelous.

char_4048_doroth_CN_030.voiceText: Your decisions were on the mark. Were you kissed by the goddess of truth? Can I touch your forehead? For good luck, you know, while I tackle my next experiment.

char_4048_doroth_CN_031.voiceText: 70% of my experiments don't turn out the way I want them to. The answer lies in the next attempt, Doctor.

char_4048_doroth_CN_032.voiceText: I won't let anyone hurt you! I'll take care of things here. Go, and never turn back...

char_4048_doroth_CN_033.voiceText: Rhodes Island is always so lively.

char_4048_doroth_CN_034.voiceText: Oh, it was you tugging at me? Thank goodness, I thought I skipped too many meals and was hallucinating...

char_4048_doroth_CN_036.voiceText: What is it that keeps you staring at me, Doctor? Did you find an interesting problem to tackle?

char_4048_doroth_CN_042.voiceText: Doctor, I was thinking about going out for a walk. Would you like to join me?

char_1027_greyy2_CN_001.voiceText: There's a limit to the types of documents I can help you with, Doctor. But I'll try to learn. I'm hoping to lead my own major engineering project someday, so I gotta accumulate knowledge from different domains.

char_1027_greyy2_CN_002.voiceText: Just spending some time reading. No, I'm not pushing myself too hard. Oripathy doesn't leave me too much time, so I must... Oh, sorry, I didn't mean to make things awkward.

char_1027_greyy2_CN_003.voiceText: I've gotten quite a bit taller in the last couple of years? Hehe, I'm still growing, after all. My ears have gotten perkier? Er, I guess it's also because I'm still growing...?

char_1027_greyy2_CN_004.voiceText: No, Doctor, I haven't gotten more talkative... but Engineering veterans say we have to sound certain of ourselves, in order for our skills and designs to feel certain... I'll keep working at it.

char_1027_greyy2_CN_005.voiceText: Looks like the upcoming courses are even more complicated, and Engineering's idea of an internship is a little… *sigh*… never mind, I can handle it. Yes, I'll be sure to get enough rest. Rest is important to studying efficiently.

char_1027_greyy2_CN_006.voiceText: Mankind may have learned to overcome the darkness of night, but there are always shadows that even the brightest lights cannot breach. If I can continue to improve this technology, and bring warmth and light to those who shiver in the cold night...

char_1027_greyy2_CN_007.voiceText: Though I now fully leave the line patrol work to my drones, it doesn't mean my early intership years are worthless. Look at my physique now, even Medical doesn't have to worry about me anymore... um, Doctor? Why are you crying?

char_1027_greyy2_CN_008.voiceText: Volvort Kochinski... I've seen their mark on Mamá's equipment. Not even Rhodes Island intelligence has been able to track down Mamá since the incident. Is she covering her tracks, running from something?

char_1027_greyy2_CN_009.voiceText: Doctor, I'm going to visit a client to help with PLC testing. It won't take too long. You can use Rhodes Island Messengers to contact me if you need something... but I'm sure you can handle anything that comes up.

char_1027_greyy2_CN_010.voiceText: Doctor... Doctor? Asleep already?... I see... This next segment is prone to bugs. I should set alerts to silent...

char_1027_greyy2_CN_011.voiceText: Hello, Doctor. This equipment was my graduation project. My initial plan was to... huh? Putting it into service? Dios mío(My goodness), so this is the 'Doctor's Thesis Defense' that Closure talked about?

char_1027_greyy2_CN_012.voiceText: No matter how much I watch, I just can't help but feel… everyone's style is so individualized, it's hard to summarize anything for general application…

char_1027_greyy2_CN_013.voiceText: It's an honor to earn your recognition, and that of Engineering. I know this is just the starting point, and I'll keep working to make sure that I don't let you down.

char_1027_greyy2_CN_014.voiceText: Countless frontiers remain uncharted on this land named science, waiting to be mapped and discovered. Though our latest technologies help get their views from afar, we have yet to set our foot on them. My dream, Doctor, is to be the pioneer that explores these realms with engineering.

char_1027_greyy2_CN_017.voiceText: A practical field study... in combat?  Sure, no problem.

char_1027_greyy2_CN_018.voiceText: Understood. I'll compile a deployment report with suggestions for improvement.

char_1027_greyy2_CN_019.voiceText: We're into an assault mission. Before we breakthrough the enemy defenses, I'm counting on you to hold the line.

char_1027_greyy2_CN_020.voiceText: Battlefield is where soldiers and war machines witness their own prime… and their own end.

char_1027_greyy2_CN_029.voiceText: Things were worse than expected, Doctor. Even our contingency plan was pushed to its limit... but we still did it!

char_1027_greyy2_CN_030.voiceText: Phew… Everything went according to plan. All equipment in good condition. We're ready for the next phase.

char_1027_greyy2_CN_031.voiceText: Effect on target below expectations, risk of potential failure… The re-simulation of both Doctor and PRTS  are required for next steps.

char_1027_greyy2_CN_032.voiceText: No obstacles on the evacuation path. It's time to retreat, Doctor!

char_1027_greyy2_CN_033.voiceText: These facilities could use an upgrade...

char_1027_greyy2_CN_034.voiceText: One moment, I'm almost done here... just a few lines more...

char_1027_greyy2_CN_036.voiceText: Here so early, Doctor? Give me a moment, I'm almost done...

char_135_halo_CN_001.voiceText: No problem. I've done all of this before, and I won't have any trouble handling it, but let's be up front, Doctor: If you come to me in the evening with a stack of documents and tell me to sort everything out that night, chances are that you might not get what you want.

char_135_halo_CN_002.voiceText: Research is actually kind of a pain. Sometimes, you go all in on your research. Other times, you have to spend time going over progress with somebody else. You need to know your specialty like the back of your hand, and you also need people skills. If I wasn't already decent at both, my head would've exploded a long time ago.

char_135_halo_CN_003.voiceText: My sister Astesia is really good at our family's chicanery, but she only ever uses it to help people. To think there would be such a pure, kind-hearted shyster running around... Oh, Doctor, don't tell anyone about this! Please, I'm begging you! If she finds out I told, Astesia will whap me upside the head!

char_135_halo_CN_004.voiceText: Rhine Lab? Hmm... Sorry, I don't really want to talk about them right now. If that place were really so great, I wouldn't have asked for a transfer to Rhodes Island, right? Okay, break time's over! Back to work!

char_135_halo_CN_005.voiceText: I'm the one who got infected, but then even Astesia... *sigh*... You probably can't tell, but she's actually pretty depressed. Enough is enough, I gotta do something to help her.

char_135_halo_CN_006.voiceText: Columbia's technology keeps advancing, and as a researcher, I can almost see that future I'm looking for. My dream is right there, and I'm going to make it come true.

char_135_halo_CN_007.voiceText: Our family's... well, how should I say this? My parents are the old-fashioned type that like to order people around. They don't care about your opinions, only the joy of being in control. It sucks. That's why I haven't been back home since college. Now they can't stop me from studying the stuff I like.

char_135_halo_CN_008.voiceText: There are those who help because they really want people to have a better life, but there are also those who help so they can use people as stepping stones. Doctor, you know how to tell the two apart, don't you? It's easy. You just need to look at the way they smile.

char_135_halo_CN_009.voiceText: My dad's kinda famous back in the city, and our names are a little peculiar, so I thought I'd give myself a new name to get away from all that trouble. But feel free to call me whatever you want, Doctor. We're friends, don't sweat it.

char_135_halo_CN_010.voiceText: Yes, this is the Doctor's office. Yes, the Doctor is resting right now. Please call back later.

char_135_halo_CN_011.voiceText: Researcher Elena Urbica of Rhine Lab. A pleasure to make your acquaintance. We're supposed to call each other by codenames here, right? No problem. In that case, call me Astgenne. It's simple and easy to remember.

char_135_halo_CN_012.voiceText: I don't think I've seen a problem like that before. Gotta take notes...

char_135_halo_CN_013.voiceText: What a pretty medal! Let me help you pin it on. Hm? How come you're the one wearing it instead of me? Isn't this commemorating your good eye for people?

char_135_halo_CN_014.voiceText: Let's join together and break the shackles, Doctor! The future is unfolding right before our eyes!

char_135_halo_CN_018.voiceText: Hold on a sec. I'll finish reading the team leader's messages in a jiffy.

char_135_halo_CN_019.voiceText: All charged up and ready to go.

char_135_halo_CN_020.voiceText: I'll show you the power of technology.

char_135_halo_CN_025.voiceText: Miracles don't just drop out of the sky.

char_135_halo_CN_027.voiceText: I'm not gonna sit here and wait for my demise.

char_135_halo_CN_028.voiceText: My lightning will illuminate the starry sky!

char_135_halo_CN_029.voiceText: You had even the finest details under control. You must be a professional.

char_135_halo_CN_030.voiceText: I knew everything was going to be okay.

char_135_halo_CN_031.voiceText: Everything's under control~ Just a little scuffed, that's all...

char_135_halo_CN_032.voiceText: No way... How could my calculation have...?

char_135_halo_CN_033.voiceText: Let's see how far this is from my workstation...

char_135_halo_CN_036.voiceText: Oh, Doctor! What a coincidence running into you here! Why don't we go shopping together?

char_1026_gvial2_CN_001.voiceText: Doctor, got any trouble for me to handle? What? Just haul these files for you?

char_1026_gvial2_CN_002.voiceText: I gotta hand it to her, Doctor, this axe Zumama made for me turned out great, but I've already got this muscle memory from whacking enemies with my staff. See, still carrying it with me. I'm here to save people, after all, not beat 'em up. Gotta work that out.

char_1026_gvial2_CN_003.voiceText: Doctor, check it out. Getting extra weapons' kind a juggling act, so I found a solution. Trained my tail a little, and now, I can use it to hold my staff. Only downside is—I think my tail got thicker after all that exercise.

char_1026_gvial2_CN_004.voiceText: How's that, Doctor? Shoulders feel much better, right? I told you, controlling my strength's a piece of cake, it's just none of you wanna believe me. I've been practicing medicine as a pro for years now. It's about time you recognized the fact, don’t you think?

char_1026_gvial2_CN_005.voiceText: Oh, right, Doctor, it’s been a while since your last trip to Acahualla, right? Join me next time I visit my home, if you can spare the time. They told me it's a party there now. Even I'm wondering what my home's gonna be like when I visit again.

char_1026_gvial2_CN_006.voiceText: Doctor, you know there's times you can trust your intuition. You've got all these Operators who trust you, see. Even with your eyes closed, your fists are still real strong—What? Compared to mine? Hey... I could K.O. you before you even made it out of this office, so I'm the stronger one there!

char_1026_gvial2_CN_007.voiceText: Zumama can build machines, Tomimi can manage people, and Inam's a damn-good lord ameer... Man, my friends rule! But my medical skills aren't bad either! Huh? What do you mean that's the one thing they’d argue?

char_1026_gvial2_CN_008.voiceText: Y'know, Doctor, I never understood why you made everything so complicated all the time. But now, I kinda get it, in a small sorta way. To put it in plaintalk, you're just finding ways to get bigger fists. So let me get real here, Doc. It's time you worked out with me.

char_1026_gvial2_CN_009.voiceText: Zumama was right. All I gotta do is think about how to get stronger, and how to throw my fists. So I've got an extremely serious question to ask you, Doctor... If I get Zumama to build us a two-seater Raging Ironhide, do you wanna ride driver-side or passenger?

char_1026_gvial2_CN_010.voiceText: Alright, how should I wake the Doc up...?

char_1026_gvial2_CN_011.voiceText: Hold on, Doctor, I know what you wanna ask, and my files are still up in Medical. But, y'know, Dr. Kal'tsit's got a point. Doesn't reflect well on Medical to have a physician steamrolling around the front lines, so from now on, this is how I'm heading out.

char_1026_gvial2_CN_012.voiceText: There... wouldn't a quick axe chop do the job?!

char_1026_gvial2_CN_013.voiceText: *sigh* Just doesn't give me the same kick I get being endorsed for my medical skills...

char_1026_gvial2_CN_014.voiceText: Doctor, doesn't matter if I've got an axe or staff in hand, I'm just hoping to accomplish a little something, make everyone's lives a little bit happier. I've managed to do a bunch so far, and before my body gives out on me here, I'm gonna do more.

char_1026_gvial2_CN_017.voiceText: Leave the front to me. The rear's all yours!

char_1026_gvial2_CN_018.voiceText: You get to follow me under one condition—you all stay alive and well. Got it?

char_1026_gvial2_CN_019.voiceText: Let's go! Oh, speaking of which, what was our objective again?

char_1026_gvial2_CN_020.voiceText: Alright, guys! Let's make some noise!

char_1026_gvial2_CN_021.voiceText: Doctor, leave the big guys to me!

char_1026_gvial2_CN_024.voiceText: I'll take the lead! The rest is up to you guys!

char_1026_gvial2_CN_025.voiceText: Relax, it'll be over in an instant.

char_1026_gvial2_CN_029.voiceText: Uh... might be kind of weird to say at this point, Doctor, but nailing down a tough mission on nothing but trust for others—that's pretty damn neat.

char_1026_gvial2_CN_030.voiceText: Everybody good? We've got another battle waiting for us. Pump yourselves up! We're gonna crush this mission together!

char_1026_gvial2_CN_031.voiceText: No rush. Doesn't matter if we're chasing 'em down or watching for a counterattack, just leave it to me. I want anyone who needs it to rest up!

char_1026_gvial2_CN_032.voiceText: Doctor, hold on tight to my shoulders! Don't go blaming me if you fall off.

char_1026_gvial2_CN_033.voiceText: I guess I'll drop in at Medical before the mission.

char_1026_gvial2_CN_034.voiceText: What's the rush, Doc? Not like I'm gonna run away.

char_1026_gvial2_CN_036.voiceText: You look pretty free to me, Doctor. Just so happens I am too. Wanna take a walk?

char_1026_gvial2_CN_042.voiceText: Doctor! ...Oops, my bad. Didn't bruise you, did I?

char_4055_bgsnow_CN_001.voiceText: Hello, Doctor. I'll be acting as your assistant from here on. Please keep an appropriate distance from me; I'll be more at ease that way.

char_4055_bgsnow_CN_002.voiceText: I recall my first time ordering a fountain pen from Zeruertza's artisans, where I didn't make my requirements clear. Then I ended up with this crossbow. It plagues me to have had the peace-loving Durin forges a weapon… Operator Myrtle? Calling herself Generalissimo? That's just a childish fan—Ahem, it's her own self-styling.

char_4055_bgsnow_CN_003.voiceText: If you'll permit my frankness, it's my belief Rhodes Island should build work and living environments more suited to the Durin operators. At least the cafeteria menu should be decided by vote—they're all satisfied? They can't be! I'll go and ask them, lest you—lest someone be tricking them.

char_4055_bgsnow_CN_004.voiceText: You require me to draft some slogans? I'd be happy to. It was routine work of mine in Zeruertza. You only need to provide me a typewriter, and that's all... Why do I not use a pen? My fountain pen is typically for more private things, more... not-so-Durin things.

char_4055_bgsnow_CN_005.voiceText: I was a steadfast teetotaler back in Ursus, but to my surprise, I could keep more drink down than most in Zeruertza. Truth be told, I didn't immediately understand why they loved their drink so, but I did eventually come to realize. We only drink in excess when hope is lost, and a forever stagnant, easy life can lose us hope as well as anything.

char_4055_bgsnow_CN_006.voiceText: I still hold that life in the Durin cities far surpasses that of the surface, but I have to admit, the flowerets that vie to bloom in the ruins have more of a power than all the blossoms of Durin greenhouses... Hah. All these years, and yet I'm a surface-dweller through and through.

char_4055_bgsnow_CN_007.voiceText: Ursus desserts and wine? Let someone else have the pastries, please. 'Ursus-style' is an exceptional stranger to me by now. That said, do leave the liquor here. Zeruertzans love their drink, and I'm no exception—wait, this isn't mead. Is this pure spirits? Oh, my head...

char_4055_bgsnow_CN_008.voiceText: Noble? Correct, I was once a noble. Until a conspiracy wrested my family away, and left me with the sole luck of escaping underground to Zeruertza. There was no avaricious nobility in the city, nor any commoners who'd take advantage for their own gain. Only kindhearted Durins... What more could I ask for?

char_4055_bgsnow_CN_009.voiceText: Doctor, I'd like to talk with you of beauty and virtue, of those things I consider vanished from the surface. I've witnessed their existence aboard Rhodes Island, and you've told me that more of their sparks are alight upon this land still... I don't dare trust. I have to go and see it for myself.

char_4055_bgsnow_CN_010.voiceText: Doctor, are you asleep? No? Well, no matter. If you're planning to hold the same posture for a while, perhaps I might draw a fountain pen sketch of you.

char_4055_bgsnow_CN_011.voiceText: I believe you're the Doctor? It's nice to meet you. Please accept my gratitude; thank you for allowing me to lodge here, a refuge on the unseemly surface.

char_4055_bgsnow_CN_012.voiceText: I could never imagine. Do you show these violent, bloody tapes to the Durins as well?

char_4055_bgsnow_CN_013.voiceText: Thank you for the gesture of confidence. I'll endure the urge to flee the award ceremony as best I can, so please, if you could wrap it up soon... There's no ceremony, it's just a normal presentation? Oh, that's a relief.

char_4055_bgsnow_CN_014.voiceText: Another promotion, is it? Thank you. I'll accept this honor with my chest out in pride... And of course, we don't need to end this presentation as quickly as last time. Do not be afraid of those I should not fear—this is what life aboard Rhodes Island has taught me.

char_4055_bgsnow_CN_017.voiceText: The day shall come for every land dweller, the day they find a cold weapon in their arms. And I learned it the hard way.

char_4055_bgsnow_CN_018.voiceText: For those of you who've spent not a second out of the fight, decades-old tactical thinking from Ursus must be far past its prime.

char_4055_bgsnow_CN_020.voiceText: Enemy... A noun I hardly want to reunite with outside of writing. It's been so long.

char_4055_bgsnow_CN_023.voiceText: Good visibility. I'm ready to fire.

char_4055_bgsnow_CN_025.voiceText: Bolt pierces deeper than nib on the battlefield.

char_4055_bgsnow_CN_027.voiceText: Abandon resistance now, or I pull the trigger!

char_4055_bgsnow_CN_029.voiceText: Surface civilization is no different to the ferocious vile beasts, but perhaps you can become one who loops its reins.

char_4055_bgsnow_CN_030.voiceText: The battle is over. It's time to return and write, and do something more meaningful than this.

char_4055_bgsnow_CN_031.voiceText: Apologies, Doctor. I'm still unaccustomed to the sensation of combat.

char_4055_bgsnow_CN_032.voiceText: Doctor, evacuate everyone as fast as you can, I—I'll bring up the rear! Don't mind me, go!

char_4055_bgsnow_CN_033.voiceText: Zeruertza has molded me. I'm still a little unused to moving about these narrow spaces.

char_4055_bgsnow_CN_036.voiceText: Doctor, if you insist on chatting with me, what say we talk about your favorite books?

char_4055_bgsnow_CN_042.voiceText: *yawn*... Good morning, Doctor. The book you recommended was very interesting. I finished reading it overnight.

char_497_ctable_CN_001.voiceText: Doctor, watch your hands. If you aren't careful around my weapons, you'll get hurt.

char_497_ctable_CN_002.voiceText: Here are the instruments I used to play. There aren't too many of them, but the gems on them are very valuable. Sell them, and they should cover my medical fees... Once my debt's cleared, I'd like to go back to living on my own. Would that be alright?

char_497_ctable_CN_003.voiceText: I've seen pets kept around your hospital here, and you have a training room. I've seen some of the children you're giving intensive care in the wards. 'Instructor?' 'Professor?' My previous savior brought me to those with the same title, and look how I ended up.

char_497_ctable_CN_004.voiceText: This? This is my lyre. I may be better with other instruments, but I like playing this one most. Listen. Such an airy, lingering timbre, and the hand moves so beautifully when playing. But when you fully lose yourself in the melody, the knife concealed inside will... I'm sorry, I got carried away.

char_497_ctable_CN_005.voiceText: Doctor, do you intend only to treat me here? Strange. You really don't need me to do anything? I can't trust kindness with no strings attached. Let me do a little something for you, okay? I'm sure you'll be satisfied, no matter the task—But, you must share with me your motivations.

char_497_ctable_CN_006.voiceText: I remember coming back from my first fulfilled mission when I was young, weeping and throwing up, scared I didn't do well enough, that I would starve to death in some forgotten corner, unknown to anyone... No longer do I fear these things. Thanks to the days with Rhodes Island, I now know how it feels to be truly alive.

char_497_ctable_CN_007.voiceText: The Originium on my arm... it hurts terribly, but it's much more manageable by now. I know none of the physicians, but I can tell how sincerely they're working to save me. Doctor, once my illness has stabilized to a point, can I... stay here?

char_497_ctable_CN_008.voiceText: A lot of my past mistakes were made out of fear. I was scared—I felt that if I didn't listen to them, I was dead. But after catching Oripathy, they threw me out there to die. I should have been terrified at that moment, but instead I was... relieved. The sun shining on my face—it was so warm, it really was.

char_497_ctable_CN_009.voiceText: Doctor, could you take me with you on your next field mission? I want to know the reasoning behind your every decision. Why did you save me, a stranger? Just what does my life mean to you...? I want to figure you out, just a little clearer.

char_497_ctable_CN_010.voiceText: All the ones before you would sleep with one eye open, when I was around. Do you... trust me that much?

char_497_ctable_CN_011.voiceText: So you're the Doctor from Rhodes Island...? Thank you for what you did. I'll pay for my treatment in time. Otherwise, I'd like to be on my own for now.

char_497_ctable_CN_012.voiceText: I'm a fast learner, don't worry.

char_497_ctable_CN_013.voiceText: So this is how it feels... to hold my life in my own hands.

char_497_ctable_CN_014.voiceText: This isn't the first time someone saves my life. But, if I had a chance to get back to those barrens, a chance to weigh up what's behind those helping hands again, I would choose to starve to death there. Doctor, I've been thinking... how nice it would've been, if you were there offering your hand instead.

char_497_ctable_CN_017.voiceText: I trust your judgment. You won't lead me astray.

char_497_ctable_CN_018.voiceText: If I make any mistakes, please point them out to me.

char_497_ctable_CN_019.voiceText: Things are different. I don't want to hide myself any longer.

char_497_ctable_CN_023.voiceText: In time, I'll find the right place for myself too.

char_497_ctable_CN_025.voiceText: I'm aware of what I'm doing.

char_497_ctable_CN_026.voiceText: I know what it is I want.

char_497_ctable_CN_029.voiceText: That's one more step in the right direction, isn't it?

char_497_ctable_CN_030.voiceText: Someday in the future, I'll have as clear a direction as you do.

char_497_ctable_CN_031.voiceText: We have a few runaways. A little like I once was.

char_497_ctable_CN_032.voiceText: This isn't happening, don't abandon me... Doctor, where are you?

char_497_ctable_CN_033.voiceText: Are you interested in my instruments? I can teach you how to play.

char_497_ctable_CN_036.voiceText: If I leave someday, you'll send me off, won't you?

char_497_ctable_CN_042.voiceText: I heard the sound of your footsteps, Doctor.

char_4054_malist_CN_001.voiceText: You want me to do file collation work...? These documents of yours all look dusty. I don't want to touch them. And how was your office even planned in the first place? Did you genuinely not feel personally, utterly disgusted leaving this cabinet here?

char_4054_malist_CN_002.voiceText: I propose swapping for more corrosion-proof materials next time you do maintenance on the ship's core structure. Why? Because when all's said and done, it's not you or me that'll be left behind. It's this landship's skeleton. That's what's going to endure. That's what will stand for us.

char_4054_malist_CN_003.voiceText: You've got some planning work for me? I'll ask to review my partners' design styles first. As long as they aren't too complex about it, I might be able to accept—okay, okay, fine, I'll do it, I'll take it, it's not as if collaborations are some big deal. Besides, it's not that you have disastrous taste.

char_4054_malist_CN_004.voiceText: What is it... Ah, darn it, the pencil smudged my belt again. I just got it replaced... Last time it was Gavial, saying she'd get me a new one of the same look. As if! The emblem on the clasp was straight from my designs, and obviously she didn't even give those an honest look!

char_4054_malist_CN_005.voiceText: I know, I'll go to the infirmary in a bit. I don't want to interrupt my thought process at the moment. And you know, Doctor, the moment is the exact thing I most value—you called Gavial in? Was she on duty at the Medical Department today? You can't fool—hello, Gavial, no no, I wasn't just working on any designs.

char_4054_malist_CN_006.voiceText: I used to appreicate a fan base of one, one who can truly see to the core of my designs, rather than having a crowd of followers with their superfacial admiration. For me, the latter holds absolutely no significance. But now… I suppose it's not all bad to let the masses see them. Discussion swirling around my work means I'm still alive.

char_4054_malist_CN_007.voiceText: Why do I tend not to greet anyone? Because once I do, I have to make small talk, and that forces me to crane my head up to speak with them, which makes me seem insignificant. We should be seeing eye-to-eye, on EQUAL footing... Are you asking if it weighs on me? As if! It just makes my neck ache.

char_4054_malist_CN_008.voiceText: I was genuinely full of anxiety back then. I always felt I didn't have enough time, though I'd never even accomplished a thing. But nowadays, I've gotten to the point where I can appreciate my own designs. The only thing is, it's been years since I last saw my teacher. I wonder if he'd be proud of me?

char_4054_malist_CN_009.voiceText: A close look is all it takes to unearth the core sense of a man from his work. Just like how I used to disdain anything superfluous. I treated my own life in the same way. Doctor, an artwork is a microcosm of its creator's life. Yours, I can understand.

char_4054_malist_CN_010.voiceText: Hmm. Such a counter-conventional sleeping posture, such a complex yet stable load-bearing structure... miraculous. Is this not going to give you neck arthritis?

char_4054_malist_CN_011.voiceText: I'm Operator Minimalist, freshly dragged here by Gavial. So this is what a nomadic landship's like? You must have a much easier time avoiding Catastrophes than we do underground. Hmph, the only thing in those fools' heads is merrily drinking their lives away—ow, Gavial, what did you hit me for?!

char_4054_malist_CN_012.voiceText: ...If it's not architecture-related, I don't want to see it.

char_4054_malist_CN_013.voiceText: A medal? Decently tasteful. You just give this to me, and that's it, right? I've absolutely no need for any sort of commendation ceremonies, and I imagine you don't like to waste time anyway. But I will—ahem—thank you for acknowledging me.

char_4054_malist_CN_014.voiceText: Everyone's experiences are different, and the significance lying behind my works will be out of sight to most... but there are some, like you, like my mentor, that I hope can understand.

char_4054_malist_CN_018.voiceText: You want me for captain? What are you even... You're joking, aren't you? Hey!

char_4054_malist_CN_019.voiceText: Hm... alright, let me be clear, I don't have any prior combat experience. However, I am going to take this mission seriously.

char_4054_malist_CN_020.voiceText: Instrument debugging complete. I can begin any time.

char_4054_malist_CN_021.voiceText: I am aware. Don't push me.

char_4054_malist_CN_022.voiceText: If you break anything, you're paying!

char_4054_malist_CN_023.voiceText: Instrument is operating fine. Now scanning terrain.

char_4054_malist_CN_026.voiceText: We're not here to be courteous.

char_4054_malist_CN_027.voiceText: I just don't get you people...

char_4054_malist_CN_029.voiceText: Huh. You're mightier than you let on, aren't you?

char_4054_malist_CN_030.voiceText: *cough* *cough* *cough*... There's so much dust—it's filthy. Gah.

char_4054_malist_CN_031.voiceText: What are you looking at me for? You want me to chase them?

char_4054_malist_CN_032.voiceText: Snap out of it! Get running!

char_4054_malist_CN_033.voiceText: I don't want to open my eyes . I'm worried the interior design is going to scare the life out of me.

char_4054_malist_CN_036.voiceText: Phew... what time is it? No, what day of the week? Er... did I eat anything yet? I don't think I did...?

char_4054_malist_CN_042.voiceText: Doctor, sitting for too long can leave you prone to neck arthritis. I suggest you watch out for yourself.

char_4067_lolxh_CN_001.voiceText: This table's really high! I guess it's easier if I just use my old form to jump up.

char_4067_lolxh_CN_002.voiceText: What are you doing here? There's these Medic Operators who keep chasing my tail all the time saying they wanna study me! I need to lay low! Still, why are you hiding here too? You're not slacking off, right, Doctor?

char_4067_lolxh_CN_003.voiceText: My power is controlling metal, stuff like the thing on your table. I can make it turn pointy, round, or flat, and even more complicated shapes too.

char_4067_lolxh_CN_004.voiceText: The people here look a lot like the spirits in our world. So maybe, the spirits in this world look like you do, Doctor?

char_4067_lolxh_CN_005.voiceText: This place is a lot like the Hall for Spirits to me, with all the Infected staying here because they have nowhere to go. But... the Infected have it really different from spirits. They can't even escape just by staying far away from everyone.

char_4067_lolxh_CN_006.voiceText: There's so many Catastrophes here... Is this why your cities have to keep wandering everywhere all the time?

char_4067_lolxh_CN_007.voiceText: I get it! Operators are Executors, aren't they? Executors do errands for the Hall for Spirits, and Operators do errands for Rhodes Island! Huh? No?

char_4067_lolxh_CN_008.voiceText: I'll be an Executor someday, just like my master. My master's really mighty! Um... you too. Everyone on this battleship listens to you, so you've got to be somebody incredible.

char_4067_lolxh_CN_009.voiceText: Doctor, are we friends now? Then if you can, you should visit our side to play sometime!

char_4067_lolxh_CN_010.voiceText: Doctor, are you eating something secret there?

char_4067_lolxh_CN_011.voiceText: Hello, Doctor, my name's Xiaohei, and I'm a spirit.

char_4067_lolxh_CN_012.voiceText: Doctor... if I don't understand these tapes, can I ask you about them?

char_4067_lolxh_CN_014.voiceText: I still don't really get it, but thanks, Doctor.

char_4067_lolxh_CN_017.voiceText: Doctor, I'm here! Huh? Is there something on my face? Ah, I just finished eating, haha.

char_4067_lolxh_CN_018.voiceText: I'm gonna be the captain? Can I handle that...?

char_4067_lolxh_CN_019.voiceText: Doctor, grab onto me, I'll use my power to send us there. It's quicker that way.

char_4067_lolxh_CN_020.voiceText: Are... all of them bad guys?

char_4067_lolxh_CN_021.voiceText: Heixiu, we have to help the Doctor out.

char_4067_lolxh_CN_022.voiceText: Uh-huh, Doctor, I'm here, don't worry.

char_4067_lolxh_CN_023.voiceText: I'm actually pretty good at assassinating.

char_4067_lolxh_CN_024.voiceText: I won't let you hurt them!

char_4067_lolxh_CN_026.voiceText: If you get any closer, I'll get mean!

char_4067_lolxh_CN_027.voiceText: I'm super strong! I'll show you how mighty I am!

char_4067_lolxh_CN_029.voiceText: Is everyone okay? I'm so, so glad!

char_4067_lolxh_CN_032.voiceText: It's all my fault for being so weak, Doctor...

char_4067_lolxh_CN_033.voiceText: I can't forget about the mission the Doctor gave me. But this mat's so comfortable, and the sun's so warm. I think I'm getting kinda sleepy...

char_4067_lolxh_CN_034.voiceText: Doctor, don't mess with my ears!

char_4067_lolxh_CN_036.voiceText: What are you still working for, Doctor? It's almost food time!

char_4064_mlynar_CN_001.voiceText: If you've thought it through, I have no qualms with it. Please let me know when the documents are due.

char_4064_mlynar_CN_002.voiceText: ...Please, go ahead. It's okay. Reading the paper is just an unhelpful habit I picked up in the Grand Knight Territory, but one can learn much more from a day's trip outside the city than a hundred papers can teach... It's true that the Nearl name often shows up in the headlines, but there's no need to pay that any mind.

char_4064_mlynar_CN_003.voiceText: I'm afraid I can't advise Rhodes Island on its affairs in Kazimierz. I may have spent a decade in that tower, but only as an unambitious nobody. I'm in no position to express my views on the General Chamber of Commerce. The sword...? Yes, I know how to use one, and I've always used the same one.

char_4064_mlynar_CN_004.voiceText: No need to have Maria come see me. She's not a child anymore, and ought to make her own decisions, lest she embarrass her parents. A knight should temper themselves through travel, and no matter what she does under Rhodes Island's wing, she must always be responsible for her own actions.

char_4064_mlynar_CN_005.voiceText: Leithanien's conspiracies... Nothing more than trifles that happened years ago. It doesn't change the fact that I'm an ordinary citizen, nor does it change anything else. To Kazimierzians, stars and heroes come and go. The success they enjoy is only that which they are permitted.

char_4064_mlynar_CN_006.voiceText: Seems Margaret kept the title she earned from that charade. Hmph, so she still sees her actions as a victory, after squandering the Nearls' glory in those cheap commercial performances... My Originium Arts? Alas, I can nary illuminate a thing.

char_4064_mlynar_CN_007.voiceText: No need to teach me how to get along with the Infected...You should be aware of my time spent living among the refugees…? The Infected, the disabled, the bankrupt, the famished and poor... they're all the same in the ways that matter. The most honorable thing they can hope to achieve is climbing out of their tent in the settlement before their final moments arrive.

char_4064_mlynar_CN_008.voiceText: You, too, encourage the others to throw themselves at a cause that will yield no results. Those who attempt to walk through fire in the dark night will only find themselves immolated. That said, you don't need my advice, given the path you so obstinately walk alone.

char_4064_mlynar_CN_009.voiceText: In the first two years after they left the Grand Knight Territory, the campaign knights would often bring me their letters. By the time the last one arrived, Maria was already old enough to understand its gist... Whether the letters were written beforehand makes no difference to me, but given the weight of their lives and deaths, they wouldn't have disappeared without so much as a peep.

char_4064_mlynar_CN_011.voiceText: Młynar Nearl. Per our contract's provisions, I shall assist Rhodes Island with its operations in Kazimierz. ...You already knew my name. I'm neither a knight, nor do I have a title.

char_4064_mlynar_CN_012.voiceText: A Kazimierzian is smart after the damage is done…

char_4064_mlynar_CN_013.voiceText: I appreciate your appraisal, if you consider such ordinary performance worthy of promotion.

char_4064_mlynar_CN_014.voiceText: Titles and positions are both meaningless. The knights of the Nearl family do not require recognition to walk their paths. Even in modern Kazimierz, where every path leads to darkness.

char_4064_mlynar_CN_017.voiceText: Man has forgotten true struggle… as well as those who require it to survive.

char_4064_mlynar_CN_019.voiceText: Sand, dust, and blood. Most fail to imagine the sight of their admixture.

char_4064_mlynar_CN_020.voiceText: To think they are unaware of their own shame...

char_4064_mlynar_CN_023.voiceText: These so-called foes… not even worth drawing my sword.

char_4064_mlynar_CN_024.voiceText: Just like the old days?… No.

char_4064_mlynar_CN_028.voiceText: That sigh... still haunts my mind.

char_4064_mlynar_CN_029.voiceText: You still have full confidence in everything... With these people's fate in your hand, you still believe there will be a happy ending.

char_4064_mlynar_CN_030.voiceText: If you have no other work for me, I shall take my leave.

char_4064_mlynar_CN_031.voiceText: Deserters… they always have somewhere to hide, among their like-minded brethren.

char_4064_mlynar_CN_032.voiceText: Mark my words, there will be battles you cannot win. Have you considered the consequences of those inevitable failures?

char_4064_mlynar_CN_033.voiceText: You... accommodate quite a few people here.

char_4064_mlynar_CN_034.voiceText: ...I believe I've made a suggestion regarding this matter?

char_4064_mlynar_CN_036.voiceText: Kazimierz's knight novels... Hmph... The Grand Knight Territory no longer has room for such fantasies.

char_4032_provs_CN_001.voiceText: These documents won't take me long to take care of. Why don't you show me Rhodes Island's old business contracts? You never know what kind of restitutions there might be hidden in a contract's terms.

char_4032_provs_CN_002.voiceText: Doctor, when you work out your business plans, feel free to put off the legal ramifications till the very end. I've never lost a case as a defense attorney.

char_4032_provs_CN_003.voiceText: Huh? Even that ice-cold Młynar is here? And here I thought he'd want a breather after leaving his job behind in the Grand Knight Territory. Well, Rhodes Island isn't a bad place. At least they don't expect you to wine-and-dine clients here. Otherwise, considering his alcohol tolerance...

char_4032_provs_CN_004.voiceText: Is that a Kazimierzian newspaper you're reading, Doctor? 'Despite Conclusive Evidence, Knight Sports Match Fixers Found Innocent'—Oh, I was in charge of that case. What does that mean? Hehe, if they walked away scot-free, then obviously the evidence wasn't conclusive enough.

char_4032_provs_CN_005.voiceText: I've never actually worked for a multinational corporation before, so I've been reading up on other countries' laws, too. But no matter where you are, the lawbooks make it clear as day who benefits under their rules.

char_4032_provs_CN_006.voiceText: The courtroom is a place of victory and defeat. Both sides submit their evidence, and their disputes are arbitrated within the confines of the law. I never expected to find any justice in that process, but when the law can be freely trampled on by capitalism, being a lawyer gets real boring, don't you think?

char_4032_provs_CN_007.voiceText: Ugh, my back hurts. I kind of want a massage chair, but money's tight with my current salary. But considering Rhodes Island's revenue, I suppose the pay isn't completely unreasonable—Speaking of which, what do you think of my plan to demand compensation from companies we've worked with? What? How can it be extortion when we're asking for pocket change?!

char_4032_provs_CN_008.voiceText: Doctor, I think there are a lot of problems with the medical malpractice liability clauses in Rhodes Island's contracts. In most countries, we as a medical company wouldn't be liable for a lot of the scenarios listed in there—You don't want to fix it? Alright, I'll give it some more thought.

char_4032_provs_CN_009.voiceText: I'm slowly starting to understand that expecting the law be able to judge all disputes fairly isn't just naive, it's intellectually lazy. The law is not perfect, and it will always be riddled with holes that we need to fill with humanity.

char_4032_provs_CN_010.voiceText: So even the Doctor likes to sleep at the desk, just like me. I'll be worried about your spine if this keeps up, though…

char_4032_provs_CN_011.voiceText: Hello, my name is Deszcz. I'm your new legal consultant. If you need to call me by a codename, then use Proviso. Let me get this out of the way first, though. The general practice of obfuscating all your employees' identities isn't going to fly with me.

char_4032_provs_CN_012.voiceText: If you're putting me in charge, I can make sure the enemies will be liable for all damages.

char_4032_provs_CN_013.voiceText: A promotion? Let me take a look at the new contract... Alright, everything checks out. My salary did go up. Thanks!

char_4032_provs_CN_014.voiceText: If you're letting me read these high clearance level materials, this is going way beyond a normal partnership, isn't it...? Thanks for your trust, Doctor. I hope I'll be able to accomplish with law what I never could before I came here.

char_4032_provs_CN_017.voiceText: I'm glad to help, but before we get started, can we be more explicit with regards to the terms of compensation?

char_4032_provs_CN_018.voiceText: Everyone, please be sure to handle the work you're assigned. Do not give our opponents any loopholes.

char_4032_provs_CN_019.voiceText: The court is now in session!

char_4032_provs_CN_020.voiceText: I've gathered enough materials on our opponents. They will lose this case.

char_4032_provs_CN_022.voiceText: Ahem. Allow me to present my argument.

char_4032_provs_CN_023.voiceText: If you are not party to this suit, please leave at once.

char_4032_provs_CN_024.voiceText: Order! The court will soon reach a verdict.

char_4032_provs_CN_025.voiceText: Hold it! The evidence submitted by the opposing party is suspect.

char_4032_provs_CN_026.voiceText: Objection! The witness's testimony is self-contradictory.

char_4032_provs_CN_027.voiceText: Anything you say can and will be used against you. I suggest you exercise your right to remain silent.

char_4032_provs_CN_028.voiceText: Based on the above, you are found guilty.

char_4032_provs_CN_029.voiceText: No surprise there. As long as you understand how to use the system, the results follow naturally.

char_4032_provs_CN_030.voiceText: I take it I met your expectations, Doctor? Now, per our contract, let's discuss legal fees.

char_4032_provs_CN_031.voiceText: Don't worry, we'll get this case thrown out and win the retrial.

char_4032_provs_CN_032.voiceText: Something must've gone wrong somewhere... I won't let this kind of failure happen again.

char_4032_provs_CN_033.voiceText: Can I apply for a more comfortable chair?

char_4032_provs_CN_036.voiceText: Doctor, I took a photo of what you just did as evidence.

char_4032_provs_CN_042.voiceText: Hello, Doctor. I'm happy to report that Rhodes Island is not currently involved in any legal disputes, for now.

char_4066_highmo_CN_001.voiceText: If some work is beyond even your power, then how can I possibly take on a share?

char_4066_highmo_CN_002.voiceText: That nightmare still comes to mind, even now. My life denied by some grand ecology... no, not denied. It would admit everything, it was more sublime than life itself... it made me feel shame at the selfishness of life.

char_4066_highmo_CN_003.voiceText: I don't want to belittle the Medical Department's effort, but I don't believe life can be 'cured' like a disease. Human or Sea Terror, I'm doomed to live on as half-baked, and that's the price I pay for my own foolishness.

char_4066_highmo_CN_004.voiceText: That special 'collaborator' of yours is just something other right now, using biological function to imitate his old form, and you should know that better than him. You're still seeking possibilities in him? I hope you aren't repeating my mistakes.

char_4066_highmo_CN_005.voiceText: I've felt at ease in my time residing aboard the landship, even come to recognize it as a feeling similar to my long-lost home... You don't need to be concerned. Even if Iberia will never be a home to the Ægir, I'd never refuse to execute my responsibilities there, such as we've agreed.

char_4066_highmo_CN_006.voiceText: Anything that seems to be given for free will eventually demand some price of you. That's the lesson I learned. And some of what you do appears to practically overturn that... I'll have to wait and see.

char_4066_highmo_CN_007.voiceText: You're wondering what this song is? It's just something my mother taught me when I was young. I didn't take much interest back then, only humming perfunctory notes to follow along. It was only after losing her, I realized... these melodies form one of the few things I still have to my name.

char_4066_highmo_CN_008.voiceText: An ignorant girl gives up her song, and gains naught but a dream snuffed as quickly as the foam in return. It sounds just like a fairytale, doesn't it? And the fact that such a stupid girl could be saved at the story's end... seems like a fairytale, too.

char_4066_highmo_CN_009.voiceText: You've helped me recover the courage to trust in other beings, so I hope you see this responsibility through. Lead those willing to follow you, and put an end to those disasters that should never have befallen the innocent. Please, don't disappoint me.

char_4066_highmo_CN_010.voiceText: You see them in your dreams too, don't you? All those faces who've quietly left your life.

char_4066_highmo_CN_011.voiceText: So, you'd be the 'Doctor'. I don't have much to introduce about myself. If I'm standing here, you must have read and approved all the files about me.

char_4066_highmo_CN_012.voiceText: Maybe I shouldn't doubt the value of these records, like I did before.

char_4066_highmo_CN_013.voiceText: The more you seek from a power you should reject, the deeper you fall into it. Eventually, it will engulf your entire being. You understand this, don't you?

char_4066_highmo_CN_014.voiceText: You wish to forge a space that can admit me, and hope for me to admit everything surrounding me...? An arrogant notion, truly. But maybe I could bear witness with you, until the day you give up.

char_4066_highmo_CN_017.voiceText: Looks like we've gotten our approvals. It's time to go.

char_4066_highmo_CN_018.voiceText: I might bring their ruin, but only you can bring our victory.

char_4066_highmo_CN_019.voiceText: Let us reap those naive delusions and immature obsessions.

char_4066_highmo_CN_020.voiceText: I hear the sound of the flooding tide.

char_4066_highmo_CN_021.voiceText: Do you have instructions for me?

char_4066_highmo_CN_022.voiceText: Do I still have to wait?

char_4066_highmo_CN_025.voiceText: They have no position to evade.

char_4066_highmo_CN_026.voiceText: They have no power to withstand.

char_4066_highmo_CN_027.voiceText: They have no way to advance.

char_4066_highmo_CN_028.voiceText: They have no path to escape.

char_4066_highmo_CN_029.voiceText: Sometimes, your grasp of the surrounding situation makes me instinctually fearful. Yes, I believe you could make even Sea Terrors comprehend fear. So, do you intend to feel happy about this?

char_4066_highmo_CN_030.voiceText: The waves have subsided. If you have no other tasks, I should leave immediately to undergo a 'routine' inspection.

char_4066_highmo_CN_031.voiceText: Were you showing mercy? Are enemies of this level worth your indulgence?

char_4066_highmo_CN_032.voiceText: We should go. Before the next wave has us drowned.

char_4066_highmo_CN_033.voiceText: So this, too, is the place you promise I can belong.

char_4066_highmo_CN_036.voiceText: This place might be more... calming than expected.

char_4066_highmo_CN_042.voiceText: We still have some time, before the tide floods the soil beneath us.

char_157_dagda_CN_001.voiceText: Siege's ordered me to serve as your assistant. I'll be a harsh supervisor for you, if it's called for.

char_157_dagda_CN_002.voiceText: Huh? Do you have a problem with my metal claws? They're totally brill! ...I mean... They're very... Wieldy. Please don't get the wrong idea about my taste.

char_157_dagda_CN_003.voiceText: Morgan picked this outfit. Obviously, something with a knightly air would definitely suit me more. Although this street style... is just a little bit... wicked.

char_157_dagda_CN_004.voiceText: Indra's a mess, both the way she lives and fights. That said, she'll go through hell and high water for her mates, and she'll fight to her last breath for Siege—maybe, she's more knight than some knights out there, and she's never even had to try.

char_157_dagda_CN_005.voiceText: Most of Victoria's people live out their whole lives in their own cities, while everyone aboard Rhodes Island has left their homes to drift around this land. It just bowls me over.

char_157_dagda_CN_006.voiceText: The Montague name and the title of Knight of the Tower used to be more precious to me than anything. But gradually, I came to see how change for Victoria was unavoidable, and it doesn't just stem from the flames of war before us. I may have to abandon my past to follow Siege, but I'll follow through, unto the very end.

char_157_dagda_CN_007.voiceText: Bound to uphold Victoria's dignity, the Knights of the Tower never once shrank back in the face of the Sarkaz's blades. I was the only one who escaped, protected by my brothers and sisters in arms... I often think to myself—if... just if... I could've fought to the end with them...

char_157_dagda_CN_008.voiceText: Siege said I should choose the life I truly want to live when the war is over. Once that day arrives, how will Victoria turn out to be? And how will I turn out to be? I... I can't imagine it. All I hope is I'm still able to stay by their sides.

char_157_dagda_CN_009.voiceText: Dr. {@nickname}... From here onwards, my blade belongs to both Victoria, and you. You can call me either Dagda or the 'Dark Blade.' Isa? T-Too frivolous! But if you've got to... then keep your voice down!

char_157_dagda_CN_010.voiceText: It's a Knight of the Tower's duty to stand night watch. May you rest well, Doctor.

char_157_dagda_CN_011.voiceText: Knight of the Tower Isabella Montague. On behalf of Siege and our little alliance, I express our sincerest gratitude… What do you mean I don't dress like a knight? L-Looks can be bloody deceiving!

char_157_dagda_CN_012.voiceText: Umm...I'm seeing a wide gap between these tactics and my old training.

char_157_dagda_CN_013.voiceText: A medal? I can't accept any that's not Victorian... hmm, but you are the Doctor of Rhodes Island. Okay, I'm making an exception just this once.

char_157_dagda_CN_014.voiceText: Ever since we left Londinium, I've trained up a million more techniques than just knightly combat! Now you're going to see my true strength!

char_157_dagda_CN_017.voiceText: I've got no need to hide my identity if I'm fighting for Rhodes Island, yeah?

char_157_dagda_CN_018.voiceText: What style of command do you want from me? The knight type, or the gang type?

char_157_dagda_CN_019.voiceText: A fight? Wicked, bring it on... Ahem, as a Knight of the Tower, I accept your challenge.

char_157_dagda_CN_020.voiceText: These punks are nothing compared to the foes Victoria's surmounted!

char_157_dagda_CN_027.voiceText: Even without a blade, I can run you through!

char_157_dagda_CN_028.voiceText: Any soldier's will is worthy of respect.

char_157_dagda_CN_029.voiceText: Be of firm enough conviction, and it won't matter what difficulties you face. You'll have nothing to be afraid of.

char_157_dagda_CN_030.voiceText: Is that it? I didn't get to show off my real skills yet... If there is a next time, permit I continue to stand by your side.

char_157_dagda_CN_031.voiceText: You can't reach perfection without pushing yourself to the limit. I must do better.

char_157_dagda_CN_032.voiceText: If only I had a blade on me, I could... No, I can't give up now. Doctor, I'm ready to enter the next battle.

char_157_dagda_CN_033.voiceText: I'll assume guard duties for this room.

char_4062_totter_CN_001.voiceText: You keep the place so messy but find what you need anyway? *sigh* Well, that's also a talent, I guess.

char_4062_totter_CN_002.voiceText: Doctor, am I able to file for exemption from paperwork? I have a bad case of farsightedness. It's a lot of strain to read, and fatigue strikes easily.

char_4062_totter_CN_003.voiceText: I'm a repressed sort, not talkative. If you're not entertained, you can head out for now. No, I don't mean to drive you off, I just...

char_4062_totter_CN_004.voiceText: I don't need to be issued a scope. In my crossbow's killing range, my naked eye sees clearly enough.

char_4062_totter_CN_005.voiceText: My bolt points are a custom make. They pierce armor and cause massive blood loss in a short time. They're based on what Sargon hunters specially use to hunt big beasts, then I made modifications after coming to Victoria. Now they fly lighter, and kill harder.

char_4062_totter_CN_006.voiceText: The merc business is tough, absolutely. Sometimes I'd be in the snow and an entire day would pass on my watch, and my feet would be frostbitten by the end. I appreciate your look of concern, but it was fine. Even lucky. My left foot hurt less when it was frozen.

char_4062_totter_CN_007.voiceText: Why I like snow, you wonder? Let me think... Does never seeing it in Sargon count? Heh, it's not really that deep. People always have their inexplicable fancies.

char_4062_totter_CN_008.voiceText: ...If it's alright for me to ask, could you read the poem in this book to me, Doctor? I borrowed it from Istina. She says it's a fine poem, about winter in Deity Grypherburg.

char_4062_totter_CN_009.voiceText: Do you know what's most precious? Someone to peacefully watch the snow with. Maybe I've met one at some point before, but who knows? Once the snow descends, it covers all traces of anything, including the fading footprints.

char_4062_totter_CN_010.voiceText: How about a mug of hot water? You seem a little pale.

char_4062_totter_CN_011.voiceText: Hello, Doctor, I'm Totter. Long-range sniping's my specialty. You can leave any task to me as long as it's a workday.

char_4062_totter_CN_012.voiceText: Hold on, Doctor, it's too close. Let me put on my glasses and try again.

char_4062_totter_CN_013.voiceText: If you're pleased with my work, then I couldn't ask for more.

char_4062_totter_CN_014.voiceText: Thank you, Doctor, but your appreciation actually leaves me at a loss. Err. If I'm being honest, I don't have big dreams for my work.

char_4062_totter_CN_018.voiceText: Everyone, please coordinate. Thanks in advance.

char_4062_totter_CN_019.voiceText: Let's move. Time waits for nobody.

char_4062_totter_CN_020.voiceText: They're fast on the move, but I can still read their tracks.

char_4062_totter_CN_022.voiceText: Great luck. Got a tail wind today.

char_4062_totter_CN_023.voiceText: I see clouds rising. Probable hostiles in the snow.

char_4062_totter_CN_024.voiceText: I see fowl taking off. Probable ambush in the grass.

char_4062_totter_CN_029.voiceText: The best kills are one-shot. Less pain for them.

char_4062_totter_CN_030.voiceText: Target down. Mission clear, no setbacks.

char_4062_totter_CN_032.voiceText: Sorry, Doctor, target's out of range. I can't hit them.

char_4062_totter_CN_033.voiceText: Nice. Luxurious compared to my safehouse.

char_4062_totter_CN_036.voiceText: Doctor, is that you? You're blurry, but you've got distinct footsteps. I can tell them apart.

char_4071_peper_CN_001.voiceText: I'm not good at this stuff either. Huh? They need it done today? Eh... Fine, I told you I'd help. I keep my word. Give it here. I'll take half, but you gotta finish the rest on your own!

char_4071_peper_CN_002.voiceText: Got any salt on you, Doc? Here, gimme some. I made potatoes. They taste so good when you sprinkle salt on them! We eat them like this a lot when we're out on a job! I roasted some fruit, too. Take it to W and Ines... Don't tell them it's from me! Got it?

char_4071_peper_CN_003.voiceText: I heard I might run into W here? Seriously? She and Ines saved me a while back, and I'm thankful for it, but she can be real annoying sometimes... Doc, I'm surprised you had the guts to hire her.

char_4071_peper_CN_004.voiceText: Manfred, that jackass! He actually did it! And he was serious about it, too! I totally thought I was going to die... Ugh, I know he's got his reasons... but I still can't let it slide! I've got a grudge!

char_4071_peper_CN_005.voiceText: You were leading the squad then, right? Hmph, how could I forget? You gave me a real bad time! But if I had to do it again, I'd still choose to take everybody and bug out... I don't want to have to watch somebody sacrifice themselves ever again.

char_4071_peper_CN_006.voiceText: Is rebuilding Kazdel really a good idea? I don't know. All I know is I care more about the people around me—my squadmates, everyone from Rhodes Island... of course, that includes you, Doctor! We're buddies now, right?

char_4071_peper_CN_007.voiceText: If Kazdel really gets rebuilt, does that really mean us Sarkaz all get to come back and reunite together? What will the Victorian rebels think of us? I can't see how this all ends... I don't know...

char_4071_peper_CN_008.voiceText: Doc! Is the mail in? Anything for me? Thing is, I was raised by my nana in a small town in Columbia, and we still write to each other! I'm always telling everyone here to write home more often, but for some reason they get pretty upset about it. I wonder why.

char_4071_peper_CN_009.voiceText: C'mere, Doc. Try this on! Hm... Looks great on you. My nana knitted it for you! It matches mine, too! How's it feel? Comfy and warm, right? I told Nana all about you, and she called you a good egg!

char_4071_peper_CN_010.voiceText: So bored... Maybe I should knit something. What do you think of this little pouch? It's very practical!

char_4071_peper_CN_011.voiceText: Hey there! Starting today, my squad and I are at your beck and call, Doctor. Call me Paprika. You seem like a solid employer, but you're still on probation! I've got my eye on you!

char_4071_peper_CN_012.voiceText: Are these the ancient Sarkaz tricks the old folks talk about?

char_4071_peper_CN_013.voiceText: Awesome, I finally got promoted! Hehe, you said you'd let me lead my own squad after my promotion. You're a doctor of your word, aren't you?

char_4071_peper_CN_014.voiceText: Doctor! You're a mighty fine employer! Amiya looks real dependable, too. There's no going wrong, hitching my wagon to you. If you've got any more high-paying gigs, be sure to give me a holler!

char_4071_peper_CN_017.voiceText: Hehe, you picked the right girl for the job!

char_4071_peper_CN_018.voiceText: Just leave it to me! I've got some experience leading a squad.

char_4071_peper_CN_019.voiceText: Stay safe and keep in contact. Remember, the mission comes second. Your lives come first!

char_4071_peper_CN_020.voiceText: Let's clear the place in one fell swoop!

char_4071_peper_CN_021.voiceText: Don't worry. I've been standing by here.

char_4071_peper_CN_022.voiceText: I don't pick fights I can't win.

char_4071_peper_CN_023.voiceText: Not one of you is getting away!

char_4071_peper_CN_024.voiceText: Don't get careless just because I'm here!

char_4071_peper_CN_026.voiceText: Get behind me, if you feel yourself slipping!

char_4071_peper_CN_027.voiceText: We can't have any more casualties...

char_4071_peper_CN_028.voiceText: You bastards... Scram! I'm busy here!

char_4071_peper_CN_029.voiceText: You're pretty amazing, coming up with a strategy like that... I gotta say, you're a lot better than W just lobbing bombs at everything.

char_4071_peper_CN_030.voiceText: Awesome, smooth like butter! Hehe, I didn't need any backup that time. Let's see what W and Ines have to say!

char_4071_peper_CN_031.voiceText: A few footmen slipped past us, but that's no big deal, right? Yep, everyone made it out of the fight alive. I call that a big win!

char_4071_peper_CN_032.voiceText: N-No way... Doctor, you aren't trying to hold the line here, are you? C'mon, quit spacing out. Hurry up and run!

char_4071_peper_CN_033.voiceText: Rhodes Island really treats us well... Oh, don't be so humble. This is much better than the dump we used to live in!

char_4071_peper_CN_036.voiceText: This poncho feels great, right? Nana knitted it for me. It's so warm.

char_4071_peper_CN_042.voiceText: Hey, Doc. What kind of missions do we have today? Oh, right. Let me get this out of the way. I'm not taking anything too crazy!

char_4072_ironmn_CN_001.voiceText: Doctor, do you mind me tinkering with a few things here, or would that be too much noise? Just give me a tap on the back when you want to chat, of course.

char_4072_ironmn_CN_002.voiceText: Doctor, I hear you've got a lot of books here. Could you lend me a few to read? They don't have to be on mechanical engineering, I'm plenty curious about stuff I don't know. Like this one, for instance, it's a beauty of a doorstopper... what was that? Don't touch? I-It's got a curse? Hold on, who put that on it?

char_4072_ironmn_CN_003.voiceText: The Sarkaz deserve sympathy for what they've been through, but one man can't steal another's home for the sake of his own. Peace will come to Londinium, and I hope, one day, every wanderer gets to build a homeland. It's what Rhodes Island wants too, isn't it?

char_4072_ironmn_CN_004.voiceText: A lot of people'll say the lord nobles do nothing but cling onto the privilege and wealth they inherit, and never think to build on this land with their own hands. Me? I don't mind fighting side-by-side with nobles, just don't make me call them 'lord.'

char_4072_ironmn_CN_005.voiceText: I didn't used to believe things could ever really be dire. Not until an almighty enemy showed up to me, and stole my pals from me, one after the other. They all trusted me, and I failed them. Granny was right. 'Being smart isn't enough to fool death.'

char_4072_ironmn_CN_006.voiceText: I'm a big fan of red. It makes me think of fireplaces on freezing nights. And all the friends who've left us along the way... I'm telling you, their sacrifices meant something. Londinium will come back to us, back to our hands, and it'll be better than before.

char_4072_ironmn_CN_007.voiceText: Doctor, I find it easy to trust people, but don't take me for stupid. If you were just another lot of plotting schemers, I would've taken up arms with no hesitation. But you see, if I offer a shake when I meet someone, that's all the more likely I've got a new friend. Haha, I'm glad my bet paid off here.

char_4072_ironmn_CN_008.voiceText: When we were on break, me and my work pals liked climbing up to the workshop ceiling. Thirty, forty-odd meters. We'd step out of the window and go jumping between buildings. Wind'd blow by with the smell of the factory heat and rust, stars'd squeeze down past the buildings and smile on me. I could feel my city in its warm embrace.

char_4072_ironmn_CN_009.voiceText: *sigh* It's a beauty of a place at Rhodes. I almost want to apply to stay aboard. Shame I've still got all those people and all that work waiting for me in Londinium... Doctor, when it's clear skies once more at home, how about you let me be your guide again? What do you say?

char_4072_ironmn_CN_010.voiceText: Doctor, you must be bored out of your mind sitting at work all day. Want me to take you out for some exercise? Don't worry, no ziplines this time.

char_4072_ironmn_CN_011.voiceText: Doctor, we've faced so much danger together. Do we still need this paperwork to stand for us being friends? Wait, you mean once I sign, I get to take any of Engineering's beauties apart? That's a promise, you hear? 'Stainless'—done.

char_4072_ironmn_CN_012.voiceText: Cor, I suppose you really do make your logistics people fight too. Not that that's much of a problem... How about a little pay bump, eh?

char_4072_ironmn_CN_013.voiceText: 'Top Engineering Operator?' If I want to be Chief Engineer, I'm still a few steps away, aren't I? Haha, I'm just pulling your leg. I've got no plan to jockey for Closure's living.

char_4072_ironmn_CN_014.voiceText: It's a luxury now, just having free time like this to work with my drill and spanner. Doctor, thank you. I'm all willing to take to the field for my homeland and freedom. But it's you and Rhodes Island that won back this moment of refuge for me.

char_4072_ironmn_CN_017.voiceText: Squad 11 of Self-Salvation Corp, joining up with Rhodes Island.

char_4072_ironmn_CN_018.voiceText: I'm a little nervous. Still, pressure's a good motivator, right?

char_4072_ironmn_CN_019.voiceText: Remember, everyone! Not one fewer when we come back!

char_4072_ironmn_CN_020.voiceText: Hello, everyone over there, you can breathe easy. What's the line? 'I'm just your average mechanic.'

char_4072_ironmn_CN_021.voiceText: About time for us to shine?

char_4072_ironmn_CN_023.voiceText: Picked a good place for me.

char_4072_ironmn_CN_028.voiceText: Fight for Londinium! Victory to Londiniers!

char_4072_ironmn_CN_029.voiceText: We'll come together, we'll fight all the way, for this city we stand on, until we fall.

char_4072_ironmn_CN_030.voiceText: Doctor, with you for company all the time, I start imagining I fight even better than the mercs. Don't you let me get too cocky. If Granny and Rockrock saw, they'd be knocking on my head with spanners.

char_4072_ironmn_CN_031.voiceText: Hah... haha, made it through another battle. Hard as nails, though. Don't look so glum, Doctor. I know it's back to the Commander for a tactical meeting, but how about a bite to eat before then?

char_4072_ironmn_CN_032.voiceText: Time to scram, Doctor. The zipline's ready. Give me your hand! It's only a win once you survive.

char_4072_ironmn_CN_033.voiceText: So it wasn't Victoria with the best construction technology.

char_4072_ironmn_CN_034.voiceText: Watch it! Drill didn't hurt you, did it?

char_4072_ironmn_CN_036.voiceText: Doctor, you always show up where I wasn't looking. I bet Rhodes Island has secret passages too, doesn't it?

char_4072_ironmn_CN_042.voiceText: Doctor, I'm just back from patrol. Safe as houses all around! You can break for a bit longer. The tenser the state of things, the more you need a proper stretch now and then.

char_4063_quartz_CN_001.voiceText: I'm not so good at desk work, but if all you need is someone to stay by your side and help you arrange your tasks and schedule... I can give it a shot, perhaps.

char_4063_quartz_CN_002.voiceText: This pocket watch? My father gave it to me before he left home. It's nothing fancy, but it keeps time if you keep the movement and dial maintained… Uh, Doctor, is there anyone at Rhodes Island who can fix watches?

char_4063_quartz_CN_003.voiceText: Out in the field, you can leave the cooking to me. That's what they had me doing back in the Columbian barrenlands. I can't promise, you know that, it's gonna taste very good… But at least it won't give you a stomachache.

char_4063_quartz_CN_004.voiceText: Back when I was with the Pioneer Team, the company left us undersupplied, and we did not take that sitting down. We ended up escaping into the barrelands. That's when I got this scar on my eye. It's not a disgrace, but it's not a badge of honor either. It's just the kind of bad luck that us regular Columbians deal with all the time. Mine's just a little more obvious than others.

char_4063_quartz_CN_005.voiceText: Planning your time and planning your life couldn't be more different. When you're eking out a living, you've got no choice but to use every last second. Even when you space out, you have to keep an eye on the clock. On the other hand, to plan out your life, you need enough time to think and feel. Those aren't contradictory. It's just the second one's more of a luxury to most people.

char_4063_quartz_CN_006.voiceText: Is my sword heavy? You bet it is. But I need a heavy one to protect my friends and defend our overdue freedom. The truer the weight I carry is, the mightier I can wield it... And when I'm hurt, it also comes in handy as a walking stick.

char_4063_quartz_CN_007.voiceText: When my mother died, I didn't even get to mourn her. I had a huge pile of medical debt waiting for me to pay off. Why did I join the Pioneer Team, and why did I become a merc? It's not like I had other options. But I came to Rhodes Island after giving it serious thought.

char_4063_quartz_CN_008.voiceText: A free mercenary only takes a mission she thinks is worth the time. There was this one night when I was sitting by the fire, affixing some beast teeth to my sword. My friends were sleeping, and the only sound in the air was my watch ticking away. Time is always on my mind, but that was the first time I really felt its passing.

char_4063_quartz_CN_009.voiceText: The mercenary crew I joined was doomed to disband, sooner or later. Without a clear goal and strict discipline, you can't survive in the wilderness… Maybe only an organization like Rhodes Island can really protect what's beautiful out there. I'm thankful that I could come here.

char_4063_quartz_CN_010.voiceText: Doctor, if you don't need anything from me, I'll just zone out here for a bit... Feel free to talk to me anytime you need me.

char_4063_quartz_CN_011.voiceText: Hello, Doctor. I'm Quartz... I think I'm on time.

char_4063_quartz_CN_012.voiceText: I wish our squad could've fought like this back there.

char_4063_quartz_CN_013.voiceText: Thanks for your recognition, but remember to tell me if there's anything I can improve on.

char_4063_quartz_CN_014.voiceText: Rhodes Island's promotion process and standards are pretty transparent. That's not easy to do.

char_4063_quartz_CN_018.voiceText: Don't worry. I think my decisions through.

char_4063_quartz_CN_019.voiceText: I propose we begin our operation at the top of the hour. It'll be easier to keep track of time.

char_4063_quartz_CN_020.voiceText: Hide, and make sure to put out the cooking fire.

char_4063_quartz_CN_022.voiceText: Sheathe my weapon for the time being? Then my sword…

char_4063_quartz_CN_024.voiceText: A bit late, not a big problem.

char_4063_quartz_CN_025.voiceText: Time your strike. It's more important than brute strength.

char_4063_quartz_CN_026.voiceText: Keep your distance. I only want to strike the enemy.

char_4063_quartz_CN_027.voiceText: You're staring at my eyepatch, it reveals a lot.

char_4063_quartz_CN_029.voiceText: When every phase of the mission proceeds with watchlike precision, victory is assured.

char_4063_quartz_CN_030.voiceText: This is worth celebrating... When we get back to Rhodes Island, we won't have to eat my cooking anymore.

char_4063_quartz_CN_031.voiceText: Even the most accurate of watches isn't always accurate. Don't be so fixated on perfection

char_4063_quartz_CN_032.voiceText: Sorry, Doctor, we had a few problems with the plan because my watch is broken. Go, and leave the rest to me.

char_4063_quartz_CN_033.voiceText: This is much more comfortable than a tent in the wilderness... Will someone stand watch at night?

char_4063_quartz_CN_036.voiceText: Let's space out together, Doctor. We can chill for as long as we need... No need to watch the clock like we used to.

char_4063_quartz_CN_042.voiceText: Hello, Doctor. Careful. You almost bumped into my sword.

char_466_qanik_CN_001.voiceText: Doctor! Do you want these files here? A Liberi lady just taught me how to use a printer! Look, I even learned how to print on both sides! This needs to be single-sided? Uh-oh, sorry! I'll print it again!

char_466_qanik_CN_002.voiceText: My mother has gotten a lot better. That time, even divination showed a dark future. If not for the medical equipment we got from the explorers, she might have left us... Since then, I decided to go out into the world. I hope to bring more equipment like that back to the village.

char_466_qanik_CN_003.voiceText: I'm really grateful to Magallan. We've only met a few times during search and rescue operations, but she put me in touch with Rhodes Island after hearing my situation. And she's an incredible lady. Not many people dare to explore the ice fields like her. Even people in our tribe seldom set foot there. It's a place that's feared and revered.

char_466_qanik_CN_004.voiceText: I'm part of my tribe's rescue team, helping people who accidentally wander into the bog, or get lost in the snowstorms. That's how I met a lot of explorers from Columbia. Woah, Doctor, how did you know they always compliment my tail?

char_466_qanik_CN_005.voiceText: I never thought I would leave the tribe and come here. I was never interested in things from the outside world. But that shiny medical equipment blew me away. They went against our divination. That's a miracle to me.

char_466_qanik_CN_006.voiceText: The explorers told me things I've never heard before, about 'corporations', 'timetables', 'entrepot'... we don't even have these words because we've never had a use for them. But I learned them quickly, thanks to my conversations with the explorers.

char_466_qanik_CN_007.voiceText: Can I see the future like Gitano? I suppose I could divine your future, but I'm not great at it. If you really want me to tell your fortune for the day, let's see... Okay, it says... the stars will fall from the sky, and eggplant must go on top of rice.

char_466_qanik_CN_008.voiceText: Doctor, Accounting says my 'reimbursement claim' has been delayed. What does 'reimbursement claim' mean? Sorry, but there's still so much I don't understand about paperwork…

char_466_qanik_CN_009.voiceText: Doctor! I'm back from my field mission! We delivered some equipment to my tribe and taught them how to use it. Turns out aunt's leg pains were caused by bone spurs. Now that we know how to treat it, she won't have to rely on my cousin's Arts to relieve the pain.

char_466_qanik_CN_010.voiceText: Oh, the phone is ringing! What did the Doctor say I should do in this situation… Okay... He-hello? Um, nice to hear you. This is the Doctor's office.

char_466_qanik_CN_011.voiceText: I forgot to ask the Perro man what I should call you. I only learned the word 'company' from the Columbians. Do you have a name? Oh, just 'Doctor'? I can do that!

char_466_qanik_CN_012.voiceText: Is this one of your technologies? How do you manage to record everything like that?

char_466_qanik_CN_013.voiceText: Doctor, is this what you call a 'contract'? It's very difficult to understand. Do I have to sign it? You say if I don't sign it, I'll be forced to work day and night by a cruel boss? But Doctor, you are not cruel… What? What do you mean don't be so sure?

char_466_qanik_CN_014.voiceText: I won't make a fool of myself like before, Doctor! You've helped me so much. My mother's getting better, and my tribe is learning to use Rhodes Island medical equipment. I hope I can do even more for them in the future.

char_466_qanik_CN_017.voiceText: Don't worry, I've been on a lot of rescue operations.

char_466_qanik_CN_018.voiceText: Everyone, follow my orders and don't run off on your own.

char_466_qanik_CN_020.voiceText: Make sure you're well-prepared. That's the foundation of a successful rescue.

char_466_qanik_CN_023.voiceText: Don't worry, help is on the way.

char_466_qanik_CN_024.voiceText: Please save your strength, we will get you out!

char_466_qanik_CN_028.voiceText: Don't worry. You're going to be fine!

char_466_qanik_CN_029.voiceText: I was nervous, but my experience really came in handy!
