char_466_qanik_CN_030.voiceText: A well-planned and well-executed rescue operation, our target has been brought to safety.

char_466_qanik_CN_031.voiceText: The victim was injured… Don't worry, I'll ease the pain for you.

char_466_qanik_CN_033.voiceText: Oh, so this is where I'm supposed to use this 'access card.'

char_466_qanik_CN_036.voiceText: Doctor, you don't really want me to divine your future, do you?

char_466_qanik_CN_042.voiceText: Boo! Did that scare you? Not at all? Aw, I used to spook lots of people in the snow.

char_4014_lunacu_CN_001.voiceText: Assistant? File Work? Not sure I followed. Anyway, I found a nice-looking mountain with a great view the other day. Want to see it?

char_4014_lunacu_CN_002.voiceText: This makes no sense. Why did you build so many walls and corridors? They block your vision. A mad burdenbeast could crash into this little room without any warning, and you don't seem to be a bit conerned. Danger can be prowling at any corner and you must stay on your guard. That's what Agnese taught me.

char_4014_lunacu_CN_003.voiceText: You call the outside 'the wilds', but you can find everything out there. Put in a little effort and you'll find food and water just fine. But in the city, there are no places to hunt. How do you even survive?

char_4014_lunacu_CN_004.voiceText: Um, Doctor, have you ever been to one of those 'parties' Exusiai talks about? They're scary! Those little balls of exploded plant seeds, those sweet, smooth milk puffs! Listen, this is not how you should live... What? They're having another party today? I wanna go.

char_4014_lunacu_CN_005.voiceText: Agnese told about a dangerous scent on Rhodes Island, but she and the pack would stay with me. Hmm? You can't see her? But she was just here a moment ago... Maybe she went to go get food?

char_4014_lunacu_CN_006.voiceText: The man named Bernardo died, and Zaaro ran back to his territory with his tail between his legs... Seems like the hunt Agnese told us about is in the bag. But still she doesn't look happy. Why? The pack has more than enough food.

char_4014_lunacu_CN_007.voiceText: Can I get a couple extra sets of Rhodes Island clothes? They're well-made, very warm, make good tents, and you can tear them up for bandages. No? Awww… Then how about the storage depot? I'd like to go and... uhh, take a look around.

char_4014_lunacu_CN_008.voiceText: Doctor, Agnese spoke highly of you, and told me to learn from your 'cunning.' What does cunning mean? Oh! Is it cunning when you hide here by yourself, eating in secret, not sharing with anyone else? I don't think that's hard to do.

char_4014_lunacu_CN_009.voiceText: Recently, I've started thinking that maybe life under a roof isn't so bad. Here, you are not a pack, you don't group up and subject yourself to one another. You're, well, something strange... Ugh! It doesn't make any sense! Anyways, I'll stay here a few more days! So get me something good to eat!

char_4014_lunacu_CN_010.voiceText: Asleep? That means nothing for me to do? Agnese, let's go play outside.

char_4014_lunacu_CN_011.voiceText: Agnese called me Lunacub, so you can call me that too. I heard there's a 'canteen' place here, where you can eat whatever you want. Is that true? Where is it? Can I go there right now?

char_4014_lunacu_CN_012.voiceText: Too much trouble! Hunting really isn't that complicated.

char_4014_lunacu_CN_013.voiceText: A promotion? Does that mean you'll listen to me? How many of these shiny... 'medals' does it take for you to obey me?

char_4014_lunacu_CN_014.voiceText: Agnese always tells me that humans are dangerous and cunning, their bellies full and hearts wicked, but you've proved you are different. You are allowed to join my pack.

char_4014_lunacu_CN_017.voiceText: I still prefer hunting with my pack. They are much more open than humans.

char_4014_lunacu_CN_018.voiceText: Since I'm the luna wolf, you all must listen to me. I'll make it clear first: if I don't see your fangs bared in the hunt, you won't get a share of the kill.

char_4014_lunacu_CN_019.voiceText: How much will we bring back today?

char_4014_lunacu_CN_022.voiceText: Where are the idiots who came to die?

char_4014_lunacu_CN_023.voiceText: Hurry, the pack and I are waiting.

char_4014_lunacu_CN_025.voiceText: Pipe down already! I'm not going to miss!

char_4014_lunacu_CN_028.voiceText: Stupid burdenbeast, you're not getting away!

char_4014_lunacu_CN_029.voiceText: Good hunt. If you lived in the wild, I'm sure you would survive for long.

char_4014_lunacu_CN_030.voiceText: Tired. Already did what you asked me. Can I go eat now? What's on the menu today?

char_4014_lunacu_CN_031.voiceText: Hey! Some of them just got away! Do you even know how to keep the prey surrounded? I'm gonna teach you next time!

char_4014_lunacu_CN_032.voiceText: Grr... Agnese, the hunt failed. Come help us! Don't let this idiot die here!

char_4014_lunacu_CN_034.voiceText: Don't scare me like that! You wanna die?

char_4014_lunacu_CN_036.voiceText: Hey, Doctor, don't you get tired of staying in these little cubes every day?

char_4014_lunacu_CN_042.voiceText: What took you so long? Next time you make me wait for you in a stuffy little box, don't blame me if I get a little rude.

char_427_vigil_CN_001.voiceText: Organizing documents? Doctor, we have much more important things to do. Bene, I'll give you a hand, if you insist. But do remember, I expect you to come up with a plan that's worth my while. Do not disappoint me.

char_427_vigil_CN_002.voiceText: What do you want to know? Secrets of the Siracusan famiglie? There's hardly anything worth mentioning there. The things we do are no different from the wolves fighting in the wilderness thousands of years ago. Only, time has taught us some new tricks. Heh, you see 'order' could be the official name for 'tearing your prey to pieces.'

char_427_vigil_CN_003.voiceText: For many years, I couldn't really understand my father. He paid the ultimate price, only to betray almost everything in the end... But I still remember the question my father posed to me many years ago, when we were sitting together in a park: 'Siracusa, sara un posto migliore senza le famiglie?'

char_427_vigil_CN_004.voiceText: Judge Lavinia never realized what she was getting herself into. The game with Signora Sicilia won't be won through courage or resourcefulness alone... She's looking for me? To discuss my unbalanced diet…? Tell her I'm not here.

char_427_vigil_CN_005.voiceText: The old ways make it impossible to find a new path. If the new Siracusa is built on violence, it will fall back into the same well. The destruction of a few individual famiglie is far, far from enough. We must kick the entire 'habit.'

char_427_vigil_CN_006.voiceText: The disputes among the famiglie were petty and stupid. The dons clung on to whatever authority they had, thinking they were the masters of Siracusa. But I invite you, Doctor, to join me in shaping a new era.

char_427_vigil_CN_007.voiceText: If you want to show respect to the Siracusans, then hire a proper Siracusan chef. The next time I see any 'innovative Siracusan cuisine' out of your minions... Beh, let's just say somebody knows about your little office naps, and it'd be a shame if the beans got spilled on your beauty sleep.

char_427_vigil_CN_008.voiceText: Something on your mind? If it calls for blackmail, bribery, or something worse... none of that would be much trouble for me. Underhanded business is pretty much all I inherited from my famiglia. As for how to use my knowledge, that's your call.

char_427_vigil_CN_009.voiceText: Zaaro, il Signore dei Lupi... the shadow lurking behind me and my father. Don't be fooled by his pretentious words. A wild beast's hunt won't slow the progress of humanity. If he appears before you one day, I will drive him away.

char_427_vigil_CN_010.voiceText: Hey. Is our 'cooperation' just me watching you sleep?

char_427_vigil_CN_011.voiceText: Buongiorno, Doctor. I am Famiglia Bellone's... Lasci perdere. My famiglia doesn't exist anymore, but that was the price we paid to buy change in Siracusa. As for what comes next... Operator Vigil is at your service, Doctor. I hope our partnership will be productive.

char_427_vigil_CN_012.voiceText: I am no stranger to violence. As long as I'm on the scene, things should be a little more efficient.

char_427_vigil_CN_013.voiceText: A promotion? There's no need to test me like that, Doctor. I've played this game too... winning people over with small rewards. But if you're just trying to show your faith in me... Va bene, grazie.

char_427_vigil_CN_014.voiceText: Our partnership has been productive, Doctor. A made man would sell out anybody for his ambitions, but I can promise you one thing: you've bought my loyalty with yours.

char_427_vigil_CN_017.voiceText: Va bene. Let's see if your plan is worthy of my work.

char_427_vigil_CN_018.voiceText: The process is just as important as the end result. Don't go dying on me, ragazzi.

char_427_vigil_CN_019.voiceText: Remember, our purpose is not violence itself, but rather the victory it brings.

char_427_vigil_CN_022.voiceText: They'll be sleeping with the fins in no time.

char_427_vigil_CN_023.voiceText: Don't make this harder than it needs to be.

char_427_vigil_CN_024.voiceText: Anything outside the plan, I'll judge for myself.

char_427_vigil_CN_025.voiceText: Let's put an end to this show, pronto.

char_427_vigil_CN_026.voiceText: And what purpose do you think your sacrifice will serve?

char_427_vigil_CN_027.voiceText: This hunt has dragged on for too long.

char_427_vigil_CN_028.voiceText: A valiant struggle, but you won't get away.

char_427_vigil_CN_029.voiceText: They have no idea who they're messing with. Bravo, Doctor. I was right to partner with you. I hope you'll find even more challenges for me in the next battle.

char_427_vigil_CN_030.voiceText: Are we done yet? What are you looking all smug for? These stronzi have already wasted too much of our time.

char_427_vigil_CN_031.voiceText: They're getting away. Do you need me to walk you through this? Ma dai! Whack them already.

char_427_vigil_CN_032.voiceText: I'll take care of the evacuation. You get moving, fast. I hope this won't happen again, Doctor.

char_427_vigil_CN_033.voiceText: Careful with the moisture-proofing. I hate the smell of rotting wood.

char_427_vigil_CN_034.voiceText: Are you having fun? Because I'm not.

char_427_vigil_CN_036.voiceText: Ah... Mi mancano le osterie di Siracusa. Doctor, is the kitchen available right now? I can make something myself.

char_427_vigil_CN_042.voiceText: None of these documents matter at all, Doctor. The only thing that matters is how you act.

char_4065_judge_CN_001.voiceText: It's been a long time since I've felt like there was any conviction or meaning in my work. Rather than sit through show trial after show trial, I prefer to wade through these thorny, complicated files.

char_4065_judge_CN_002.voiceText: You don't have to tiptoe around me. I don't judge good or evil on any ironclad law. And with all the crimes staged in the name of order… Ah, pay no mind to this judge's grumble, a powerless judge waiting to be indicted for misconduct in office.

char_4065_judge_CN_003.voiceText: The thorns on this codex? Yes, of course the spikes hurt, but I wish for the pain to remind me: No matter how weak the statutes in Siracusa, no matter how highly I think of my calling, perversion of justice and blasphemy against the law are crimes.

char_4065_judge_CN_004.voiceText: They say 'the law is the basis of morality,' but that's not a natural truth. It emerges from a consensus of the people. When the people come to see violence as order, the law is nothing but a fantasy to dream of. And I, as the keeper of that fantasy, am the most ridiculous of all.

char_4065_judge_CN_005.voiceText: In Siracusa, being a city court judge is a dangerous job. Either you join 'them,' or... you disappear. I thought I could strike a balance between the two, but there's no way to stay clean when you're surrounded by mud. In the end, I was just another accomplice.

char_4065_judge_CN_006.voiceText: Maybe Siracusa really is that hard to change. The gangs, the famiglie... They shared a womb with Siracusa and shaped it into the country it is today. But we can't take them for granted. We must believe that a different path exists.

char_4065_judge_CN_007.voiceText: Oh, mi dispiace, I didn't see you there. If you're all done with work, how about joining me for a drink?… Why that look in your eyes? I'm not an alcoholic. But everyone needs some liquid assistance every now and then, whether for fatigue or for suffering. Ecco. It's on the strong side, so sip slowly.

char_4065_judge_CN_008.voiceText: If you ever get a chance to visit Siracusa, please avoid the rainy season. However, if you really are that unfortunate... best thing you can do is find a little shop on the street and sit for a while. Maybe only after the rain can one enjoy the momentary illusion that the city is clean.

char_4065_judge_CN_009.voiceText: In my many years as a judge, I've only handed down a few verdicts I could feel good about. I still remember the look on those two kids' faces when I broke up their little scuffle and told the aggressor to apologize. What, why are you laughing? Even the greatest justice must start from somewhere small.

char_4065_judge_CN_010.voiceText: You're sleeping? There's nothing more valuable than these rare moments of peace. Conserviamo questi momenti.

char_4065_judge_CN_011.voiceText: I am Lavinia Falcone, formerly a judge of Siracusa. Today, I report to you as Operator Penance. I hope that in working for Rhodes Island, I can absolve myself of my past mistakes.

char_4065_judge_CN_012.voiceText: So much violence in the name of order... Doctor, I can only pray that your efforts are more than futile.

char_4065_judge_CN_013.voiceText: I am honored to earn your support. We can certainly work together and offer mutual assistance, but let me be frank – that doesn't mean you can influence my decisions. Sorry, no offense intended, but that's a lesson I learned the hard way.

char_4065_judge_CN_014.voiceText: Be it a famiglia, a society, or a country, people are often bound by mutual interest... I used to assume this was the way of the world, but Doctor, you showed me a different path. I hope we can share this mutual trust long into the future.

char_4065_judge_CN_017.voiceText: Sitting around in an office won't bring about justice. That's one thing I know for a fact.

char_4065_judge_CN_018.voiceText: Whether or not you are burdened by a criminal record is unimportant to me. All I ask is that in this coming battle, our goals might be aligned.

char_4065_judge_CN_019.voiceText: Contempt for the law is a crime. The words of my codex will prove their own worth.

char_4065_judge_CN_020.voiceText: This time, I will hand down a fair verdict.

char_4065_judge_CN_021.voiceText: No matter what I might encounter, I will not back down.

char_4065_judge_CN_022.voiceText: What the law does not specify, I will reveal through practice.

char_4065_judge_CN_023.voiceText: This gavel of justice is weighty. Spero che siate pronti.

char_4065_judge_CN_024.voiceText: I am fighting for more than just the law. Also the justice and virtue that extend beyond it.

char_4065_judge_CN_025.voiceText: The law is a means, not an end.

char_4065_judge_CN_026.voiceText: There is no such thing as absolute justice, but I still invoke it!

char_4065_judge_CN_027.voiceText: Can crimes be punished through methods outside of the law?

char_4065_judge_CN_029.voiceText: Even a crime-ridden swamp is not beyond salvation. Doctor, thank you for once again reminding me of this fact.

char_4065_judge_CN_030.voiceText: A trial in all its vaunted glory will not bring about any substantive change. It matters more what we do after the trial. Doctor, I've seen what you've done, and find it praiseworthy.

char_4065_judge_CN_031.voiceText: Doctor, prepare a team to arrest the fugitives. There is no difference between a moment of mercy and a miscarriage of justice. They have not yet been read their verdict.

char_4065_judge_CN_032.voiceText: Naturally, they and the darkness behind them will occasionally prevail... But mark my words, even the most frustrating rainy season will pass in time. Until then, all we can do is persevere, and keep trying.

char_4065_judge_CN_033.voiceText: This place is nothing like stagnant, old Siracusa. The breath of hope flows here.

char_4065_judge_CN_036.voiceText: Are you here to discuss criminal procedure with me? No? Eccellente. I hope you never need my knowledge in that regard.

char_4065_judge_CN_042.voiceText: Doctor, I've categorized these documents according to their importance. Let me remind you that some of your operations land in a legal gray zone. I'm not opposed to them, but you need to think things through. I'll offer my advice as well.

char_1028_texas2_CN_001.voiceText: I'm your bodyguard again, just like old times, Doctor. And it's not just a job, it's a reunion. That's something worth cherishing.

char_1028_texas2_CN_002.voiceText: How does it feel to be back in Siracusa? Not great. It's for wise guys and famiglie, not me. I'm only staying long enough to cut ties with the past. After I'm done washing my hands of the whole business, I'm heading back to Lungmen to pick up the girls, and then going out for a nice drive.

char_1028_texas2_CN_003.voiceText: I didn't want to get Penguin Logistics involved, but it was a relief to see them in Siracusa. My noisy friends, that life of freedom... Looking back now, staying with them in Lungmen was the best decision I ever made. Just, don't tell them I said that.

char_1028_texas2_CN_004.voiceText: Sometimes I hear Siracusans talking about the downfall of Famiglia Texas. No two versions of the story are the same. Most are pretty dull, and some make for interesting fairytales, but in the end, they're all pretty embellished. The real story is... I just got exhausted, and decided to leave.

char_1028_texas2_CN_005.voiceText: Ever noticed how even the rain here stains the walls outside? Dirty rainwater can't wash anything clean. And that's Siracusa. Siracusans might be used to it, but I'm not.

char_1028_texas2_CN_006.voiceText: I've got no interest in joining Greyhall. The dons sit in their chairs, acting all high and mighty, hiding their plans. I decided to confront Signora Sicilia because she thinks she can tame everyone, and that's one thing I can't stand.

char_1028_texas2_CN_007.voiceText: I saw Lappland in Siracusa. Oh, you haven't seen her in a while? Not like she needs anyone worrying about her. If she's over me now, she'll find something else to cut. As for the score we haven't settled, I say it doesn't matter. We'll meet again soon enough.

char_1028_texas2_CN_008.voiceText: I was born in Columbia, but my grandfather wanted me to become a proper mafiosa and sent me to Siracusa to learn the trade. But to this day I don't understand why the people here like macaroni so much? I used to go to this little place for macaroni myself, but it closed down a long time ago. The owner died in a back alley.

char_1028_texas2_CN_009.voiceText: In Siracusa, there were a whole lot of people trying to guess what I'd do. It wasn't that complicated. I was there to do what I had to do, and help those who deserved help. Doctor, all I ask is that we continue to get along just like we used to. This relationship, built on real trust, is hard to find there.

char_1028_texas2_CN_010.voiceText: It's quiet here. No hitmen haunting the shadows, no wolves waiting in the alleys.

char_1028_texas2_CN_011.voiceText: We meet again, Doctor. The Siracusan rainy season always gets my tail wet, so I prefer the climate here. Don't worry, Exusiai and the girls will keep taking care of the deliveries, but I'll handle any jobs assigned to me personally.

char_1028_texas2_CN_012.voiceText: Thanks. Doesn't seem much different from your average delivery run in Lungmen.

char_1028_texas2_CN_013.voiceText: I'm not helping you for the money, Doctor. But still, go ahead and send my salary over to Penguin Logistics as usual. I'll pick it up from Emperor.

char_1028_texas2_CN_014.voiceText: I still have a lot to take care of before I can enjoy a peaceful life, and if the only way to shake the past is to smash it to pieces, then that's exactly what I'll do. Simple as that.

char_1028_texas2_CN_018.voiceText: Alright. Try to keep up. Let me know if you can't.

char_1028_texas2_CN_019.voiceText: No need to make a scene.

char_1028_texas2_CN_020.voiceText: Don't leave bloodstains. They're hard to clean.

char_1028_texas2_CN_023.voiceText: Got a problem that needs solving?

char_1028_texas2_CN_024.voiceText: I see them. I'll be right back.

char_1028_texas2_CN_025.voiceText: Bad luck, you ran into me.

char_1028_texas2_CN_027.voiceText: Pass on your last words? No.

char_1028_texas2_CN_029.voiceText: The only way to solve a problem is to clear all the obstacles in the way, no matter what they might be and keep moving.

char_1028_texas2_CN_030.voiceText: A battle without an explosion or cheering makes me feel a little uneasy. Let's head back. A drink? Maybe next time.

char_1028_texas2_CN_031.voiceText: There's still more to clean. When's our next sweep?

char_1028_texas2_CN_032.voiceText: I can take out a few more. You go ahead and retreat.

char_1028_texas2_CN_033.voiceText: This place reminds me of Lungmen. It's quiet. Doesn't have the constant pitter patter of the rain.

char_1028_texas2_CN_036.voiceText: Doctor, where's the hair dryer? I'd like to dry my tail.

char_1028_texas2_CN_042.voiceText: Great, this place is the same as it ever was. Morning. Got any new plans?

char_4017_puzzle_CN_001.voiceText: Sorting files, serving tea, and transcribing meetings? Of course, I'm at your disposal... Come to think of it, in my first mission, I also approached the target under the guise of a secretary. One week later, I'd hollowed them of all valuable intel, and torn their influence down to rubble.

char_4017_puzzle_CN_002.voiceText: If you don't trust me, you have permission to search my briefcase, and ascertain whether any data inside is critical to Rhodes Island. The Curio Collector's Guide to Antique Appraisal? Learning material for skills required under certain guises—nothing more, certainly not a personal interest. Pardon me if you wanted specifics, but no comment.

char_4017_puzzle_CN_003.voiceText: The Dublinn Feline, name of Harmonie. Her plan had a lot of moving parts, and almost went off without a hitch—shame she still left an opening. Even your smallest mistake can have irredeemable consequences, such is the cutthroat nature of intelligence work. Yes? Do I consider her an enemy? Hardly; there is no value in a spy whose identity is exposed.

char_4017_puzzle_CN_004.voiceText: I'm working on a puzzle... Sorry, please be quiet for a while; your voice is disturbing the pieces. A puzzle's answer is unique; do you solve it through incessant trial-and-error, or through calm analysis and a hold of every detail? Only morons would elect for the former... Well then, did you need me for something?

char_4017_puzzle_CN_005.voiceText: Inside the aristocrat's ballroom, you need to mind every gaze, to pry into or guard against one another. That is the battlefield the spy roams. It demands of us the proficiency to cruise through it, but I highly doubt anyone truly enjoys it.

char_4017_puzzle_CN_006.voiceText: I rarely make decisions based on emotion, but my saving a completely unrelated civilian was out of fear, it's true. It didn't amount to a mistake, Doctor, and it won't impact anything... War only showed me some of its spiny thorns, but I know It will crush every emotion we feel and every concept we hold

char_4017_puzzle_CN_007.voiceText: Rhodes Island's doctors constantly limit my usage of Originium Arts. Aside from ensuring my condition doesn't worsen, they must be concerned that I'll cause some sort of uncontrollable accident... You can put your worries to rest, I know my limits. But nevertheless, thank you for caring.

char_4017_puzzle_CN_008.voiceText: It was on a mission that an unanticipated explosion infected me with Oripathy. Of course, that mission was still a success... Why didn't I take cover? Doctor, a variable like that could impact the entire operation. But we could also accept it, and implement it as part of the plan.

char_4017_puzzle_CN_009.voiceText: Thanks to work reasons, I've met quite a few people as unique and interesting as you. And for those same work reasons, the 'me' they got to know has vanished. Is it a shame? No, it's just the piecing of a new puzzle. All that said, I don't plan to ditch my current codename, for the time being.

char_4017_puzzle_CN_010.voiceText: No pending intelligence work for the moment... What a rare break.

char_4017_puzzle_CN_011.voiceText: You'll have received personal correspondence from the Duke. I'll be stationed and active aboard under the codename Puzzle. No need to bother investigating me; I've handed you all personal information that's been made public.

char_4017_puzzle_CN_012.voiceText: This deployment is somewhat sloppy... or does it speak to your confidence in their individual abilities?

char_4017_puzzle_CN_013.voiceText: Doctor, you need caution when promoting intelligence workers. It may well add danger to your situation... But I'll let this one pass, seeing as you're affirming my work ability with it.

char_4017_puzzle_CN_014.voiceText: The last promotion wasn't that long ago... I appreciate your trust. Of course, if Rhodes Island is wishing to work on closer terms with any nobility I serve, I'd be willing to pass on the message.

char_4017_puzzle_CN_017.voiceText: Doctor, my public activity with Rhodes Island is better kept on the minimal end.

char_4017_puzzle_CN_018.voiceText: An intelligence worker in this position is barely a good fit... I have no reason to decline, naturally, if you have your own considerations.

char_4017_puzzle_CN_019.voiceText: Do you need me to tell you all, you seem like a pack of children at a holiday camp?

char_4017_puzzle_CN_022.voiceText: The intel work began long beforehand.

char_4017_puzzle_CN_023.voiceText: Probing the enemy's weak points, posthaste.

char_4017_puzzle_CN_024.voiceText: Be ready at a moment's notice for the info I send back.

char_4017_puzzle_CN_025.voiceText: Don't leave it written across your face.

char_4017_puzzle_CN_026.voiceText: Every look you take has value.

char_4017_puzzle_CN_027.voiceText: Every expression you make is an opening.

char_4017_puzzle_CN_028.voiceText: I can read you like an open book.

char_4017_puzzle_CN_029.voiceText: Such adaptability and command proficiency... I'm all too glad you're not my target.

char_4017_puzzle_CN_030.voiceText: Intelligence is the invisible scaffold, each battle merely following whatever course it lays out. With the boon of our preceding work, this victory should come as little surprise, Doctor.

char_4017_puzzle_CN_031.voiceText: Check for lost weaponry, cover all tracks, don't let anyone in the future discover what happened here.

char_4017_puzzle_CN_032.voiceText: A comprehensive plan must include a contingency for failure at every step. We're prepared, so evacuate ASAP... wait, destroy this intel before we leave.

char_4017_puzzle_CN_033.voiceText: If certain Victorian nobles decorated their residences the way you do, my work would be more than twice as difficult.

char_4017_puzzle_CN_036.voiceText: I was out of practice with a few skills—it seems I can revise here.

char_4017_puzzle_CN_042.voiceText: Oh, I see it's you again, Doctor.

char_297_hamoni_CN_001.voiceText: If you didn't have the time to get to all these files, why didn't you come ask me for help? I would've been more than glad.

char_297_hamoni_CN_002.voiceText: Don't worry, there wouldn't be anything in it for me if I left Rhodes Island, at this point. You're free to get up to whatever it is you usually do, never mind the fact I'm here. And as recompense for your trust, I won't leak a single detail of your work. Now come on, chop-chop. I'm deathly concerned for you, what with that doorstopper of a document.

char_297_hamoni_CN_003.voiceText: 'Darling Rita.' I assume you're curious, if you bring it up? You know those certain few students who always leave their mark on you in your school years? I took quite a fancy to one of them—such an excellent soldier she turned out to be. Still, we have the space to keep out of each other's ways here, and that suits my fancy just as well.

char_297_hamoni_CN_004.voiceText: Anything you'd like of me, Doctor of Rhodes Island? If it's in my power to deepen our bilateral trust, then I would be willing to stop gazing out at the window scenery, and focus a little instead on whatever it is that's vexing you.

char_297_hamoni_CN_005.voiceText: Shame you're short on people with a shrewd eye for Londinium affairs—I was quite curious what they'd think of me. After all, a medical organization like Rhodes Island, unaffiliated with any nation, opting to work with us? Either you did it out of sheer idiocy, or if not, then you must've known a little too much.

char_297_hamoni_CN_006.voiceText: So what's your next step? Keep throwing yourself into the maelstrom of Victoria, or continue to build the peaceful paradise that Rhodes Island hopes for? The Leader once gave me a display of land torched to ash by her fires, and I'm ever so curious. If you had flames, what color would they be?

char_297_hamoni_CN_007.voiceText: 'Reed.' Such a darling codename—I can practically guess what was on her mind when she came up with it. Still, I'd be more the fool for claiming the prospect of a book club partner drove me here. She just happens to be somebody very useful, hence my need to protect her.

char_297_hamoni_CN_008.voiceText: Just making a little bookside conversation, but... how do you regard the act of dancing? You know, when hands rest on collars, and gazes lock, and involuntary reactions let slip the true intentions of you or I—my my, your heart's hardly fluttering at all. No wonder The Leader's so interested in you.

char_297_hamoni_CN_009.voiceText: I've gone through the files on my desk. Not at all surprised Rhodes Island would be going after my true reasons for coming here. That said, you were kind enough to drop the papers off with me? You must not be planning to boot me out any time soon, let alone hand me off to a duke. So, what is it you want me to do for Rhodes Island, or perhaps, for you?

char_297_hamoni_CN_010.voiceText: Hm-hmm, time to paint my nails. What pattern shall we go with?

char_297_hamoni_CN_011.voiceText: Pleased to meet you, and my codename is Harmonie. Here's a dossier on Victoria for Rhodes Island's perusal, as a gesture of goodwill. Don't umm and ahh about it, now—that's basic etiquette for when someone thanks you. May we get along smashingly in the days to come, Doctor.

char_297_hamoni_CN_012.voiceText: Oh, what a splendid war command.

char_297_hamoni_CN_013.voiceText: Ah, well, thank you very much. It's my honor to receive your endorsement.

char_297_hamoni_CN_014.voiceText: What you're doing here has me startlingly curious. What could you be up to, placing me in this position?

char_297_hamoni_CN_017.voiceText: What would you have me do for Rhodes Island?

char_297_hamoni_CN_018.voiceText: I thank Rhodes Island for its trust.

char_297_hamoni_CN_019.voiceText: I do hope none of you turn on the waterworks anytime soon.

char_297_hamoni_CN_025.voiceText: Take a breath, go on. It's not as if I'm crushing your throat.

char_297_hamoni_CN_026.voiceText: Stop flailing about, and do as I tell you.

char_297_hamoni_CN_028.voiceText: This'll all be over before you're bored of it.

char_297_hamoni_CN_029.voiceText: If I hadn't seen the battle for myself, I just might have been shocked by your command style.

char_297_hamoni_CN_030.voiceText: I'm sure if The Leader saw you now, she'd be delighted.

char_297_hamoni_CN_031.voiceText: Oh, there's a rare sight. Maybe you have other things on your mind?

char_297_hamoni_CN_032.voiceText: Right, what else can I do here?

char_297_hamoni_CN_033.voiceText: Minimalistic, but not at all design-deficient. I have to laud your tastes.

char_297_hamoni_CN_034.voiceText: Tut...! Ah. Was something the matter, Doctor? Do tell.

char_297_hamoni_CN_036.voiceText: If you're free, we could always chat about your bookshelf.

char_1020_reed2_CN_001.voiceText: There's a lot more I can do for you now—more than secretarial work. I won't be opposed to fighting anymore. But still, to be here, writing for you, is... a great honor of mine.

char_1020_reed2_CN_002.voiceText: What would you like to ask? Maybe you want to know—how much power Dublinn has... no? Oh, just how I'm personally doing? I'm still no more than a shadow, but—not my sister's. Dublinn's flame is lit by so many people, so many ideals, and the shadow cast by that firelight—that is what I am now.

char_1020_reed2_CN_003.voiceText: It's getting dark. Around this hour, there'd be people walking leisurely along the grey pavements, perhaps fowlbeasts gathering by the ponds—that is the Tara I remember. It's no special thing, but neither has it truly existed before. Doctor, I believe everyone should have a home to welcome them back.

char_1020_reed2_CN_004.voiceText: I can't make myself out to be a comrade of yours—there are some by your side that surely hate me. But—once Dublinn no longer needs these raging, burning flames, then I'll come back here... I want to come back here.

char_1020_reed2_CN_005.voiceText: In my spare time? I still like prose, and poetry, both reading and writing... and I like to hear others sing. I know a few folk songs—very pretty ones, but no record has been made of them. Doctor, Have you ever heard, how the stems of reeds can be used as whistles? Yes, the reeds that would burn away at the brush of a flame.

char_1020_reed2_CN_006.voiceText: Once you've caught Oripathy, living can become very painful... Do I resent it? No, I just used to not understand... life is so fragile, so much is ready to steal it away, yet we were meant to withstand that—to resist each and every trouble? But now... I can see you fight not just to resist—you fight to give people back their lives.

char_1020_reed2_CN_007.voiceText: Do not fear, but do not disregard. Be light, be gentle... that is how you touch another. I remember learning this from you, Doctor, and it ensures my flames won't turn others to ash. Don't worry, I can bear the pain that accompanies. My fire won't die out.

char_1020_reed2_CN_008.voiceText: Many prophecies say similar things—'it is the Draco's nature to fight.' I won't stand for that. But—if my sister stays blind to what will become of the land, once blanketed by the fires of death... then I will stop her. I know what kind of Leader the people put their hopes in—and that's not what she is.

char_1020_reed2_CN_009.voiceText: My mind's not at peace, Doctor. Is my every choice truly right? Their lives stoke our flames in the night. Yet in the end, if they fail to burn through the darkness... No, why should their lives even be mine to dictate...? But still, I will walk on. Now I bear a duty, and I will walk on.

char_1020_reed2_CN_010.voiceText: Not a word needed... It's always so tranquil, by your side.

char_1020_reed2_CN_011.voiceText: I know—you'll have many new questions for me, about my identity, about my goals... but—I am still the same Reed.

char_1020_reed2_CN_012.voiceText: No matter how many times, you'll still choose to fight like this...

char_1020_reed2_CN_013.voiceText: What is it you seek, from those who earn this medal? Tell me more about your dreams.

char_1020_reed2_CN_014.voiceText: Upon the damp soil, there struggles life after life. While my flame does not yet die, I will reach them—I will.

char_1020_reed2_CN_017.voiceText: I understand the objective you've set.

char_1020_reed2_CN_018.voiceText: You fight not by my will, but yours. You choose to be warriors. So I will stand with you, shoulder to shoulder.

char_1020_reed2_CN_019.voiceText: What blocks the way, I will burn through.

char_1020_reed2_CN_020.voiceText: It is your tyrannies that fuel this flame.

char_1020_reed2_CN_021.voiceText: Where do you wish to go?

char_1020_reed2_CN_024.voiceText: Your lives are mine to protect.

char_1020_reed2_CN_026.voiceText: This endless burn, you needn't bear.

char_1020_reed2_CN_029.voiceText: In honesty, it's hard to even tell whether your battles are victories, given your dreams still lie so far, far away. But at times like these, it strikes me—perhaps we may all see the day, when peace comes.

char_1020_reed2_CN_030.voiceText: To drive them away with fire is easily done. But—if we're to ensure they'll never come back to hurt us, then a fire is not enough.

char_1020_reed2_CN_031.voiceText: Did they flee? I have no hate for those who do—but here on the battlefield, I will pursue them.

char_1020_reed2_CN_032.voiceText: The pain of burning, I can bear much more of. Just—don't let anyone else—disappear to the flames again...

char_1020_reed2_CN_033.voiceText: I remember how I hid away in the ship's cabins. I miss those days.

char_1020_reed2_CN_036.voiceText: The poems I've transcribed? I can read them to you, if you're interested. It's okay if you don't understand Taran—perhaps you'll still feel the emotions' touch.

char_1020_reed2_CN_042.voiceText: Ah, Doctor. Yes, some things never change.

char_4080_lin_CN_001.voiceText: I can offer you protection, and even handle a little business for you. But you'd better prove it's worth my time.

char_4080_lin_CN_002.voiceText: Rhodes Island's work in Lungmen will remain confidential, but I know that your actions saved lives. I've spent a long time trying to gauge just how trustworthy Rhodes Island really is. As for my conclusion, I trust you had no trouble setting up your office in Lungmen?

char_4080_lin_CN_003.voiceText: I'm sure you've been working with Mr. Lee. You can trust the information you get from him, but there are limits to what a private investigator can do. If you need something outside his purview, you come to me. Don't worry, my methods won't send any trouble Rhodes Island's way.

char_4080_lin_CN_004.voiceText: I just saw Swire here. It surprised me how she was working so hands-on. If we'd followed the dreams we had as kids, she would've become the head of Lungmen's Chamber of Commerce, and I might be a university lecturer right now. You never know... Hm? No, I don't need to say hello. Given her status, it would be inappropriate for us to be seen in public.

char_4080_lin_CN_005.voiceText: The coat my father always wears is a birthday present I gave him. I'm so used to the dignified airs he puts on, sometimes I even forget that... underneath the coat is an old man growing frailer by the day. Sooner or later, someone will have to stand up and take the weight off his shoulders.

char_4080_lin_CN_006.voiceText: To certain people, the slums are a problem that needs to be solved. To others, this is their home. The shift from 'Slums' to 'Downtown' could take generations to settle. I don't know how far I can carry it myself, but I'll do what I can.

char_4080_lin_CN_007.voiceText: I've never seen Ch'en onboard Rhodes Island. She has things to do, doesn't she? Hmph, hardly see any merit in recruiting operators like her. It's true that we don't get along very well. But I must admit, she is the one who showed me a different path.

char_4080_lin_CN_008.voiceText: I had nothing to do, so I trimmed the potted plant on your desk a little. No matter how busy life is, we can't forget our aesthetics. Why are you so surprised? The four arts, flower arrangement, tea ceremony... They were all part of my education. You would never have guessed? Whatever.

char_4080_lin_CN_009.voiceText: The nightscape here is very different from my childhood memories. Lungmen may be advancing by the day, but it still has its unlit corners... How about we go for a drink together? You can't truly know a city until you've visited its streets during the wee hours.

char_4080_lin_CN_010.voiceText: You can't let them see you exhausted, can you…?

char_4080_lin_CN_011.voiceText: You and I have probably crossed paths before, Doctor, but we finally found time for a formal introduction. There'll be much more done on the problems the Infected face in the Lungmen slums, now that we're working in direct communication.

char_4080_lin_CN_012.voiceText: There are many ways to deal with trouble, and direct confrontation is usually my last choice.

char_4080_lin_CN_013.voiceText: I sometimes attend ceremonies like these just to make things go smoother. I don't remember how many titles I have. But in the end, I always have to return to the shadows.

char_4080_lin_CN_014.voiceText: I know what I'm doing, and that's all that matters. At the end of the day, not all honors need to be made public, and not all roads need to be trod together.

char_4080_lin_CN_017.voiceText: You tell me your ends, just don't ask me my means.

char_4080_lin_CN_018.voiceText: If any of you have any doubts about the target, this is your last chance to pull out.

char_4080_lin_CN_019.voiceText: I hope I won't have to explain to you what we mean by 'necessary methods.'

char_4080_lin_CN_020.voiceText: It's time to make an example. They'll see what happens when they break the rules.

char_4080_lin_CN_024.voiceText: Let's put them six feet under.

char_4080_lin_CN_025.voiceText: You didn't think. So this is what happens when you cross the line.

char_4080_lin_CN_026.voiceText: You want to talk? Too late for that.

char_4080_lin_CN_027.voiceText: Give me a reason to let you go. Don't have one? What a pity.

char_4080_lin_CN_029.voiceText: It better remain a secret forever.

char_4080_lin_CN_030.voiceText: Clean, decent. No one will ever find their remains.

char_4080_lin_CN_031.voiceText: The situation is still salvageable. Leave the rest to me.

char_4080_lin_CN_032.voiceText: There is always a way to correct a mistake. Don't let anger get the best of you.

char_4080_lin_CN_033.voiceText: I don't need too much room here, but this place could use some decoration.

char_4080_lin_CN_034.voiceText: You'll need an explanation for what you just did.

char_4080_lin_CN_036.voiceText: Boh loh yau, fresh out of the oven, want one?

char_4080_lin_CN_042.voiceText: I hope you didn't run into any trouble, Doctor.

char_4082_qiubai_CN_001.voiceText: I may not be at your side all the time. But don't worry, when you need me, I will be there.

char_4082_qiubai_CN_002.voiceText: Logistics permits, equipment approvals, mission evaluations... Rhodes Island has too much red tape. While recklessness does tend to get you in trouble, being overcautious also gets on people's nerves. Let's keep it simple. If anything comes up, you tell me directly. I'll decide what to do from there.

char_4082_qiubai_CN_003.voiceText: I heard the Grandmaster also came to Rhodes Island? Don't worry, I won't pick a fight; but he must be curious if my skills have improved since I left Yumen... Come to think of it, after walking such a long road, he really should be taking it easy. And yet, he still pushes himself into a life of conflict. The same goes for you, Doctor.

char_4082_qiubai_CN_004.voiceText: My dad hated the snow. Snow keeps the doors shut, ruining 'business' for his river fort. That's why he gave me this name. 'Qiu' for hatred, 'Bai' for the white of snow. People always find something to blame for their misfortunes: snow, storms, calamities natural or manmade. As for me, I happened to be born on a snowy day, that's all there is to it.

char_4082_qiubai_CN_005.voiceText: I've seen some die in vain, some turn to crime, and others drive their friends and loved ones to despair… Justice is rare upon this cruel land, and eking out a living is always difficult. But there is no excuse for evil. Never has been, never will be.

char_4082_qiubai_CN_006.voiceText: The conflicts I can resolve with my sword are actually the simple ones. Unfortunately, most are as a great river surging forth, sweeping up all the sand and silt in its path until it turns into an unstoppable murky mess. I may encounter more places like that small mountain village. And I can't say for certain that I will do better next time. But good is good, and evil is evil. One may not confuse them, and I will find my own way to distinguish the two.

char_4082_qiubai_CN_007.voiceText: You'd like me to demonstrate my swordsmanship to the operators? Doctor, it's not something you can learn by watching. I know a scribe who served as the Grandmaster's record keeper. He followed the Grandmaster for over a decade. After years of observation, he could nitpick nearly any kung fu style under Heaven. And yet, he is weak to this day. A stiff breeze could blow him over... Anyway, I do happen to have some spare time. So I'll show you all a few moves.

char_4082_qiubai_CN_008.voiceText: The sharper the blade, the easier it is to break. The same goes for hatred in one's heart... It's easy to understand. But the hard part is, you must first face that which lies in your heart before you can really let it go. I have both hatred and gratitude toward the Grandmaster. The hatred, I paid back how I saw fit; the gratitude, I will hold as close. That is all.

char_4082_qiubai_CN_009.voiceText: The tumult in Yumen is done, and there's no more reason for me to be there. And the home that I came from is nothing but a river now. In short, I've become the 'one without roots.' But, being rootless is not all bad, as it's led me here to you and Rhodes Island. There will always be a place where my sword comes in handy.  The land under Heaven is vast, and my fate will mark the grave for me.

char_4082_qiubai_CN_010.voiceText: A rare bit of fine weather, a rare bit of leisure.

char_4082_qiubai_CN_011.voiceText: Dr. {@nickname}, I am Qiubai. I can't say for certain how long I will stay at Rhodes Island, but every meeting is a stroke of fortune. I trust we'll get along just fine.

char_4082_qiubai_CN_012.voiceText: When I was in Yumen, the Grandmaster would also review recordings of my every battle. For us practitioners of kung fu, having someone to provide feedback is always a good thing.

char_4082_qiubai_CN_013.voiceText: Why wield a sword? To combat injustice.

char_4082_qiubai_CN_014.voiceText: I've seen a certain type of fowlbeast in the Gobi to the north of Yan. Their habitat is on the verge of disappearing. So they fly in groups, wet their bodies with water from afar, then bring it back home... If even beasts can go to such an extent, there must be more we can do as people.

char_4082_qiubai_CN_018.voiceText: Very well. Let's walk this path together.

char_4082_qiubai_CN_019.voiceText: Don't waste too much energy on the road.

char_4082_qiubai_CN_020.voiceText: Don't bother telling me your names.

char_4082_qiubai_CN_023.voiceText: A true battlefield. This is the right place to settle things.

char_4082_qiubai_CN_024.voiceText: Dew falls heavy, grass bends low. Something's not right.

char_4082_qiubai_CN_025.voiceText: Your hostile intent is all too clear.

char_4082_qiubai_CN_026.voiceText: No blade has mercy. Brace yourself!

char_4082_qiubai_CN_027.voiceText: And this is your excuse for evil?

char_4082_qiubai_CN_029.voiceText: Let's go, Doctor. Time to head back.

char_4082_qiubai_CN_030.voiceText: Even to the very end, I do not know why those people drew their blades... Perhaps, even they did not know themselves.

char_4082_qiubai_CN_031.voiceText: Let it be. No sword technique is perfect, just as no outcome is flawless. We shouldn't get too fixated on fighting.

char_4082_qiubai_CN_032.voiceText: Even a technique you have executed a thousand times can fail. Don't focus too much on winning and losing, Doctor, you did what you could.

char_4082_qiubai_CN_033.voiceText: Were you the one who decorated this room? No, nothing. I am a jianghu wanderer, and we are not picky.

char_4082_qiubai_CN_034.voiceText: I'll write this off as a little joke. But, next time...

char_4082_qiubai_CN_036.voiceText: Doctor, why don't you come practice the blade with me?

char_4082_qiubai_CN_042.voiceText: Doctor, remember to practice your kung fu.

char_493_firwhl_CN_001.voiceText: With all this paper around, it's hard to resist the urge to start fires… Whoa, whoa, don't look at me like that, I'm just joshin', okay?

char_493_firwhl_CN_002.voiceText: Doctor, our employees are all Billy natives who know the lay of the land. If any Rhodes operators are traveling to Rim Billiton and need an escort, come find us! We will offer you a fair price.

char_493_firwhl_CN_003.voiceText: Why hire Infected when it's bad for business? Well, umm, because... Ah, come on, we all know how Oripathy's transmitted. All you need is proper protection and monitoring. Rhodes Island does the same, right? Ahaha…

char_493_firwhl_CN_004.voiceText: The right type of ammo can turn the tide of a battle', it's a line every artilleryman knows. So their bags are filled with grapeshot, flashbangs and tracers. 'Course, they always have trouble deciding which to use when the time comes. As for me, I just bring incendiaries. Use 'em right, and they replace any type of ammo you could need.

char_493_firwhl_CN_005.voiceText: I hated it whenever anyone brought up my dad while I was in university. Are we on bad terms? Naw, he's not a bad dad, and I'm grateful to him. But I hate it when people look at me like a mining mogul's spoiled kid. I'm more than just my dad's daughter!

char_493_firwhl_CN_006.voiceText: Dad wouldn't let me near fire, Mum didn't let me play with the miners' kids, my old boss told me not to poke my nose into business that isn't my own, and everyone told me not to be too nice to the Infected. I never listened to any of that. You decide what's right and wrong for yourself, and never get swept up if you need time to make a choice.

char_493_firwhl_CN_007.voiceText: That little firefighter always tenses up when she sees me, then points her hose right at me. Well, It's cute, sure, but that can't go on forever. The three of us should go for a drink sometime and clear up this misunderstanding. For the two of you, I'll make my special flaming cocktail.

char_493_firwhl_CN_008.voiceText: I know I'm not great at business, but I also know how it feels to be helpless, relying on the kindness of others. It hurts, the company being in debt, but debtor's prison beats having to burn your own comrades to cinders.

char_493_firwhl_CN_009.voiceText: I loved playing army when I was little, and I always dreamed of becoming a general. But Rim Billiton wasn't the place for that, so I had to settle for a private security firm... Now? Now I just want to keep my people warm and fed. My dream of becoming a general died the first time I saw someone get shot.

char_493_firwhl_CN_010.voiceText: Yawn... I'm bored. Might as well build a grenade tower over here... Whoa?! You're awake? Er, these are blanks! Nah yeah, just blanks!

char_493_firwhl_CN_011.voiceText: Thank you for choosing Firewhistle Security Services! My name is... huh? Codename? Umm, just call me Firewhistle. Yup, that's the key to raising brand awareness!

char_493_firwhl_CN_012.voiceText: Nice strat. Would've been even better with some fire on that spot.

char_493_firwhl_CN_013.voiceText: A promotion? Thank you! If you've got any more security jobs for me and my people, that'd be even better. Hehe.

char_493_firwhl_CN_014.voiceText: Working with Rhodes Island's seen my company turn a profit at last. I'm not paying my employees out of my own pocket anymore! Thank you so much, Doctor! You have all my appreciation and all my gratitude!

char_493_firwhl_CN_018.voiceText: Captain? No problem, I'm used to running the show.

char_493_firwhl_CN_019.voiceText: Let's go,everyone! I'll buy a round for us all when we're done.

char_493_firwhl_CN_020.voiceText: Stay low. Wait 'till you see my fire.

char_493_firwhl_CN_021.voiceText: Need some fire to turn up the heat?

char_493_firwhl_CN_023.voiceText: In position and ready to light'em up.

char_493_firwhl_CN_027.voiceText: Panicking just spreads the fire faster.

char_493_firwhl_CN_029.voiceText: Your plan actually worked! Sure wish I had a tactical genius like you on my payroll.

char_493_firwhl_CN_030.voiceText: We should put out the fires before we call it a day. Wanna join me?

char_493_firwhl_CN_031.voiceText: Leaving a smoldering ember is a good way to end up with a wildfire. Let's watch out for those.

char_493_firwhl_CN_032.voiceText: I'll cover our retreat. Don't worry, I've done this a bunch of times.

char_493_firwhl_CN_033.voiceText: Rhodes Island's base is outfitted so much better than my little office.

char_493_firwhl_CN_036.voiceText: Here, I made this ornament out of a shell casing. Hehe, I'm really good at it, right?

char_493_firwhl_CN_042.voiceText: G'day, Doctor! Need a warm fire?

char_4083_chimes_CN_001.voiceText: Are these the documents you need to mail? Alright, let me check them off.

char_4083_chimes_CN_002.voiceText: There's a letter for you from the Lungmen slums, Doctor. A former patient? Your expression tells me pretty much exactly what's in this letter.

char_4083_chimes_CN_003.voiceText: I use this sword to fight beasts that slip into the village, as well as bandits and thieves. For beasts, it's just a matter of driving them away. But people,  it's hard to keep them from going astray.

char_4083_chimes_CN_004.voiceText: There are villages that don't even appear on maps, relying on Messengers to communicate. I used to follow the ones who came to my village around, and even learned my first words from the stuff written on envelopes. But I had to grow up before I learned how much those few words meant.

char_4083_chimes_CN_005.voiceText: I once went back to the village where I grew up. All I found was a few abandoned huts and fields. The people who lived there probably found new lives in the cities. But sometimes I wonder, if I had worked harder, would they have stayed?

char_4083_chimes_CN_006.voiceText: You know, I haven't been to that many places. I've wandered between the mountains and cities, and seen people suffering from hardship, helplessness, and stress... This is a vast land, but how many people live in its nameless corners from birth to death, with no one ever to know they existed?

char_4083_chimes_CN_007.voiceText: The villagers didn't kick me out when they learned I had Oripathy, but still I couldn't go back to my old life. No, getting infected was my own responsibility. It'd be too full of myself to say I got Infected to help people.

char_4083_chimes_CN_008.voiceText: I'm still looking for the young man's family. My words were too harsh... I didn't know his name, even at the very end of it. Superficial as it might have been, he came down for a taste of our harsh lives and recorded it. There's meaning in that.

char_4083_chimes_CN_009.voiceText: I've seen many people wait at the village entrance, hoping for a letter from their families. I've seen all sorts of emotions on their faces when they opened the letters. Messengers carry little slivers of people's lives. That's got nothing to do with me, and everything too.

char_4083_chimes_CN_010.voiceText: What a beautiful sunset. The weather tomorrow should be fine and clear.

char_4083_chimes_CN_011.voiceText: Hi there, Are you the Doctor that's in charge here? I heard I could get treatment for Oripathy in exchange for work here... Oh, right, just call me Wind Chimes. It's a name that represents hope.

char_4083_chimes_CN_012.voiceText: I'd rather not get into fights while making deliveries...

char_4083_chimes_CN_013.voiceText: All I did was carry out my duties as a Messenger... Anyway, leave it to me if you have a job like that again. I won't let you down.

char_4083_chimes_CN_014.voiceText: Many more people are waiting for hopeful news. Doctor, let's walk this path together.

char_4083_chimes_CN_017.voiceText: As long as there's a destination, there's a way.

char_4083_chimes_CN_018.voiceText: I'll make sure everyone arrives safely.

char_4083_chimes_CN_019.voiceText: The road is long. Walk slowly.

char_4083_chimes_CN_023.voiceText: Bare mountains, dirt n' dust... all familiar sights.

char_4083_chimes_CN_024.voiceText: A long path through tall mountains… Stay alert.

char_4083_chimes_CN_025.voiceText: Leave now and I'll act like I never saw you.

char_4083_chimes_CN_026.voiceText: I never wanted to point this blade at anyone.

char_4083_chimes_CN_027.voiceText: There are people waiting for me.

char_4083_chimes_CN_028.voiceText: Don't keep pushing down the wrong path…

char_4083_chimes_CN_029.voiceText: No matter how far the destination, you will get there one day, as long as you keep moving forward.

char_4083_chimes_CN_030.voiceText: I'm happy to bring news of victory, but I would rather avoid conflict like this.

char_4083_chimes_CN_031.voiceText: The goods are still here. Let's hope those who ran away will learn and repent.

char_4083_chimes_CN_032.voiceText: Let's rest and regroup. We can take back what we lost later.

char_4083_chimes_CN_033.voiceText: It's good to have a place to rest.

char_4083_chimes_CN_036.voiceText: Careful, I just got back and I'm covered in dust…

char_2024_chyue_CN_001.voiceText: You would like to be my 'kung fu recorder?' The way Rhodes Island treats its guests truly moves me. It is no wonder my sisters love this place so much… I misunderstand?  No problem, I have no qualms with being your subordinate either.

char_2024_chyue_CN_002.voiceText: Doctor.' Your title reminds me of the Yanese scholars. Experienced and knowledgeable, they see the forest for the trees. You feel like we've met before? It's true that after awakening from my dream of chaos, I have traveled to many places... Sadly, the more friends I make, the lonelier I feel. Perhaps we are alike in that respect.

char_2024_chyue_CN_003.voiceText: As you can see, I note down only my experiences and insights, rather than any specific kung fu moves. What really matters to the martial arts is 'Yi' — your intent. If you let yourself be constrained by those gaudy forms, you will find it hard to break out of them. Take Dusk's paintings, for example. If I couldn't grasp the intent behind them, and sought to discuss techniques and styles with her, she would only shut the door on my face.

char_2024_chyue_CN_004.voiceText: I agreed to be a 'fight choreographer' for Nian's movie. It keeps her from making too much of a racket, or getting too lonely. Dusk is timid, and Ling is too fond of drink. I will look after them as well... We are far from a normal family. Nevertheless, we are siblings, and not the collective 'we' as we are often called.

char_2024_chyue_CN_005.voiceText: Death is a daily occurrence to warriors on campaign. But the real challenge they face, is preserving their humanity and morality after facing such morbidity, rather growing jaded and desensitized. Indeed, conflicts and mortality have been the way of these lands for eons. But only those giant, terrible creatures are cold-hearted enough to think so.

char_2024_chyue_CN_006.voiceText: The world is a vast place, and wonderful sceneries abound, yet man has limited strength and time. It is impossible to see all these sights, much less defend them. To those who practice the martial arts, all we can do is train day and night, from the depths of winter to the height of summer. It may sound like a clumsy and brutish method, but the result is giving every last drop you have, leaving no regrets.

char_2024_chyue_CN_007.voiceText: That sword is an unwanted possession that must not be cast away. Huai Tianpei keeping it is an outcome that all concerned parties can accept. My duel with him, you ask? He trained for forty years, and landed a single heavy blow on me. But how many comings and goings of spring and autumn have I trained? All things considered, I was the one who lost.

char_2024_chyue_CN_008.voiceText: 'Who am I'... For this question, you need only gaze upon the water. Be it human, beast, mountains, foggy woods, or the reflection of the twin moons on the night sky, whatever it is you see, that is your answer. As for the distant, radically different future, whether we siblings will return to chaos and seek new answers, is an entirely different question.

char_2024_chyue_CN_009.voiceText: The scholars at court seek perfect answers in everything. The kung fu practitioners who wander in jianghu seek revenge, status, glory, or a simple resolution. Their obsessions run deep, yet their time runs short. Often, they spend their whole lifetimes chasing a single ideal or undertaking... All those people, how woeful and pitiful, how respectable and regrettable.

char_2024_chyue_CN_010.voiceText: The spring comes and goes, leaving a lonely autumn.

char_2024_chyue_CN_011.voiceText: Doctor, thank you kindly for taking care of my sisters. I hope you will excuse me for intruding upon Rhodes Island for a little while. Please call me 'Chongyue.' It's a name given to me by... an old friend of mine.

char_2024_chyue_CN_012.voiceText: The colors that once embellished the autumn grass, hues long buried by war.

char_2024_chyue_CN_013.voiceText: Often I think about those soldiers who traveled from all corners of Great Yan to Yumen. They risked their lives in battle until death took them, or their age crept upon themselves... yet never for their own ends.

char_2024_chyue_CN_014.voiceText: Battles we have fought, death we have braved. Doctor, no need to say more.

char_2024_chyue_CN_017.voiceText: Lit, quenched, then lit again… The signal fires never ever rest.

char_2024_chyue_CN_018.voiceText: In that case, Doctor, will you beat the drums for me as we sortie?

char_2024_chyue_CN_019.voiceText: The sunset weaves a silken river. Heaven and earth bolster me upon departure.

char_2024_chyue_CN_020.voiceText: Warriors from afar rest scarce, the armor they wear spurs them to march.

char_2024_chyue_CN_021.voiceText: One should spar from time to time.

char_2024_chyue_CN_023.voiceText: Look at this spectacular sight. Alas, it is now a battlefield.

char_2024_chyue_CN_024.voiceText: Many intellectuals must join a battle before penning a decent verse, including that sister of mine… This too is an opportunity.

char_2024_chyue_CN_025.voiceText: Unsteady posture, wavering intent. Much to learn yet.

char_2024_chyue_CN_026.voiceText: A thousand moves in one breath!

char_2024_chyue_CN_027.voiceText: Strike, and sunder the tides cleft. Retract, and leave no peace bereft.

char_2024_chyue_CN_028.voiceText: After all this time, you still turn to war for solutions!

char_2024_chyue_CN_029.voiceText: You calmly place your pieces to plot your victory... Doctor, a weiqi player like you is a truly rare sight.

char_2024_chyue_CN_030.voiceText: A thousand armies move at the beating of your war drums, with a handful of sand to clean the blood from one's armor... What a tremendous victory!

char_2024_chyue_CN_031.voiceText: There is never a true victory in brandishing a sword and formulating a strategy, while looking for gains and losses is an even greater folly. So long as you leave no regrets, then all is well.

char_2024_chyue_CN_032.voiceText: All warriors must face defeat. Don't lose heart.

char_2024_chyue_CN_033.voiceText: This is much more comfortable than a military tent. Can I even manage a good night's sleep without the sound of drilling soldiers…?

char_2024_chyue_CN_034.voiceText: Doctor, have you figured out how to counter that move from yesterday?

char_2024_chyue_CN_036.voiceText: The times are changing, and man along with them. So too does the scenery change.

char_2024_chyue_CN_042.voiceText: Doctor, I did not see you at this morning's training session.

char_4078_bdhkgt_CN_001.voiceText: I'll protect you, as I've promised. But...it'll take some time before I can read all the words on these documents... Don't worry, I'll get there.

char_4078_bdhkgt_CN_002.voiceText: You have to be prepared, out in the wastelands. Always carry flint for starting fires, a weapon for self-defense, and fabric to use as a water filter... no flammable items in the office? But, what if there's a power outage?

char_4078_bdhkgt_CN_003.voiceText: Shifu taught us how to fight, how to avoid Catastrophes, how to farm and store food. Now we don't have to drift around in search of water and pasture anymore... Just like you, Doctor, Shifu seemed to know everything. I can't be like you and my Shifu, but I can protect you, so you can help people.

char_4078_bdhkgt_CN_004.voiceText: Whenever the tribe is on the move, everyone worries whether we'll find a good place to settle down. But people in nomadic cities don't seem concerned at all... Maybe for them, they're not moving in search of a new home, but drifting with the home they have?

char_4078_bdhkgt_CN_005.voiceText: Oripathy is not a rare sight in my tribe. We only think the stones that grow from the skin, they look like the stones we dig out of the earth… There are already so many things that can kill you; why persecute someone for a disease?

char_4078_bdhkgt_CN_006.voiceText: The name 'Anasa' means 'one without roots.' My people say that if you have no attachments, there's nothing that can trouble you. But everyone I've met since I left has something that they are attached to. Me? You mean I'm the same, in how I want to repay my debt? Hmm...

char_4078_bdhkgt_CN_007.voiceText: My name comes from the first Yanese poem my Shifu taught me. It tells of a cloud, 'Yun' in Yanese, that has been drifting for a thousand li, raining across the land, until it finally finds a mountain to rest upon. 'Jie' is the end of that long journey. After all, 'everyone should have a place to call home.'

char_4078_bdhkgt_CN_008.voiceText: That martial arts master is here too... I thought he was cold and heartless, but now I kind of understand him... a man who has lived for so long and traveled so far can only carry so much. That must be what Shifu thought as well.

char_4078_bdhkgt_CN_009.voiceText: Sometimes you see the clear night sky after a Catastrophe has passed in the distance. Wind blows toward the horizon, and the stars seem so close you could touch them. A bonfire keeps the beasts away, while singing keeps you warm. The wastes are dangerous, but they are not terrible.

char_4078_bdhkgt_CN_010.voiceText: Are you retiring for the night? I'll stand watch.

char_4078_bdhkgt_CN_011.voiceText: My birth name? Doctor, you understand the Anasa language...? But I would rather continue to use the name 'Jieyun.' Shifu gave me this name, and I like it.

char_4078_bdhkgt_CN_012.voiceText: The reasons to fight never change much.

char_4078_bdhkgt_CN_013.voiceText: I still have a lot to learn after leaving the wastes. I'm willing to do more, if you trust me to. As the Yanese expression goes: a promise is worth a thousand taels of gold.

char_4078_bdhkgt_CN_014.voiceText: I haven't thought much about what I will become, but Rhodes Island could become home to many. Thank you, Doctor.

char_4078_bdhkgt_CN_017.voiceText: Yes, I will complete the task you gave me.

char_4078_bdhkgt_CN_018.voiceText: Stay close. The wastelands are a dangerous place to get lost.

char_4078_bdhkgt_CN_019.voiceText: We're bringing everyone home, safe and sound.

char_4078_bdhkgt_CN_020.voiceText: The wind and sand don't cover all tracks. Something's not right here.

char_4078_bdhkgt_CN_023.voiceText: Remember those poplars, and you'll always find your way.

char_4078_bdhkgt_CN_024.voiceText: I'll pile some stones here to mark the trail.

char_4078_bdhkgt_CN_025.voiceText: Would you give up after a loss?

char_4078_bdhkgt_CN_026.voiceText: You have invaded someone else's home...

char_4078_bdhkgt_CN_027.voiceText: Your families will be sad if they never see you again.

char_4078_bdhkgt_CN_028.voiceText: A few more cairns on the barrens.

char_4078_bdhkgt_CN_029.voiceText: Will anyone remember them when all this is buried beneath the sand?

char_4078_bdhkgt_CN_030.voiceText: If I could learn from you, Doctor, I could protect my people's lands.

char_4078_bdhkgt_CN_031.voiceText: Shifu says it isn't important whether or not you achieved what you set out to do, but whether you gave your best without running away. We've done well, Doctor.

char_4078_bdhkgt_CN_032.voiceText: Don't worry, I remember the way that we came. There's time to retreat.

char_4078_bdhkgt_CN_033.voiceText: I'm used to the darkness... oh, there's the light.

char_4078_bdhkgt_CN_034.voiceText: Be careful, Doctor. You don't want to be mistaken for an attacking beast.

char_4078_bdhkgt_CN_042.voiceText: Would you like to go out for some fresh air, Doctor?

char_1029_yato2_CN_001.voiceText: I'm to assist you? One moment, then. I'll go and change into more appropriate uniform... What? No need?

char_1029_yato2_CN_002.voiceText: I'll be honest, even now I'm not used to life with my mask off—it always feels like there's something missing from my face. Still, it seems I can operate freely in daylight now. Please, give me more daytime missions, Doctor.

char_1029_yato2_CN_003.voiceText: The combat style the Felynes have taught me is like nothing I've known before. Unbroken strings of attacks as a defense, swift evasive maneuvers, different styles combining to achieve completely differing effects... Even though I've been training day and night, I still can't say I've mastered it.

char_1029_yato2_CN_004.voiceText: These clothes have your attention, Doctor? They confused me just as much when I first put them on—they have a startling defensive capacity, despite their obvious design. How it's achieved is completely beyond me.

char_1029_yato2_CN_005.voiceText: There's a strange force in these dual blades. They attack with thunder, but without the use of Arts... Is it the materials that cause it? I was definitely more proficient with my old katana... but when it comes to protecting us all, I'll shy away from no weapon.

char_1029_yato2_CN_006.voiceText: The Felynes never cease to mention monsters even more fearsome than Rathalos—the kind that could bring about Catastrophe-scale disasters with the flap of a wing. If Rhodes Island ever faced such a threat... no. After all we've been through, I wouldn't fear an enemy like that anymore.

char_1029_yato2_CN_007.voiceText: Though I've changed my loadout and gained new skills, I'm still the same Yato you know. Just give the order, and I'll take on whatever role Rhodes Island needs of me, Doctor.

char_1029_yato2_CN_008.voiceText: Noir Corne's always been this way, fussing over minor details, dragging down the mission. Still, I admit he's occasionally helpful... okay, a little more than occasionally. The point is, I don't hate him.

char_1029_yato2_CN_009.voiceText: Operators are often worried about the way I do things, wondering if I'm putting myself in harm's way. Honestly, the concern's unnecessary. Thinking too much on my situation would only slow me down, but when it comes to what my friends are going through, trust me, I will care.

char_1029_yato2_CN_010.voiceText: It seems you need some rest, Doctor. You can try this, if you want. It's a Felyne blend of a remedial plant they call Sleep Herb and some kind of mushroom. I hear it works very well, sleep-wise.

char_1029_yato2_CN_011.voiceText: Hey, Doctor. That's right, it's me. Op Team A4 Captain Yato, back and reporting in. As for where I got all this new equipment, you have the whole story from me in the mission debrief.

char_1029_yato2_CN_012.voiceText: Hold on, I had notes on the locale. Let me find them...

char_1029_yato2_CN_013.voiceText: Whatever role I'm in, I'll bring everything I have.

char_1029_yato2_CN_014.voiceText: Another medal for me? I'd love to wear them, but I don't think this outfit has anywhere for them to go. Still, thank you, Doctor.

char_1029_yato2_CN_018.voiceText: Alright, it's in my hands now. The success of our mission is assured.

char_1029_yato2_CN_019.voiceText: Target confirmed. They won't know what hit them.

char_1029_yato2_CN_020.voiceText: Op Team A4 Yato in position.

char_1029_yato2_CN_028.voiceText: Fight or flee, it's no use!

char_1029_yato2_CN_029.voiceText: We owe this victory to your fine command. I still have a long way to go.

char_1029_yato2_CN_030.voiceText: Take victory as a whetstone to hone the cutting edge.

char_1029_yato2_CN_032.voiceText: This falls on me. You make a retreat, and grant me one more attempt.

char_1029_yato2_CN_033.voiceText: I'd like more dangerous or challenging work, but if these are your orders, I'll gladly accept, Doctor.

char_1029_yato2_CN_034.voiceText: What is it, Doctor? Intrigued by the materials for this outfit?

char_1029_yato2_CN_036.voiceText: Oh, hey, Doctor. I guess I'm not used to dropping the mask after all.

char_1029_yato2_CN_042.voiceText: Hey, Doctor. You're the same as ever. I wonder if I'm any better than I used to be?

char_4077_palico_CN_001.voiceText: Remember, you two, this purr-ticular assistant role calls for maximum vigilance. If any meownsters come knocking, we throw the Doctor on the cart and go!

char_4077_palico_CN_002.voiceText: Curious about our latest research? We're gnawing on 'An Investigation into Biological Discrepancies Between Us Felynes with a Y and Terran Felines with an I.' We were halfway done, but then we found out you have Aslans too, so it's back to the scratching post for us... You Terrans are meowder with your subspecies!

char_4077_palico_CN_003.voiceText: Your Meowjesty, never forget to eat your fill before you go on a hunt. Dive into a fight with full stamina, and you might end up doing things you didn't even think you could... mrrreow!

char_4077_palico_CN_004.voiceText: *dink* *dink* No Machalite Ore left...  Could substitute with Rock Spider stones and gloompincer shells... Don't know without trying. In you go.

char_4077_palico_CN_007.voiceText: The mountains never fail to remind me of an old bud, built just as tall and strong. He broke his weapon once and quit the Palico life after, but if memory serves, he then went with the Research Commission to take up cheffing in the New World... You never know what turn your next life'll take.

char_4077_palico_CN_008.voiceText: Say, Doctor, I'll let you in on a secret trick, friend to... maybe furless friend. If you ever get hurt in battle and you need to chug a Potion, set off a Barrel Bomb behind you while you do. Why? It'll stop any baddies getting the pounce on you, that's why!

char_4077_palico_CN_009.voiceText: Terra has new materials. Lots of ores. Very lovely... Maybe I can make a weapon just like that Great Sword in the ice cave back home! For mew, Doctor!

char_4077_palico_CN_010.voiceText: Meow, meow, lots of... fascinating things in Doctor's room. Want to move them elsewhere, while Doctor's asleep... Smithy! Stay your paw!

char_4077_palico_CN_011.voiceText: On Your Meowjesty's summons, we the Felyne Special Corps... cream of the crop of the Terra Research Commission's Furst Fleet, have arrived! Meowch! Get your hind paws off my head!

char_4077_palico_CN_012.voiceText: What are you doing inside this box, Smithy? Im... Impawssible! It's all moving! How is it done?

char_4077_palico_CN_018.voiceText: A simple task! I'm a purr-ime leader, after all!

char_4077_palico_CN_019.voiceText: Let's go, 'Hunters!' Put some pep in your step!

char_4077_palico_CN_020.voiceText: Purr-ey spotted. Watch out, Your Meowjesty.

char_4077_palico_CN_027.voiceText: Taste the flaming soul of a hunter!

char_4077_palico_CN_029.voiceText: Are... Are we out of danger meow? Can I open my eyes yet?

char_4077_palico_CN_030.voiceText: Absolutely stellar command, Your Meowjesty. That's what I call great gains... mrreow.

char_4077_palico_CN_031.voiceText: Equipment everywhere... grabbing, all of it. Grabbing and going.

char_4077_palico_CN_032.voiceText: Good gravy, they're catching up! Run, run like your tail's on fire!

char_4077_palico_CN_033.voiceText: Hauling, hauling... Smithy, why do you drag that meowntain of materials with you everywhere you go?

char_4077_palico_CN_036.voiceText: What are you doing? Mrrow... right there, please... Hey, save a pet or two for me!

char_4077_palico_CN_042.voiceText: Ah, Doctor! Fine day to mew!

char_1030_noirc2_CN_001.voiceText: Alright, I'm here to help! Chill, I'm all good with this gear now. Bumping into everything? That's the old me!

char_1030_noirc2_CN_002.voiceText: Out in the field, it's pretty important to watch what you and your teammates eat. Just a while ago, I learned how to use this simple BBQ spit to treat raw meat. Here, lemme demo for you right now!

char_1030_noirc2_CN_003.voiceText: I've hauled butt all across Terra, and I've never seen gear both as sturdy and as comfortable as this. Feels like when I wear it, my attack power gets boosted, plus I can hit enemy weaknesses way better, and my fire attacks are stronger too! Yeah, uh, I figure that might just be me? Haha.

char_1030_noirc2_CN_004.voiceText: The Felynes say the more experienced the hunter, the more thorough the pre-mission prep. Packing all your potions and tools is just as key to the hunt. Still, Yato loves to chew me out, saying I'm always bringing too much stuff on missions. Rock and a hard place, y'know?

char_1030_noirc2_CN_005.voiceText: Feels weird, honestly, not having my ol' reliable shield on hand. Still, the Felynes say if I get good enough with this long sword, I can basically fend off every attack under the sun. Guess my training's got a long way to go.

char_1030_noirc2_CN_006.voiceText: You only really master combat technique after taking on enough enemies. I guess no shortcut to getting promoted after all, huh? Especially for dummies like me, haha.

char_1030_noirc2_CN_007.voiceText: I get that whetstones aren't thrilling, but they're a tool you can't go without. Even a blade with sharpness this fine is gonna need nonstop polishing its whole life.

char_1030_noirc2_CN_008.voiceText: I just wanna do my job as a guy in the background, even now. Us nobodies, we've got our own duties, our own worries, and our own things we wanna protect.

char_1030_noirc2_CN_009.voiceText: Ditching the shield, using a long sword like this, it keeps reminding me of the old days. Bad times I hate to remember. But without our past, I guess Yato and me wouldn't be who we are today.

char_1030_noirc2_CN_010.voiceText: Get your rest on, Doctor. Leave the place to me.

char_1030_noirc2_CN_011.voiceText: Operator Noir Corne, back under your command with all-new gear! Alright, Doctor, don't care if it's bandits or nightmare bizarro creatures, you leave it all to me!

char_1030_noirc2_CN_012.voiceText: Lemme scrub back a sec, I want a closer look. Yeah, mm-hm...

char_1030_noirc2_CN_013.voiceText: I've gotta give thanks to my kickass gear for carrying me this far. But obviously, the biggest props go out to you and everyone around me for all your help!

char_1030_noirc2_CN_014.voiceText: This is Operator Noir Corne, everyone's shield through hell and high water! And hey, I guess I can handle being everyone's sword too!

char_1030_noirc2_CN_017.voiceText: No prob. I'm all readied up.

char_1030_noirc2_CN_018.voiceText: You want me to lead, without Yato? You sure? I think it'd be better if you got her on.

char_1030_noirc2_CN_019.voiceText: Everybody done eating? Alright, go time!

char_1030_noirc2_CN_020.voiceText: Mission start! Target position is a lock!

char_1030_noirc2_CN_021.voiceText: Which area am I heading to?

char_1030_noirc2_CN_029.voiceText: Now THAT was a good battle. Take pride, everyone, and good work!
