I no longer have to put a price on gems with blood on them... all of which have put my mind at ease, in fact. I no longer have to imagine the gems being cut into pieces, after all.

char_499_kaitou_CN_008.voiceText: I don't know when I'll return to Leithanien, but I would like to invite you for my next operation. There won't be any cooperation, nor do I intend to share my plans... but I'll ask you to keep your eyes on me, to witness all that I do. You're the only one who can see through me, aren't you? Come then.

char_499_kaitou_CN_009.voiceText: I can take you to the top of any spire in Leithanien. How does that sound? You'd understand me there. The scent of the wind is clean at the top... and that's all. That's all that young boy in the gem mine longed for.

char_499_kaitou_CN_010.voiceText: If you fall asleep, then nothing here can pique my interest.

char_499_kaitou_CN_011.voiceText: Which name card would you like: the one in my left hand, or the one in my right...? Diamante, gemologist. Pleased to make your acquaintance. Don't worry, there's no target here worth my attention, even if you picked the other card.

char_499_kaitou_CN_012.voiceText: A practical video, free from excessive narration and trite background music.

char_499_kaitou_CN_013.voiceText: Thanks. I don't normally collect medals for the purpose of displaying status, but if you insist, I will place it at the top of my collection to demonstrate my respect for you.

char_499_kaitou_CN_014.voiceText: Steal a piece of bread, go to jail. Offend a noble, get beaten. Steal a priceless treasure, and you get to stand at the top of the tallest spire. Be my guest, Doctor, and come watch my show, watch the audience cheer. Will it bring you joy, or sorrow?

char_499_kaitou_CN_017.voiceText: Colluding with me is not something to be done lightly.

char_499_kaitou_CN_018.voiceText: One wrong step, and we'll pay a heavy price. I expect perfect teamwork from you.

char_499_kaitou_CN_020.voiceText: What do you possess that's mine to take?

char_499_kaitou_CN_022.voiceText: This is the only value of gemstones.

char_499_kaitou_CN_023.voiceText: To all my enemies: I will Crack. You. Down.

char_499_kaitou_CN_024.voiceText: I shall have the honor to pulverize what you treasure.

char_499_kaitou_CN_025.voiceText: Will you cheer for me? I can't help but wonder!

char_499_kaitou_CN_026.voiceText: How will you struggle? How will you hold on to what you have?

char_499_kaitou_CN_027.voiceText: When will I strike, and take what you cherish the most?

char_499_kaitou_CN_028.voiceText: Who has not earned their end?

char_499_kaitou_CN_029.voiceText: I shared my life with you. Repay that debt, and tell me what fruit our efforts have born. Tell me what's the rewards of valor.

char_499_kaitou_CN_030.voiceText: We can leave now. I'm sure no witnesses escaped.

char_499_kaitou_CN_031.voiceText: A gem loses its value when flawed with impurities and cracks. You might as well dispose of it.

char_499_kaitou_CN_032.voiceText: Are you still alive? Good. We all have our share of misfortune, but now you've had your stakes back, which you can risk on the line in the next game. Allow me to congratulate you on that.

char_499_kaitou_CN_033.voiceText: What assessment would you like from me? It's the only place I can call home for now. I don't dare to be critical.

char_499_kaitou_CN_036.voiceText: If I may interest you with a grind such as gem polishing, then please, take the seat to my opposite.

char_499_kaitou_CN_042.voiceText: Greetings, Doctor. Do you need something appraised?

char_4098_vvana_CN_001.voiceText: Hm, by the way, may I ask who was your previous assistant? No, I'm not snooping or anything. It's just... There's not much I can do for you here, besides offer my quiet thoughts on the occasional poem.

char_4098_vvana_CN_002.voiceText: I see what you're hiding behind your back. Be at ease, I know very well that Leithanien needs a citizen to heighten her glory in foreign lands. Kazimierz, on the other hand, needs a scandal-plagued knight of self-professed purity. Both are as plain as day. Besides, that issue of The Red Wine is outdated. Their kinds never run short of personalities to gossip over.

char_4098_vvana_CN_003.voiceText: The wind can get very strong up on the decks. Perhaps you should change into something warmer. Me? I'm just dressing this place up as a certain city of greenery and shade in my imagination. The one where the gentle breeze blew from lands unknown, and the blacksmith's rhythmic hammering sounded the passage of time... Those days were brief. So brief, they are worth remembering.

char_4098_vvana_CN_004.voiceText: 'Droste' is my mother's maiden name. It is a common name with no place in the spires. How long would you stay in an alley full of marigolds, Doktor? Very few would grace their proses and stanzas with these forbidden blossoms, but they're really beautiful... To be honest, I'm surprised you actually remembered my full name, Doktor.

char_4098_vvana_CN_005.voiceText: Poetry is charming as a respite from grammatical convention. It is a search for the most fitting of expressions in the most irrational.  The Candle Knight, who upholds virtue, and Viviana, who loves poetry... I have been a contradiction since the very beginning.

char_4098_vvana_CN_006.voiceText: Tales about foreign lands usually end with the traveler returning home. I was always preparing to return to Leithanien, but even after having experienced so much, my truest imp ression of the place remains in the candlelit books on those dark nights. I've seen the people I wanted to see, and I've made my choice.

char_4098_vvana_CN_007.voiceText: Look. What is it the candle lights here? Our faces? Lines of poetry that no one reads? Or the dark and mired path ahead of us? I guess you've always been able to see them, even without my candlelight. Right then, rest your eyes upon me. Don't let the light distract your gaze.

char_4098_vvana_CN_008.voiceText: I returned to that small, dark chamber in the spire and spoke to the little girl within. I told her that she will endure a lifetime of slander, suffer regrets that cannot be undone, and be trapped in a cycle of endless pursuit and loss… Yes, farewells feel the same as a dream. Do you find me, as I am in this moment, real enough?

char_4098_vvana_CN_009.voiceText: 'If you and I were notes from one stanza, on which instrument are we strung? And what player has us in his hand?' Oh, I knew you would come. Have you finished reading the poems I gave you? Let me guess. I couldn't possibly share the image of your beloved, and it must lie within the most uplifting cantata.

char_4098_vvana_CN_010.voiceText: Mein Tag war heiter, glücklich meine Nacht.

char_4098_vvana_CN_011.voiceText: Greetings. Margaret told me about you.  It's a shame we didn't have a chance to meet in the Grand Knight Territory… They called me 'The Candle Knight' at the time. You can call me Viviana, Doktor.

char_4098_vvana_CN_012.voiceText: Watching my own fights through a screen... For a moment, I thought I was still in Kazimierz.

char_4098_vvana_CN_013.voiceText: Are you going to grant me a title as well?  There's no need for that, but it probably won't matter anyway. This place is no arena.

char_4098_vvana_CN_014.voiceText: Can I interpret this as... your hope that I will stay?

char_4098_vvana_CN_017.voiceText: I, Viviana Droste, shall wield candle and blade to win victories in your name.

char_4098_vvana_CN_018.voiceText: Um, truth be told, the General Chamber of Commerce's spokesmen kept complaining that I didn't care much about my own matches.

char_4098_vvana_CN_019.voiceText: Let us move. A timely departure paves the way for an early return.

char_4098_vvana_CN_020.voiceText: Moonlight barely laid upon the breezy parterre, yet you've witnessed the entirety of autumn?

char_4098_vvana_CN_021.voiceText: I listen, to this passing silence.

char_4098_vvana_CN_022.voiceText: I wait, for that belated serenity.

char_4098_vvana_CN_023.voiceText: This is no arena. No scars will be remembered or awarded.

char_4098_vvana_CN_024.voiceText: Leave. This is my last suggestion.

char_4098_vvana_CN_025.voiceText: Why obsess over rhymes? Poetry is woven with the thread of ideas.

char_4098_vvana_CN_027.voiceText: Alas, but tying your legs together won't make you fly.

char_4098_vvana_CN_028.voiceText: Let time rest upon this unlit night.

char_4098_vvana_CN_029.voiceText: Tired already, Doktor? Me too. The last time I had such an unforgettable bout was that match I fought in Kawalerielki.

char_4098_vvana_CN_030.voiceText: Doktor, you're right. Words that shake one's soul always come from within the storm.

char_4098_vvana_CN_031.voiceText: Even the most uninspiring poetry may contain a few lines that tug at our hearts. Despite the regrettable techniques employed, I can't help but approve of the writer's expression.

char_4098_vvana_CN_032.voiceText: Doktor, accept this temporary lapse in creativity and remember how this moment feels. I'm still looking forward to the completion of this sonnet.

char_4098_vvana_CN_033.voiceText: No bathtub...? Never mind. Just a little joke.

char_4098_vvana_CN_034.voiceText: Hmm, who is there? Whatever. I already knew it was you.

char_4098_vvana_CN_036.voiceText: Doktor, if the candle goes out, I can't say for sure what might happen next.

char_4098_vvana_CN_042.voiceText: Hmm, Doktor, what are you muttering there? I won't force you to recite any poems. But you have read them, have you not?

char_245_cello_CN_001.voiceText: What kind of ambience do you prefer when you're working? Of course, my music can't directly alleviate the busy state you're in, but I'd feel terrible if it couldn't make you more comfortable…  or content.

char_245_cello_CN_002.voiceText: This next concert is for Amiya. I really am curious... what would she see in me if I were allowed to touch her emotions? Oh, that look on your face... are you worried? Then, why not come along... and confine me to your side?

char_245_cello_CN_003.voiceText: 'Music is the order you dig out of chaos.' That's what my Leithanian teachers taught me, but they've all since died in silence or lunacy. If it were me... I would tell my students, 'Music is a flowing will, a language of self-expression.'

char_245_cello_CN_004.voiceText: I can tell your fingers are still stiff. It seems you're not yet used to learning this way. Don't be nervous, I'll guide you... Oh? What's the matter, Fede? Are you going to greet me with a mine or an electric fence this time? If you'd like a music lesson, the Doctor and I will oblige.

char_245_cello_CN_005.voiceText: I'll never stop performing, even if you, Doctor, are the one who asks me. Trauma is one thing, but freedom is another. My life is the same as the others, it will simply come to an end if I stop in my tracks.

char_245_cello_CN_006.voiceText: No matter how powerful one's spirit may be, there is no way to vanquish the inevitability of death. If there is meaning in life, if there is really something out there that can fight against chaos and nothingness... it has to be every emotion that I'm feeling right here and now, and the melodies they'll turn into.

char_245_cello_CN_007.voiceText: I'm watching... the clouds. Water accumulates above and in excess before turning to rain. Mother made just as natural a choice when she decided to leave. But father still refuses to accept it, even now. What about you, Doctor? Will you also refuse to listen to the truest self... that lies within you?

char_245_cello_CN_008.voiceText: Working with you is actually quite dull to me. Yes, because I don't want to, and can't play your music. So I've curbed my expectations of you, for I fear that when this emotion bursts in resonance along with my strings, you will turn to a grotesque collection of variegated fragments in my arms.

char_245_cello_CN_009.voiceText: Let me be your personal musician. Let me... feel my way around your mind. How elaborate are your ideas, and how terrifying is your rising willpower? I will of course be captivated by your music when it blooms into its ultimate form; and at that moment, what I will perform for you... shall be myself.

char_245_cello_CN_010.voiceText: Rest well… I don't need to mix any 'illusion' into this lullaby. Your dreams... are already colorful enough.

char_245_cello_CN_011.voiceText: I should have introduced myself by playing some music for you. Unfortunately, I've been forbidden from doing so for the moment. Let's start with a codename, then. You may call me... 'Virtuosa.'

char_245_cello_CN_012.voiceText: I've no interest in these means of inflicting harm. Do you mind if I wander about for a bit?

char_245_cello_CN_013.voiceText: You've come to understand me more and more, even without the sound of an instrument to connect us. And yet... just how am I supposed to share this joy in my heart with you?

char_245_cello_CN_014.voiceText: Whenever I touch the strings, the surrounding emotions all flow into me, through my fingertips, surging up into the sky and down into the ground. Did you hear it too? The cry of life in its truest form... How astonishing, how beautiful.

char_245_cello_CN_017.voiceText: What audience have you picked for me today?

char_245_cello_CN_018.voiceText: I don't often play with accompaniment, but I can try to match the others' voices.

char_245_cello_CN_019.voiceText: Notes fall into memory, and a melody resonates in the mind.

char_245_cello_CN_020.voiceText: What tones are your souls in?

char_245_cello_CN_021.voiceText: The concert may begin at any time.

char_245_cello_CN_022.voiceText: What would you like to hear?

char_245_cello_CN_027.voiceText: Liberty and sunlight all around us.

char_245_cello_CN_028.voiceText: Feel your own self, to your heart's content.

char_245_cello_CN_029.voiceText: War itself is unworthy of a performance. But I will listen to every voice on the battlefield, from hero to refugee.

char_245_cello_CN_030.voiceText: Over already? Your victory doesn't need to be embellished by my music. I'd much rather... perform for you a piece inspired by that cloud passing overhead.

char_245_cello_CN_031.voiceText: Guilt, doubt, fear... this surge of emotion rising from the battlefield will follow them, accompanying them to their graves.

char_245_cello_CN_032.voiceText: The performance ends, and the audience scatters. After such a conclusion, how long can the strings continue to vibrate?

char_245_cello_CN_033.voiceText: What a beautiful sunset. It would be even more romantic if there were music swirling around the deck.

char_245_cello_CN_034.voiceText: These strings are vibrating... for you.

char_245_cello_CN_036.voiceText: Hmm? Have I been lurking in this corner for a long while? There's a tune lingering in my head, and I refuse to go to sleep before I can express it.

char_245_cello_CN_042.voiceText: Sometimes, I too prefer to avoid the crowd, far away from all the sounds, just to feel my own self... and to feel you as well.

char_194_leto_CN_001.voiceText: Make you a deal, Doctor. I'll help you with work, and you teach me whatever it is you're good at. What do you think? Shake on it?

char_194_leto_CN_002.voiceText: Doctor, you know this language, don't you? How do you pronounce this word…? Ooh, that's right! I remember now. I knew I could count on you, Doctor. Just wait till I get back from my trip, I'll have a souvenir for you!

char_194_leto_CN_003.voiceText: Heh! Hah—! Get up, all of you! Weren't you going to fight the USSG? Now look at you all, lying on the ground already! Bunch of babies. You don't see my girls much on the landship these days, but there was a time when we followed the Doctor around, conquering the world... Yow! Anna...? Why'd you hit me?

char_194_leto_CN_004.voiceText: Honey drunk? Who's honey drunk? Beehunter? I told her to slow down already, but she won't listen. And now she'sh all drunk and shays I'm the one getting... Wait... Doctor... Shtand shtill, shtop... shaking... yer making me dizzshy...

char_194_leto_CN_005.voiceText: What are Sonya and the girls going to do? You're asking the wrong one, Doctor. We're friends, yeah. But aside from Lada, the rest of them don't really talk to me about that kinda stuff. Especially Sonya—she'll go to Anna when she needs something, maybe Natalya, but she'd never come to me.

char_194_leto_CN_006.voiceText: Lada had a secret talk with me recently. Said she wants to open a little shop in Ursus, and we could all chip in and get our share. As for the shop, it'll be our headquarter. All the girls can have regular meetups there. And I can go over to hang out whenever I miss her, too. It's gonna be great!

char_194_leto_CN_007.voiceText: Has you-know-who been to Rhodes Island? Oh, so he spent a whole day sitting in the reception before you shooed him out...? Thanks for that. It's fine, I've got nothing to say to him anyway. Hmph, he wasn't there when I needed him, and now he feels bad enough to try to make up for it? Keep Dreaming!

char_194_leto_CN_008.voiceText: What do I think? Ummm... first of all, you should stop treating us like kids. Come on, Doctor, you don't need to worry about us so much. If you have time, why don't you teach me a few more formulas for Anna's Math lessons? We've counted you as a friend all this time, so if there's really something bugging us, you'll definitely know.

char_194_leto_CN_009.voiceText: I know we'll have to go our separate ways someday. But so what? We trust each other with our lives. The USSG won't fall apart, and we'll never forget the days we spent together. The same goes for you, Doctor. Call me anytime you need my help, and I'll be there, no matter what.

char_194_leto_CN_010.voiceText: Doctor, let me play you a refreshing tune on my guitar!

char_194_leto_CN_011.voiceText: Hey, Doctor. You already know me, do we really still have to do this? Formalities matter, huh? Fine. Leto of the Ursus Student Self-government Group. Reporting in!

char_194_leto_CN_013.voiceText: Sooooo…. How long did it take for Sonya to get promoted?

char_194_leto_CN_014.voiceText: What's this? Promotion gift for 'General Leto'? Ah... That's a name I've not heard in a long time. Time really flies, it's like years have gone by and I've done nothing.

char_194_leto_CN_018.voiceText: For real? Are you trying to improve my teamwork again?

char_194_leto_CN_025.voiceText: You thought that would knock me out?

char_194_leto_CN_027.voiceText: Here's a few bolts to eat!

char_194_leto_CN_028.voiceText: I'll take on all of you!

char_194_leto_CN_029.voiceText: Phew—I always thought I was pretty adventurous myself, but now? I think you really enjoy living life on the edge, Doctor.

char_194_leto_CN_030.voiceText: We have to toast to occasions like these. Who wants in?

char_194_leto_CN_031.voiceText: This isn't over! I can still fight!

char_194_leto_CN_032.voiceText: No way I'm gonna swallow this... Can we go one more round?

char_194_leto_CN_033.voiceText: I've been here a while, but I still gotta say... Rhodes Island is crazy big.

char_194_leto_CN_036.voiceText: Doctor, are you heading to Medical too? Let's go together!

char_4114_harold_CN_001.voiceText: Induct yourself an adjutant, one you can trust, and secretarial busywork will never hound you again. Between ourselves, that's an industry secret. Steady, Doctor, I would be loath to suggest you induct me...!

char_4114_harold_CN_002.voiceText: Hip-hip to Rhodes Island's young generation. They can fight and they can imbibe, my goodness. But youth's folly is ignorance, you see: they don't know all's fair in love and war, they never caught me diluting my drink! Bah-hah-hah-hah-, my head... Doctor, if you'd hurry. Fetch me a sobering physic.

char_4114_harold_CN_003.voiceText: Hah, what talent General Hellagur's girl possesses! I'd gladly have the youths here make a friend of her sometime. All the while my daughter plays the contrarian, but she at least heeds her father's wise words. Hm? To speak of which, Doctor, that letter you're holding... Excuse me? Incorrect address? Returned to sender?

char_4114_harold_CN_004.voiceText: Good girl, no fear, just a little more... Doctor! Yes, like that, stroke the girl on the neck there, softly, gently, let her know you're there for her, you love her... well done, girl, now push! I see the child coming! It's a stupendous little burdenbeast lad!

char_4114_harold_CN_005.voiceText: Will! Charles! Funny business, they've vanished. What? They're off playing drinking games again? They had the nerve not to invite me...?! So be it, let them drink. All the years they've been company to me, the old fellows, and what have they gained? A riddling of scars and chronic pains, too pernicious for me to cure. How can I blame them, now they've so little but tipple for pastime.

char_4114_harold_CN_006.voiceText: War stories? No, no, no, a richness of topics I could be your partner in. Why one of such sensitive dearth? I've said my piece on it—the battlefield lingers in your Sunday lapel like a bad odor, and never comes clean even should you change your suit. No, what say we talk of something else, Doctor?

char_4114_harold_CN_007.voiceText: I've partaken of fine foods across the land, but in my lowly opinion, only in the bosom of hometown, amidst the throng of locals, can you taste the most essential delicacy. This fondue tells such a tale. You'd like a travel guide from me? Hah-hah, very well, as you wish. To be asked for a work so dear to my passions is my honor.

char_4114_harold_CN_008.voiceText: You have a most vorpal gaze to recognize this pipe's Gaulish make. It was seized by my father's commander in the Battle of the Four Emperors, a spoil accorded to my father, then—bless his resting soul—it was handed down to me. Some decades it's spent crossing the fields of war. You'll even note the lost segment along the shank, much as I've lost a leg.

char_4114_harold_CN_009.voiceText: Hush, Doctor. We shouldn't forget that I'm an officer to Victoria when all is said and done. Befriend me you may, and depend on me, but never should you drop your guard, nor tell me too much. Should the worst come to pass, it would spell the end of our continued association... and with my age, I'd fold under the regret.

char_4114_harold_CN_010.voiceText: Don't watch your health now, and you'll certainly curse yourself when you're old.

char_4114_harold_CN_011.voiceText: Here I thought they'd finally given me hard labor on the borders, and yet... I wonder if the Empire's deigning to smile on me? Oh, where are my manners? You, then, should be my commanding officer from hereon? I render you my services as a plain medical officer.

char_4114_harold_CN_012.voiceText: Combat that would emphasize the individual's strengths... What revelation.

char_4114_harold_CN_013.voiceText: Could it be? Is this in recognition of my surgeon's abilities? This means far more to me than a higher title ever could.

char_4114_harold_CN_014.voiceText: I feel I could return home and open a practice right this instant. In fact, I plan to be off on the morrow. Hoh-hoh, yes, I'm pulling your leg. I tell you, I could have found no greater place than here to retire.

char_4114_harold_CN_017.voiceText: Me? Surely I'm not about to be an accomplice in your sunbathing schemes?

char_4114_harold_CN_018.voiceText: Attention, good fellows. Your only obliged consideration is how you survive. Agreed?

char_4114_harold_CN_019.voiceText: Good fellows, let us think of happier things. If I may: how about something nice to eat after this operation?

char_4114_harold_CN_020.voiceText: Be a little courteous to our guests, boys and girls.

char_4114_harold_CN_022.voiceText: I trust your plans are drawn.

char_4114_harold_CN_024.voiceText: What fine scenery. A shame about the fighting.

char_4114_harold_CN_026.voiceText: No soldier may cower in the field!

char_4114_harold_CN_027.voiceText: All casualties, retreat! All others, cover!

char_4114_harold_CN_028.voiceText: I say this once, protect your own lives first! I'll bear the onus!

char_4114_harold_CN_029.voiceText: Outstanding peace talks! As I always say—bloodshed can spoil anything. Best we remain amicable.

char_4114_harold_CN_030.voiceText: I see I'm deprived of a chance to practice my surgery! A marvelous regret to have.

char_4114_harold_CN_031.voiceText: You say I've 'held back', do you? Hah-hah-hah, piffle! Don't you worry.

char_4114_harold_CN_032.voiceText: To admit our own defeat is a form of virtue.

char_4114_harold_CN_033.voiceText: Mm-hrmm. Doctor, your tastes are... comparatively maverick.

char_4114_harold_CN_034.voiceText: Oh? Are you angling to swipe my cane?

char_4114_harold_CN_036.voiceText: Oh, Doctor! Would you care to take a stroll with me?

char_4114_harold_CN_042.voiceText: Tally-ho, Doctor. Your presence suggests today will be a fine day indeed.

char_4116_blkkgt_CN_001.voiceText: There are some matters I could help you with. But make no mistake, I am not a go-between for you and Enciodes.

char_4116_blkkgt_CN_002.voiceText: I once ran into the Saintess at the foot of the mountain, where she stuffed a book into my hands. She told me that, if I'm bored, I might as well try copying some scripture. I heeded her suggestion and copied a passage every day. At first, I did it just to pass the time, but then I realized it helps me to relax a little too. I find it intriguing.

char_4116_blkkgt_CN_003.voiceText: Leithanien, Kazimierz, Kjerag. Three decades, more or less. The days I spent in Kjerag were the most dull. No opponents, no challenges, no excitement... But before I knew it, I had become accustomed to the bleats of burdenbeasts, the sensation of shoes sinking into the snow, and the weight of a little sobering medicine on me.

char_4116_blkkgt_CN_004.voiceText: The first time I became champion was to prove myself. The second time was to hone myself. And the third was a wake up call I made to those who thought they could control me. The price I paid for it? Just a few Darksteel arrows. Hmph, a pity I didn't get an actual match.

char_4116_blkkgt_CN_005.voiceText: I saw the Radiant Knight. No, there's no point in fighting here, so you need not arrange one for me. A proper fight needs her at her peak, at the right time, in the right place, and situation. Victory then will be a matter of life and death. Though, how or when that moment will come won't be up to me at all.

char_4116_blkkgt_CN_006.voiceText: Enciodes treats me like a sword—a sword intended to reflect more than kill, a blade serving as a mirror with which to scrutinize himself. The stronger I get, the more he exercises restraint. Such a relationship will continue until the day... he no longer needs a sword.

char_4116_blkkgt_CN_007.voiceText: I went back to Leithanien once, after becoming champion. From 'a defective Leithanian unable to use Arts', to 'a natural-born warrior', only to still find myself unwelcome. The locals looked at me the same as they did decades earlier. Coming to terms with that, I found my hatred for the land had cooled some.

char_4116_blkkgt_CN_008.voiceText: A few years ago in Kjerag, I was dining at a local restaurant I frequented where some foreign tourists tried to pick a fight with me. Before I could get a word in, the shop owner grabbed me by the arm and shouted to them, 'What are you punks doing?! Get away from our Kjerag lady!' I'll never forget that.

char_4116_blkkgt_CN_009.voiceText: There are many who rely on you and Enciodes to provide them a meaningful way of life, and you relish it just as he does. But for me, I've just met another patron who engages in self-neglect. Right then, the meeting's about to begin. Drink this glass of water to refresh yourself. And hold still, your collar's wrinkled.

char_4116_blkkgt_CN_010.voiceText: Sleep. No one will bother you.

char_4116_blkkgt_CN_011.voiceText: Degenbrecher. A codename? You can just use that. I looked through the contract, and the scope of my work seems unchanged. I am still a bodyguard, just the employer is different.

char_4116_blkkgt_CN_013.voiceText: Formalities like these remind me of the time when Karlan Trade was first established. Gnosis was so full of himself as he declared my position to the others. It was then that I decided to wait for a chance... to smash that cocky face of his to the ground.

char_4116_blkkgt_CN_014.voiceText: When I pinned the medals on my soldiers, the first cohort of Tschäggättä to complete my training, I saw some pretty fine expressions on them. I can see this ship has many with similar faces.

char_4116_blkkgt_CN_017.voiceText: Is this a mission, or a training session?

char_4116_blkkgt_CN_018.voiceText: Follow me close, no dinner for those who fall behind.

char_4116_blkkgt_CN_019.voiceText: Good, I suppose you've already got a plan.

char_4116_blkkgt_CN_020.voiceText: Keep your distance, or you risk getting caught up in the fighting.

char_4116_blkkgt_CN_021.voiceText: Still mulling things over, Dr. Perfectionist?

char_4116_blkkgt_CN_023.voiceText: How soon do you want them gone?

char_4116_blkkgt_CN_024.voiceText: You can go do something else.

char_4116_blkkgt_CN_026.voiceText: Conviction will throw you off pace.

char_4116_blkkgt_CN_027.voiceText: Still soaking yourself in the past?

char_4116_blkkgt_CN_028.voiceText: Use your weapon to tell me who you are.

char_4116_blkkgt_CN_029.voiceText: Whenever there's an avalanche in Kjerag, I always free my schedule to test my skills there. It's a rare form of recreation for me. Apparently, Rhodes Island won't be dull in that respect, at the very least.

char_4116_blkkgt_CN_030.voiceText: Your face just now... it seems the expression 'fowls of a feather flock together' is indeed true.

char_4116_blkkgt_CN_031.voiceText: I let a few get away, as you bid me. What next?

char_4116_blkkgt_CN_032.voiceText: Hold my hand tight, and your breath with it. What comes next might be a little disorienting, but press on.

char_4116_blkkgt_CN_033.voiceText: We have to use codenames here? That's obnoxious.

char_4116_blkkgt_CN_034.voiceText: You'll need to try a little harder if you want to pick up my degenbrecher.

char_4116_blkkgt_CN_036.voiceText: Here. You left this file in the meeting room. It's fine, I'm used to doing this.

char_4116_blkkgt_CN_042.voiceText: Doctor, you know how busy your schedule is today, yes?

char_4081_warmy_CN_001.voiceText: Coming, coming! Warmy coming in with warmth! Huh...? Sheesh, Doctor! No calling me a little potlid like Lanns!

char_4081_warmy_CN_002.voiceText: Doctor, do you smell that? Hehe, it's the smell of my sweet pear and vegetables soup, slow cooked to perfection! I said it before, I'm gonna cook the best meals to cure everyone's Oripathy! Huff, huff—It's not so hot anymore. Give it a try, won'tcha? If you don't, everyone else will eat it right up!

char_4081_warmy_CN_003.voiceText: Rhodes Island is such a big, biiiig transport, and it has a kinda different furnace than the one at the factory... Oh, I just went to the engine level. The boiler man there thought I was lost and took me back up. I was fine down there, though. I'm used to the heat.

char_4081_warmy_CN_004.voiceText: Come, Doctor. Hurry up and eat. No need to worry about me. It cheers me right up to see people enjoying their food. Aw, you still want to share with me? Okay, I'll clean this plate! Om nom nom... Wha? You were just picking out things you don't want to eat? Well alright then.

char_4081_warmy_CN_005.voiceText: I made this bracelet from bottle tree leaves. I can keep them fresh for a short while. Hehe, didn't think my Arts could be used like this, did you? Oh, Don't worry, it'll only be for a short while. I won't keep it going for too long, or they'll get tired, too. We should let them be. The withering will come slowly.

char_4081_warmy_CN_006.voiceText: Dad liked to collect the carrots we had left to carve into small animals. Doctor, do you think Ray will like this carrot sandbeast? Ah! I think I carved a little too deep. I'm still not very good at this, not like Dad. If only he'd taught me a bit longer...

char_4081_warmy_CN_007.voiceText: Doctor, look! The lady at Medical gave me a plaster with pears on it! Rhodes Island has so many Infected. It's the same back home, but we didn't live so well. And I had nowhere to go... Doctor, Is it a bad thing to be an Infected?

char_4081_warmy_CN_008.voiceText: Deep in the pitch darkness, those warm breaths slowly got colder...' That's how Ray told her sandbeast stories. I've heard the workers saying stuff like that ever since the accident. They were kind of hard to understand at first, but I know what they mean now.

char_4081_warmy_CN_009.voiceText: Yeah, it hurts a lot when my Oripathy flares up. And I'm worried I could go out of control, too. Huff... Hufffff... Doctor, want to try a bite of stewed pear? It doesn't cure Oripathy, but it's sweet. When life's all hard and bitter, we need something sweet! Hehe, does it taste good? Alright, I'll take this to Lanns now.

char_4081_warmy_CN_010.voiceText: Doctor? Are you feeling warmer? Have a good sleep now. I'm right here.

char_4081_warmy_CN_011.voiceText: Nice to see you again, Doctor. Do you miss Billy stew? I was just heading to the aft kitchen with Lanns— Hey! I'm not a little potlid. Don't call me Potlid!

char_4081_warmy_CN_012.voiceText: Whoa... Did you command all these battles, Doctor? You're amazing…

char_4081_warmy_CN_013.voiceText: I-I got promoted? Does that mean I can ask Closure to buy some more authentic ingredients?

char_4081_warmy_CN_014.voiceText: Thanks for your recognition, Doctor! I'll do what I can to bring even more warmth to the people! Um... Actually, what I mean is... I'm glad I can help out!

char_4081_warmy_CN_018.voiceText: Huh? I'm the head chef today?

char_4081_warmy_CN_020.voiceText: They're not part of a good breakfast!

char_4081_warmy_CN_024.voiceText: This place feels a little too cool…

char_4081_warmy_CN_029.voiceText: Everyone did such a great job... I'll make a big stew to reward them!

char_4081_warmy_CN_030.voiceText: Hm—Smells so good. Today was another huge success!

char_4081_warmy_CN_031.voiceText: We spilled a lot out of the pot. What a shame...

char_4081_warmy_CN_032.voiceText: I wasn't paying attention, it's all burnt...

char_4081_warmy_CN_033.voiceText: This room's so warm… Hm? You can adjust the temperature with this panel?

char_4081_warmy_CN_036.voiceText: I'm not— Okay, if it's what you want to call me, Doctor, then no worries. I am a little potlid.

char_4081_warmy_CN_042.voiceText: Doctor, are you eating good today?

char_4117_ray_CN_001.voiceText: This animal almanac's a beauty. Right, from the bookshelves. I've washed my hands, so the pages'll be fine... Yeah, this is your office. Something wrong?

char_4117_ray_CN_002.voiceText: I hear explosions. One min, I'll head down to check. Exhaust fans sound normal, then next is... No, right. Forgot I'm riding with Rhodes Island now. You don't get Originium slugs in the pipes here. Um... Must be Engineering running weapon tests. Sorry about that, breaking your door down.

char_4117_ray_CN_003.voiceText: You can tell how the air's doing from a sandbeast's back, so that's why you see pitsinkers bring one down. If there's poison and it keels over... you buy a new one. But this one wasn't from the shop. I don't even own it, so I don't keep it on a leash.

char_4117_ray_CN_004.voiceText: Tales of the supernatural, these tapes said. Didn't really like watching them, but I do feel... Chills, from these? No. It's hot in the dark. The deeper down the pit, the hotter, harder to breathe. Always took yonks for the lift to bring us back up. I'd just stare at the lights in the ceiling, waiting.

char_4117_ray_CN_005.voiceText: Got shooed out of the workshop by Lanns. She wasn't pissed though, just hauled me along to a doctor, then had me on Potlid-watching duty. And watching I love my own body more... That day she asked me what life was like catching Oripathy. But all that came to mind was being down in the pit, staring at the Infected creatures and thinking, 'we're more alike now.'

char_4117_ray_CN_006.voiceText: Proactive? Is this about me applying to rescue Infected...? Remember when you had me treat my wounds? So I have my cotton wads, and they're getting covered in bloodstains, and dust, and Originium shards, and sandbeast fur, and it struck me then: the pit's behind me, a million miles behind, and it's like I'm still being stabbed. Do you think I'm... still carrying the fear?

char_4117_ray_CN_007.voiceText: Ninety-seven, ninety-eight... Oh, first time seeing you at the training grounds. You always train at four in the morning too? That's not it? An op said I scared them target practicing here all night...?  But the light went kaput in my accommodation. I wanted to be somewhere lit-up.

char_4117_ray_CN_008.voiceText: I think Amiya's being nice to me. Hiding something and she won't tell me what. But it does occur to me, you know. The giant shadow I saw in a sandstorm as a kid. I might've mistook it. But it's always occurred to me... Doctor, give her these carrot pies for me, would you? She's always so busy and all, I want to be nice back, and care for her.

char_4117_ray_CN_009.voiceText: I've given it some thought. Hijacking Rhodes Island sounds unideal, but dragging you off might leave the whole ship out of order... Hm? Oh, it's just there's some great tales in your database. A few I wanna see with my own eyes, and it'd be nice if you come with. That's the new goal I found. What's wrong?

char_4117_ray_CN_010.voiceText: No scratching, you'll wake the Doctor. C'mon, let's go walkies on the deck.

char_4117_ray_CN_011.voiceText: I passed the Operator tests, Doctor, so thanks for all of you inviting me. That whole chase is over with, but I'm thinking I'll find my new goal on this ship.

char_4117_ray_CN_012.voiceText: That's not danger I can cope with yet.

char_4117_ray_CN_013.voiceText: You know, they wanted to certify me for my professional skills before. Gloompincer made off with the paper that time. Lost to the mineshaft depths... Anyway, there's a few extra things I can do. What's this ship need?

char_4117_ray_CN_014.voiceText: If that tiny patch of sky opened wide... wouldn't people want to chase the sun and the moons?

char_4117_ray_CN_017.voiceText: Here, Sandbeast, we need to get going.

char_4117_ray_CN_018.voiceText: I'll take the very front, as always.

char_4117_ray_CN_019.voiceText: Sound of muddy air, tracks of animal... I'll keep a watch that way.

char_4117_ray_CN_020.voiceText: Fine visibility. I can see more than just danger.

char_4117_ray_CN_023.voiceText: Yeah, you'll hear from me as needed.

char_4117_ray_CN_024.voiceText: You lot stay up there if it gets risky.

char_4117_ray_CN_025.voiceText: Threat at my position—yeah, not anymore soon.

char_4117_ray_CN_027.voiceText: And that's as far as you go.

char_4117_ray_CN_028.voiceText: I'm done rambling in the dark.

char_4117_ray_CN_029.voiceText: Sun's out. What a beauty… Sandbeast, let's get home.

char_4117_ray_CN_030.voiceText: This area's clear of danger for now. Doctor, you always been like this? Any problem, you'll solve it?

char_4117_ray_CN_031.voiceText: We'll have to expand the mine out... Hold the treatment for now. Got a lurking threat to handle.

char_4117_ray_CN_032.voiceText: You all leg it. Comms might cut out. If things get grim, I'll leave the most discernible signs I can.

char_4117_ray_CN_033.voiceText: Ship's sailing on sandstone… That's strange. Like I've heard it somewhere before?

char_4117_ray_CN_034.voiceText: Was I not meant to dodge that? Okay, I'll stay put. You tap me again.

char_4117_ray_CN_036.voiceText: Sandbeasts with arcing backs like this should be living in the desert... Wonder why this bugger came with me? Here, got you new food to try.

char_4117_ray_CN_042.voiceText: Weather's fine outside. No dust cloud, and not a Catastrophe billow in sight.

char_4121_zuole_CN_001.voiceText: When I first became a Candleholder, it took me three whole months to finish reading all the literature in the Sui Regulator's library. The paperwork you have piled up here... is no less impressive in size. I will have time to familiarize myself with my duties, right?

char_4121_zuole_CN_002.voiceText: Doctor? Let me join you for a walk... Oh, it's just Kroos and Mr. Nothing said they would take me around to introduce myself to all the operators on the landship. They've been very warm, much more so than when we first met... Wait, what? You're inspecting the entire ship today?

char_4121_zuole_CN_003.voiceText: My father forged these blades for me. 'Drive out the shadows of the Feranmut and all the people's troubles.' A Candleholder's work is not so simple that we can manage it with force alone... Um, of course, I've also been practicing my kung fu every day!

char_4121_zuole_CN_004.voiceText: Yes, I do know Lin Qingyan. We held different titles, serving the Sui Regulator and the Central Judicial Office respectively. I've had my doubts about Rhodes Island before I arrived, and my time spent here has only doubled those suspicions. That being said, I shan't pry into the matters that 'Operator Leizi' is investigating.

char_4121_zuole_CN_005.voiceText: That Operator just now... was that Lord Wei's niece? No, I don't know her, but when I was little, my father told me to learn from her example. Not long ago, we discovered that Miss Ch'en resigned her position with the Lungmen Guard Department. Father did not say anything to me that day. Thinking back, I indeed find her admirable.

char_4121_zuole_CN_006.voiceText: My father sent me to Dahuang in hopes that I would reflect upon my mistakes and improve as a man. Indeed, one should avoid deviating from the proper path. But perhaps my father's meaning runs deeper... Decades ago, he and the Grandmaster worked all night on a blade at the Sword Forge, making them late for work the following morning. Hmm... It may be that Father hates to see the flame in my heart snuff out.

char_4121_zuole_CN_007.voiceText: I'll keep an eye on the siblings, but I can't simply stand by and watch as Nian plays mahjong. Doctor, you've seen those exaggerated metal casts of hers. She conjures them as effortlessly as she blinks. Don't you think she's... just a little obnoxious? I can tell you're not playing dumb. That's the trickiest part.

char_4121_zuole_CN_008.voiceText: On-deck capture the flag is no doubt a competition of athletic ability. I was the first to climb onto the bridge, but the Vulpo lady riding her staff breezed past me to snatch the flag. That is blatant cheating, Doctor. How could you accuse me of being too competitive and unsportsmanlike?

char_4121_zuole_CN_009.voiceText: This is a handbook that all Candleholders keep on their person. I did record some observations about you, Doctor. I'm very sorry. But for what it's worth, I am now sure of one thing: You are the guiding post of this ship, and you are indeed ordinary. I will shred those pages, and I will ensure your safety.

char_4121_zuole_CN_010.voiceText: The Feranmuts breathe with this vast land, and the Candleholder walks into the long night.

char_4121_zuole_CN_011.voiceText: Doctor, I am Zuo Le. The number of proxies aboard Rhodes Island has almost exceeded that of those in Yan. The Sui Regulator should have sent someone here long ago. In fact, it has been some time since we sent you an official notice, but it would seem your company may have forgotten to reply?

char_4121_zuole_CN_012.voiceText: For a pharmaceutical company to have so competently recorded and analyzed battle records… This is nigh unimaginable.

char_4121_zuole_CN_013.voiceText: My sincerest apologies, in my capacity as the mandarin, I'm afraid I cannot accept any form of 'promotion' from Rhodes Island... Ahem, what I mean is... we will forgo the titles, but I can accept the other benefits.

char_4121_zuole_CN_014.voiceText: Each megastructure coursing through Catastrophes has a meaning unique to itself. Shangshu transferred its mountains and waterscapes to its nomadic cities, while Yumen fends off sandstorms with its Wind Aegis. And so, what of Rhodes Island? On what convictions do you sail?

char_4121_zuole_CN_017.voiceText: I hope my meager assistance will prove fruitful.

char_4121_zuole_CN_018.voiceText: To the right men, give the right jobs, enlist the talent, and forsake the snobs. I, Zuo Le, shall do my very best.

char_4121_zuole_CN_019.voiceText: The arrow has been nocked. Do not hesitate.

char_4121_zuole_CN_020.voiceText: The thrust of a blade takes no shape, take no comfort that it lies sheathed.

char_4121_zuole_CN_021.voiceText: From here on, your words are my command.

char_4121_zuole_CN_022.voiceText: The situation is complicated, I shall improvise and adapt.

char_4121_zuole_CN_023.voiceText: When chaos abounds, tugging a single thread can pull the entire net.

char_4121_zuole_CN_024.voiceText: Not even a stirring of grass will go overlooked.

char_4121_zuole_CN_025.voiceText: Go no further, this road is closed.

char_4121_zuole_CN_026.voiceText: Such violence will not be tolerated!

char_4121_zuole_CN_027.voiceText: All balance held by the orders of Yan. All beasts hunted by the sons of man!

char_4121_zuole_CN_028.voiceText: Tiny may a candle be, it shall drive out the darkest night!

char_4121_zuole_CN_029.voiceText: Seeking total victory in peril. You are truly of extraordinary talent and courage.

char_4121_zuole_CN_030.voiceText: A unit never takes the same formation, as water never takes the same shape. Such extraordinary planning and execution... Doctor, I cannot fathom your past.

char_4121_zuole_CN_031.voiceText: Man strives for perfection, yet flaws remain in every plan. Doctor, the deed is done. Let's not dwell on it further.

char_4121_zuole_CN_032.voiceText: The Sui Regulator has contingencies for all possible outcomes. Leave the cleanup to me. Don't worry, my qinggong is good. I'll catch up.

char_4121_zuole_CN_033.voiceText: I've lived in tents, and I've slept in fields. I'm not particularly demanding.

char_4121_zuole_CN_034.voiceText: You must have urgent need of assistance?

char_4121_zuole_CN_036.voiceText: Doctor, how about a game of weiqi? Or perhaps a capture-the-flag rematch?

char_4121_zuole_CN_042.voiceText: Good timing. You must have something to discuss with me. Yes and no?

char_4023_rfalcn_CN_001.voiceText: Here are the documents. If that's all, I'll be going... The stain on that sheet? Oh, that's, uh... I guess I did spill something when I was having a couple of drinks last night. Haha... Damn, I put it in the middle of the stack, how'd you catch it...?

char_4023_rfalcn_CN_002.voiceText: Do cultured folks like you even drink? Come, come, let's take a swig together, okay? Climb the hills in the dark, cross the desert in a storm. Now we gather in the oasis, drinking all the finest booze… Hehehe, oh, my friend, let's return to our homeland…

char_4023_rfalcn_CN_003.voiceText: Why are you all wrapped up like that on such a warm day? You'll be drenched in sweat. Hey you! Yes, you! Why don't you take off that jacket? A true warrior isn't afraid to show the results of hard training!

char_4023_rfalcn_CN_004.voiceText: Operator'? No, I'm a warrior of Rhodes Island. Don't worry, it's not because I can't let go of the past, but because I want to defend the present. I'll train new warriors for you... same as I was taken in and raised back on the sands.

char_4023_rfalcn_CN_005.voiceText: I once took in some war orphans. They begged me to teach them how to use a sword to get revenge. I agreed, and they succeeded, but at the cost of their lives… Many years ago, the chief taught me that the sword is only for protection.

char_4023_rfalcn_CN_006.voiceText: The war took the lives of everyone in my tribe. My friends blocked blows with their bodies, and the chief's blood dripped onto my head... Me and the other children set out on a path of revenge. I'm the only one left. No one and nothing else. Only me.

char_4023_rfalcn_CN_007.voiceText: The mark I'm drawing on your forearm? It's a 'bite mark'. Look, I have one too. The chief carved it into my skin herself. She said that those who have undergone the trial of blood and pain become the bravest warriors. The mark brings us strength.

char_4023_rfalcn_CN_008.voiceText: I've taken plenty of hits both in battle and in the mines, but not many left marks. I used to think I was lucky, but now I wish I wasn't. I want the scars to help me remember certain people and things. Death brings back nothing, you know. I have to stay alive, and carry them myself.

char_4023_rfalcn_CN_009.voiceText: Is it snowing on that peak...? Ohh... Guess what, Doctor? I had a dream last night about sleeping in the chief's arms when I was first taken in. She stroked my forehead gently, and her palm was like the sun-scorched sand, warm and rough. They've never seen the snow. Now I see it for them.

char_4023_rfalcn_CN_010.voiceText: It's a beautiful day out there. I had a good nap, and a good dream, for once.

char_4023_rfalcn_CN_011.voiceText: I choose to stand here, and so the land beneath my feet is my home.

char_4023_rfalcn_CN_012.voiceText: No need, I'll grab my weapon and shield and head to the training grounds.

char_4023_rfalcn_CN_013.voiceText: It's a warrior's duty, no need to thank me... Wha? blushing? Of course I'm not blushing. How could can you even tell I'm blushing through my tan?

char_4023_rfalcn_CN_014.voiceText: Thanks, Doctor... I'll take this medal back to my homeland. The spring there has dried up, but it will continue to bless me, and they will know that I'm still fighting.

char_4023_rfalcn_CN_017.voiceText: Love, friends, hearth. That's what a warrior lives for.

char_4023_rfalcn_CN_018.voiceText: Warriors! Your courage will bring glory.

char_4023_rfalcn_CN_019.voiceText: Don't eat too much before a battle, unless you want to throw it all up.

char_4023_rfalcn_CN_027.voiceText: The enemy will never see our backs!

char_4023_rfalcn_CN_028.voiceText: Raise your weapons and shields! Not one step back!

char_4023_rfalcn_CN_029.voiceText: This is the home that we defend. This is where they die.

char_4023_rfalcn_CN_030.voiceText: The invaders' swords cut their own throats. An end they deserve.

char_4023_rfalcn_CN_031.voiceText: Haha, it is an honor to die defending my home.

char_4023_rfalcn_CN_032.voiceText: My homeland, my friends, my love... they're all waiting for me.

char_4023_rfalcn_CN_033.voiceText: The heck? No alcohol here...? Huh? What's that in my mug? It's just some b… umm... bubbly barley juice.

char_4023_rfalcn_CN_036.voiceText: Hahaha! Oh, I hate being tickled…

char_4023_rfalcn_CN_042.voiceText: Yo, Doctor, you sure you don't need to sun a bit?

char_2025_shu_CN_001.voiceText: Doctor, all life requires both sunlight and water to grow. While this potted plant seems to have its needs met, I don't think you've had your ten cups of water yet today.

char_2025_shu_CN_002.voiceText: Who am 'I'? The answer lies only in all that I've seen. The same way seeds are inanimate, and yet they germinate after you put them in the ground. I too lodged myself in a seed once, to feel the growth of life. You wonder what it's like? Hehe, take a deep breath and you've more or less felt it.

char_2025_shu_CN_003.voiceText: I am no fin, and yet I can reason what one is thinking. You may say I've spent the whole day idling. But you are not me, so how can you tell I've not been swimming freely with the fins in the ever-flowing streams? Yes, I know you think this water jug is too small for fincatching, but who's to say I can't drop a line in?

char_2025_shu_CN_004.voiceText: My eldest brother Shuo guards the border all year round, while my eldest sister Ling sleeps her days away clutching a pot of wine. Without me worrying over the rest of us, we would've ceased to be 'siblings' long ago. Hmm? Of course it's my duty to look after them—I'm the sixth out of us twelve, making me a big sister to five.

char_2025_shu_CN_005.voiceText: Doctor, give me your hand. I'll read your palm. Hmm... Your heaven, earth, and human lines are really impressive. Your past is dim and vague. Your journey is fraught with peril. Your future is criss-crossed with conflict... I see, Doctor. You are an 'ordinary one' who 'stirs up a storm fighting for a good end.'

char_2025_shu_CN_006.voiceText: A pity? How so? Petals fall to the ground, so the soil may be nourished, allowing new flowers to bloom the following year. Rivers flow into the sea, but the water will condense into clouds, raining the drops back onto the mountains and streams. Even if this great land is to meet a snow-white end, the cycle continues. When spring comes, there will always be buds sprouting anew.

char_2025_shu_CN_007.voiceText: Grain Buds is teaching some children how to make string figures? Yes, it's a Yanese children's hobby. A millennium ago, my younger brother had just arrived in Dahuang, where he invented this pastime to entertain the lonely children. A string in his hands could turn into countless hours of fun... Ah... it's been a thousand years.

char_2025_shu_CN_008.voiceText: Doctor, there's a pond up ahead—Nian! I see you adding chili oil to Dusk's cup. The villagers tell of a huge fin—Dusk! Pouring ink into Nian's bowl is going too far. Oh, Doctor, would you like to go fincatch—Are you two still fighting?! ...Get over here, both of you.

char_2025_shu_CN_009.voiceText: Our lives vary in their spans, and in their spans only. Just as how this landship holds so many people on its decks, a fallen leaf floating in that puddle is a sufficient vessel to sustain an ant for its entire life. Our burdens only grow as we gather more, yet you and I are naught but a single millet grain in our respective realms.

char_2025_shu_CN_010.voiceText: In east sun lifts; in west moons fall. Spring cold foretells rain; summer chill, clear skies.

char_2025_shu_CN_011.voiceText: Nian should have already told you my name—'Shu'. With my eldest brother, eldest sister, and my two younger sisters here, I feel as if I've returned home… Intriguing. Has that boy from the Sui Regulator not caused you any trouble yet?

char_2025_shu_CN_012.voiceText: Sow no reason for retaliation—point your blades at one another, and strife will never end.

char_2025_shu_CN_013.voiceText: The people of Dahuang pray for a year of peace and harvest with this jade cong. The ceremonial artifact also serves as the source of the one I hold in my hand. Summon wind and rain? Hehe, of course I can. Want me to demonstrate?

char_2025_shu_CN_014.voiceText: The fertile fields stretch to the horizon, the fragrance of rice spreads from the golden ocean... Day after day, year after year, with constant work, it finally draws near.

char_2025_shu_CN_017.voiceText: A day of fine sun and gentle breeze. I hope everyone makes it home safe.

char_2025_shu_CN_019.voiceText: Reap not what's sown by malice.

char_2025_shu_CN_020.voiceText: When were the seeds of this tragedy planted?

char_2025_shu_CN_021.voiceText: I wasn't supposed to act, but…

char_2025_shu_CN_022.voiceText: If you're really incapable of settling this, then let me handle it.

char_2025_shu_CN_023.voiceText: Spring breeze, timely rain; now we sow the grain.

char_2025_shu_CN_024.voiceText: War'... A word I've not heard in a long, long time.

char_2025_shu_CN_025.voiceText: Clear skies for Qingming, rain clouds for Guyu.

char_2025_shu_CN_026.voiceText: Sow the mountains when summer leaves a white dew. Seed the plains when equinox paints russet hue.

char_2025_shu_CN_027.voiceText: Branch and bone bear weeds; mounds and ruins bloom fields.

char_2025_shu_CN_028.voiceText: I'll plant you into the soil to grow anew.

char_2025_shu_CN_029.voiceText: Seeds are now in the field—another season full of hope.

char_2025_shu_CN_030.voiceText: Good, good. I had no idea you were so clever and learned. I was going to ask you help me make maiyatang, but with such a good head on your shoulders, I'm feeling a little bad now.

char_2025_shu_CN_031.voiceText: Perfection is a tall order, just as our crops may suffer from inclement weather, Catastrophe, and pestilence. These problems may not be solved in ten thousand years. You tried your best, Doctor.

char_2025_shu_CN_032.voiceText: Fortune and misfortune are two sides of the same coin. What you have sown is not necessarily wicked, so why lose heart?

char_2025_shu_CN_033.voiceText: Now let's see... where's a good spot for my fincatching tools?

char_2025_shu_CN_034.voiceText: You want me to plant you in the soil too, Doctor?

char_2025_shu_CN_036.voiceText: Hm? You want to come fincatching with me?

char_2025_shu_CN_042.voiceText: Doctor, come over here for a bit. Let's see... Hmm, the crops cultivated in Jiangqi this year are indeed taller than a man.

char_4119_wanqin_CN_001.voiceText: I've arranged the incoming documents just the way you like them, and added a few labels for categorization. Feel free to use them to find what you need. If only my master was so organized... Oh, it's nothing, just an idle musing.

char_4119_wanqin_CN_002.voiceText: Wait, there's a bug on your collar. Don't worry, it's a green lacewing, a helpful sort. They hunt the pests that eat our crops. Look at the wings on this cute little guy, the color of jade. Really beautiful... My master always jokes that if I didn't become a farmer, I could've been an entomologist.

char_4119_wanqin_CN_003.voiceText: Low clouds bring rain, high clouds bring fair skies.' See that cloud down by the horizon? That's a cumulus... The proverbs may not always be right, but they do have reference value. Using that one, you predict that tomorrow will be clear, but with strong winds and lightning? You might be a Catastrophologist, but just how did you come to that conclusion?

char_4119_wanqin_CN_004.voiceText: I've read that 'Tianshi' means 'to be a role model for the generations to come, and to search for perpetual truth.' I used to think I could never live up to that, but after seeing some of my seniors befuddled from time to time... Maybe I've been overthinking it. There may be a saying more suitable for me: 'Focus on your search, and learn for the sake of the people'.

char_4119_wanqin_CN_005.voiceText: I once challenged myself to a fast, but I ended up fainting on the fourth day. Still, my master said this was not true hunger. I didn't know what it was like to go hungry for years on end, so I could not possibly understand. I hope there comes a time when no one has to know that feeling.

char_4119_wanqin_CN_006.voiceText: I've gotten tanned again, you say? No big deal, every farmer worth his salt ends up dark as a chestnut. So long as we accomplish our goal, so long as we see our  crops prosper in the contaminated soil, and the hard work of so many bears fruit, then it's all good. Me? I don't need to be there to see it. If the people keep walking the right path, that's enough for me.

char_4119_wanqin_CN_007.voiceText: Oh, did you need me for something? Just a second, I need to braid my hair again. When I was younger, I grew out this 'rice stalk braid' as a prayer for peace. Now I spend a lot of time managing it every day. Back then, Grain Buds always thought I was a girl thanks to this braid...

char_4119_wanqin_CN_008.voiceText: The crops grown in Dahuang have a much better texture and taste than others. If you get a chance, I'd love to show you about the city. You wonder if they could supply Rhodes Island with food? Um, that's a little... I-I'm afraid that you'll need to discuss that with the proper authorities. It's not up to me.

char_4119_wanqin_CN_009.voiceText: These seeds occasionally fall onto the ship. Oftentimes I gather them up and wait like this on the solid ground, closing my eyes and feeling which way the wind is blowing. There, once the breeze rises, I let them go, and those seeds find someplace to take root all on their own.

char_4119_wanqin_CN_011.voiceText: Why am I called 'Wanqing'? It's one of the breeds of rice that my master cultivated in Dahuang. Others include Fanglao #3, the waterlogging-resilient one, Zaoyou #8, the quick-ripening one, and Kangdong #11, the frost-resistant one... 'Wanqing' means wide, and it sounds the most like a proper name.

char_4119_wanqin_CN_012.voiceText: Everyone looks so well-mannered around here, it's hard to imagine that they're so fierce in battle...

char_4119_wanqin_CN_013.voiceText: The rating standards of the Tianshi Bureaus seem to stipulate that you can use evaluations from exchange visits in their assessments... Excuse me Doctor, is Rhodes Island able to provide an officially-stamped study visit certificate?

char_4119_wanqin_CN_014.voiceText: I've consulted with my master. As long as Rhodes Island agrees to sign a contract of cooperation with the Tianshi Bureaus, I'll get to offer my assistance as an advisor on experimental crop fields. We both do what we can for the sake of the many, and we'd be delighted to support your goals.

char_4119_wanqin_CN_017.voiceText: Initial environmental survey completed. Nothing abnormal. We're good to go.

char_4119_wanqin_CN_018.voiceText: I hope everyone takes my commands seriously. Let’s get this done right.

char_4119_wanqin_CN_019.voiceText: If we cross any farmland, watch where you step.

char_4119_wanqin_CN_020.voiceText: I'm a student of the Tianshi Bureaus. I won't hold you back.

char_4119_wanqin_CN_021.voiceText: Here! Er, I mean I'm in position.

char_4119_wanqin_CN_022.voiceText: Tell me what you require, and I will deliver.

char_4119_wanqin_CN_023.voiceText: I've finished construction of the refinement system. Deployment point confirmed.

char_4119_wanqin_CN_024.voiceText: We're in a complex environment. Don't go off on your own or you might get disoriented.

char_4119_wanqin_CN_025.voiceText: With the aid of the wind, we too can soar through the skies.

char_4119_wanqin_CN_026.voiceText: Watch your step, don't hurt the crops.

char_4119_wanqin_CN_027.voiceText: The landscape here is tricky. Only step where I step.

char_4119_wanqin_CN_028.voiceText: Until we can confirm that this area is safe, I will hold this position.

char_4119_wanqin_CN_029.voiceText: Ensuring the harvest isn't easy. I hope to pass on the torch of our ideals.

char_4119_wanqin_CN_030.voiceText: Just as the farms never rest, there will always be new growth from the ground, and there will always be those who wish to follow in our footsteps.

char_4119_wanqin_CN_031.voiceText: Let's try that one again. The tiniest oversight leads to different experimental outcomes, and you can't let an error cloud your conclusions.

char_4119_wanqin_CN_032.voiceText: Success is the fruit of a thousand failures. Experiments under the Tianshi Bureaus are the same. Don't be discouraged, Doctor.

char_4119_wanqin_CN_033.voiceText: Ever since I got here, there haven't been any leftovers? Of course. Waste not, want not.

char_4119_wanqin_CN_034.voiceText: Who—Ah, my braid hit you? I am truly sorry...

char_4119_wanqin_CN_036.voiceText: I reassemble my Tianshi apparatus while I wait for my experiments to finish. My record is twelve seconds. Would you like to try?

char_4119_wanqin_CN_042.voiceText: Doctor, I'm pretty sure I heard this cactus say 'I was already watered yesterday—'.

char_4122_grabds_CN_001.voiceText: I looked after the stockbeasts in Dahuang, so I'm looking after you here, of course. You'll have to listen to me, work hard, and rest on time. Let's see... It's rest time now. Let's head out and have some fun!

char_4122_grabds_CN_002.voiceText: Of course I know what the stockbeasts are saying. The beastlings in Dahuang always talk to me about things like what kind of snacks they want or who they like, and I sneak them a little help. This apple? A stockbeast asked for it, obviously. I'm just tasting it for them, making sure it's sweet enough.

char_4122_grabds_CN_003.voiceText: Zuo Le is Candlestick, the Record Keeper is Inkbrush, that blinged out guy is Megaphone, and you're Wisehead. I also know a Tall Shades and Smiley Sharpshooter! Oh, and Amiya is the best! We made a promise to come up with a better nickname for you together.

char_4122_grabds_CN_004.voiceText: Shu made me this fowlbeast whistle, and whenever I wanna tell the stockbeasts to go home, I give it a blow. Sometimes, when Dahuang feels empty, I sit down on the street corner to play it. People come and go, and my whistle's my goodbye and hello.

char_4122_grabds_CN_005.voiceText: Dahuang's operas are sung in different dialects. That commemorates the farmers who came to our rescue a few centuries ago. They were from all across Yan, farming here for generations. They're why Dahuang fields are so fertile and prosperous now. I'm really proud that I can play the accompaniment on my flute here every year!

char_4122_grabds_CN_006.voiceText: When I first stood on the terraces, I could only see the aqueducts, but after the farmlands were raised, I could see the edge of the city, and now that Shu brought me here, I can see the horizon from the top deck. Megaphone tells me that Baba and Mama will come back someday, but when, exactly?

char_4122_grabds_CN_007.voiceText: Could you draw a line over my head...? I'm not standing on my tiptoes! I'm not stretching my neck out, either! Are you done? Let's see. See? I told you I got taller! Maybe I'll be taller than Xiaohe next year! Let's see how tall you are. Minus your hood and shoes, you... come up to my shoulders!

char_4122_grabds_CN_008.voiceText: When I'm in a bad mood, I sometimes go to the embankment to play my flute. There's a woodcutter there who yelled at me every time, but he always quieted down as soon as I played this song. He even hummed along. That was the first time I saw him smile! Like I said, I'm really good at the flute.

char_4122_grabds_CN_009.voiceText: The farmers say that the stockbeasts live by following water and grass. Fowlbeasts fly freely in the sky, but they always eventually land in the fields. I know what that means now.  Everyone has a field to call their own. Rhodes Island is your field, and you are the fowlbeast that will come back to land, isn't that right?

char_4122_grabds_CN_010.voiceText: Hm... You fell asleep...? You really fell asleep...? Hehe, have this coat then. Have a good dream. I'm off to have some fun!

char_4122_grabds_CN_011.voiceText: Shu brought me here to hang! I think I wrote my name on a document she was supposed to sign...? She said it was fine, though. Now that I've signed it, I get to come here to hang out all the time!

char_4122_grabds_CN_012.voiceText: ...Wah! I'd never fall asleep in class, Laoshi...! Huh? It's you.

char_4122_grabds_CN_013.voiceText: I developed a way to train stockbeasts to identify foods based on their smell. The Tianshi Bureaus gave me a medal for it. It doesn't have a serial number, but it says how amazing I am! And now I have this one you gave me. I'm putting them next to each other.

char_4122_grabds_CN_014.voiceText: I got taller again, right? By the time I'm as tall as you, the people of Dahuang will definitely have cultivated the seeds they want. When that happens, I'll invite you to come sit with us in the fields. The rice flowers are gonna look even better then!

char_4122_grabds_CN_017.voiceText: Is it time to do pest control again? I'm the best at catching these nasty little things!

char_4122_grabds_CN_018.voiceText: Trust me. I know I can do it extra good.

char_4122_grabds_CN_019.voiceText: Listen up, get your boots on, and tread lightly!

char_4122_grabds_CN_021.voiceText: Qui-Qui-Quick! The pests are getting away.

char_4122_grabds_CN_022.voiceText: I saw them hiding in the bushes there!

char_4122_grabds_CN_024.voiceText: None of you are getting away this time!

char_4122_grabds_CN_026.voiceText: Come any closer, and I'll whap your heads with my flute!

char_4122_grabds_CN_028.voiceText: And don't ever come back to our fields!

char_4122_grabds_CN_029.voiceText: Come on, let's go! We need to hurry and tell Shu. She's going to be so happy with me.

char_4122_grabds_CN_030.voiceText: Next year, the year after, and the year after that... One day, the whole of Dahuang will live without fear of Catastrophes or pests, and we'll have stack our harvests as high as Heaven for Shennong.

char_4122_grabds_CN_031.voiceText: It's okay. We've been through Catastrophes much worse than this. This one's just a little setback. We'll work harder next season!

char_4122_grabds_CN_032.voiceText: We're in trouble... I'll go get the Tianshi to help us!

char_4122_grabds_CN_033.voiceText: I want to sneak out when the landship docks. Can you keep it from Shu?

char_4122_grabds_CN_034.voiceText: These buns aren't for you to grab!

char_4122_grabds_CN_036.voiceText: Have you learned to play the song I taught you?

char_4122_grabds_CN_042.voiceText: I have the basket ready. Should we head to the fields to catch mudfins together?

char_113_cqbw_epoque#7_CN_001.voiceText: Cook this, cook that, my turn to cook again… Oh, it's snowing.

char_113_cqbw_epoque#7_CN_002.voiceText: Hoederer, what's wrong? The book you wanted me to check out? How should I know? What's that pile of ash in the fire? That's... Oh, I 'mistook' the book for tinder a little while ago. Eh, it's fine. We're cooking dinner with knowledge tonight. It's gonna taste way better than usual, don'tcha think?

char_113_cqbw_epoque#7_CN_003.voiceText: How much ammo I got? I just used ten grenades, so I have fifteen left. And three mines spent yesterday, so six remaining... See, the numbers are correct. Hold it, I know what you're about to say. 'If only you applied that memory to study and read.' Seriously, Hoederer, you should've been a teacher.

char_113_cqbw_epoque#7_CN_004.voiceText: Check this potato, Ines got a head like so-Hmm... now that I think of it, you could probably squeeze a bomb into a potato. Maybe a good trick to play on some miserable dumbass. Hey, Hoederer, you want a potato?

char_113_cqbw_epoque#7_CN_005.voiceText: Hey Hoederer, I've been thinking. If the two of us went at that nasty Kal'tsit together, how do you figure our chances taking her out? I mean, you guys are always planning for all contingencies, so we gotta have a plan for that one too, right? Hah, now that's a funny look on your face.

char_113_cqbw_epoque#7_CN_006.voiceText: Hey Ines, maybe you should try to learn a thing or two from that {@nickname}. There's not a whole lot of people who could get away with using you as bait. I mean, you only figured it out halfway through. Me? One look at you and Hoederer's faces had my in stitches! Makes me wanna gift the Doctor a potato next time.

char_113_cqbw_epoque#7_CN_007.voiceText: My name... my name... Hey, Hoederer, you're always reading books, so why don't you come up with a name for me? Theresa said I should come up with a new one... Wait a second, what's with all those books? Pick a name myself?! Go to hell!

char_113_cqbw_epoque#7_CN_008.voiceText: 'Hoederer, if you've got a death wish, just say so.' 'Ines, trust me. My head's reserved for just you, okay?' That's how your lovers' spat went last time, Ines. I'm just giving you my best impression. What? You mad?

char_113_cqbw_epoque#7_CN_009.voiceText: As soon as I'm done cooking, Ines always makes me help put up the tent, then Hoederer always drags me somewhere for recon. After that, there's always some kind of strategy meeting... Huh? Hey, Hoederer. Nothing. I was just talking about how I'll come collect your corpses when the two of you drop dead.

char_113_cqbw_epoque#7_CN_010.voiceText: Haghhh... I'll get some sleep before my next mission...

char_113_cqbw_epoque#7_CN_011.voiceText: I know what it means to take up the weapons of the dead, naturally.

char_113_cqbw_epoque#7_CN_012.voiceText: Your acting's too lame. Let me spice things up a little.

char_113_cqbw_epoque#7_CN_013.voiceText: How many pieces of candy am I worth now? I actually kinda like that method of valuing people. You sure we shouldn't go with that?

char_113_cqbw_epoque#7_CN_014.voiceText: Theresa called me over and told everyone what an amazing fighter I am, but she didn't look happy at all. How can I make her happy...? What if I invited her over and cooked her a nice dinner?

char_113_cqbw_epoque#7_CN_017.voiceText: Who's the unlucky one this time?

char_113_cqbw_epoque#7_CN_018.voiceText: As long as I'm not on the same team as Ines.

char_113_cqbw_epoque#7_CN_019.voiceText: I'll blow up what I want. You guys do whatever you please.

char_113_cqbw_epoque#7_CN_020.voiceText: Let me plant some potatoes first.

char_113_cqbw_epoque#7_CN_021.voiceText: Yeah, yeah, coming. Don't rush me.

char_113_cqbw_epoque#7_CN_022.voiceText: The plan is to blow them all up, right?

char_113_cqbw_epoque#7_CN_023.voiceText: I'm in a good mood. Sucks to be you.

char_113_cqbw_epoque#7_CN_024.voiceText: I'm in a bad mood. Sucks to be you.

char_113_cqbw_epoque#7_CN_025.voiceText: I wouldn't move that foot, if I were you.

char_113_cqbw_epoque#7_CN_027.voiceText: Take a guess. Is this potato a bomb?

char_113_cqbw_epoque#7_CN_029.voiceText: Theresa always says the {@nickname} volunteers for these missions. Must be dying to die.

char_113_cqbw_epoque#7_CN_030.voiceText: Not a single one left. Babel oughta pay me extra for this.

char_113_cqbw_epoque#7_CN_031.voiceText: Hmm... If memory serves, I have some potatoes planted over where they're running.

char_113_cqbw_epoque#7_CN_032.voiceText: If only I brought a few more mines, things would've been different.

char_113_cqbw_epoque#7_CN_033.voiceText: How come this door still hasn't been fixed?

char_113_cqbw_epoque#7_CN_036.voiceText: Isn't that the bunny who always follows the Doctor around?

char_472_pasngr_epoque#17_CN_001.voiceText: What did you find in time, mysterious master of the black market? The past, Elliot. I have always been seeking the past. Perhaps I will find a home in the patterns of the cacti and quicksand, but neither you nor I know the answer of fate.

char_472_pasngr_epoque#17_CN_002.voiceText: I detest everything there. I have no choice but to leave Sargon, even if obeying the coin meant acquiescing to fate. But I am here, Sand Soldier. You can't escape what you are. Our destinies have already been written.

char_472_pasngr_epoque#17_CN_003.voiceText: Sargon leaves marks on you. To the employer, you are feeble as a fledging fowlbeast. I forgot how it feels to be put to the lash. Do you hate them? No. I know their end. I know it from your eyes. Fortunately, you do not seem to regret it.

char_472_pasngr_epoque#17_CN_004.voiceText: Your expression gives no answer. Did you not put it all to the torch? There is a plaza in the black market with a view of the sky. Do you remember what night reminds you of? I called it a cremation, but when the conspirators had their way and the flames raged, it was not the face of my teacher that that came to mind.

char_472_pasngr_epoque#17_CN_005.voiceText: Do you remember the first component of Thorne's Gift? The shoddy Arts Unit that was obtained by burying conscience in the sand and deceiving a guard who lost his son? And... Thorne's Gift? What will a teacher give to an evil mastermind, Passenger?

char_472_pasngr_epoque#17_CN_006.voiceText: Tell me. Has Oripathy changed our lives? Do you feel pain? How will the illness transform me? Have the schemers behind the scenes miscalculated? You are trembling, poor Elliot. Never mind the cause. Now, all I do is marvel at its beauty in the mirror.

char_472_pasngr_epoque#17_CN_007.voiceText: Business is best in the spring. Festivals adorn the summer. Autumn is the season to seek fortune away from Ibut. Winter belongs to war. These are the seasons of Sargon, seasons that you will come to hate... but the stars shine bright on summer nights in Ibut.

char_472_pasngr_epoque#17_CN_008.voiceText: Strange things, fabricated dreams are. What should I say to you, Doctor of the future? If I had met you earlier... no. The Doctor does not exist at any point between you and I. The Doctor belongs to my time, and may act as the Doctor wills. I have high hopes for the Doctor.

char_472_pasngr_epoque#17_CN_009.voiceText: A Vouivre, and the 'Doctor'. Are you begging for their pity? No, I simply want to learn about my future, or tell others about theirs. Eternal nothingness is worse than any illness... listen to me, Elliot. I feel a little tired.

char_472_pasngr_epoque#17_CN_010.voiceText: Sleep, my Elliot. Sleep and dream together with me. In our dreams, you will become me, and I will still be you.

char_472_pasngr_epoque#17_CN_011.voiceText: Have I flipped open the pages of destinies past? No, it is but a dream, a dream that you seek to avoid. My future.

char_472_pasngr_epoque#17_CN_012.voiceText: I see conspiracies... yes, Elliot. The conflicts, the greed. They are everywhere.

char_472_pasngr_epoque#17_CN_013.voiceText: Oripathy has robbed me of my future. I hope that Rhodes Island can make use of what I have left. No. Rhodes Island does not exist to indulge your desire for self-harm. It is not that they are too kind; it is that you are too harsh. This is Elliot Glover's conclusion.

char_472_pasngr_epoque#17_CN_014.voiceText: Will you see the Sargon of winter when you awaken? Will you sleep away in the eternal summer? Must I become you? Prophecy is fate in disguise. Sleep, Elliot. You built me, and I complete you, until the day the prophecies no longer foretell.

char_472_pasngr_epoque#17_CN_017.voiceText: Why do you not seek more companions? It is inefficient. You will understand. Many things will make you understand.

char_472_pasngr_epoque#17_CN_018.voiceText: Elliot would have asked me: How does an empty soul lead others with sincerity?

char_472_pasngr_epoque#17_CN_019.voiceText: I remember the feeling of carrying my injured teacher on my back. It was the feeling of war. But war is profitable.

char_472_pasngr_epoque#17_CN_020.voiceText: I fought for a single purpose. Let war be the past, then, if the purpose is lost.

char_472_pasngr_epoque#17_CN_022.voiceText: Do you remember the touch of quicksand?

char_472_pasngr_epoque#17_CN_023.voiceText: My war machine will fulfill your wishes.

char_472_pasngr_epoque#17_CN_025.voiceText: I remember how this equipment was born.

char_472_pasngr_epoque#17_CN_026.voiceText: What is there to be gained by fighting in the name of my teacher?

char_472_pasngr_epoque#17_CN_029.voiceText: There is no snow in the winter of the black market. Will I still see snow? Yes, but there will be nothing you recognize in that world of silvery white.

char_472_pasngr_epoque#17_CN_030.voiceText: Your machinations will catch up to everyone. Is this how you became the master of the black market? Yes, you will too, Elliot. I know that well. You will not let anyone escape.

char_472_pasngr_epoque#17_CN_031.voiceText: Did you see how the chastened fled? I saw them. I wonder if that was how those Columbians saw me.

char_472_pasngr_epoque#17_CN_032.voiceText: The days to permit mistakes are gone, never to return. We are fighting an enemy too powerful for us. Fate? No, ourselves.

char_472_pasngr_epoque#17_CN_033.voiceText: Do you find Rhodes Island comforting? It's more the caffeine.

char_472_pasngr_epoque#17_CN_036.voiceText: Treasure your memories, treasure a time when you still had emotions. I understand; at least, I still do.

char_472_pasngr_epoque#17_CN_042.voiceText: I dreamt of a future. Everything became nothing as the seasons changed. No sweet dreams, no nightmares... only the darkness remained. That is the answer of fate, Elliot. The darkness means nothing. It is Nothing itself.

char_003_kalts_boc#6_CN_001.voiceText: The Ark does not have the resources to maintain unnecessary, extended communications. But there will be no restrictions on transmissions between the two of us. Keep the channel open.
