char_003_kalts_boc#6_CN_002.voiceText: With the Originium held back by the curtains Rhodes Island has drawn, mankind was able to build the Ark and drag out its feeble existence. Yet the pressures of survival cannot suppress greed and desire. Every faction's leader yearns to become the administrator who holds all the keys. I understand that you pity them for their predicament, but you must decide based on your own judgment.

char_003_kalts_boc#6_CN_003.voiceText: Inactive Originium solidified and accumulated, while redundant information piled atop itself in layers, giving us a new home. Only because you were there by our side could we delay the awakening of the arrogant master of all creation. All those who survived rely on your aid. They are all very appreciative, and so am I.

char_003_kalts_boc#6_CN_004.voiceText: The people of today may still remember what trees looked like. That is why they can point to Originium clusters and call them an Originium Forest. But when we can no longer conceive of trees and woods, the word 'forest' will forever disappear from our languages. If things continue that way, 'these lands' will cease to exist as well.

char_003_kalts_boc#6_CN_005.voiceText: Originium soared through the skies and seized the twin moons, its clusters dispersing into the universe like spores, contacting and assimilating both the living and the dead— This is what is currently happening outside of Terra. Originium is swallowing everything into its body and incubating an all-encompassing chaos. But Terra can still be saved, and only because you remain by our side.

char_003_kalts_boc#6_CN_006.voiceText: Under the curtain weaver, symptoms of Oripathy have faded into history, yet mankind continues to voice its dissatisfaction. The old order did collapse, but the minds of man remain narrow. Amiya must still go hither and thither to unite them. While she is now an excellent leader, you are still the only one she can rely on.

char_003_kalts_boc#6_CN_007.voiceText: We can no longer draw meaningful lessons from past experiences. The answers to our questions come not from our collective pool of knowledge, but from innovation and imagination. As you are more proficient than I in those aspects, there is no need to seek my advice on every single matter. Your insights are more important than my opinion here.

char_003_kalts_boc#6_CN_008.voiceText: You already know how 'death' functions for me. So there's no need to worry about the damage I take. Instead, you should pay more attention to your own condition. The sarcophagus cannot heal the trauma wrought by extreme stress and exhaustion. If there is anything you would like to say, I will listen.

char_003_kalts_boc#6_CN_009.voiceText: I can hear the crystal clusters surging. The Originium tides will soon dissolve me... Don't give me that look. Take care of Amiya and the city. We can continue to work on those problems the next time we speak. Well, then... see you again, Doctor.

char_003_kalts_boc#6_CN_010.voiceText: Scanning... The atmospheric oxygen level is still decreasing... No, let the Doctor rest. I will check it out.

char_003_kalts_boc#6_CN_011.voiceText: The anti-Originium communication lines have been activated... Signal received. Come in, Babel. This is Kal'tsit, exploring the former Leithanien region as planned. No coagulation point found as of yet. What about you, Doctor? What's the situation there?

char_003_kalts_boc#6_CN_012.voiceText: Experiences from before the crystallization age are for reference only. Do not overly rely on them.

char_003_kalts_boc#6_CN_013.voiceText: Formalities are no longer necessary between you and I. You need only keep your promise to maintain the Ark's safe course.

char_003_kalts_boc#6_CN_014.voiceText: Mon3tr, these tattered lands will one day need you more than ever. Now, with your own voice, say hello to the Doctor.

char_003_kalts_boc#6_CN_017.voiceText: I will correct any flawed decisions that occur during exploration.

char_003_kalts_boc#6_CN_018.voiceText: Mark the area you need explored. I will arrange for the rest.

char_003_kalts_boc#6_CN_019.voiceText: All units, double check the status of your anti-Originium equipment.

char_003_kalts_boc#6_CN_020.voiceText: Stick to the plan. Do not throw your life away for nothing.

char_003_kalts_boc#6_CN_022.voiceText: I will synchronize the battlefield data.

char_003_kalts_boc#6_CN_025.voiceText: Never let your guard down before the enemy.

char_003_kalts_boc#6_CN_028.voiceText: On my mark, prepare to counterattack.

char_003_kalts_boc#6_CN_029.voiceText: How much time do we have left?  I see… I trust your judgment.

char_003_kalts_boc#6_CN_030.voiceText: All units, proceed according to plan. I will hand the report to the Doctor.

char_003_kalts_boc#6_CN_031.voiceText: You should be more careful. We can't afford even a single loss.

char_003_kalts_boc#6_CN_032.voiceText: All personnel, retreat to safe zone. Comm permits are transferred to you for now. I will sort out the situation before us.

char_003_kalts_boc#6_CN_034.voiceText: Seems you are still very fond of your little tricks.

char_003_kalts_boc#6_CN_036.voiceText: Have you ever imagined a future where only you remain?

char_003_kalts_boc#6_CN_042.voiceText: There is still much we can do, Doctor.

char_4064_mlynar_epoque#28_CN_002.voiceText: I've never guaranteed your survival for following me, Toland. If it was their lives that your hunters valued, they shouldn't have stepped onto the battlefield or had their recklessness take over them in the first place... Their deaths are not what you need to downplay for your mockery. You will always remember. As will I.

char_4064_mlynar_epoque#28_CN_003.voiceText: The rivalries in the halls of power never ceased, they've merely become a part of the opportunistic pursuit of profit. The only constant is the innocent being dragged into the cesspool. As vassals of a treasonous knight, your parents were forced to take you into their involuntary flight ere the fabricated incrimination could arrive... Czcibor, why? Why didn't you... flee even further?

char_4064_mlynar_epoque#28_CN_004.voiceText: Why are you still here? Our ideals have come to an end, and I witnessed their final moments... No, never mind. You wish to spar? Then pick up your spear. Entrust your future not to a failure, but to sacrifice, and the pain in your flesh. Come.

char_4064_mlynar_epoque#28_CN_005.voiceText: Father, you once told me that longswords are suitable only for valorous young knights. But the National Council's miscarriage of justice, the General Chamber of Commerce's rise to prominence—everything I've wanted to stop, my blade was useless to prevent. I couldn't remove your lesions, and with it by my side I watched as Schnitz left... I merely became accustomed to its prescence.

char_4064_mlynar_epoque#28_CN_006.voiceText: Golden plains, a field of wheat, the path of a nomadic city, and the wake of a Catastrophe. The manor's garden, the arena, and those who hand over their last coin along with their last harvest... Father, I've always tried to walk a righteous path.

char_4064_mlynar_epoque#28_CN_007.voiceText: Forget it, Schnitz. How am I to tutor Maria in your stead? I am no knight, and certainly no father. No one would call me 'gentle.' Besides... I never once imagined I would actually return to this place... Why, Schnitz? Why am I the one to remain?

char_4064_mlynar_epoque#28_CN_008.voiceText: Margaret doesn't speak to me, but considering how she was back then... we had no need to. She is just like you were at that age, Yolanta, too much so. She will experience the same things you did, and she will never regret them. That I should tarry at her side more? Hmph, there's no point.

char_4064_mlynar_epoque#28_CN_009.voiceText: The Grand Knight Territory's appearance is ever-fluid. Today, the city exhibits no trace of what it was twenty years ago, its sunset-lit silhouette sunken and gone... Yet its nightscapes still spring up to my mind at times wanted and at times not. Often, I find myself thinking that I should at least... try to seek out and reclaim that past.

char_4064_mlynar_epoque#28_CN_010.voiceText: The sound of a rainstorm in the wilderness...

char_4064_mlynar_epoque#28_CN_011.voiceText: 'Fear neither hardship nor darkness...' Hmph. A bygone time unworthy of remembering. A dream, far too lucid.

char_4064_mlynar_epoque#28_CN_012.voiceText: Nearly the same struggles and sacrifices...

char_4064_mlynar_epoque#28_CN_013.voiceText: Blank paperwork for promotion within the order, excerpts from the recon knights' reports on our movements... Schnitz often sent these things, as his way of saying hello.

char_4064_mlynar_epoque#28_CN_014.voiceText: How should I present myself...? As the one slandered by the papers and the groundless gossip in town? Or as the wanderer who once treated that vilification as a badge of honor?

char_4064_mlynar_epoque#28_CN_017.voiceText: To think they all still believe that blood is not spilled in vain…

char_4064_mlynar_epoque#28_CN_019.voiceText: The sound of the wind in the barrens... Far too familiar.

char_4064_mlynar_epoque#28_CN_020.voiceText: It would seem they have yet to remember what to fear.

char_4064_mlynar_epoque#28_CN_022.voiceText: Blade whetted again… for but another battle…

char_4064_mlynar_epoque#28_CN_023.voiceText: Do I need to repeat myself on the battle plan?

char_4064_mlynar_epoque#28_CN_024.voiceText: All those... I have yet to abandon.

char_4064_mlynar_epoque#28_CN_025.voiceText: It will be over before you feel the pain.

char_4064_mlynar_epoque#28_CN_027.voiceText: The sunlight will have to wait.

char_4064_mlynar_epoque#28_CN_028.voiceText: Even if there is but a sigh at the very end.

char_4064_mlynar_epoque#28_CN_029.voiceText: There is no one man who loftily sneers at the pointlessness of it all... Time speeds past us equally.

char_4064_mlynar_epoque#28_CN_031.voiceText: From the windows of Kawalerielki's towers, my eyes have grown tired of those men and their unpunished misdeeds.

char_4064_mlynar_epoque#28_CN_032.voiceText: 'Failure can be endured.' ... But the price is always dear.

char_4064_mlynar_epoque#28_CN_033.voiceText: I have no promises to make.

char_4064_mlynar_epoque#28_CN_034.voiceText: I can tell who you are. Speak freely.

char_4064_mlynar_epoque#28_CN_036.voiceText: Do not add any frivolous decorations to my sword, Toland... In the Grand Knight Territory, there are merchants eying the Nearl name. They will do as you do, and ridicule me in your place.

char_4064_mlynar_epoque#28_CN_042.voiceText: Do I long for the old days? No. I simply cannot forget. That which I saw in the places untouched by light... and could do nothing about.

char_511_asnipe_CN_018.voiceText: Alright, squad, keep your status updated.

char_511_asnipe_CN_020.voiceText: The enemy's moving as expected. Brace yourselves.

char_511_asnipe_CN_022.voiceText: I know the difference between sparring and a real fight.

char_511_asnipe_CN_025.voiceText: Don't worry, you won't escape the storm.

char_511_asnipe_CN_026.voiceText: This surge of energy has only one place to go.

char_511_asnipe_CN_027.voiceText: I've got a clear shot on target.

char_511_asnipe_CN_030.voiceText: Aggression is all part of the plan. Returning to base.

char_510_amedic_CN_026.voiceText: War is a plague, and I'm the cure.

char_510_amedic_CN_028.voiceText: No more suffering, no more pain.

char_510_amedic_CN_030.voiceText: Your commands were my thoughts as well, Doctor.

char_508_aguard_CN_018.voiceText: Read the briefing? Good, now here's your assignments.

char_508_aguard_CN_019.voiceText: Know your jobs? Then let's do this.

char_508_aguard_CN_020.voiceText: I prefer to keep my fight quiet.

char_508_aguard_CN_024.voiceText: I can handle this on my own.

char_508_aguard_CN_030.voiceText: It's always reassuring to carry out your orders, Doctor.

char_509_acast_CN_018.voiceText: Attention casters: set comms to operation channel.

char_509_acast_CN_020.voiceText: Opertaion is a go. Keep your support countersign in mind.

char_513_apionr_CN_017.voiceText: Give your orders. I will work with them the best I can.

char_513_apionr_CN_018.voiceText: I have nothing to say. But remember this one word: survive.

char_513_apionr_CN_019.voiceText: Watch your surroundings. Do not get ambushed.

char_513_apionr_CN_024.voiceText: This will be a disappointing day for our foes.

char_513_apionr_CN_027.voiceText: Pay for your sins with your life.

char_513_apionr_CN_030.voiceText: Finally, I can leave the commanding to others...

char_2014_nian_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_001.voiceText: Man, I'm so bored... Might just go shopping... You know what, yeah, we're doing it! Come on, put your shoes on. Yeah, we're both going out, that's why I said 'we'!

char_2014_nian_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_002.voiceText: That lame look of yours is grinding my gears... Here, have a toy to lighten up. You're busy with work? Who cares about some boring-ass work? Just one thing: don't lose sight of this little doll, or it'll vanish in the blink of an eye.

char_2014_nian_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_003.voiceText: Maaan, I'm so hungry... But as they say, gourmet food takes a gourmet cook. My brother's a great chef, you get hungry at one of our family reunions, just call him up and he'll take care of you. Now that's what I call service! Rhodes Island's food tastes like crap compared to his.

char_2014_nian_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_004.voiceText: Lungmen's a pretty chill place, but their cuisine? It's got no kick to it! How can they eat that flavorless baby food? Listen up: spice is a way of life. Once you taste a little pleasant pain and feel that explosion of heat on your tongue, you'll realize what you've been missing all this time.

char_2014_nian_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_005.voiceText: I used to just focus myself on what I needed for daily life, but I'm the type to really absorb my surroundings. And somehow or other I keep getting into fights. So I guess I could say it feels weird to NOT carry a weapon around. So it goes, I guess.

char_2014_nian_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_006.voiceText: Rituals get passed down from generation to generation not 'cause they have any inherent meaning, but because people find their own meaning in them. A performance has its rewards, and a wish has its fulfillment. And when one of my favorite stories is involved, you bet your ass I'm gonna participate.

char_2014_nian_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_007.voiceText: If you're out of touch with reality, you'll end up crushed beneath its boot, sooner or later. You'd think that's common freakin' sense, but some of my siblings ignore reality for what it is. Their dull lives are only gonna get harder for 'em as time goes on.

char_2014_nian_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_008.voiceText: Your dreams turn to haze when you've lived as long as I have. But I've got better stuff to do than dream all day, and that's why l feel so alive. Sure, life is suffering, but seeing people carve something out for themselves is incredible. And as for you: think you got what it takes to be the anvil to my hammer?

char_2014_nian_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_009.voiceText: Blacksmithing may just be a regular old occupation, but it was also a part of early civilization. I'll keep metallurgy well and alive, even if everything else dies out. That's the future I chose for myself long ago. And you, you've made important choices before, haven'tcha? Don't ever go back on them. Stay true to the end and see it through. That's what it means to complete something.

char_2014_nian_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_010.voiceText: You're sleeping AGAIN? Wake up, sunshine! We're going shopping! C'mon, hurry!

char_2014_nian_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_011.voiceText: Anybody home? Heard from one of your guys that I can make a comfy living here! Something about free lodging and food, with plenty of free time left over... Hm? This area is for staff only? Don't be like that! You make it sound like I don't belong here!

char_2014_nian_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_012.voiceText: Huh? What good do you think this stuff's gonna do me? Skills like these are only useful to people who value them.

char_2014_nian_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_013.voiceText: A promotion? That takes me back... I got something like this once before. Anyway, that's cool, I guess. You have my thanks!

char_2014_nian_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_014.voiceText: People are like tools; you can classify 'em. And you, you're an interesting one... Or should I say 'unusual'? I could forge you a good sword, but since you ain't gonna swing it, let alone fight in the first place, it'd just be a waste of metal.

char_2014_nian_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_017.voiceText: Guess one thing's never gonna change with time: swords will inevitably clash.

char_2014_nian_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_018.voiceText: Say what? Lead the team? Never led anyone before, but I guess I'll try.

char_2014_nian_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_019.voiceText: A smith's gotta be ready to pay the debts accrued by the weapons she forges.

char_2014_nian_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_020.voiceText: My sword's gonna cleave your bodies and values alike.

char_2014_nian_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_021.voiceText: Oh? You want me to handle this, personally?

char_2014_nian_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_022.voiceText: A knife, a life; weapons are the basis for society.

char_2014_nian_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_023.voiceText: 'When 'tis a choice of life and death, why shouldst thou lay down thy arms?'

char_2014_nian_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_024.voiceText: Let's just get this done with.

char_2014_nian_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_025.voiceText: You dare strike my shield with your spear? That's gonna end with you in pieces!

char_2014_nian_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_026.voiceText: My body burns at over 1,400 degrees!

char_2014_nian_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_027.voiceText: Even a virtuous king must, from time to time, look to the sword.

char_2014_nian_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_028.voiceText: Why do I gotta waste my precious time on the likes of you third-rate amateurs?

char_2014_nian_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_029.voiceText: Not bad! I see some faint promise in you!

char_2014_nian_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_030.voiceText: These small fry ain't even close to quelling my hunger.

char_2014_nian_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_031.voiceText: Man, you sure messed up. What'd I tell you about air bubbles weakening the iron?

char_2014_nian_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_032.voiceText: Terrible... If I really let myself loose, things would get a whole lot nastier... for everyone involved.

char_2014_nian_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_033.voiceText: Mind if I do some redecorating in here?

char_2014_nian_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_036.voiceText: Hold still! I'm making you a little something for your ear. It'll look great, just don't move!

char_2014_nian_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_042.voiceText: Yo, Doctor, you had lunch yet?

char_2015_dusk_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_001.voiceText: Hm? Did I not explain that you were forbidden to enter without my express permission, after knocking? Oh? This is your office? You're working? Then have I not come out of my room to work as well? What is the meaning of 'your office'? Get out! I'm still sketching it out.

char_2015_dusk_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_002.voiceText: You want to see my painting? You may. For you, I could even give you the painting. But if you like it, I won't give it to you. You don't like it? Huh, then you wouldn't want it anyway. This is who I am. Deal with it.

char_2015_dusk_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_003.voiceText: Haa… I'm trapped on this ship. If anyone asks, you tell them so, and you do not let them into my room. I'm taking up space? I'm refusing to perform my operator duties? Hello, I am Dusk, the great painter trapped in this room.

char_2015_dusk_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_004.voiceText: I'm not going out. Don't try to make me go out, I don't want to go out. I no longer care for the world outside. Do I dislike it? I like it fine. The mountains and rivers, the flowers and feathers, the pools and forests, the common folk, young and old, I could paint forever, I could watch forever, and yet, I will not go. It does not hold my interest forever.

char_2015_dusk_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_005.voiceText: I loathe the word 'taste.' What gives these people the confidence to demand something good just as they open their mouths to lock the gates to others? It is unbecoming. If you are satisfied, you are satisfied. Should you enter, you must not bar the gate. Do you see the twin moons thinking only of themselves?

char_2015_dusk_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_006.voiceText: An opportunity to watch me paint in earnest comes but once in a lifetime to one in ten thousand individuals. 'When the time comes, the strength of heaven and earth are one.' Ch'i, bone, shape, color, method, pouring out as a vast river, fine like the shadow of mountain bamboo, such is my brush, and it will not stop.

char_2015_dusk_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_007.voiceText: I took the time to partake of some contemporary works. Films are not bad, they are like paintings. The good ones all have a unique strength of character, with form, and with decent meaning. Right, poetry and painting have a legacy. Do you have time to help me burn Nian's mountain of garbage? She is denigrating the very concept of cinema. Please.

char_2015_dusk_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_008.voiceText: Food? Oh, thank you. Hm, where does this drink come from? It's good. Quite good. But I feel like it's missing something. You want to know what I usually eat? Then close your eyes. Ah~ You feel nothing, yes? That's because if you don't look, the food in my paintings does not exist.

char_2015_dusk_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_009.voiceText: Take a look at Nian's carefree expression. You know the truth, don't you? She cares quite a bit about our lives, and our deaths. As for me? I may not get along with the wretched scribbler, but neither of us care much. When people die, the paintings remain. When I die, my work remains.

char_2015_dusk_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_010.voiceText: Dreams are like unto life, like unto the scroll. One sleeps this sleep, will one sleep for millennia?

char_2015_dusk_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_011.voiceText: Oh? {@nickname}? Another contract? Very well, please don't bother me again after I sign this one. Here... I should tell you here and now: I, Dusk, do not give out my paintings. Not to anyone. And I don't take commissions!

char_2015_dusk_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_012.voiceText: Hm? A swing of an axe becomes rivers of blood. Do you mean... you want me to paint this?

char_2015_dusk_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_013.voiceText: Why use a sword? There is a reason. 'With an inkstone sheath, one may learn the annals. With a brush sword, one may paint the celestial.' Is it true? Naturally, I speak off the cuff.

char_2015_dusk_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_014.voiceText: Ahh, to make it this far with me... I should paint you a scroll. But be careful! Do not get caught up within it. The world I paint is much more fascinating than this one. How many have been lost, since ancient times? How many have escaped?

char_2015_dusk_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_018.voiceText: Captain? What does a captain do?

char_2015_dusk_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_020.voiceText: I'm in a good mood today. I'll give you this one I've titled 'Bones on the Sand'.

char_2015_dusk_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_022.voiceText: Better leave the fine brush at home.

char_2015_dusk_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_023.voiceText: Would any of you like to be my paint?

char_2015_dusk_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_024.voiceText: This battlefield would do well with a splash of ink.

char_2015_dusk_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_025.voiceText: Too difficult to explain, let me paint it for you.

char_2015_dusk_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_026.voiceText: With the setting of the sun, the brush draws up the peaks!

char_2015_dusk_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_027.voiceText: Copy the infinite with the tangible, bring the intangible to life!

char_2015_dusk_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_028.voiceText: I am rather attached to you. Most of the time.

char_2015_dusk_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_029.voiceText: Once, painting and war were quite different. But with this power, battle is art.

char_2015_dusk_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_031.voiceText: Hm... a failed painting must be destroyed. It will bring shame.

char_2015_dusk_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_032.voiceText: Slipped on a stroke? Start over.

char_2015_dusk_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_033.voiceText: Do not bother preparing the room for me. I will handle it myself.

char_2015_dusk_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_042.voiceText: What was your name again? Oh, {@nickname}?

char_2023_ling_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_001.voiceText: Evocative so. Years and an age ago, the very palace rained and drizzled in the whisperers of consultants.

char_2023_ling_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_002.voiceText: Yea, when Yan scholars speak of Sui, that is us, and It too. Facts hardly worth covering up; Nian's worries are not mine. After all, I am only me, and my death, no more than death is. The only shames would be this wine and world, for at day's end I love them long.

char_2023_ling_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_003.voiceText: I was of the mind I would finally meet someone past, an old friend. Never did I think this is how you now present yourself. From knowing not one is one, isn't this like a dream? However, {@nickname}. It is fine to be as yourself. Long have I contended with myself; myself I shall prefer to act.

char_2023_ling_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_004.voiceText: Where the heart is as will, and its utterance is as verse. If wells your chest with depths manifold, wouldn't failing their writing be shame to meet yourself? Hm? My tail? Ah, so too do I make use of a common brush, naturally. But it is at times inconvenient, as an extremity would be. My body is an unfettered one; who says I can't use my tail?

char_2023_ling_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_005.voiceText: Poetry, speech, lyric, essay. Though they all differ as their own, they are common in places. A pity the people of now are, by and large unable to exercise patience. To listen to a song, to read a poem. I take no objection to it, but how must our present scholars suffer.

char_2023_ling_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_006.voiceText: Nian is too impetuous, Dusk timid, yet to see the two as they are now, it seems they already know what they like, and want to do. So why probe at veracity or falsity or object or subject? To bicker and squabble every day, knowing emotion's gamut, is that not what a person is?

char_2023_ling_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_007.voiceText: {@nickname}, would you want for me to compose you a verse? Hm? Nay, I'm simply in the mood. I need not write it, nor record it. Ah, wait, if it were a song... that would be quite good too! But to dance a song, I fear I would need some preparation. Good! You sit there, and await me a short while.

char_2023_ling_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_008.voiceText: I am drunk? Hah... I have not yet seen the sky throw wide, moon rise, seas race, ice break, to wait true for all the world's sobriety would be but the withering of a bud, to want true for deep intoxication would be far too early still... {@nickname}, now, why do you say I am drunk?

char_2023_ling_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_009.voiceText: Last night I dreamt of you. Nay! Perhaps it's you who dreamt of me. Oh, can you not recall? A shame; it delighted me so, yet I cannot share this revelry. Delighted how? Hmm. That eight thousand years of springs, eight thousand of winters, all dreamt, were no more than a brief handful of autumns. That is all.

char_2023_ling_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_010.voiceText: Clouds ranged as billows, distant-run roads withered. I, departed of the vistas, sailed a ferry in late autumn.

char_2023_ling_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_011.voiceText: Ling, you can call me. Have my two troublemaking sisters vexed you any? Hm? You've seen me before? Ah... perhaps so, in a dream.

char_2023_ling_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_012.voiceText: Though antithetical at a glance, your nature is quite similar.

char_2023_ling_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_013.voiceText: Hm... 'General, I heed thy order,' should I say? Ha, do not take it seriously. I only suppose that if you were truly a field marshal, then I may not mind once again serving as a strategist.

char_2023_ling_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_014.voiceText: Nian was not wrong. This farcical dream of a thousand autumns is only right to wake from.

char_2023_ling_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_017.voiceText: The river bends a thousand times, a city lone in desolation, vivid in the mind's eye.

char_2023_ling_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_018.voiceText: To scatter the fill of a brimming cup, to share the sip for a soothed sorrow.

char_2023_ling_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_019.voiceText: Plotted schemes, waged wars, crossed arms, shed blood. An eternity, unaltered and unfailing in its challenge.

char_2023_ling_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_020.voiceText: To gaze the fire from afar, knowing not its heat.

char_2023_ling_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_021.voiceText: Has it come to my turn?

char_2023_ling_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_023.voiceText: And thus has autumn made reckoned her arrival.

char_2023_ling_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_024.voiceText: For the marching, a warsong. For the fallen, a lament.

char_2023_ling_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_025.voiceText: The split halberd sinks in the sand, great aspirations unrecompensed.

char_2023_ling_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_026.voiceText: One word to address all beneath the heaven, one scope to spare none upon the earth.

char_2023_ling_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_027.voiceText: When will the hate sunk beneath the battlefield disperse?

char_2023_ling_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_028.voiceText: Speak as your heart wills, and be as your intoxication wishes.

char_2023_ling_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_029.voiceText: Another song, sublime and majestic. {@nickname}, perhaps you and I truly are as two entwined friends.

char_2023_ling_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_030.voiceText: Duly satisfying, as a cup filled to the brim. We should remain level and humble, yet... we ought to sing your praises, yes. You did well.

char_2023_ling_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_031.voiceText: Mm... things disappoint on occasion; there's no need to blame yourself too hard. Leave the rest to me.

char_2023_ling_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_032.voiceText: Victory and defeat are commonplace in war. As we have freedom to maneuver, this is not a complete loss.

char_2023_ling_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_033.voiceText: Rhodes Island's interior... I'm lost as to whether I should say it's reminiscent or curious.

char_2023_ling_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_036.voiceText: What is it? Would you like a cup? You wouldn't? What a shame.

char_010_chen_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_001.voiceText: I will be your bodyguard, Doctor.

char_010_chen_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_002.voiceText: I've always had my suspicions about Rhodes Island. Still do.

char_010_chen_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_003.voiceText: Why are you staring at me? Nothing better to do?

char_010_chen_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_005.voiceText: I know every nook and cranny in Lungmen. The docks, the neon signs, the winding paths, I can see them all in my mind, clear as day. I'll never forget them.

char_010_chen_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_006.voiceText: Things around here have deteriorated lately. I'll be on guard, but I'll still need you to be careful.

char_010_chen_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_007.voiceText: Maybe one day that man will take note of my efforts, but until then…

char_010_chen_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_008.voiceText: Amiya trusts you completely. When I see you two together, it makes me wonder... what if I had someone like that by my side?

char_010_chen_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_009.voiceText: I've... I've never been able to rely much on anyone, not even...

char_010_chen_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_010.voiceText: Doctor? You fell asleep? Hmph. No nerves to keep you awake, then.

char_010_chen_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_011.voiceText: Ch'en. Leader of the L.G.D.'s Special Inspection Unit. For my own reasons,I'll be joining you for a while. Seeing as we're already well acquainted from our prior work together, I'll ask you to take me to my workplace now.

char_010_chen_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_012.voiceText: It's all in the service of more efficient operations.

char_010_chen_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_013.voiceText: A promotion? I've been through these things before.

char_010_chen_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_014.voiceText: Roger. Just give me all the missions your usual Operators can't handle.

char_010_chen_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_018.voiceText: Listen up! We'll be much more efficient if we work together.

char_010_chen_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_029.voiceText: Your evil must be stopped. I will do so by any means necessary.

char_010_chen_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_030.voiceText: Where did you find the courage to challenge me?

char_010_chen_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_031.voiceText: The wounded wait here for a medivac. The rest of you, stay on guard.

char_010_chen_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_033.voiceText: So this is Rhodes Island's base? Bigger than I expected.

char_010_chen_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_036.voiceText: Doctor, you're in a good mood. Is it because that operation went well? Same here.

char_1013_chen2_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_001.voiceText: You're not the type to sit around the office. It's easier to guard you if I dress more casually.

char_1013_chen2_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_002.voiceText: I won't doubt Rhodes Island anymore. Your cause, Amiya and Dr. Kal'tsit, and all the other operators here are worthy of my respect.

char_1013_chen2_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_003.voiceText: The way operators are supposed to see things and deal with problems is nothing I've known before. It'll take some time to get used to this.

char_1013_chen2_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_004.voiceText: I heard from Amiya what you went through in Siesta. Sounds like you had a tough holiday. What about me? It was terrible. Maybe not terrible. That's all I can say.

char_1013_chen2_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_005.voiceText: My roots are in Lungmen. That will never change. The world I knew there will stay with me wheresoever I go.

char_1013_chen2_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_006.voiceText: When I left Lungmen, I thought there was an answer to find, but now I get it. There's no such thing as answers, only actions and results.

char_1013_chen2_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_007.voiceText: Doctor, it's been a while since I left Lungmen and came on board as a Rhodes Island operator. It's about time you treat me as an operator too. It's hard for me to do anything if you are always on your toes around me.

char_1013_chen2_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_008.voiceText: I've got a lot of people relying on me, and I used to take that trust for granted. It may be harder than ten sets of advanced training every day, but I'll be worthy of their trust.

char_1013_chen2_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_009.voiceText: The events in Chernobog and my experiences in Dossoles both proved one thing—Whether fighting or saving, I must first understand my target. I need to broaden my horizons and open my eyes, Doctor.

char_1013_chen2_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_010.voiceText: Asleep again... You've done a lot of work already, so I'll let you have ten minutes.

char_1013_chen2_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_011.voiceText: Ch'en, reporting back in from my holiday in Dossoles. I have a lot of reports to write about my trip, so I'm just passing by to say hello, Doctor. Let me know if you've got something. Now that the holiday's over, everything's back to normal.

char_1013_chen2_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_012.voiceText: There is always someone out there who's better than us.

char_1013_chen2_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_013.voiceText: You're giving me a promotion as a Sniper operator? No problem. I'm sure I can set a fine example.

char_1013_chen2_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_014.voiceText: To tell you the truth, I never thought my shooting would get to this level. I'm more used to fighting with a sword, but shooting is indeed more convenient in certain scenarios.

char_1013_chen2_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_018.voiceText: No need to fret. I'll take care of it all.

char_1013_chen2_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_019.voiceText: Buck up and get ready for battle!

char_1013_chen2_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_020.voiceText: Are you all ready? Let's go, then!

char_1013_chen2_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_022.voiceText: Ch'en here. Ready at a moment's notice.

char_1013_chen2_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_029.voiceText: Pure evil and a little torment is nothing to be afraid of. But there's never anything pure there, that's what's terrifying.

char_1013_chen2_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_030.voiceText: That was some beautiful teamwork. Great work, everyone.

char_1013_chen2_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_031.voiceText: Help the wounded, and if you got any strength left, I need a few of you to stand guard with me.

char_1013_chen2_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_032.voiceText: Stay calm and fall back! I'll bring up the rear!

char_1013_chen2_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_033.voiceText: Hm? Another new room? Engineering's at it for sure.

char_1013_chen2_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_034.voiceText: You never learn, do you, Doctor?

char_1013_chen2_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_036.voiceText: Doctor, do you have a field operation next? I'll come with you.

char_136_hsguma_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_001.voiceText: Relax, Doctor. I'll keep you safe.

char_136_hsguma_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_002.voiceText: Lots of new recruits lately, many new faces. Don't let your guard down.

char_136_hsguma_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_003.voiceText: If something happens, don't forget to use the emergency communication channel. Just call me and I'll come running.

char_136_hsguma_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_004.voiceText: I sound cold when I talk? I'm on the clock. I'm a lot less serious when I'm off.

char_136_hsguma_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_005.voiceText: Rhodes Island needs more than just combat Operators. You need experts in education, PR, and all kinds of stuff.

char_136_hsguma_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_006.voiceText: I used to only get called in for the nastiest fights, but now every fight is a nasty one.

char_136_hsguma_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_007.voiceText: This shield has a name: Hannya. I brought it from my hometown. Its 'father' and mine were old friends. Back in the L.G.D., my superiors would always tease me about it, but together we've proven that a shield makes a great weapon, and so do I.

char_136_hsguma_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_008.voiceText: Hannya's tasted plenty of Lungmen gangster blood. I never thought it'd win me many friends, but the ones who looked down on me started showing me some respect after all that had happened. Or maybe they're just scared of how big I am? What do you think?

char_136_hsguma_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_009.voiceText: How about another shot...? Oh, you've had enough? Don't sweat it... I can carry you back to your room if you pass out. What? That worries you even more? C'mon, don't be a buzzkill.

char_136_hsguma_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_010.voiceText: Hm? Heh. Nothing. Just guarding you, Doctor.

char_136_hsguma_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_011.voiceText: Hoshiguma, Defender Operator. I'll be your shield, your blade, your fortress. Very glad to meet you, Doctor.

char_136_hsguma_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_012.voiceText: It's all thanks to your teaching, Doctor.

char_136_hsguma_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_014.voiceText: No one tells me where I'm going, and no one can stop me once I make up my mind. And now—I've made up my mind to follow you, Doctor.

char_136_hsguma_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_018.voiceText: Protecting Rhodes Island is my responsibility too.

char_136_hsguma_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_019.voiceText: I want everyone to get home safe.

char_136_hsguma_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_020.voiceText: If you've got a reason to fight, you've got a reason to die!

char_136_hsguma_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_026.voiceText: If you want to hurt my friends, you have to go through my shield first.

char_136_hsguma_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_028.voiceText: Hannya, unleash the rage your father poured into you!

char_136_hsguma_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_029.voiceText: The harder the journey, the stronger you'll become.

char_136_hsguma_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_030.voiceText: Hurting my friends right in front of me? I'll make you pay!

char_136_hsguma_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_031.voiceText: Are you hurt? I'm sorry. I failed.

char_136_hsguma_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_032.voiceText: Fall back, now! I'll bring up the rear!

char_136_hsguma_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_033.voiceText: With my size... it's kind of hard to get through the door.

char_136_hsguma_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_036.voiceText: Doctor, you should take a load off now that we finally got a break.

char_455_nothin_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_001.voiceText: Hm. The office of the vaunted Doctor, then? Marvelous, truly. Allow me a brief moment to consult my feng shui crash-course guidebook...

char_455_nothin_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_002.voiceText: I'm no mere braggart! Beyond a little kickboxing in a scuffle, I can rustle up meals, practice acupuncture, divine with feng shui, work masonry, tend to rice and angle fish alike—I'm a maestro of all kinds! Doctor, you need only give the order, and I'll see everything through!

char_455_nothin_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_003.voiceText: D-Doctor, I was a little idle, see, and went to make myself useful at HR, and by carelessness glimpsed at a few operator files, and... er, well, could FEater be the very star of 'Fiends of the Gods Reincarnated Immortal' herself? Truly? Could I go get an autograph?

char_455_nothin_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_004.voiceText: Who was my master? Hmm, a question as complex as a showdown of Yan cuisines. Normally I'd refrain from answering that, as slipping up would get me beaten sideways. That said... you need only know, Doctor, I'm the last descendant of the Lien line. Ah, but my family name's not Lien. I'm a Ch'u.

char_455_nothin_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_005.voiceText: M-Miss Dusk really did... come to Rhodes Island with us, then? My, um... what was it now? My recollection's quite fuzzy now, yet I have the vague impression that within her painted dreams, I had a peek into my own miserable future. Ah, let's never mind. Dear, oh, dear. You be quite careful too, Doctor.

char_455_nothin_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_006.voiceText: Now, now, Doctor, don't worry about me. I and the Infected do get along well. Back at my old place, a Catastrophe once struck not too far away. It frightened all of us, seeing the world go pitch black. My master remarked then that Catastrophes were Heaven's false charge against the human realm. Ah, truly a bitter thing.

char_455_nothin_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_007.voiceText: Benefactor Lava? Yes, I call her my benefactor. She once saved me, and as time went on, it became second nature. Throughout my life I've been saved thrice, and every time, I engrave it upon my soul. The gloompincer incident, you mean? No, not that. She showed to me a path, and that was true grace beyond all.

char_455_nothin_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_008.voiceText: Say, Doctor, are people able to brush the past away as they live? Certainly not, hm? If the bonds you once left behind still hold fast, what ought you do? You've no idea either? Well, then. It seems we're companions in our misery. Here, what say we crack some sunflower seeds?

char_455_nothin_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_009.voiceText: Countless, they were, the ancient parasol trees about Kou-wu City. Oh, just reminiscing all of a sudden. I remember the leaves scattered across the ground come fall, when my parents would visit me from the country. Only then would my strict master speak nothing but good, and her other disciples, my brothers and sisters, wouldn't bully me. No, well, just reminiscing.

char_455_nothin_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_010.voiceText: Hmm. I've been pondering a fan for you too, but what ought we write on it?

char_455_nothin_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_011.voiceText: My codename? 'Mr. Nothing.' The latter man of Tzu-hsu and Wu-yu; Nonexistent and Nothing indeed. And you, fine soul, are the Doctor? That is to say, my new boss? Well, then, would you like me to massage your back? Loosen up your legs?

char_455_nothin_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_012.voiceText: Ho, what a hundredfold bouquet of martial prowess. You've got my eyes wide open now!

char_455_nothin_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_013.voiceText: A promotion and a raise?! Ohh, ohh, I thank you, Doctor, in all respects possible! Be it for you, I would brave the greatest fires and waters, I would not hesitate to... well, that said, how much might my wages be growing by?

char_455_nothin_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_014.voiceText: Sooner or later, I plan to return to Kou-wu City and set every debt in my books straight. My only worry is I may invite trouble and sweep others up in its path. You know this, dear Doctor, and yet you still wish to bestow such partiality on me...? Your kindness toward me is a grace, and I will never, in eternity, forget it.

char_455_nothin_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_017.voiceText: Very well! Doctor, I'll see to it that you have nothing at all to worry about.

char_455_nothin_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_018.voiceText: Me, the captain? Hold one moment, just let me find my secret tomes for the art of war, now...

char_455_nothin_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_019.voiceText: As they say, all have their own methods, whether arms against a force or earth to a waterspout. There'll be a way!

char_455_nothin_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_020.voiceText: I'm witnessing fiends, one and all! Quite frightening!

char_455_nothin_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_023.voiceText: Very well! Leave this to me.

char_455_nothin_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_024.voiceText: The Doctor, you are! What a sagacious decision!

char_455_nothin_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_026.voiceText: A perfect technique makes freedom to act!

char_455_nothin_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_027.voiceText: The moon waxes and wanes. The fan opens and shuts!

char_455_nothin_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_028.voiceText: Let's have you make a move first, now.

char_455_nothin_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_029.voiceText: More hands bring more fuel for the fire. When we concert our efforts together, yes, we truly can burn the sky a red to rival sunsets. Not bad, not bad.

char_455_nothin_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_030.voiceText: As they say, those of just ways have much support, and those of lost ways find little. Seen as such, our victory is assured.

char_455_nothin_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_031.voiceText: Pursue not the cornered. Suppose anything troublesome should happen, we'll just bear it together.

char_455_nothin_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_032.voiceText: Go on ahead, everyone. No worries. My runaway act is first in class. I'll be just fine.

char_455_nothin_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_033.voiceText: Oh-hoh, Rhodes Island truly is a wondrous land. I feel quite dizzy just looking.

char_455_nothin_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_034.voiceText: Hoh? What's this for exactly, Doctor?

char_455_nothin_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_036.voiceText: Doctor, what say I teach you a thing or two about some moves?

char_455_nothin_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_042.voiceText: Well, if it isn't the Doctor! What a happy coincidence!

char_241_panda_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_001.voiceText: So... I have to just stand here and not do anything? Laaaame.

char_241_panda_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_002.voiceText: These gauntlets aren't that heavy. See? Even a dainty little girl like me can carry 'em around real easy.

char_241_panda_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_003.voiceText: You remember fighting by my side before? Can't say I remember fighting by yours, sorry... I just fight for what's right, that's all.

char_241_panda_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_004.voiceText: Hah. That boxer, Beehunter? She's really something! I enjoyed sparring with her so much, I had to throw out some serious moves. And she's got an amazing honey collection too. Wanna visit her with me next time? You gotta learn some kung fu first, though.

char_241_panda_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_005.voiceText: Reading a movie magazine...? Well, guess what? The 'hot kung-fu actress' mentioned in this article is ME! What? You don't believe me? Come on, look! This is me, can't you tell? C'mon, that's definitely me!

char_241_panda_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_006.voiceText: Do I regret forgoing my previous life? Well, sometimes, of course. But the world ain't kind to us Infected. Lots of places I'm not allowed to go. It blows.

char_241_panda_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_007.voiceText: There's a street full of food stalls in the neighboring city. And... a candy shop over there? And a theme park? Aww, Doctor, can I get a day off? I wanna check out these places!

char_241_panda_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_008.voiceText: Am I satisfied with life at Rhodes Island, you ask? Hm, to be honest... It's even sweeter than what they show in the movies! I got cool opponents to practice with, top-notch food, and by working here, I'm doing something good for the world! What could be better!

char_241_panda_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_009.voiceText: Doctor, look! What do you think about this script? Oh, who's gonna act in it, you wonder? You and I are gonna be the main characters! There's this scene where we leap from the roof of a thirty-story building and slide all the way down. Isn't that cool? Hey! Come back! Wait!

char_241_panda_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_010.voiceText: You're catching some z's, eh? Guess I'll slack off for a bit too. Man, this couch is so fluffy!

char_241_panda_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_011.voiceText: You swear you've seen my face before? Probably saw it in a movie I was in! Call me FEater, and what I do from here is your call!

char_241_panda_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_012.voiceText: It's over? Come on, let's watch just a while longer. We're almost at the fun part!

char_241_panda_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_013.voiceText: Oooh! A promotion! Thanks so much, Doctor!

char_241_panda_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_014.voiceText: This here's the perfect opportunity to show you some REAL kung fu!

char_241_panda_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_018.voiceText: Huh? I'm the leader? Not sure how it'll go, but...

char_241_panda_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_020.voiceText: I'm FEater. Pleased to beat you!

char_241_panda_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_026.voiceText: This is straight out of one of my movies!

char_241_panda_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_028.voiceText: Who says a movie star couldn't be a real kung-fu master!

char_241_panda_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_030.voiceText: It's over already? I was just starting to get warmed up.

char_241_panda_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_031.voiceText: Hey, it's no biggie. Just a few scratches and bruises.

char_241_panda_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_032.voiceText: Aw... I just wanna go home and sleep...

char_241_panda_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_036.voiceText: Hey, Doctor, want my autograph? I'll take a pic with you if you want, too!

char_241_panda_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_042.voiceText: Did you have breakfast yet, Doctor?

char_308_swire_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_001.voiceText: Doctor, we can't waste even one single precious minute! One minute could mean a loss of millions on the account with extra casualties on the field! Huh? Coffee? I take it with a sachet of sugar and heavy on the milk foam, thanks!

char_308_swire_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_002.voiceText: They say Rhodes Island is a criminal organization, full of Infected people dirtying up the corridors. But that couldn't be further from the truth. Rhodes Island's Operators are giving their lives to make things better for everyone, just like the police force of Lungmen!

char_308_swire_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_003.voiceText: Hear me out, do you think we could redesign the instructors' office? At least add a bit of flavor to it, maybe a handmade rug or some atomistic art whatnot. It's just so bland now. Dobermann might say she doesn't care, but it really kills my enthusiasm...

char_308_swire_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_004.voiceText: Ahhh, that awful Ch'en isn't here, is she? Back when we were in the L.G.D. together, she shot me this dirty look every time we bumped into each other. It made me wonder if I've done anything bad! I just... kinda want to take over the L.G.D. myself. That couldn't be bad, right?

char_308_swire_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_005.voiceText: Exercise, study, training, researching my competitors and market shifts... Gotta keep them up!

char_308_swire_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_006.voiceText: I've been allowed to set aside the family business for a while. But it's clear to me that the future of Lungmen needs both a stable public sector and security apparatus, as well as a healthy business and financial system. In both respects, I'm ready to be of service to Lungmen!

char_308_swire_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_007.voiceText: Lungmen bureaucracy is complicated, even for us. Keeping the peace, protecting the people, directing traffic, negotiating trade... Agh, it's absolutely backbreaking. But as long as what we do is good for Lungmen, I'll be—hehe—very pleased.

char_308_swire_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_008.voiceText: Doctor, why is Rhodes Island's training course so short...? Insufficient capital? Unacceptable, I'm requesting an immediate transfer to the business division! It's-it's not as if I like business, but if you need me to do it, I'm... more than capable!

char_308_swire_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_009.voiceText: You know, Doctor, Lungmen could use someone as talented as you. So, well... If you're not enjoying this line of work, there's plenty of opportunities in the banking and management sectors! I-I can get you a job! Oh? You'd rather we work with Rhodes Island? ...Fine!

char_308_swire_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_010.voiceText: Uughh... I'm exhausted... Two shifts in a row really does... zzz... zzz...

char_308_swire_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_011.voiceText: Swire, Senior Superintendent of the L.G.D.. I'll be joining Rhodes Island as a training consultant. Dr. {@nickname}, I'm looking forward to working together with you for the future of Lungmen!

char_308_swire_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_012.voiceText: Hmm, as far as tactical theory goes, this is a decent application!

char_308_swire_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_013.voiceText: A promotion? Hmm? But it doesn't do anything for me back in Lungmen, does it? Well, if you insist, I suppose I will accept it!

char_308_swire_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_014.voiceText: Maybe it's that you want me to improve your relationship with Lungmen. Or, possibly, you truly need my talents. I suppose it could be something else you want, too... I'm not sure exactly what, and I can't promise it'll be on offer. But I'll be a stalwart with you to the end.

char_308_swire_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_017.voiceText: Aha~! You finally need my wisdom!

char_308_swire_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_018.voiceText: Everyone, follow my orders to the letter!

char_308_swire_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_019.voiceText: Wipe them out in one fell swoop! It's cheaper that way!

char_308_swire_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_020.voiceText: Let's finish this quickly. My time is far too precious!

char_308_swire_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_022.voiceText: I've seen through the enemy's strategies!

char_308_swire_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_023.voiceText: This is far from my only battlefield!

char_308_swire_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_024.voiceText: Business competitor or not, you will get a lesson from me!

char_308_swire_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_029.voiceText: Fantastic! In battle as in business: high risk, high return!

char_308_swire_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_030.voiceText: Capital is all mergers and acquisitions! Victory is like investigation and arrest!

char_308_swire_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_031.voiceText: ...Bad... just bad... You can do better, can't you? We'll work it out together. Don't give up!

char_308_swire_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_032.voiceText: How could this have happened? How could I... How could I have blundered so badly?!

char_308_swire_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_033.voiceText: Not bad... No, I think this room could use some more renovation!

char_308_swire_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_036.voiceText: How... How about we go for dinner together? M-my treat!

char_2024_chyue_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_001.voiceText: You would like to be my 'kung fu recorder?' The way Rhodes Island treats its guests truly moves me. It is no wonder my sisters love this place so much… I misunderstand? No problem, I have no qualms with being your subordinate either.

char_2024_chyue_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_002.voiceText: 'Doctor.' Your title reminds me of the Yanese scholars. Experienced and knowledgeable, they see the forest for the trees. You feel like we've met before? It's true that after awakening from my dream of chaos, I have traveled to many places... Sadly, the more friends I make, the lonelier I feel. Perhaps we are alike in that respect.

char_2024_chyue_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_003.voiceText: As you can see, I note down only my experiences and insights, rather than any specific kung fu moves. What really matters to the martial arts is 'Yi' — your intent. If you let yourself be constrained by those gaudy forms, you will find it hard to break out of them. Take Dusk's paintings, for example. If I couldn't grasp the intent behind them, and sought to discuss techniques and styles with her, she would only shut the door on my face.

char_2024_chyue_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_004.voiceText: I agreed to be a 'fight choreographer' for Nian's movie. It keeps her from making too much of a racket, or getting too lonely. Dusk is timid, and Ling is too fond of drink. I will look after them as well... We are far from a normal family. Nevertheless, we are siblings, and not the collective 'we' as we are often called.

char_2024_chyue_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_005.voiceText: Death is a daily occurrence to warriors on campaign. But the real challenge they face, is preserving their humanity and morality after facing such morbidity, rather growing jaded and desensitized. Indeed, conflicts and mortality have been the way of these lands for eons. But only those giant, terrible creatures are cold-hearted enough to think so.

char_2024_chyue_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_006.voiceText: The world is a vast place, and wonderful sceneries abound, yet man has limited strength and time. It is impossible to see all these sights, much less defend them. To those who practice the martial arts, all we can do is train day and night, from the depths of winter to the height of summer. It may sound like a clumsy and brutish method, but the result is giving every last drop you have, leaving no regrets.

char_2024_chyue_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_007.voiceText: That sword is an unwanted possession that must not be cast away. Huai Tianpei keeping it is an outcome that all concerned parties can accept. My duel with him, you ask? He trained for forty years, and landed a single heavy blow on me. But how many comings and goings of spring and autumn have I trained? All things considered, I was the one who lost.

char_2024_chyue_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_008.voiceText: 'Who am I'... For this question, you need only gaze upon the water. Be it human, beast, mountains, foggy woods, or the reflection of the twin moons on the night sky, whatever it is you see, that is your answer. As for the distant, radically different future, whether we siblings will return to chaos and seek new answers, is an entirely different question.

char_2024_chyue_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_009.voiceText: The scholars at court seek perfect answers in everything. The kung fu practitioners who wander in jianghu seek revenge, status, glory, or a simple resolution. Their obsessions run deep, yet their time runs short. Often, they spend their whole lifetimes chasing a single ideal or undertaking... All those people, how woeful and pitiful, how respectable and regrettable.

char_2024_chyue_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_010.voiceText: The spring comes and goes, leaving a lonely autumn.

char_2024_chyue_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_011.voiceText: Doctor, thank you kindly for taking care of my sisters. I hope you will excuse me for intruding upon Rhodes Island for a little while. Please call me 'Chongyue.' It's a name given to me by... an old friend of mine.

char_2024_chyue_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_012.voiceText: The colors that once embellished the autumn grass, hues long buried by war.

char_2024_chyue_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_013.voiceText: Often I think about those soldiers who traveled from all corners of Great Yan to Yumen. They risked their lives in battle until death took them, or their age crept upon themselves... yet never for their own ends.

char_2024_chyue_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_014.voiceText: Battles we have fought, death we have braved. Doctor, no need to say more.

char_2024_chyue_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_017.voiceText: Lit, quenched, then lit again… The signal fires never ever rest.

char_2024_chyue_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_018.voiceText: In that case, Doctor, will you beat the drums for me as we sortie?

char_2024_chyue_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_019.voiceText: The sunset weaves a silken river. Heaven and earth bolster me upon departure.

char_2024_chyue_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_020.voiceText: Warriors from afar rest scarce, the armor they wear spurs them to march.

char_2024_chyue_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_021.voiceText: One should spar from time to time.

char_2024_chyue_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_023.voiceText: Look at this spectacular sight. Alas, it is now a battlefield.

char_2024_chyue_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_024.voiceText: Many intellectuals must join a battle before penning a decent verse, including that sister of mine… This too is an opportunity.

char_2024_chyue_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_025.voiceText: Unsteady posture, wavering intent. Much to learn yet.

char_2024_chyue_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_026.voiceText: A thousand moves in one breath!

char_2024_chyue_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_027.voiceText: Strike, and sunder the tides cleft. Retract, and leave no peace bereft.

char_2024_chyue_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_028.voiceText: After all this time, you still turn to war for solutions!

char_2024_chyue_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_029.voiceText: You calmly place your pieces to plot your victory... Doctor, a weiqi player like you is a truly rare sight.

char_2024_chyue_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_030.voiceText: A thousand armies move at the beating of your war drums, with a handful of sand to clean the blood from one's armor... What a tremendous victory!

char_2024_chyue_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_031.voiceText: There is never a true victory in brandishing a sword and formulating a strategy, while looking for gains and losses is an even greater folly. So long as you leave no regrets, then all is well.

char_2024_chyue_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_032.voiceText: All warriors must face defeat. Don't lose heart.

char_2024_chyue_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_033.voiceText: This is much more comfortable than a military tent. Can I even manage a good night's sleep without the sound of drilling soldiers…?

char_2024_chyue_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_034.voiceText: Doctor, have you figured out how to counter that move from yesterday?

char_2024_chyue_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_036.voiceText: The times are changing, and man along with them. So too does the scenery change.

char_2024_chyue_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_042.voiceText: Doctor, I did not see you at this morning's training session.

char_4080_lin_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_001.voiceText: I can offer you protection, and even handle a little business for you. But you'd better prove it's worth my time.

char_4080_lin_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_002.voiceText: Rhodes Island's work in Lungmen will remain confidential, but I know that your actions saved lives. I've spent a long time trying to gauge just how trustworthy Rhodes Island really is. As for my conclusion, I trust you had no trouble setting up your office in Lungmen?

char_4080_lin_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_003.voiceText: I'm sure you've been working with Mr. Lee. You can trust the information you get from him, but there are limits to what a private investigator can do. If you need something outside his purview, you come to me. Don't worry, my methods won't send any trouble Rhodes Island's way.

char_4080_lin_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_004.voiceText: I just saw Swire here. It surprised me how she was working so hands-on. If we'd followed the dreams we had as kids, she would've become the head of Lungmen's Chamber of Commerce, and I might be a university lecturer right now. You never know... Hm? No, I don't need to say hello. Given her status, it would be inappropriate for us to be seen in public.

char_4080_lin_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_005.voiceText: The coat my father always wears is a birthday present I gave him. I'm so used to the dignified airs he puts on, sometimes I even forget that... underneath the coat is an old man growing frailer by the day. Sooner or later, someone will have to stand up and take the weight off his shoulders.

char_4080_lin_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_006.voiceText: To certain people, the slums are a problem that needs to be solved. To others, this is their home. The shift from 'Slums' to 'Downtown' could take generations to settle. I don't know how far I can carry it myself, but I'll do what I can.

char_4080_lin_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_007.voiceText: I've never seen Ch'en onboard Rhodes Island. She has things to do, doesn't she? Hmph, hardly see any merit in recruiting operators like her. It's true that we don't get along very well. But I must admit, she is the one who showed me a different path.

char_4080_lin_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_008.voiceText: I had nothing to do, so I trimmed the potted plant on your desk a little. No matter how busy life is, we can't forget our aesthetics. Why are you so surprised? The four arts, flower arrangement, tea ceremony... They were all part of my education. You would never have guessed? Whatever.

char_4080_lin_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_009.voiceText: The nightscape here is very different from my childhood memories. Lungmen may be advancing by the day, but it still has its unlit corners... How about we go for a drink together? You can't truly know a city until you've visited its streets during the wee hours.

char_4080_lin_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_010.voiceText: You can't let them see you exhausted, can you…?

char_4080_lin_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_011.voiceText: You and I have probably crossed paths before, Doctor, but we finally found time for a formal introduction. There'll be much more done on the problems the Infected face in the Lungmen slums, now that we're working in direct communication.

char_4080_lin_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_012.voiceText: There are many ways to deal with trouble, and direct confrontation is usually my last choice.

char_4080_lin_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_013.voiceText: I sometimes attend ceremonies like these just to make things go smoother. I don't remember how many titles I have. But in the end, I always have to return to the shadows.

char_4080_lin_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_014.voiceText: I know what I'm doing, and that's all that matters. At the end of the day, not all honors need to be made public, and not all roads need to be trod together.

char_4080_lin_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_017.voiceText: You tell me your ends, just don't ask me my means.

char_4080_lin_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_018.voiceText: If any of you have any doubts about the target, this is your last chance to pull out.

char_4080_lin_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_019.voiceText: I hope I won't have to explain to you what we mean by 'necessary methods.'

char_4080_lin_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_020.voiceText: It's time to make an example. They'll see what happens when they break the rules.

char_4080_lin_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_024.voiceText: Let's put them six feet under.

char_4080_lin_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_025.voiceText: You didn't think. So this is what happens when you cross the line.

char_4080_lin_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_026.voiceText: You want to talk? Too late for that.

char_4080_lin_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_027.voiceText: Give me a reason to let you go. Don't have one? What a pity.

char_4080_lin_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_029.voiceText: It better remain a secret forever.

char_4080_lin_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_030.voiceText: Clean, decent. No one will ever find their remains.

char_4080_lin_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_031.voiceText: The situation is still salvageable. Leave the rest to me.

char_4080_lin_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_032.voiceText: There is always a way to correct a mistake. Don't let anger get the best of you.

char_4080_lin_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_033.voiceText: I don't need too much room here, but this place could use some decoration.

char_4080_lin_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_034.voiceText: You'll need an explanation for what you just did.

char_4080_lin_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_036.voiceText: Boh loh yau, fresh out of the oven, want one?

char_4080_lin_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_042.voiceText: I hope you didn't run into any trouble, Doctor.

char_473_mberry_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_001.voiceText: Doctor, I'll leave the files I sorted here. Oh, you don't have to thank me. I am used to it, and it's nothing difficult... Um, are you thirsty perhaps? Should I make you some tea?

char_473_mberry_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_002.voiceText: I'm not very good at speaking any languages other than Yanese. That's why I was a little scared at first and didn't talk much. But everyone's very friendly, and there are a lot of people from Yan here. Phew... it really puts my mind at ease.

char_473_mberry_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_003.voiceText: Sorry to disturb you, Doctor, but would you happen to know where Provence and everyone else went? My family sent me some goodies from back home, and I thought I'd share some with them since they've been taking care of me... Oh, there are some for you too, Doctor. Please have a taste!

char_473_mberry_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_004.voiceText: Doctor, could you help me look for my little dumpling? It's the small black-and-white doll. I thought I'd left it here, but I can't find it... *Whimpers*, please, I can't sleep at night without it.

char_473_mberry_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_005.voiceText: The rescue team has to deal with the Catastrophes a lot, so it's only a matter of time for us before we become infected. None of us reject anyone because of that. The crystallization on my body isn't very conspicuous, and it doesn't hurt even if you press down on it... Sometimes, I even forget that I have this on my body.

char_473_mberry_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_006.voiceText: When I first joined the rescue team, I wasn't very used to the climate or the food there. I'd get too homesick to fall asleep at night, and I cried to myself many, many times, but whenever I see the people we rescued, I start to think that maybe I can keep at it...

char_473_mberry_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_007.voiceText: Doctor, sorry to bother you... I've been studying Oripathy prevention techniques during Catastrophe relief, and Tsukinogi suggested that I come ask for your advice... Um... Sorry, am I being a bother?

char_473_mberry_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_008.voiceText: Uhh! Doctor, why would you sneak up on me like that? Huh? What am I holding? Oh, this is a letter I got from home. When I made the decision to leave, my parents were so angry that they said they would disown me, but there's a saying where I come from: Blood is thicker than water...

char_473_mberry_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_009.voiceText: When I got infected with Oripathy, I knew I probably wouldn't be able to live the peaceful life my parents wanted for me. I don't regret it, though... Besides, if I hadn't made my decision, I would never have met you or anyone else from Rhodes Island here and now, hehe.

char_473_mberry_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_010.voiceText: Doctor? Doctor? Sorry to bother you. Please lift your head up a little and sleep with the cushion. If you fall asleep like this, the letters from the report will get all over your face...

char_473_mberry_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_011.voiceText: Hello, I'm a member of the Yan disaster relief organization 'Chun-qian,' dispatched here as an intern. My name is... Oh, I-I'm sorry. We need to use our codenames here, right? I'm terribly, terribly sorry. Please call me Mulberry.

char_473_mberry_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_012.voiceText: Uhh..The mountain collapsed, and the ground crumbled...! They're not special effects from an action movie, are they?

char_473_mberry_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_013.voiceText: Huh? A promotion? Really? I get a salary from Rhodes Island as well as Chun-qian?! I... I'm so happy...!

char_473_mberry_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_014.voiceText: This time, I'm not doing this to help someone else, I'm doing it for myself... Doctor, thanks for always being there to cheer me on. Now, I'm sure that everything that I've done is truly meaningful.

char_473_mberry_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_017.voiceText: I'll do my best to support everyone!

char_473_mberry_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_018.voiceText: Huh? Me as team captain? Ah... Are you sure?

char_473_mberry_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_019.voiceText: Okay, we'll head out right away... Everyone, please stay safe. We'll meet again once this is over.

char_473_mberry_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_020.voiceText: Watch out, everyone! There's movement up ahead!

char_473_mberry_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_021.voiceText: Safety goggles... Okay, I have mine on. Let's go!

char_473_mberry_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_022.voiceText: Phew... Haah! Oh, I'm here! I-I'm not nervous!

char_473_mberry_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_026.voiceText: I... I can do it too!

char_473_mberry_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_027.voiceText: Where are you looking? It's dangerous to get distracted!

char_473_mberry_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_028.voiceText: It's my job to ensure everyone's safety!

char_473_mberry_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_029.voiceText: Report! All rescue operations in the area have been completed. Evacuation and escort proceeding without issue! Phew, thank goodness nobody's hurt...

char_473_mberry_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_030.voiceText: Phew, that wraps up the operation. Doctor, was I helpful?

char_473_mberry_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_031.voiceText: Wait! It's not safe that way... We have to do something. I'll go fetch them right away!

char_473_mberry_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_032.voiceText: It's not safe here! Everyone, please evacuate! Doctor, follow me!

char_473_mberry_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_033.voiceText: Whoa, this is the staff dormitory... Um, will I need to pay rent?

char_473_mberry_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_034.voiceText: Huh? Ah! I'm sorry! I'm sorry!

char_473_mberry_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_036.voiceText: Doctor! I really appreciate it, but please stop trying to sneak any more amulets onto me... I have way too many already!

char_473_mberry_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_042.voiceText: Hello, Doctor. Do you have work today too?

char_383_snsant_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_001.voiceText: D-Doctor! Excuse me, but could you please move a little? You're stepping on a coin...

char_383_snsant_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_002.voiceText: My dream is to be praised sincerely by the entire world... Ah, um, maybe just Lungmen... Well, maybe I should start with Rhodes Island, or, um, just you! Yes, that is my dream for the time being...

char_383_snsant_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_003.voiceText: Ugh, I forgot to turn off the light when I left the office yesterday... Hm? Rhodes Island has a power generation facility so there's no need to pay for electricity? Really? Does that I mean I get to eat dinner in the future?

char_383_snsant_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_004.voiceText: This is the Originium ammunition that Jessica ordered... Eh? D-Doctor! Isn't this dollar amount wrong? Or is this the currency of some small remote country? It's not? It's LMD? I, I, I, I, I see... Don't worry, I was just a l-l-l-little s-surprised.

char_383_snsant_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_005.voiceText: Oripathy... Hm, even though it's a bit beyond my field of study, it does seem to be worth looking into... But if I add another research project, I'll go from two meals a day to two days a meal... Ugh...

char_383_snsant_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_006.voiceText: Frugality is a type of virtue, but for me, it's closer to a habit... D-despite that, if you or my friends were in need, I'd gladly help out! I'm serious!

char_383_snsant_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_007.voiceText: You'd like to take a look at my clawhook? That's maybe fine... but whatever you do, don't push this button. And watch your thumb when you're holding the grip... W-wait, you're not winding the rope correctly, and... Ack! Sorry, don't mind me, you can keep looking at it...

char_383_snsant_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_008.voiceText: After I become a great, world-famous scientist with lots of money, I swear I'll have three meals a day and dessert too, just like Jessica... And then, with the money I'm not able to spend, I'd put it back into making Lungmen a better place. Um... if a day like that ever comes.

char_383_snsant_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_009.voiceText: Money is very important. Before I returned to Lungmen, I refused a large retention fee from the research institute, so my self-funded research project went under... But it's more important to be home. I can always save up more money, and now I won't go dizzy from looking at all those large numbers!

char_383_snsant_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_010.voiceText: ...Did you fall asleep? Just let me handle the rest, though I am a bit hungry.

char_383_snsant_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_011.voiceText: Oww... my head! Sorry... Oh, y-you're the Doctor? It's a pleasure to meet you. My name is Snowsant. Sorry, I shouldn't be walking with my head down...

char_383_snsant_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_012.voiceText: Woah... This isn't something you can learn with more effort...

char_383_snsant_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_013.voiceText: Ehh? A p-promotion? I feel a bit more pressure, but I'll be okay. This is the proof that I'm one step farther than when I first came.

char_383_snsant_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_014.voiceText: 'Heaven rewards the hard-working.' Wouldn't you agree, Doctor?

char_383_snsant_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_017.voiceText: It'll be all right, as long as I work just as hard as I did during training...

char_383_snsant_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_018.voiceText: You want m-me to be the squad leader? I really don't know anything about battle though...

char_383_snsant_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_019.voiceText: Clawhook inspection complete! Take a deep breath... I can do this!

char_383_snsant_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_024.voiceText: This is my first time being so close to a battlefield...

char_383_snsant_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_026.voiceText: Stop moving around, it'll be easier this way!

char_383_snsant_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_029.voiceText: As long as we work together, there's no obstacle we can't overcome!

char_383_snsant_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_030.voiceText: What a flawless victory - not a bit of waste!

char_383_snsant_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_031.voiceText: Some enemies got away, sh-should we chase after them?

char_383_snsant_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_032.voiceText: I, I'll go salvage some damage parts, to at least reduce our losses...

char_383_snsant_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_033.voiceText: Woah, so this is what it's like inside Rhodes Island... I'm so envious...

char_322_lmlee_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_001.voiceText: Sorting files? Whoa, I've suddenly gotten this headache. I can't take it, I need a break. Well, keep at it, Doctor. Such little paperwork should be a walk in the park for you, right?

char_322_lmlee_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_002.voiceText: A job? Of course, I'm all ears. Or maybe you'd like something a little spicier than detective work? Some wet work? Haha, just pulling your leg. We don't do that sort of thing. We're fine, upstanding citizens running a legitimate business.

char_322_lmlee_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_003.voiceText: Having Waai Fu and Hung around to keep an eye on that Aak boy really saves me a broken back. I'll admit, it's shameful, but I started out babysitting these kids, and now they're all taking care of me. Kids these days do more than we did when I was young, and that's great.

char_322_lmlee_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_004.voiceText: It's thanks to your patronage that the agency is still running smoothly, give or take. Lungmen's a place with the human touch—live there long enough, and sooner or later you'll know a crowd, find the right connections. We don't like spilling blood in our line of work—always best to solve things friendly.

char_322_lmlee_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_005.voiceText: How do you like it, Doctor? Jaye makes mean finballs, doesn't he? Old Tung taught that boy his trade and his way of treating people. It all combines for a flavor unique to Lungmen. Come on, have a try. It'll warm you up.

char_322_lmlee_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_006.voiceText: Under this heading, you had the third row on the left here wrong, so I patched that up, no need for thanks. Oh, do I come off very fluent? Not at all, this is still my first time accounting on a scale so small outside of the agency. Things used to be very—ah, I'm getting distracted, don't you mind.

char_322_lmlee_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_007.voiceText: Why are the lights all on at this hour... oh? Ah, Doctor. Are you still processing battle records? Well, I never thought you were such a workaholic. I'm impressed. But! You'd better turn in sooner. It's not worth it to break your body doing it.

char_322_lmlee_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_008.voiceText: Everyone's chasing fame and profit. But after so many winning and losing, how many people get to end up as what they like? Living a decent little life of your own is sometimes a lot to ask for. Ah, what are we all doom and gloom for? I'll go stir-fry something up, so you wait for me, Doctor. A drink together would be even better, don't you think?

char_322_lmlee_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_009.voiceText: My hexagram says to avoid going out, so I'll pass on this mission today... what, I can't? I have to go, no two ways about it? Hah, I see. Then this is a special exception, once only! I'm lending you a hand, so dinner's on you tonight! Look, I'm all decided! This is the joint!

char_322_lmlee_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_010.voiceText: Why a busy life when you can have a leisurely cup of tea. *gulp* Doctor, you do keep some good tea leaves here.

char_322_lmlee_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_011.voiceText: Hello, hello there, you must be the Doctor? You've been looking after my employees for me. They haven't made trouble for you, have they? Oh, that reminds me, here's a card for my agency. Take it, go ahead.

char_322_lmlee_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_012.voiceText: How about a quick scrap? No, no, I'm just joking. I'm no good in a fight.

char_322_lmlee_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_013.voiceText: A promotion...? There's a first for me. Feels quite fresh, too. I think times like these call for some magic words—thank you very much, boss?

char_322_lmlee_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_014.voiceText: Life goes by in a flash. If you're always jostling for the lead, when do you stop to smell the roses? Don't think too hard about things. Enjoy the moment. No matter how paranoid you are, it'll happen if it's going to happen. And you've dealt with it, all's right with the world.
