char_322_lmlee_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_017.voiceText: Do I have to come along too? *Sigh*... fine, fine. Let's get going.

char_322_lmlee_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_018.voiceText: Good. Follow my instructions closely, then. Alright, everyone, dismissed—wait, hold it, don't head off for real! I was joking! Joking!

char_322_lmlee_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_019.voiceText: It's like we're on a school trip here, eh?

char_322_lmlee_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_020.voiceText: Fortune favors the bold, but you still need a few tricks up your sleeves to win the battle.

char_322_lmlee_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_021.voiceText: I'm sure you can sort them... wait, hold it. Am I up now?

char_322_lmlee_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_022.voiceText: There, there. Put your worries to rest. I'm right here.

char_322_lmlee_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_023.voiceText: Hello, friends, what are we talking about?

char_322_lmlee_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_024.voiceText: Time for a little telling off. But not too harshly.

char_322_lmlee_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_025.voiceText: Come on, man. Friendliness is good for business.

char_322_lmlee_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_026.voiceText: Hey, buddy! Calm it down! You nearly spilled my tea!

char_322_lmlee_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_027.voiceText: My friends, I implore you to reconsider—Is there REALLY no room for negotiation here?

char_322_lmlee_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_028.voiceText: *Grumble* I told you. Don't get so worked up.

char_322_lmlee_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_029.voiceText: My thanks. It couldn't have happened without you, Doctor... I owe you for this one. I won't forget.

char_322_lmlee_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_030.voiceText: Well done, Doctor. What, where was I just now? Well, given your capability, it was better for me to be your moral support. Cheered the whole time, you see.

char_322_lmlee_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_031.voiceText: Now, now, hold it! Do not press an enemy at bay. Let them run free.

char_322_lmlee_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_032.voiceText: Risky, risky. There's a terrifying fortune to get. Thank goodness we run fast.

char_322_lmlee_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_033.voiceText: Doctor? Here, take this. Decorate your room with it. Ah, but not at the head of your bed. What does it do? Haha, now that would be telling.

char_322_lmlee_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_034.voiceText: I'm sure we can talk this out, nice and easy. No need for physical contact, right?

char_322_lmlee_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_036.voiceText: No smoking here? But this isn't a cigarette, it's white stick candy. You don't believe me? Go on, try some.

char_322_lmlee_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_042.voiceText: Welcome to Lee's Detective Agency, do you have any work... Well, if it isn't the Doctor!

char_226_hmau_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_001.voiceText: Hey, Doc. Have you eaten yet? You could have one of my cookies if you're hungry.

char_226_hmau_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_002.voiceText: Doc, if Aak ever steps out of line, could you be lenient with him? He teases people a lot, but he's not a bad person. Also, if he ever gets under your skin, just tell me and I'll get him to tone it down.

char_226_hmau_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_003.voiceText: Just call on me when you're hungry, Doc, and I'll make you a little something to eat. I may not be a chef, but Mr. Lee taught me how to cook a few recipes.

char_226_hmau_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_004.voiceText: Say, Doc, do you give any lectures on machines here at Rhodes Island? I've got an interest in that stuff and was hoping I could learn something new.

char_226_hmau_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_005.voiceText: Hahah, just between you and me, Doc, for the longest time I thought all detectives do the same stuff as Mr. Lee. You know, like investigating crime scenes, that sort of thing.

char_226_hmau_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_006.voiceText: I'm sure you already know, but with the intellect and talent that Aak's got, he's destined for great things one day. But personally, all that matters to me is that he doesn't ever go back to his old way of doing things.

char_226_hmau_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_007.voiceText: Me and Mr. Lee, well... How should I put it... I was a bit scared at first. He seemed like a guy who's got dark secrets, which had me on edge... But now after knowing him for so many years, I know that's definitely not the case.

char_226_hmau_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_008.voiceText: If you need info on something or someone, just tell me and I'll ask Mr. Lee for you. Nothing in Lungmen happens without him knowing about it.

char_226_hmau_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_009.voiceText: To be honest with you, I actually don't like getting into fights. I'd much rather we could all get along with each other. But I'm not a militant pacifist; there are things I'll fight to protect. Things like the agency, and now, Rhodes Island as well.

char_226_hmau_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_010.voiceText: Do— Phew, I just nearly woke the Doc up... Guess I'll take this opportunity to rest too.

char_226_hmau_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_011.voiceText: You must be the Doctor that Mr. Lee talked about. The name's Hung, it's a pleasure to meet you. My fields of expertise are security and repairing machinery. If you ever need a bodyguard for a public appearance, or if your TV or fridge break down, then be sure to give me a holler!

char_226_hmau_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_012.voiceText: So this is what the elite of the elite are like... I've got to work just as hard.

char_226_hmau_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_013.voiceText: Thanks, Doc! I'll be giving it 110% from here on out!

char_226_hmau_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_014.voiceText: Doc, don't hesitate to give me all the work you need done. I'll admit I'm not an expert at many things, but I've got the build for physically intense tasks!

char_226_hmau_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_019.voiceText: Stay close behind me so we don't get split up.

char_226_hmau_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_020.voiceText: You can all rest easy, knowing I'm here!

char_226_hmau_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_024.voiceText: I'm here to protect you all!

char_226_hmau_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_025.voiceText: Don't think you're getting past us!

char_226_hmau_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_026.voiceText: Is anyone in need of healing?

char_226_hmau_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_027.voiceText: You're not hurting anyone on my watch!

char_226_hmau_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_029.voiceText: *pant*... *pant*... Sorry, Doc, but could you give me a minute? My body's shaking.

char_226_hmau_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_030.voiceText: You just stay here and rest, Doc. I'll clean up the battlefield.

char_226_hmau_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_031.voiceText: Stay beside me, Doc. There are still enemies around.

char_226_hmau_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_032.voiceText: Hurry, Doc, climb onto my back! I'm getting you out of here!

char_226_hmau_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_034.voiceText: Are there any broken machines in here?

char_225_haak_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_001.voiceText: Oh yeah, my dude, when you're callin' my name to get my attention, don't forget to stress the K at the end. Or else I might assume you're stammering or somethin'.

char_225_haak_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_002.voiceText: Whoa, whoa, hold up! Is that vampire lady none other than 'Mr. Blood'?! Man, we've still not settled that medical score we had a while back, and this is the perfect opportunity! I'll have to set up my experiment equipment later... Heheheheh!

char_225_haak_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_003.voiceText: Lemme guess, Hung's still tellin' you to watch out around me, ain't he? Oh, just to 'look after me,' huh? Yeah, that sounds like him all right. But listen, my dude, I know your type. You're like me and just wanna do whatever you want, right? Then you can just ignore that guy and we can do whatever fun stuff we want instead.

char_225_haak_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_004.voiceText: Yeah, I develop new drugs, do surgery, and nurture bacteria cultures, but those are all just fun hobbies to me. And don't call me a doctor, you got no reason to. I don't go 'round saving people's lives, y'know, I just 'save' people by teaching them the value of their lives. All I can really do is prevent 'em from dying.

char_225_haak_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_005.voiceText: The medical department guys are askin' for me? Tell 'em to stop. I don't dig those oh-so-professional physicians. They firmly believe that being a doctor's this noble job and are content with just saving lives... And everything comes crashing down when that faith of theirs is shattered. I've seen that happen time and time again. Honestly, it's kinda sad.

char_225_haak_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_006.voiceText: Rhodes Island is pretty decent, or more accurately, it's just what I'd hoped. People are dyin' in the world right as we speak. There are doctors cooped up in labs, only workin' to cure diseases rather than prevent 'em. Hardly anyone gets it, but you people actually do. Keep up the good stuff!

char_225_haak_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_007.voiceText: Me, a sociopath? You got it all wrong, my dude. Everyone's got their own hardships to deal with, and I know that. Nobody wants to suffer, but what's the point of medicine if the bastards causing suffering are still around? Is medicine gonna save those people who're being murdered? Doctors in suits are not the saviors that Terra needs, my dude.

char_225_haak_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_008.voiceText: My pops was an amazing doctor, and he was all about saving people's lives. But his colleagues laughed at him, shunned him, and framed him for malpractice, and that's how he wound up racing down a nasty new path in life. But y'know, stuff like that ain't so unusual, really. I'll admit though, what happened to him really changed my own life.

char_225_haak_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_009.voiceText: Have Waai Fu and Hung left? Really? Aight, I'm gonna hang out in your office for a while then. Y'know, if anyone can make the world a better place, it's gotta be people like them. You, meanwhile... Well, who knows, maybe you can be my right hand?

char_225_haak_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_010.voiceText: What's up? Feelin' tired? Then how about testing this new compound I made? Free of charge, of course!

char_225_haak_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_011.voiceText: So you're the Doctor, eh? Nice to meet'cha. My name's Aak. That's right, two A's with a K. Anyway, I'm here 'cause someone at the agency said Rhodes Island needed me. I'm just askin' to make sure here, but does the phrase 'medical mishap' put you off?

char_225_haak_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_012.voiceText: Huh... Does this mean I might get involved in combat scenarios like this? Surely not, right?

char_225_haak_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_013.voiceText: A promotion? That's almost too good to be true, man. Those agency guys really HAVE been exploiting me all along!

char_225_haak_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_014.voiceText: Honestly, I dunno if I'm helpful or not. The way I see it, you've gotta be nice to be helpful, and I'm not blind to how people perceive me. But in any case, if you ever get sick, I've got you covered.

char_225_haak_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_017.voiceText: We goin' on a mission? Let's do it.

char_225_haak_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_018.voiceText: All right, team, gimme your thoughts on my new meds after this is done.

char_225_haak_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_019.voiceText: Once I start an operation, there's no stoppin' it.

char_225_haak_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_020.voiceText: Simmer down, guys. With me on your team, none of you's gonna die even if you want to.

char_225_haak_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_021.voiceText: My treatment is not for the squeamish!

char_225_haak_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_022.voiceText: The battlefield ain't for me, but I can't pass up on some fun treatment.

char_225_haak_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_023.voiceText: Time for a clinical test of my new meds.

char_225_haak_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_024.voiceText: You've gotta dose in moderation, 'else it's gonna hurt when you really need it.

char_225_haak_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_025.voiceText: All lives are equal... With the exception of yours!

char_225_haak_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_026.voiceText: Try my meds and you'll see how crazy they are.

char_225_haak_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_027.voiceText: Looks like my meds have the ability to reform bad guys!

char_225_haak_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_028.voiceText: Medicine is like Pandora's box: once you open it, there's no goin' back!

char_225_haak_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_029.voiceText: I doubt I can make the world a better place on my own. But with your talent, we can at least stop it from gettin' any worse.

char_225_haak_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_030.voiceText: Capturing our enemies and experimenting on 'em doesn't violate any ethics as long as nobody catches us doin' it. Relaaax.

char_225_haak_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_031.voiceText: Aren't you a real humanitarian, just letting 'em get away like that?

char_225_haak_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_032.voiceText: Don't worry, my dude. I can fix any injury as long as the patient's still breathing.

char_225_haak_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_033.voiceText: Let's see here, which of these rooms is my new lab?

char_225_haak_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_036.voiceText: Yo, my dude! Found any new experiment samples for me?

char_243_waaifu_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_001.voiceText: Doctor, where are you going? Shouldn't you be working? Lunch? Well then, I'm coming along. There's a few things I want to buy, and I can protect you too.

char_243_waaifu_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_002.voiceText: Sorry, Doctor, Rhodes Island is just a part-time job for me. I have to study hard to make sure I have a nice, normal future ahead of me. I am committed to keeping in touch with everyday society.

char_243_waaifu_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_003.voiceText: I color coded all the documents to be sent out, the backups have already been delivered, your schedule is right here. I bought your late night snack and put it in the refrigerator. Don't forget to heat it up. And last, oh, do you need me to change the light bulb in your office for you?

char_243_waaifu_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_004.voiceText: Did I ever tell you about my other job? No? Well, I won't. Don't look at me like that, Doctor. There's just not much to say. If my other office worked a tenth as hard as Rhodes Island does, they'd monopolize Lungmen's entire investigations industry.

char_243_waaifu_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_005.voiceText: You wonder where I learned martial arts? Well, I have my nasty old dad and his weird education to thank for that. Not that I resent kung fu. A hero must uphold justice. Martial arts are a part of me.

char_243_waaifu_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_006.voiceText: Just like the human heart, martial arts have yin and yang, right and wrong. To right those wrongs, to defeat evil, to counter bad kung fu, these are all second nature to me. The world is dark, and someone must stand for justice.

char_243_waaifu_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_007.voiceText: You think you just saw me? In downtown Lungmen? That may have been me. I just finished class. Hm? You saw me beat down some thugs who were harassing a passerby? And then slipped away before the police arrived? Must have been someone else. Heh heh. Definitely. That's enough about that.

char_243_waaifu_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_008.voiceText: My rotten dad said he had to go find the true meaning of kung fu. I still don't know where he is. Please! What year does he think it is? Find some common sense and learn some responsibility before you get yourself killed. But at least I haven't forgotten what he taught me: 'Martial arts have martial virtue, humans have human kindness.'

char_243_waaifu_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_009.voiceText: Doctor, did any mail come for me? It did? Great. These are my grades... my very important grades! It's been straight A's for me, so far. If I don't work hard enough, I'll end up regretting all the things I wasn't strong enough to do.

char_243_waaifu_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_010.voiceText: Falling asleep at a time like this... Oh well, I'll just finish your work for you.

char_243_waaifu_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_011.voiceText: Is this Rhodes Island? Nice to meet you. I'm Waai Fu, your new part-timer. Please don't go easy on me. I can handle anything you ask of me.

char_243_waaifu_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_012.voiceText: If I can fight like this here, I can definitely knock them out.

char_243_waaifu_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_013.voiceText: Thank you very much. I won't let you down, Doctor.

char_243_waaifu_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_014.voiceText: I often witness injustices in my life. If I ever find myself unable to stop them, I reflect on the moment, and force myself to get stronger. So, if ever you need me, don't hesitate to say so. I'll be there, with all my strength!

char_243_waaifu_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_018.voiceText: I don't have much experience, but I won't turn down the responsibility.

char_243_waaifu_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_019.voiceText: Fight evil with the fist of justice!

char_243_waaifu_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_020.voiceText: Like cutting weeds and pulling roots!

char_243_waaifu_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_025.voiceText: You have turned your backs on society!

char_243_waaifu_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_026.voiceText: Pick on someone your own size!

char_243_waaifu_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_027.voiceText: Behold, the power of the Song Do Bart Cham style!

char_243_waaifu_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_028.voiceText: The mind directs, the fist executes!

char_243_waaifu_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_029.voiceText: Foul intentions lead a foul life. Repent now. There is still time.

char_243_waaifu_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_031.voiceText: That was not enough. I need to train more.

char_243_waaifu_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_032.voiceText: Father... I'm still... not strong enough.

char_243_waaifu_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_033.voiceText: At least it's better than some old, messy detective agency.

char_243_waaifu_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_034.voiceText: An ambush...?! Doctor, don't sneak up on me like that. You'll end up in Medical.

char_243_waaifu_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_036.voiceText: You want to go for a walk? I'll go with you. You'll be safe with me.

char_1033_swire2_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_001.voiceText: Alright, chop chop. Take care of all your work during your coffee break, and you'll get to relax during the rest of your work hours.

char_1033_swire2_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_002.voiceText: It's a holiday, so of course I gotta dress a little more casual. It's true I haven't been on as many missions the last couple years, but I could earn passing marks on the L.G.D.'s physical exams wearing heels, I'll have you know.

char_1033_swire2_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_003.voiceText: If Rhodes Island's looking for business partners, you can definitely trust these companies—Why are you looking at me like that? I'm just listing off my recommendations. You're making it look like I'm plotting to take over Rhodes Island. If I were actually planning to do that... I just have to talk you over, right?

char_1033_swire2_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_004.voiceText: Ahem... I've taken a glance at our recent operational records. Looks like Rhodes Island's tactics have got more professional over the past few years. Not bad, not bad. Hah? As your former training consultant, what's wrong with me checking your records? I definitely have not been looking at Ch'en's files!

char_1033_swire2_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_005.voiceText: It's not really a big deal, being the L.G.D.'s chief. I've got a little more on my shoulders, a little more to worry about, and I can put myself in Ch'en's shoes a little more now... Oh, let me reiterate: I may have taken over the L.G.D., but I didn't take over for Ch'en! If that stupid dragon were to come back now, she'd have to call me 'Chief.'

char_1033_swire2_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_006.voiceText: I may have left my family's company, but I still deal in business every now and then. I can build Lungmen this way; there's no need to run away. And now that I've figured out what it is that I need to do, my grandfather doesn't seem nearly that scary anymore. It's only when you put your past fears to good use that you've truly triumphed over fear, right?

char_1033_swire2_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_007.voiceText: The new Siesta's an interesting place. Even without its beaches and volcano, it's still worth a visit for its sky pools and natural springs. My investment there has resulted in pretty decent returns too~ Doctor, whenever you have the time, we should go and have a look. When you visit a place you haven't been to for some time, it might just feel like meeting an old friend.

char_1033_swire2_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_008.voiceText: Things are looking up for the trading company I'm running with Bison. Transporting one country's goods to another and showing people the sights and cultures of places afar is one of the charms of business. Many are afraid of breaking barriers, but, Doctor, I'm sure we can find common ground.

char_1033_swire2_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_009.voiceText: Is this the last document you have? Alright! You really kept me waiting this time, but finally! Time for supper! I know this new place that's not so bad. It's on me toni—Hm? You don't want me spending money? Hm... Well, you can take me out, too. I know some other places.

char_1033_swire2_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_010.voiceText: Rawr... Ahem... Doctor, are you finished with work already?

char_1033_swire2_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_011.voiceText: Long time no see, Doctor. Ahem, let me introduce myself again. Beatrix Schwire, soon-to-be Chief Commissioner of the Lungmen Guard Department—I really am the chief! Whoever said the L.G.D. chief can't take holidays?!

char_1033_swire2_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_012.voiceText: It's been a while, but that's quite the improvement—Hey, why must you emphasize that happened while I wasn't working here as an instructor?

char_1033_swire2_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_013.voiceText: Exceptional talents earn exceptional rewards. That's how things should be.

char_1033_swire2_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_014.voiceText: Alright, alright. I get that you can't do without me anymore. No need to beat around the bush like that. If you need my help, just say the word. I'll always be here for you as your friend.

char_1033_swire2_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_017.voiceText: Hm? Not making me the captain?

char_1033_swire2_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_018.voiceText: Just follow my command and it'll all be fine.

char_1033_swire2_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_019.voiceText: Let's try to take up as little of our holiday time as possible.

char_1033_swire2_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_020.voiceText: I don't really want my holiday mood ruined, so hurry up and let yourselves get arrested.

char_1033_swire2_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_021.voiceText: It's been a while since I've taken orders from anyone... Feels kinda weird.

char_1033_swire2_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_025.voiceText: You've had nowhere to run since the moment you violated the law.

char_1033_swire2_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_026.voiceText: Where are you trying to run?

char_1033_swire2_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_027.voiceText: Be good and let yourself be cuffed. I'll hear all about your motive in the interrogation room.

char_1033_swire2_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_028.voiceText: Put your hands up and don't move!

char_1033_swire2_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_029.voiceText: That's all the men and wares accounted for. Let's call it a day here~

char_1033_swire2_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_030.voiceText: Don't get cocky. This is just barely a pass mark by L.G.D. standards, but if you manage to keep this up, I guess I could still commend you.

char_1033_swire2_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_031.voiceText: If you can take care of something in one go, it's best not to do it twice. Keep your costs under control.

char_1033_swire2_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_032.voiceText: Let's wrap it up here. I'll take care of the mission report.

char_1033_swire2_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_033.voiceText: This place hasn't been redecorated even once this whole time? You serious?

char_1033_swire2_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_034.voiceText: Doctor, do you know what are the consequences of attacking a cop in Lungmen? Don't worry. I'm just teaching you about the laws there.

char_1033_swire2_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_036.voiceText: Oh, you like this fashion brand? I can pick out an outfit for you.

char_1033_swire2_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_042.voiceText: Good morning... Hm? Just saying hello. What were you expecting? Rawr?

char_4121_zuole_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_001.voiceText: When I first became a Candleholder, it took me three whole months to finish reading all the literature in the Sui Regulator's library. The paperwork you have piled up here... is no less impressive in size. I will have time to familiarize myself with my duties, right?

char_4121_zuole_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_002.voiceText: Doctor? Let me join you... Oh, Kroos and Mr. Nothing said you'd take me around for a 'bai shan men' today to meet all the operators on the landship. They've been very warm, much more so than when we first met... Hold on, are you going to tour the entire ship?

char_4121_zuole_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_003.voiceText: My father forged these blades for me in Yumen himself. 'Exorcise the shadows of the Feranmuts, and ameliorate the plague on our land.' A Candleholder's work is not so simple that we can manage it with force alone... Um, of course, I've also been training as diligently as ever.

char_4121_zuole_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_004.voiceText: Yes, I do know Lin Qingyan. We held different titles, serving the Sui Regulator and the Central Judicial Office respectively. I've had some doubts about Rhodes Island both before and after I arrived here. That being said, I shan't pry into the matters that 'Operator Leizi' is investigating.

char_4121_zuole_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_005.voiceText: That woman just now... was that Lord Wei's niece? No, I don't know her, but when I was little, my father told me to learn from her example. We later discovered that Miss Ch'en resigned her position. Father did not say anything to me that day. Thinking back, I indeed find her admirable.

char_4121_zuole_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_006.voiceText: My father sent me to Dahuang in hopes that I would improve myself. But decades ago, he and the Grandmaster worked all night forging a blade at the Sword Forge, making them late for work the following morning. Of course, one should avoid deviating from the proper path, but I think my father wanted me to hold on to that spirit.

char_4121_zuole_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_007.voiceText: I'll keep an eye on the siblings, but I can't simply stand by and watch when Nian plays mahjong. You've seen those exaggerated casts that Nian conjures up, and you think she's... only a little obnoxious? You're not playing dumb. That's the trickiest part.

char_4121_zuole_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_008.voiceText: On-deck capture the flag is a challenge of mobility. Even though I was the first to climb onto the bridge, the Vulpo lady rode her staff and breezed past me to snatch the flag... Doctor, that is blatant cheating. How could you accuse me of being too competitive and unsportsmanlike?

char_4121_zuole_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_009.voiceText: This is a handbook that all Candleholders keep on their person. Yes, I recorded some observations about you... I'm very sorry, Doctor, but for what it's worth, I am now sure of one thing: You are the guiding post of this ship, and you are indeed ordinary. I will shred those pages, and I will ensure your safety.

char_4121_zuole_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_010.voiceText: The beast walks with the generous earth, as the Candleholder walks into the long night...

char_4121_zuole_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_011.voiceText: Doctor, I am Zuo Le. The number of proxies aboard Rhodes Island has almost exceeded that of those in Yan. The Sui Regulator should have sent someone here long ago. In fact, it has been some time since we sent you an official notice, but it would seem your company may have forgotten to reply?

char_4121_zuole_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_012.voiceText: To think that a pharmaceutical company has made such a competent analysis of battle records.

char_4121_zuole_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_013.voiceText: My sincerest apologies, in my capacity as the mandarin Zuo Le, I'm afraid I cannot accept any form of 'promotion...' Ahem, what I mean is... we will forgo the titles, but I can accept the other benefits.

char_4121_zuole_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_014.voiceText: Each megastructure coursing through Catastrophes has a meaning unique to itself. Shangshu transferred its mountains and waterscapes to its nomadic cities, while Yumen fends off sandstorms with its Wind Aegis. And so, what of Rhodes Island? On what convictions do you sail?

char_4121_zuole_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_017.voiceText: I hope my meager assistance will prove fruitful.

char_4121_zuole_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_018.voiceText: To choose the right man for the job is a virtue, to choose a talent is more virtuous still. I, Zuo Le, shall do my very best.

char_4121_zuole_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_019.voiceText: The arrow has been nocked, why hesitate?

char_4121_zuole_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_020.voiceText: The thrust of a blade takes no shape, take no comfort that it lies stowed.

char_4121_zuole_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_021.voiceText: From here on, your wish is my command.

char_4121_zuole_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_022.voiceText: The more complicated the situation, the simpler it is for me to act.

char_4121_zuole_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_023.voiceText: When chaos abounds, the most minute adjustment can change everything.

char_4121_zuole_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_024.voiceText: Not even the slightest stirring of grass will go overlooked.

char_4121_zuole_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_025.voiceText: Go no further, this road is closed.

char_4121_zuole_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_027.voiceText: Let there be order in Yan, and may Heaven safeguard our hunt.

char_4121_zuole_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_028.voiceText: Even the shortest candle may exorcise the longest dark of night!

char_4121_zuole_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_029.voiceText: Seeking total victory in peril. You are truly of extraordinary talent and courage.

char_4121_zuole_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_030.voiceText: A unit never takes the same formation, as water never takes the same shape. Such extraordinary planning and execution... Doctor, I cannot fathom your past.

char_4121_zuole_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_031.voiceText: Man strives for perfection, yet flaws remain in every plan. Doctor, the deed is done. Let's not dwell on it further.

char_4121_zuole_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_032.voiceText: The Sui Regulator has contingencies for all possible outcomes, of course. Leave the cleanup to me. I have good qinggong. I'll catch up.

char_4121_zuole_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_033.voiceText: I've lived in tents, and I've slept in fields. I'm not particularly demanding.

char_4121_zuole_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_034.voiceText: You must have urgent need of assistance?

char_4121_zuole_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_036.voiceText: Doctor, how about a game of weiqi? Or perhaps a capture-the-flag rematch?

char_4121_zuole_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_042.voiceText: Good timing. You must have something to discuss with me... Yes and no?

char_2025_shu_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_001.voiceText: Doctor, you need both sunlight and water to grow, and this potted plant seems to have gotten plenty. But I don't think you've had your ten cups of water yet today.

char_2025_shu_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_002.voiceText: Who am 'I'? The answer lies only in all that I've seen. The same way seeds are inanimate, and yet they germinate after you put them in the ground. I too lodged myself in a seed once, to feel the growth of life. You wonder what it's like? Take a deep breath and you've more or less felt it.

char_2025_shu_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_003.voiceText: I am no fin, and yet I can reason what one is thinking. You are not me, so how would you know for sure if I've spent the day idling here, not feeling the fins swimming freely in the ever-flowing streams? Even if you think this water jug is too small for fincatching, who's to say you can't drop a line in?

char_2025_shu_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_004.voiceText: Toahia guards the border all year round, while my eldest sister Ling sleeps her days away clutching a pot of wine. Without me worrying over the lot of them, we would've ceased to be 'siblings' long ago. Hmm? Of course I'm a big sister-type—I'm the sixth out of us twelve, making me a big sister to five.

char_2025_shu_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_005.voiceText: Doctor, give me your hand. I'll read your palm... Hmm? Your heaven, earth, and human lines are really something. A previous life unknown, your life line split into four, and conflict criss-crossing all along your path... I see, I get it now. An 'ordinary one' who 'stirs up a storm fighting for a good end.'

char_2025_shu_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_006.voiceText: A pity? How so? Petals fall to the ground to nourish the soil for new flowers to bloom the following year. Rivers flow endlessly into the sea, yet the water will condense into clouds and rain back onto the mounts and streams. Even if this great land is to meet a snow-white end, the cycle of cause and effect continues, and there will always be buds beneath the snow sprouting in spring anew.

char_2025_shu_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_007.voiceText: Grain Buds is teaching some children how to make string figures? Yes, it's a Yanese children's hobby. A millennium ago, my younger brother had just arrived in Dahuang, where he invented this pastime to entertain the lonely children. A string in his hands could turn into countless hours of fun... Yes, it's been a thousand years.

char_2025_shu_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_008.voiceText: Doctor, there's a pond up ahead—Nian! I see you adding chili oil to Dusk's cup. *ahem* The villagers tell of a huge fin—Dusk! Pouring ink into Nian's bowl is going too far. Doctor, would you like to go fincatch—Are you two still fighting?! ...Get over here, both of you.

char_2025_shu_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_009.voiceText: There is a limit to our lifespans, and that limit is the limit. Just as how this landship holds only so many people, the fallen leaves floating in that puddle are sufficient to sustain an insect for its entire life. The more we gather, the heavier the load we bear. You and I are naught but a single millet grain in our respective realms.

char_2025_shu_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_010.voiceText: In east sun lifts; in west moons fall. Spring cold foretells rain; summer chill, clear skies.

char_2025_shu_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_011.voiceText: Nian should have already told you my name—'Shu'. With my eldest brother, eldest sister, and my two younger sisters here, I feel as if I've returned home... Remarkable. Has that boy from the Sui Regulator not caused you any trouble yet?

char_2025_shu_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_012.voiceText: Sow no reason for retaliation—point your blades at one another, and strife will never end.

char_2025_shu_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_013.voiceText: I pray for a year of favorable weather with this jade cong from Dahuang. This ceremonial artifact also serves as the source of all that I hold in my hand. Summon wind and rain? Of course I can. Want me to demonstrate?

char_2025_shu_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_014.voiceText: The fragrance of rice sprouting over ten thousand mu of fertile fields... day after day, year after year, with constant work it will draw near.

char_2025_shu_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_017.voiceText: A fine day today. I hope everyone makes it home safe.

char_2025_shu_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_020.voiceText: When were the seeds of this tragedy planted?

char_2025_shu_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_021.voiceText: *sigh* I wasn't supposed to act, but...

char_2025_shu_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_022.voiceText: If there's no other way to settle this, then let me handle it.

char_2025_shu_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_023.voiceText: Spring breeze turns to rain; come ring the season in.

char_2025_shu_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_024.voiceText: 'War'... A word I've not heard in a long, long time.

char_2025_shu_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_025.voiceText: Clear skies for Qingming, rain clouds for Guyu.

char_2025_shu_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_026.voiceText: Sow the mounts for Bailu, and flatlands come Qiufen.

char_2025_shu_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_027.voiceText: Branch and bone bear weeds; mounds and ruins bloom fields.

char_2025_shu_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_028.voiceText: I'll plant you into the soil to grow anew.

char_2025_shu_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_029.voiceText: Sowing seeds into the soil—another fine day today.

char_2025_shu_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_030.voiceText: Not bad, not bad. I had no idea you were so clever and learned. I feel a little bad now, putting you to work pulling maiyatang with such a good head on your shoulders.

char_2025_shu_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_031.voiceText: Perfection is a tall order, just as the sustenance we sow is beset by the elements, Catastrophe, and pestilence. Ten thousand years will not change this, so just try your best.

char_2025_shu_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_032.voiceText: Fortune and misfortune are two sides of the same coin. What you have sown is not necessarily wicked, so why lose heart?

char_2025_shu_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_033.voiceText: Now let's see... where's a good spot for my fincatching tools?

char_2025_shu_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_034.voiceText: Doctor, want me to plant you in the soil too?

char_2025_shu_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_036.voiceText: Hm? Want to come fincatching with me?

char_2025_shu_CN_TOPOLECT_CN_042.voiceText: Doctor, come over here for a bit. Let's see... Hmm... the scallions from Jiangqi this year are indeed taller than man.

char_427_vigil_ITA_CN_001.voiceText: Organizing documents? Doctor, we have much more important things to do. Bene, I'll give you a hand, if you insist. But do remember, I expect you to come up with a plan that's worth my while. Do not disappoint me.

char_427_vigil_ITA_CN_002.voiceText: What do you want to know? Secrets of the Siracusan famiglie? There's hardly anything worth mentioning there. The things we do are no different from the wolves fighting in the wilderness thousands of years ago. Only, time has taught us some new tricks. Heh, you see 'order' could be the official name for 'tearing your prey to pieces.'

char_427_vigil_ITA_CN_003.voiceText: For many years, I couldn't really understand my father. He paid the ultimate price, only to betray almost everything in the end... But I still remember the question my father posed to me many years ago, when we were sitting together in a park: 'Siracusa, sara un posto migliore senza le famiglie?'

char_427_vigil_ITA_CN_004.voiceText: Judge Lavinia never realized what she was getting herself into. The game with Signora Sicilia won't be won through courage or resourcefulness alone... She's looking for me? To discuss my unbalanced diet…? Tell her I'm not here.

char_427_vigil_ITA_CN_005.voiceText: The old ways make it impossible to find a new path. If the new Siracusa is built on violence, it will fall back into the same well. The destruction of a few individual famiglie is far, far from enough. We must kick the entire 'habit.'

char_427_vigil_ITA_CN_006.voiceText: The disputes among the famiglie were petty and stupid. The dons clung on to whatever authority they had, thinking they were the masters of Siracusa. But I invite you, Doctor, to join me in shaping a new era.

char_427_vigil_ITA_CN_007.voiceText: If you want to show respect to the Siracusans, then hire a proper Siracusan chef. The next time I see any 'innovative Siracusan cuisine' out of your minions... Beh, let's just say somebody knows about your little office naps, and it'd be a shame if the beans got spilled on your beauty sleep.

char_427_vigil_ITA_CN_008.voiceText: Something on your mind? If it calls for blackmail, bribery, or something worse... none of that would be much trouble for me. Underhanded business is pretty much all I inherited from my famiglia. As for how to use my knowledge, that's your call.

char_427_vigil_ITA_CN_009.voiceText: Zaaro, il Signore dei Lupi... the shadow lurking behind me and my father. Don't be fooled by his pretentious words. A wild beast's hunt won't slow the progress of humanity. If he appears before you one day, I will drive him away.

char_427_vigil_ITA_CN_010.voiceText: Hey. Is our 'cooperation' just me watching you sleep?

char_427_vigil_ITA_CN_011.voiceText: Buongiorno, Doctor. I am Famiglia Bellone's... Lasci perdere. My famiglia doesn't exist anymore, but that was the price we paid to buy change in Siracusa. As for what comes next... Operator Vigil is at your service, Doctor. I hope our partnership will be productive.

char_427_vigil_ITA_CN_012.voiceText: I am no stranger to violence. As long as I'm on the scene, things should be a little more efficient.

char_427_vigil_ITA_CN_013.voiceText: A promotion? There's no need to test me like that, Doctor. I've played this game too... winning people over with small rewards. But if you're just trying to show your faith in me... Va bene, grazie.

char_427_vigil_ITA_CN_014.voiceText: Our partnership has been productive, Doctor. A made man would sell out anybody for his ambitions, but I can promise you one thing: you've bought my loyalty with yours.

char_427_vigil_ITA_CN_017.voiceText: Va bene. Let's see if your plan is worthy of my work.

char_427_vigil_ITA_CN_018.voiceText: The process is just as important as the end result. Don't go dying on me, ragazzi.

char_427_vigil_ITA_CN_019.voiceText: Remember, our purpose is not violence itself, but rather the victory it brings.

char_427_vigil_ITA_CN_022.voiceText: They'll be sleeping with the fins in no time.

char_427_vigil_ITA_CN_023.voiceText: Don't make this harder than it needs to be.

char_427_vigil_ITA_CN_024.voiceText: Anything outside the plan, I'll judge for myself.

char_427_vigil_ITA_CN_025.voiceText: Let's put an end to this show, pronto.

char_427_vigil_ITA_CN_026.voiceText: And what purpose do you think your sacrifice will serve?

char_427_vigil_ITA_CN_027.voiceText: This hunt has dragged on for too long.

char_427_vigil_ITA_CN_028.voiceText: A valiant struggle, but you won't get away.

char_427_vigil_ITA_CN_029.voiceText: They have no idea who they're messing with. Bravo, Doctor. I was right to partner with you. I hope you'll find even more challenges for me in the next battle.

char_427_vigil_ITA_CN_030.voiceText: Are we done yet? What are you looking all smug for? These stronzi have already wasted too much of our time.

char_427_vigil_ITA_CN_031.voiceText: They're getting away. Do you need me to walk you through this? Ma dai! Whack them already.

char_427_vigil_ITA_CN_032.voiceText: I'll take care of the evacuation. You get moving, fast. I hope this won't happen again, Doctor.

char_427_vigil_ITA_CN_033.voiceText: Careful with the moisture-proofing. I hate the smell of rotting wood.

char_427_vigil_ITA_CN_034.voiceText: Are you having fun? Because I'm not.

char_427_vigil_ITA_CN_036.voiceText: Ah... Mi mancano le osterie di Siracusa. Doctor, is the kitchen available right now? I can make something myself.

char_427_vigil_ITA_CN_042.voiceText: None of these documents matter at all, Doctor. The only thing that matters is how you act.

char_4065_judge_ITA_CN_001.voiceText: It's been a long time since I've felt like there was any conviction or meaning in my work. Rather than sit through show trial after show trial, I prefer to wade through these thorny, complicated files.

char_4065_judge_ITA_CN_002.voiceText: You don't have to tiptoe around me. I don't judge good or evil on any ironclad law. And with all the crimes staged in the name of order… Ah, pay no mind to this judge's grumble, a powerless judge waiting to be indicted for misconduct in office.

char_4065_judge_ITA_CN_003.voiceText: The thorns on this codex? Yes, of course the spikes hurt, but I wish for the pain to remind me: No matter how weak the statutes in Siracusa, no matter how highly I think of my calling, perversion of justice and blasphemy against the law are crimes.

char_4065_judge_ITA_CN_004.voiceText: They say 'the law is the basis of morality,' but that's not a natural truth. It emerges from a consensus of the people. When the people come to see violence as order, the law is nothing but a fantasy to dream of. And I, as the keeper of that fantasy, am the most ridiculous of all.

char_4065_judge_ITA_CN_005.voiceText: In Siracusa, being a city court judge is a dangerous job. Either you join 'them,' or... you disappear. I thought I could strike a balance between the two, but there's no way to stay clean when you're surrounded by mud. In the end, I was just another accomplice.

char_4065_judge_ITA_CN_006.voiceText: Maybe Siracusa really is that hard to change. The gangs, the famiglie... They shared a womb with Siracusa and shaped it into the country it is today. But we can't take them for granted. We must believe that a different path exists.

char_4065_judge_ITA_CN_007.voiceText: Oh, mi dispiace, I didn't see you there. If you're all done with work, how about joining me for a drink?… Why that look in your eyes? I'm not an alcoholic. But everyone needs some liquid assistance every now and then, whether for fatigue or for suffering. Ecco. It's on the strong side, so sip slowly.

char_4065_judge_ITA_CN_008.voiceText: If you ever get a chance to visit Siracusa, please avoid the rainy season. However, if you really are that unfortunate... best thing you can do is find a little shop on the street and sit for a while. Maybe only after the rain can one enjoy the momentary illusion that the city is clean.

char_4065_judge_ITA_CN_009.voiceText: In my many years as a judge, I've only handed down a few verdicts I could feel good about. I still remember the look on those two kids' faces when I broke up their little scuffle and told the aggressor to apologize. What, why are you laughing? Even the greatest justice must start from somewhere small.

char_4065_judge_ITA_CN_010.voiceText: You're sleeping? There's nothing more valuable than these rare moments of peace. Conserviamo questi momenti.

char_4065_judge_ITA_CN_011.voiceText: I am Lavinia Falcone, formerly a judge of Siracusa. Today, I report to you as Operator Penance. I hope that in working for Rhodes Island, I can absolve myself of my past mistakes.

char_4065_judge_ITA_CN_012.voiceText: So much violence in the name of order... Doctor, I can only pray that your efforts are more than futile.

char_4065_judge_ITA_CN_013.voiceText: I am honored to earn your support. We can certainly work together and offer mutual assistance, but let me be frank – that doesn't mean you can influence my decisions. Sorry, no offense intended, but that's a lesson I learned the hard way.

char_4065_judge_ITA_CN_014.voiceText: Be it a famiglia, a society, or a country, people are often bound by mutual interest... I used to assume this was the way of the world, but Doctor, you showed me a different path. I hope we can share this mutual trust long into the future.

char_4065_judge_ITA_CN_017.voiceText: Sitting around in an office won't bring about justice. That's one thing I know for a fact.

char_4065_judge_ITA_CN_018.voiceText: Whether or not you are burdened by a criminal record is unimportant to me. All I ask is that in this coming battle, our goals might be aligned.

char_4065_judge_ITA_CN_019.voiceText: Contempt for the law is a crime. The words of my codex will prove their own worth.

char_4065_judge_ITA_CN_020.voiceText: This time, I will hand down a fair verdict.

char_4065_judge_ITA_CN_021.voiceText: No matter what I might encounter, I will not back down.

char_4065_judge_ITA_CN_022.voiceText: What the law does not specify, I will reveal through practice.

char_4065_judge_ITA_CN_023.voiceText: This gavel of justice is weighty. Spero che siate pronti.

char_4065_judge_ITA_CN_024.voiceText: I am fighting for more than just the law. Also the justice and virtue that extend beyond it.

char_4065_judge_ITA_CN_025.voiceText: The law is a means, not an end.

char_4065_judge_ITA_CN_026.voiceText: There is no such thing as absolute justice, but I still invoke it!

char_4065_judge_ITA_CN_027.voiceText: Can crimes be punished through methods outside of the law?

char_4065_judge_ITA_CN_029.voiceText: Even a crime-ridden swamp is not beyond salvation. Doctor, thank you for once again reminding me of this fact.

char_4065_judge_ITA_CN_030.voiceText: A trial in all its vaunted glory will not bring about any substantive change. It matters more what we do after the trial. Doctor, I've seen what you've done, and find it praiseworthy.

char_4065_judge_ITA_CN_031.voiceText: Doctor, prepare a team to arrest the fugitives. There is no difference between a moment of mercy and a miscarriage of justice. They have not yet been read their verdict.

char_4065_judge_ITA_CN_032.voiceText: Naturally, they and the darkness behind them will occasionally prevail... But mark my words, even the most frustrating rainy season will pass in time. Until then, all we can do is persevere, and keep trying.

char_4065_judge_ITA_CN_033.voiceText: This place is nothing like stagnant, old Siracusa. The breath of hope flows here.

char_4065_judge_ITA_CN_036.voiceText: Are you here to discuss criminal procedure with me? No? Eccellente. I hope you never need my knowledge in that regard.

char_4065_judge_ITA_CN_042.voiceText: Doctor, I've categorized these documents according to their importance. Let me remind you that some of your operations land in a legal gray zone. I'm not opposed to them, but you need to think things through. I'll offer my advice as well.

char_1028_texas2_ITA_CN_001.voiceText: I'm your bodyguard again, just like old times, Doctor. And it's not just a job, it's a reunion. That's something worth cherishing.

char_1028_texas2_ITA_CN_002.voiceText: How does it feel to be back in Siracusa? Not great. It's for wise guys and famiglie, not me. I'm only staying long enough to cut ties with the past. After I'm done washing my hands of the whole business, I'm heading back to Lungmen to pick up the girls, and then going out for a nice drive.

char_1028_texas2_ITA_CN_003.voiceText: I didn't want to get Penguin Logistics involved, but it was a relief to see them in Siracusa. My noisy friends, that life of freedom... Looking back now, staying with them in Lungmen was the best decision I ever made. Just, don't tell them I said that.

char_1028_texas2_ITA_CN_004.voiceText: Sometimes I hear Siracusans talking about the downfall of Famiglia Texas. No two versions of the story are the same. Most are pretty dull, and some make for interesting fairytales, but in the end, they're all pretty embellished. The real story is... I just got exhausted, and decided to leave.

char_1028_texas2_ITA_CN_005.voiceText: Ever noticed how even the rain here stains the walls outside? Dirty rainwater can't wash anything clean. And that's Siracusa. Siracusans might be used to it, but I'm not.

char_1028_texas2_ITA_CN_006.voiceText: I've got no interest in joining Greyhall. The dons sit in their chairs, acting all high and mighty, hiding their plans. I decided to confront Signora Sicilia because she thinks she can tame everyone, and that's one thing I can't stand.

char_1028_texas2_ITA_CN_007.voiceText: I saw Lappland in Siracusa. Oh, you haven't seen her in a while? Not like she needs anyone worrying about her. If she's over me now, she'll find something else to cut. As for the score we haven't settled, I say it doesn't matter. We'll meet again soon enough.

char_1028_texas2_ITA_CN_008.voiceText: I was born in Columbia, but my grandfather wanted me to become a proper mafiosa and sent me to Siracusa to learn the trade. But to this day I don't understand why the people here like macaroni so much? I used to go to this little place for macaroni myself, but it closed down a long time ago. The owner died in a back alley.

char_1028_texas2_ITA_CN_009.voiceText: In Siracusa, there were a whole lot of people trying to guess what I'd do. It wasn't that complicated. I was there to do what I had to do, and help those who deserved help. Doctor, all I ask is that we continue to get along just like we used to. This relationship, built on real trust, is hard to find there.

char_1028_texas2_ITA_CN_010.voiceText: It's quiet here. No hitmen haunting the shadows, no wolves waiting in the alleys.

char_1028_texas2_ITA_CN_011.voiceText: We meet again, Doctor. The Siracusan rainy season always gets my tail wet, so I prefer the climate here. Don't worry, Exusiai and the girls will keep taking care of the deliveries, but I'll handle any jobs assigned to me personally.

char_1028_texas2_ITA_CN_012.voiceText: Thanks. Doesn't seem much different from your average delivery run in Lungmen.

char_1028_texas2_ITA_CN_013.voiceText: I'm not helping you for the money, Doctor. But still, go ahead and send my salary over to Penguin Logistics as usual. I'll pick it up from Emperor.

char_1028_texas2_ITA_CN_014.voiceText: I still have a lot to take care of before I can enjoy a peaceful life, and if the only way to shake the past is to smash it to pieces, then that's exactly what I'll do. Simple as that.

char_1028_texas2_ITA_CN_018.voiceText: Alright. Try to keep up. Let me know if you can't.

char_1028_texas2_ITA_CN_019.voiceText: No need to make a scene.

char_1028_texas2_ITA_CN_020.voiceText: Don't leave bloodstains. They're hard to clean.

char_1028_texas2_ITA_CN_023.voiceText: Got a problem that needs solving?

char_1028_texas2_ITA_CN_024.voiceText: I see them. I'll be right back.

char_1028_texas2_ITA_CN_025.voiceText: Bad luck, you ran into me.

char_1028_texas2_ITA_CN_027.voiceText: Pass on your last words? No.

char_1028_texas2_ITA_CN_029.voiceText: The only way to solve a problem is to clear all the obstacles in the way, no matter what they might be and keep moving.

char_1028_texas2_ITA_CN_030.voiceText: A battle without an explosion or cheering makes me feel a little uneasy. Let's head back. A drink? Maybe next time.

char_1028_texas2_ITA_CN_031.voiceText: There's still more to clean. When's our next sweep?

char_1028_texas2_ITA_CN_032.voiceText: I can take out a few more. You go ahead and retreat.

char_1028_texas2_ITA_CN_033.voiceText: This place reminds me of Lungmen. It's quiet. Doesn't have the constant pitter patter of the rain.

char_1028_texas2_ITA_CN_036.voiceText: Doctor, where's the hair dryer? I'd like to dry my tail.

char_1028_texas2_ITA_CN_042.voiceText: Great, this place is the same as it ever was. Morning. Got any new plans?

char_102_texas_ITA_CN_001.voiceText: My next mission is to protect you, Doctor.

char_102_texas_ITA_CN_002.voiceText: I don't say much? That's because I'd rather avoid thinking about most things.

char_102_texas_ITA_CN_003.voiceText: Our job is to handle life and death.

char_102_texas_ITA_CN_004.voiceText: I usually listen to Sora's songs when I'm driving.

char_102_texas_ITA_CN_005.voiceText: Cigarette? Oh, no, this is chocolate. You've gotta replenish your energy regularly. Which reminds me... do you want some coffee?

char_102_texas_ITA_CN_006.voiceText: How long have I worked for Penguin Logistics? When did I start...? I don't even know how long it's been.

char_102_texas_ITA_CN_007.voiceText: Watch out for the Red Wolf. She's not evil, but... she's not like us.

char_102_texas_ITA_CN_008.voiceText: No matter how hard I run, my past will catch up to me one day.

char_102_texas_ITA_CN_009.voiceText: My independent lifestyle and rowdy friends have brought me a lot of trouble... but I kind of like it this way.

char_102_texas_ITA_CN_010.voiceText: Is it time for a break?

char_102_texas_ITA_CN_011.voiceText: Code name Texas. I'm responsible for driving, moving cargo, and keeping our people safe. Try to get the mission briefings as concise as possible, please.

char_102_texas_ITA_CN_018.voiceText: I'm not good at barking orders.

char_102_texas_ITA_CN_031.voiceText: A few of them passed through.

char_102_texas_ITA_CN_032.voiceText: I may have underestimated this operation.

char_102_texas_ITA_CN_033.voiceText: Do you need any supplies? Just let me know.

char_140_whitew_ITA_CN_001.voiceText: Ehi, Doctor. Hope you don't mind if I bring my weapons inside. I'll plop myself right over here.

char_140_whitew_ITA_CN_002.voiceText: Somebody out to get you, huh? Then have a long, hard think about who you might've wronged in the past.

char_140_whitew_ITA_CN_003.voiceText: If someone's out for revenge on you, don't hesitate, just take them out. Once you decide to pick up a weapon, you don't need a reason to kill.

char_140_whitew_ITA_CN_004.voiceText: It's been a while... I see that Texas made some friends. Hehehe... Affascinante! Can't wait to get to know them!

char_140_whitew_ITA_CN_005.voiceText: You think I'm an assassin, huh? Yeah, alright. Call me whatever you want. I can be anyone, do anything, kill anyone anytime. Just so long as I want to!

char_140_whitew_ITA_CN_006.voiceText: I love power, Doctor. And you offered me a job where I can use my power to my heart's content... Love it. Honestly, the only joy I get out of this insane world is using my power to conquer it.

char_140_whitew_ITA_CN_007.voiceText: Texas? Ha, she's afraid of me, but I don't wanna do anything to her, except maybe try to bring back the old Texas. The one we got here's a cucciolo impaurito.

char_140_whitew_ITA_CN_008.voiceText: That red one... oh... Doctor, keep her away from me! She'd definitely kill me in a fight. But I have this feeling... this feeling... ugh, why do I want to fight her so badly?

char_140_whitew_ITA_CN_009.voiceText: You want to know what happened between me and Texas? Hehe, you don't have a single idea of what you are sticking your nose into. You'll find out the truth someday, but not from me.

char_140_whitew_ITA_CN_010.voiceText: Sleep tight... enjoy your sweet dreams while you still can.

char_140_whitew_ITA_CN_011.voiceText: A great evil stands in the way of justice. My master, in the name of hatred and revenge, lead the weak onward!

char_140_whitew_ITA_CN_012.voiceText: Don't you just love how I keep getting more and more powerful?

char_140_whitew_ITA_CN_013.voiceText: Hahaha! Bene! I love how much you trust me. You can't say the same for Texas, right?

char_140_whitew_ITA_CN_014.voiceText: Molto bene! That's more like it! Strength, unfettered and unchained! That's what I'm talking about!

char_140_whitew_ITA_CN_019.voiceText: Haha, you people... I don't think I'll even remember your faces after this one... Anyway, let's just get started.

char_140_whitew_ITA_CN_020.voiceText: We're fighting you guys? Then please do your bestest job, or I'll be really bored.

char_140_whitew_ITA_CN_028.voiceText: You'll have to try harder than that!

char_140_whitew_ITA_CN_030.voiceText: Hahaha, sliced 'em up like a millefoglie. How do you like it?

char_140_whitew_ITA_CN_031.voiceText: Not my best work. You can lay it on me for letting a few get away.

char_140_whitew_ITA_CN_032.voiceText: Bravo! Now I want to crush them that much harder! Hahaha!

char_140_whitew_ITA_CN_033.voiceText: Hm? Did I see a red shadow flash by?

char_140_whitew_ITA_CN_036.voiceText: The more I get to know you, the better I understand Texas. I Love it.

char_311_mudrok#1_CN_001.voiceText: Hm? Ah, this soil... it can murmur. It can dance. It is my friend.

char_311_mudrok#1_CN_002.voiceText: Miss Closure told me I shouldn't walk about Rhodes Island 'fully equipped'... but I'm not used to... revealing... myself. Sorry...

char_311_mudrok#1_CN_003.voiceText: Thank-you letters? Ah, from the Sarkaz workers yesterday? My equipment and type of Arts are a good match for physical work. Besides, their materials and fuel weren't featherweight. And they relied on the power of flesh and blood to ensure Rhodes Island sails smooth... it's incredible.

char_311_mudrok#1_CN_004.voiceText: That elite operator... I thought I'd seen enough bizarre Originium Arts in Leithanien to write any wild fantasy. But the moment he pushed apart the fog with a wave of his hand, I understood, as a Sarkaz, he was young yet incredibly ancient.

char_311_mudrok#1_CN_005.voiceText: I often think of the soldiers and companions that have left us. Sometimes, I have a sort of delusion that even now, I'm still fleeing... Doctor, have you been to Kazdel before? That was where my journey started, and once, where I'd thought it would end.

char_311_mudrok#1_CN_006.voiceText: Dr. Kal'tsit, huh... She startled me, but she's reassuring in spades... One thing, though. Rhodes Island seems to get along well with another mercenary group, too. Could you tell me about them, Doctor? It's best I don't know? I see... then I think I can more or less guess who.

char_311_mudrok#1_CN_007.voiceText: I became a Rhodes Island Operator so they could be treated properly, live on properly, and only then would those warriors... have died with meaning. But... since coming to Rhodes Island, I've seen clearly what I, myself, am truly fighting for. That was a first for me.

char_311_mudrok#1_CN_008.voiceText: Me, alone, talking to a clay doll...? You're... you're telling you saw me? That was just a kind of ceremony... huh? So everyone already knew? Really? Then I'll be more careful next time, do it late when nobody's up... um, I shouldn't?

char_311_mudrok#1_CN_009.voiceText: From Kazdel to Leithanien, so many marks have been carved onto the suffering. The moment they had no choice but to fight, I realized I had nothing at all. How do you see me, Doctor? You trust me? Will that trust... allow me to live on?

char_311_mudrok#1_CN_010.voiceText: ...The person napping there is the Doctor. Remember that well. Our road together is sure to be long and far.

char_311_mudrok#1_CN_011.voiceText: Sarkaz mercenary, Mudrock... You're the Doctor, then. Rhodes Island has saved me many times, and now, I'd like you to let me return the favor.

char_311_mudrok#1_CN_012.voiceText: I've had a taste of how Rhodes Island fights before, but, well, this still makes a great reference...

char_311_mudrok#1_CN_013.voiceText: I used to be known as Reunion, and then under the Mudrock Squad, and now... I've been promoted by my former enemy. Is this what they meant by 'life is a rollercoaster?'

char_311_mudrok#1_CN_014.voiceText: Hm? This seems fresh? I never take my helmet off in battle, after all... There's a lot of reasons why, but things have changed now. S... staying like this? If I have to...

char_311_mudrok#1_CN_017.voiceText: I'm simply a Rhodes Island Operator, now. I'll obey your command.

char_311_mudrok#1_CN_018.voiceText: The captain... I don't like leading, but... I'm used to it.

char_311_mudrok#1_CN_025.voiceText: The land is as my friend.

char_311_mudrok#1_CN_029.voiceText: Running is useless... resist it, even if you are not willing to resist. This is the only way I've come to know to face suffering.

char_311_mudrok#1_CN_030.voiceText: My friends are whispering their celebration. They cheer our victory, Doctor.

char_311_mudrok#1_CN_031.voiceText: Chase them... I'll watch over the battlefield with my friends' eyes.

char_311_mudrok#1_CN_032.voiceText: It's not the first I've fled with my back to the enemy. If even more can live on this way... I'll cover your backs.

char_311_mudrok#1_CN_033.voiceText: The ceiling's... a little lower than I imagined.

char_311_mudrok#1_CN_034.voiceText: ...Mm? Did you touch me just now?

char_311_mudrok#1_CN_036.voiceText: Doctor? Could you stay with me for a bit? I'd like... to ask you a little about Kazdel. Ah, and my friends have missed you, too.

char_4067_lolxh#1_CN_001.voiceText: This table's really high! I guess it's easier if I just use my old form to jump up.

char_4067_lolxh#1_CN_002.voiceText: What are you doing here? There's these Medic Operators who keep chasing my tail all the time saying they wanna study me! I need to lay low! Still, why are you hiding here too? You're not slacking off, right, Doctor?

char_4067_lolxh#1_CN_003.voiceText: My power is controlling metal, stuff like the thing on your table. I can make it turn pointy, round, or flat, and even more complicated shapes too.

char_4067_lolxh#1_CN_004.voiceText: The people here look a lot like the spirits in our world. So maybe, the spirits in this world look like you do, Doctor?

char_4067_lolxh#1_CN_005.voiceText: This place is a lot like the Hall for Spirits to me, with all the Infected staying here because they have nowhere to go. But... the Infected have it really different from spirits. They can't even escape just by staying far away from everyone.

char_4067_lolxh#1_CN_006.voiceText: There's so many Catastrophes here... Is this why your cities have to keep wandering everywhere all the time?

char_4067_lolxh#1_CN_007.voiceText: I get it! Operators are Executors, aren't they? Executors do errands for the Hall for Spirits, and Operators do errands for Rhodes Island! Huh? No?

char_4067_lolxh#1_CN_008.voiceText: I'll be an Executor someday, just like my master. My master's really mighty! Um... you too. Everyone on this battleship listens to you, so you've got to be somebody incredible.

char_4067_lolxh#1_CN_009.voiceText: Doctor, are we friends now? Then if you can, you should visit our side to play sometime!

char_4067_lolxh#1_CN_010.voiceText: Doctor, are you eating something secret there?

char_4067_lolxh#1_CN_011.voiceText: Hello, Doctor, my name's Xiaohei, and I'm a spirit.

char_4067_lolxh#1_CN_012.voiceText: Doctor... if I don't understand these tapes, can I ask you about them?

char_4067_lolxh#1_CN_014.voiceText: I still don't really get it, but thanks, Doctor.

char_4067_lolxh#1_CN_017.voiceText: Doctor, I'm here! Huh? Is there something on my face? Ah, I just finished eating, haha.

char_4067_lolxh#1_CN_018.voiceText: I'm gonna be the captain? Can I handle that...?

char_4067_lolxh#1_CN_019.voiceText: Doctor, grab onto me, I'll use my power to send us there. It's quicker that way.

char_4067_lolxh#1_CN_029.voiceText: Is everyone okay? I'm so, so glad!

char_4067_lolxh#1_CN_032.voiceText: It's all my fault for being so weak, Doctor...

char_4067_lolxh#1_CN_033.voiceText: I can't forget about the mission the Doctor gave me. But this mat's so comfortable, and the sun's so warm. I think I'm getting kinda sleepy...
